</style></head><body><div class="wrap">
<h1>🏚 수급 빈집 리포트 <span class="dt" id="hdt"></span></h1>
<div class="sub">태린이아빠식 <b>수급 오실레이터</b> — 수급이 비었다가(빈집) <b>다시 채워지기 시작</b>하는 종목을 매일 포착.<br>
오실레이터 최저값 나열이 아니라 <b>'빈집 → 유입 시작' 전환점</b>만 추립니다(떨어지는 칼 제외).</div>
<div class="meta" id="meta"></div>
<div class="summary" id="summary"></div>

<h2>🌡 시장 환경</h2>
<div class="h2sub" id="mctxsub"></div>
<div class="mgrid" id="market"></div>

<h2>🎯 오늘의 빈집 + 유입 시작</h2>
<div class="h2sub">게이트(빈집 확인·유입 시작·미과열·칼 아님·유동성) 통과 종목을 <b>빈집점수</b> 순으로. 점수↑ = 더 비었고·더 들어오고·신선한 전환.</div>
<div class="bar">
  <div class="tab on" data-mkt="ALL">전체</div>
  <div class="tab" data-mkt="KOSPI">코스피</div>
  <div class="tab" data-mkt="KOSDAQ">코스닥</div>
  <div class="tab" data-mkt="NH">신고가권만</div>
</div>
<div class="tblwrap"><div id="cand"></div></div>

<h2>🔭 깊은 빈집 관찰 <span class="h2sub" style="margin:0">(아직 유입 전 — 식으면 기다림)</span></h2>
<div class="h2sub">osc가 매우 낮지만(빈집) 아직 순매수 전환 안 됨. <b>유입이 시작되면</b> 위 후보로 올라옵니다. 관찰 리스트.</div>
<div class="tblwrap"><div id="watch"></div></div>

<h2>🔍 전 종목 검색</h2>
<input id="q" class="search" placeholder="종목명 또는 코드 검색  (예: 삼성전자, 005930, 에코프로)" autocomplete="off">
<div id="searchInfo" class="meta" style="margin:9px 0 4px"></div>
<div class="tblwrap" style="border:none"><div id="search"></div></div>

<details>
<summary>📐 방법론 — 빈집+유입시작은 어떻게 뽑나</summary>
<div class="doc">
<div class="quote">"수급 오실레이터는 기관과 외국인 수급을 합치고, 시가총액 비율로 만든 뒤 이동평균으로 가공,
다시 한번 오실레이터로 표현한 것입니다. 빈집(낮음)은 팔 자리가 아니라 살 자리입니다."
<cite>— 「태린이아빠 주식투자 생각의 공간」 채널 설명 재현</cite></div>
<p><b>오실레이터</b> = (기관 순매수 + 외국인 순매수) ÷ 시가총액(상장주식수×종가) → EMA 평활 → 룩백 백분위(0~100).
낮으면 <b style="color:var(--green)">빈집</b>(수급 비었음), 높으면 <b style="color:var(--red)">찬집</b>(과열).</p>
<p><b>핵심:</b> osc가 가장 낮은 종목을 그냥 나열하면 <b>계속 빠지는 종목(떨어지는 칼)</b>이 잔뜩 잡힙니다.
진짜 '빈집'은 <b>비었다가 다시 채워지기 시작하는 자리</b>예요. 그래서 아래 5개 게이트를 모두 통과한 종목만 후보로 올립니다.</p>
<ol class="gates">
  <li><b>빈집 확인</b> · 최근 <code id="g_win"></code>거래일 안에 osc가 <code id="g_empty"></code> 이하로 떨어진 적이 있음 (실제로 수급이 비었던 적).</li>
  <li><b>유입 시작</b> · osc가 5일 전보다 오르고 + 바닥대비 <code id="g_reb"></code> 이상 반등 + <b>최근 5일 기관+외국인 순매수 합 &gt; 0</b> (매수세가 실제로 들어오기 시작).</li>
  <li><b>아직 안 참</b> · osc ≤ <code id="g_notfull"></code> (이미 과열된 건 제외 — 들어갈 자리 남음).</li>
  <li><b>칼 아님</b> · 최근 5일 수익률 ≥ <code id="g_knife"></code> & 종가 ≥ 최근 5일 최저 (가격이 멈추거나 반등 — 자유낙하 제외).</li>
  <li><b>유동성</b> · 거래대금 20일평균 ≥ <code id="g_val"></code>억 & 시총 ≥ <code id="g_cap"></code>억.</li>
</ol>
<p><b>빈집점수</b> = 남은 방(55−osc) + 반등폭(osc−바닥) + 유입강도(5일순매수÷시총) + 가격버팀 + 신고가권(+6) + 매도→매수전환(+4).
높을수록 더 비어있고·더 들어오고·전환이 신선합니다.</p>
<p><b>깊은 빈집 관찰</b> = osc가 <code id="g_empty2"></code> 이하인데 아직 순매수 전환이 안 된 종목. 유입이 시작되면 후보로 승격됩니다.</p>
<div class="note"><b>한계</b> · ① 원공식 비공개 → 공개 설명 기반 <b>근사 재현</b>, 파라미터 보정 가능.
② 종목 데이터 100일 한계로 osc 변동성 존재. ③ <b>단독 매매신호 아님</b> — 주도섹터·거래대금·차트와 함께 보는 보조지표.
④ 금리 높은 국면(원작자: 4.5%↑)에선 수급 빈집 전략 유효성이 떨어진다고 봄.</div>
</div>
</details>

<div class="foot" id="foot"></div>
</div>
<script>
const D = /*DATA*/;
const EMPTY=D.empty_th, NOTFULL=D.notfull;
const fmtDt=d=>d?`${d.slice(0,4)}.${d.slice(4,6)}.${d.slice(6)}`:'-';
const fmtN=n=>Math.round(n).toLocaleString();
function oscColor(v){return v<=EMPTY?'#5cbf8a':v>=80?'#e0606a':v>=55?'#d4af37':'#5db4a4';}
function badgeCls(s){return s.includes('빈집')?'b-bin':s.includes('찬집')?'b-full':'b-mid';}

document.getElementById('hdt').textContent='— '+fmtDt(D.asof);
document.getElementById('meta').innerHTML=
  `기준일 <b>${fmtDt(D.asof)}</b> (KRX 장마감 정산) · 생성 ${D.generated_at} · 유니버스 <b>${D.counts.universe}</b>종목(ETF·ETN·스팩 제외 보통주)`;
document.getElementById('summary').innerHTML=
  `오늘 <span class="hl">빈집 + 유입 시작</span> 후보 <b class="hl">${D.counts.candidates}</b>종목 포착 · `+
  `깊은 빈집 관찰 <b>${D.counts.watch}</b>종목.<br>`+
  `빈집점수 상위 = 수급이 비어있던 자리에 기관·외국인이 <b>막 들어오기 시작</b>한 종목들입니다.`;

/* 시장 환경 */
function sparkLine(cv,ser,low,high,W,H){
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1; W=W||230;H=H||50;
  cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;cv.style.width=W+'px';cv.style.height=H+'px';
  const x=cv.getContext('2d');x.scale(dpr,dpr);const n=ser.length;
  const px=i=>3+(W-6)*i/(n-1), py=v=>3+(H-6)*(1-v/100);
  x.fillStyle='rgba(92,191,138,.06)';x.fillRect(3,py(low),W-6,py(0)-py(low));
  x.fillStyle='rgba(224,96,106,.06)';x.fillRect(3,py(100),W-6,py(high)-py(100));
  x.strokeStyle='#2a2f3a';x.lineWidth=1;[low,high].forEach(v=>{x.beginPath();x.moveTo(3,py(v));x.lineTo(W-3,py(v));x.stroke();});
  x.strokeStyle=oscColor(ser[n-1]);x.lineWidth=1.7;x.beginPath();
  ser.forEach((v,i)=>{i?x.lineTo(px(i),py(v)):x.moveTo(px(i),py(v));});x.stroke();
  x.fillStyle=oscColor(ser[n-1]);x.beginPath();x.arc(px(n-1),py(ser[n-1]),3,0,7);x.fill();
}
const mC=document.getElementById('market');
if(D.market){
  document.getElementById('mctxsub').innerHTML=
    `시장 오실레이터 기준 <b>${fmtDt(D.market.asof)}</b> · 빈집&lt;${D.market.low} 과열&gt;${D.market.high} `+
    (D.market.asof!==D.asof?`<span style="color:var(--gold)">(시장 데이터는 종목 기준일과 다를 수 있음 — 시장 캐시 갱신 주기 영향)</span>`:'');
  Object.entries(D.market.markets).forEach(([k,m])=>{
    const dir=m.prev5==null?'':(m.cur>m.prev5?'▲':m.cur<m.prev5?'▼':'–');
    const card=document.createElement('div');card.className='mcard';
    card.innerHTML=`<div class="mleft"><div class="mname">${k}</div>
      <div class="bigosc" style="color:${oscColor(m.cur)}">${m.cur}</div>
      <div class="badge ${badgeCls(m.status)}">${m.status}</div>
      <div class="mkt" style="margin-top:3px">5일전 ${m.prev5} ${dir}</div></div>
      <canvas></canvas>`;
    mC.appendChild(card);sparkLine(card.querySelector('canvas'),m.osc,D.market.low,D.market.high);
  });
}else{mC.innerHTML='<div class="nodata">시장 오실레이터 데이터 없음 (osc_market.json 미생성)</div>';}

/* 스파크(종목 osc 60일) */
function spark(cv,ser){
  const W=92,H=28,dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;cv.style.width=W+'px';cv.style.height=H+'px';
  const x=cv.getContext('2d');x.scale(dpr,dpr);const n=ser.length;
  const px=i=>2+(W-4)*i/(n-1), py=v=>2+(H-4)*(1-v/100);
  x.strokeStyle='#2a2f3a';[EMPTY,NOTFULL].forEach(v=>{x.beginPath();x.moveTo(0,py(v));x.lineTo(W,py(v));x.stroke();});
  x.strokeStyle=oscColor(ser[n-1]);x.lineWidth=1.4;x.beginPath();
  ser.forEach((v,i)=>{i?x.lineTo(px(i),py(v)):x.moveTo(px(i),py(v));});x.stroke();
  x.fillStyle=oscColor(ser[n-1]);x.beginPath();x.arc(px(n-1),py(ser[n-1]),2.1,0,7);x.fill();
}
function nameCell(r){return `<span class="nm">${r.name}</span><span class="cd">${r.code}</span>${r.newhigh?'<span class="tag-nh">신고가</span>':''}<div class="mkt">${r.market}</div>`;}
function retCell(v){return `<span class="${v<0?'neg':'pos'}">${v>0?'+':''}${v}%</span>`;}
function oscBar(v){return `<span class="oscv" style="color:${oscColor(v)}">${v}</span><span class="bar-osc"><i style="width:${Math.max(3,v)}%;background:${oscColor(v)}"></i></span>`;}

function candTable(list){
  if(!list.length) return '<div class="nodata">조건에 맞는 종목 없음</div>';
  let h=`<table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th class="l">종목</th><th>점수</th><th>현재 osc</th><th>바닥</th>
    <th>추이(60일)</th><th>5일순매수</th><th>20일순매수</th><th>5일%</th><th>거래대금</th><th>시총</th><th class="l">사유</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
  list.forEach((r,i)=>{
    h+=`<tr><td class="rk">${i+1}</td><td class="l">${nameCell(r)}</td>
      <td class="scorecell" style="color:${r.score>=62?'var(--green)':r.score>=52?'var(--gold)':'var(--sub)'}">${Math.round(r.score)}</td>
      <td>${oscBar(r.osc)}</td>
      <td style="color:var(--sub)">${r.osc_min}</td>
      <td><canvas data-spk="${i}"></canvas></td>
      <td class="${r.flow5<0?'neg':'pos'}">${r.flow5>0?'+':''}${fmtN(r.flow5)}억</td>
      <td class="${r.flow20<0?'neg':'pos'}">${r.flow20>0?'+':''}${fmtN(r.flow20)}억</td>
      <td style="color:var(--sub)">${r.inflow_pct5}%</td>
      <td style="color:var(--sub)">${fmtN(r.val_eok)}억</td>
      <td style="color:var(--sub)">${fmtN(r.cap_eok)}억</td>
      <td class="l reason">${r.reason}</td></tr>`;});
  return h+'</tbody></table>';
}
function watchTable(list){
  if(!list.length) return '<div class="nodata">관찰 종목 없음</div>';
  let h=`<table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th class="l">종목</th><th>현재 osc</th><th>바닥</th>
    <th>추이(60일)</th><th>5일순매수</th><th>20일순매수</th><th>거래대금</th><th>5일수익률</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
  list.forEach((r,i)=>{
    h+=`<tr><td class="rk">${i+1}</td><td class="l">${nameCell(r)}</td>
      <td>${oscBar(r.osc)}</td><td style="color:var(--sub)">${r.osc_min}</td>
      <td><canvas data-spk="${i}"></canvas></td>
      <td class="${r.flow5<0?'neg':'pos'}">${r.flow5>0?'+':''}${fmtN(r.flow5)}억</td>
      <td class="${r.flow20<0?'neg':'pos'}">${r.flow20>0?'+':''}${fmtN(r.flow20)}억</td>
      <td style="color:var(--sub)">${fmtN(r.val_eok)}억</td>
      <td>${retCell(r.ret5)}</td></tr>`;});
  return h+'</tbody></table>';
}
function fillSparks(box,list){box.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-spk]').forEach(cv=>{const r=list[+cv.dataset.spk];if(r&&r.osc_series)spark(cv,r.osc_series);});}

/* 후보 + 시장필터 */
let curMkt='ALL';
function renderCand(){
  let rows=D.candidates;
  if(curMkt==='NH') rows=rows.filter(r=>r.newhigh);
  else if(curMkt!=='ALL') rows=rows.filter(r=>r.market===curMkt);
  const box=document.getElementById('cand');box.innerHTML=candTable(rows);fillSparks(box,rows);
}
document.querySelectorAll('.tab[data-mkt]').forEach(t=>t.onclick=()=>{
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab[data-mkt]').forEach(z=>z.classList.remove('on'));
  t.classList.add('on');curMkt=t.dataset.mkt;renderCand();});
renderCand();

const wbox=document.getElementById('watch');wbox.innerHTML=watchTable(D.watch);fillSparks(wbox,D.watch);

/* 검색 (all 은 스파크 없음 — osc 바만) */
const qEl=document.getElementById('q'),sEl=document.getElementById('search'),siEl=document.getElementById('searchInfo');
function searchTable(list){
  if(!list.length) return '<div class="nodata">결과 없음</div>';
  let h=`<table><thead><tr><th class="l">종목</th><th>종가</th><th>현재 osc</th><th>바닥</th>
    <th>5일순매수</th><th>20일순매수</th><th>거래대금</th><th>5일</th><th>20일</th><th>상태</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
  list.forEach(r=>{
    const st=r.osc<=EMPTY?'빈집':r.osc>=80?'찬집':r.osc>=55?'중상':'중립';
    h+=`<tr><td class="l">${nameCell(r)}</td><td>${r.close.toLocaleString()}</td>
      <td>${oscBar(r.osc)}</td><td style="color:var(--sub)">${r.osc_min}</td>
      <td class="${r.flow5<0?'neg':'pos'}">${r.flow5>0?'+':''}${fmtN(r.flow5)}억</td>
      <td class="${r.flow20<0?'neg':'pos'}">${r.flow20>0?'+':''}${fmtN(r.flow20)}억</td>
      <td style="color:var(--sub)">${fmtN(r.val_eok)}억</td>
      <td>${retCell(r.ret5)}</td><td>${retCell(r.ret20)}</td>
      <td style="color:${oscColor(r.osc)};font-weight:700;font-size:12px">${st}</td></tr>`;});
  return h+'</tbody></table>';
}
function doSearch(){
  const q=qEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if(!q){sEl.innerHTML='';siEl.textContent=`전 종목 ${D.all.length}개 검색 가능 — 종목명 또는 코드를 입력하세요.`;return;}
  const res=D.all.filter(r=>r.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)||r.code.startsWith(q)).slice(0,40);
  siEl.textContent=`"${qEl.value.trim()}" 결과 ${res.length}건`+(res.length>=40?' (상위 40)':'');
  sEl.innerHTML=searchTable(res);
}
qEl.addEventListener('input',doSearch);doSearch();

/* 방법론 동적 값 */
const P=D.params;
const setT=(id,v)=>{const e=document.getElementById(id);if(e)e.textContent=v;};
setT('g_win',P.empty_win);setT('g_empty',P.empty_th);setT('g_empty2',P.empty_th);setT('g_reb','+'+P.rebound);
setT('g_notfull',P.notfull);setT('g_knife',(P.knife*100).toFixed(0)+'%');setT('g_val',P.min_val);setT('g_cap',fmtN(P.min_cap));
document.getElementById('foot').innerHTML=
  '⚠ 공개 채널 설명을 토대로 재현한 <b>근사 지표</b>입니다. 원공식 비공개·파라미터 보정 필요. '+
  '빈집+유입시작은 단독 매매신호가 아니라 주도섹터·거래대금·차트와 함께 보는 보조지표입니다. 투자판단의 책임은 본인에게 있습니다.';
</script></body></html>"""


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
바이오텍 딜 모멘텀 대시보드 — 이사님 픽 9종.
소스 4종 병합: 키움(bio_cache) + 미래에셋·삼성 리포트(bio_reports_digest) + 19에이전트 웹리서치(bio_research)
산출: 바이오_딜모멘텀_MMDD.html
"""
import sys, io, os, json, time, html as H
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
def load(fn):
    return json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, fn), encoding="utf-8"))
cache = load("bio_cache.json")
digest = load("bio_reports_digest.json")
research = load("bio_research.json")
if "stocks" not in research and isinstance(research.get("result"), dict):
    research = research["result"]
stocks = research["stocks"]
syn = research["synthesis"]
rank_by = {r["name"]: r for r in syn["ranking"]}

def esc(s):
    return H.escape(str(s)) if s is not None else ""
def eok(v):  # 백만원 → 억
    return v / 100.0

VERDICT_COLOR = {
    "사실": "#1a7f37;background:#eaf6ec", "대체로 사실": "#2b7a3e;background:#edf7ee",
    "부분 사실": "#b45309;background:#fdf3e3", "확인불가": "#666;background:#f1f1f1",
    "반증": "#c2410c;background:#fdeee6",
    "확인": "#1a7f37;background:#eaf6ec", "부분확인": "#b45309;background:#fdf3e3",
}
def vbadge(v):
    c = VERDICT_COLOR.get(v, "#666;background:#f1f1f1")
    return f'<span class="vb" style="color:{c}">{esc(v)}</span>'

TIER_COLOR = {
    "1군": "#BE2E22;background:#fdeeec", "2군": "#b45309;background:#fdf3e3",
    "관찰": "#555;background:#eef0f2",
}
def tier_badge(t):
    key = "1군" if t.startswith("1군") else ("2군" if t.startswith("2군") else "관찰")
    c = TIER_COLOR[key]
    return f'<span class="tier" style="color:{c}">{esc(t)}</span>'

def stars(n):
    return '<span class="stars">' + "●" * int(n) + '<span class="dim">' + "●" * (5 - int(n)) + "</span></span>"

# ── 종목 카드 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ORDER = [r["name"] for r in syn["ranking"]]
sd = {s["name"]: s for s in stocks}

cards = ""
for i, name in enumerate(ORDER, 1):
    s = sd[name]; r = s["research"]; v = s["verify"]; rk = rank_by[name]
    c = cache.get(name, {}); dg = digest["stocks"].get(name, {})
    mac_jo = c["mac"] / 10000 if c.get("mac") else s["mac_jo"]  # 키움 최신 시총(억→조), 없으면 리서치값
    chg = c.get("flu_rt", 0)
    chg_html = (f'<span class="up">+{chg:.2f}%</span>' if chg > 0 else
                (f'<span class="dn">{chg:.2f}%</span>' if chg < 0 else "0.00%"))
    # 파이프라인 표
    pipe = ""
    for p in r.get("lead_pipeline", [])[:5]:
        pipe += (f'<tr><td class="pa">{esc(p["asset"])}</td><td>{esc(p["indication"])}</td>'
                 f'<td>{esc(p["phase"])}</td><td class="pp">{esc(p["partner"])}</td></tr>')
    # 딜 이력
    deals = ""
    for d in r.get("deals", []):
        deals += (f'<div class="deal"><span class="dp">{esc(d["period"])}</span>'
                  f'<b>{esc(d["counterparty"])}</b> · {esc(d.get("asset",""))}'
                  f'<div class="dh">{esc(d["headline"])}</div></div>')
    # 카탈리스트
    cats = ""
    for ct in r.get("upcoming_catalysts", [])[:6]:
        cats += (f'<div class="cat"><span class="ct">{esc(ct["timing"])}</span>'
                 f'<span class="ce">{esc(ct["event"])}</span></div>')
    # 리스크
    risks = "".join(f"<li>{esc(x)}</li>" for x in r.get("risks", [])[:3])
    # 하우스뷰
    house = ""
    if dg.get("mirae"):
        house += f'<div class="hv"><span class="hh mi">미래에셋</span>{esc(dg["mirae"])}</div>'
    if dg.get("samsung") and dg["samsung"] != "삼성 리포트 직접 언급 없음.":
        house += f'<div class="hv"><span class="hh sa">삼성</span>{esc(dg["samsung"])}</div>'
    # 하드데이터
    frg = eok(c.get("flow_frg_20", 0)); org = eok(c.get("flow_orgn_20", 0))
    def flowspan(x):
        return (f'<b class="up">+{x:,.0f}</b>' if x > 0 else (f'<b class="dn">{x:,.0f}</b>' if x < 0 else "0"))
    hard = (f'<span>시총 <b>{mac_jo:.2f}조</b></span>'
            f'<span>공매도5일 <b>{c.get("short_w5",0):.1f}%</b></span>'
            f'<span>외국인20일 {flowspan(frg)}억</span>'
            f'<span>기관20일 {flowspan(org)}억</span>'
            f'<span>유통 <b>{c.get("dstr_rt",0):.0f}%</b></span>'

<script>
const DATA=__TDATA__;
const tb=document.getElementById('sumb');let key='deal';
const f=v=>v.toLocaleString('ko-KR');
const tierC=t=>t.startsWith('1군')?'#BE2E22':(t.startsWith('2군')?'#b45309':'#555');
function render(){
  const rows=[...DATA].sort((a,b)=>(b[key]-a[key])|| b.deal-a.deal);
  tb.innerHTML=rows.map((r,i)=>{
    const chg=r.chg>0?`<span class="up">+${r.chg.toFixed(2)}%</span>`:(r.chg<0?`<span class="dn">${r.chg.toFixed(2)}%</span>`:'0.00%');
    const fr=r.frg>0?`<span class="up">+${f(r.frg)}</span>`:(r.frg<0?`<span class="dn">${f(r.frg)}</span>`:'0');
    const og=r.org>0?`<span class="up">+${f(r.org)}</span>`:(r.org<0?`<span class="dn">${f(r.org)}</span>`:'0');
    const st='<span class="stars">'+'●'.repeat(r.deal)+'<span class="dim">'+'●'.repeat(5-r.deal)+'</span></span>';
    return `<tr onclick="document.getElementById('s${r.code}').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">
    <td>${i+1}</td><td><b>${r.name}</b> <span style="color:#aaa;font-size:10px">${r.code}</span></td>
    <td>${r.mac.toFixed(2)}</td><td style="text-align:left"><span class="tier" style="color:${tierC(r.tier)};background:#f4f0ef">${r.tier}</span></td>
    <td>${st}</td><td>${chg}</td><td>${r.short.toFixed(1)}%</td><td>${fr}</td><td>${og}</td>
    <td style="font-size:11px;color:#666">${r.timing}</td></tr>`;
  }).join('');
}
document.querySelectorAll('.btn').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  document.querySelectorAll('.btn').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));b.classList.add('on');key=b.dataset.k;render();
}));
render();
</script>
</body></html>"""

            .replace("__TOC__", toc).replace("__CARDS__", cards)
            .replace("__PUZZLES__", puzzles).replace("__CAL__", cal)
            .replace("__TDATA__", json.dumps(table, ensure_ascii=False)))
out = os.path.join(HERE, f"바이오_딜모멘텀_{time.strftime('%m%d')}.html")
with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(html)
print("저장:", out, f"({os.path.getsize(out)/1024:.0f} KB)")

    "329180": "+1M +0 · +3M +2 · +6M +3",
    "042660": "+1M +0 · +3M −4 · +6M +10",
    "010120": "+1M +49 · +3M +75 · +6M +203",
    "267260": "+1M +20 · +3M +32 · +6M +55",
}


def candles_svg(candles, evIdx, w=1080, h=250):
    pl, pr, pt, pb = 56, 12, 14, 22
    n = len(candles)
    hi = max(c["h"] for c in candles); lo = min(c["l"] for c in candles)
    rng = (hi - lo) or 1
    def X(i): return pl + i * (w - pl - pr) / (n - 1)
    def Y(p): return pt + (hi - p) / rng * (h - pt - pb)
    cw = max(2.0, (w - pl - pr) / n * 0.6)
    P = []
    for k in range(5):
        p = lo + rng * k / 4; y = Y(p)
        P.append(f'<line x1="{pl}" y1="{y:.1f}" x2="{w-pr}" y2="{y:.1f}" stroke="#2a2f3a" stroke-width="0.5"/>')
        P.append(f'<text x="{pl-5}" y="{y+3:.1f}" fill="#6f7682" font-size="9" text-anchor="end">{int(round(p)):,}</text>')
    ex = X(evIdx)
    P.append(f'<line x1="{ex:.1f}" y1="{pt}" x2="{ex:.1f}" y2="{h-pb}" stroke="#e8a33d" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="3 2" opacity="0.85"/>')
    P.append(f'<text x="{ex:.1f}" y="{pt-3}" fill="#e8a33d" font-size="9.5" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="800">▼ cap 이벤트</text>')
    for i, c in enumerate(candles):
        x = X(i); up = c["c"] >= c["o"]
        col = "#e5484d" if up else "#4f8cff"  # 한국식: 양봉 빨강 / 음봉 파랑
        yh, yl, yo, yc = Y(c["h"]), Y(c["l"]), Y(c["o"]), Y(c["c"])
        bt, bb = min(yo, yc), max(yo, yc); bh = max(0.8, bb - bt)
        P.append(f'<line x1="{x:.1f}" y1="{yh:.1f}" x2="{x:.1f}" y2="{yl:.1f}" stroke="{col}" stroke-width="0.8"/>')
        P.append(f'<rect x="{x-cw/2:.1f}" y="{bt:.1f}" width="{cw:.1f}" height="{bh:.1f}" fill="{col}"/>')
    step = max(1, n // 7)
    for i in range(0, n, step):
        x = X(i); dt = candles[i]["dt"]
        P.append(f'<text x="{x:.1f}" y="{h-6}" fill="#6f7682" font-size="8.5" text-anchor="middle">{dt[4:6]}/{dt[6:8]}</text>')
    return f'<svg viewBox="0 0 {w} {h}" style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block">' + "".join(P) + "</svg>"


# 차트 카드
cards = []
for d in DATA:
    s = SELL.get(d["code"], {})
    post = d["candles"][d["evIdx"]:]
    p0 = d["eventClose"]
    maxhi = max(c["h"] for c in post); maxret = round(maxhi / p0 * 100 - 100, 1)
    minlo = min(c["l"] for c in post[:25]) if len(post) > 1 else p0
    dip = round(minlo / p0 * 100 - 100, 1)
    cards.append(f"""
    <div class="chart">
      <div class="chd">
        <div><span class="nm">{d['name']}</span> <span class="cd">{d['code']}</span> <span class="ev">cap 이벤트 {d['event'][:4]}-{d['event'][4:6]}-{d['event'][6:8]} · 종가 {p0:,}</span></div>
        <div class="badges">
          <span class="bd">매도물량 <b>{s.get('sell','-')}</b></span>
          <span class="bd">최대상회 <b>{s.get('exceed','-')}</b></span>
          <span class="bd dip">cap후 저점 <b>{dip:+.1f}%</b></span>
          <span class="bd up">이후 최고 <b>+{maxret:.0f}%</b></span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="etfnote">{s.get('etf','')}</div>
      {candles_svg(d['candles'], d['evIdx'])}
      <div class="fwd">이후 수익률(cap_absorb 기준): {FWD.get(d['code'],'')}</div>
    </div>""")

</style></head><body><div class="wrap">
<h1>5종목 <span class="s">cap 매도물량 + 일봉 캔들</span> — vs 삼성전기</h1>
<div class="meta">키움 ka10081 일별 OHLC · cap 이벤트(▼) 전후 · 한국식 캔들(<b style="color:var(--up)">빨강=양봉</b>/<span style="color:var(--dn)">파랑=음봉</span>)</div>

<div class="callout">
<span class="big">결론: 5종목 모두 삼성전기보다 cap 매도물량이 1~2 자릿수 작다 — 삼성전기가 아웃라이어.</span>
방산·조선·전력 ETF의 cap(20~25%)은 그 테마 <b>1위 종목을 전제로 높게</b> 잡혀, 리더가 cap에 '딱 붙어' 있지 폭주하지 않는다. 오직 <span class="hl">삼성전기만 30% 하드캡을 +14.7%p 뚫어 ~9,200억</span> 강제매도. 따라서 이 5종목은 '같은 수준 비교군'이 아니라 <b>'cap 매도가 미미했는데도 어떻게 흡수·급등했나'의 참고군</b>으로 읽어야 정확하다.
</div>

<h2><span class="no">①</span>cap 매도물량 비교 (억원, 삼성전기=100%)</h2>

<div class="meta" style="margin-top:4px">레인지의 대표값으로 바 길이 표시 · 한화에어로·조선·전력은 '베스트케이스' 상한이며 실측은 더 작음(예: 한화에어로 6/12 실측 +0.06%p≈8억).</div>

<h2><span class="no">②</span>종목별 일봉 캔들 (cap 이벤트 ▼ 전후)</h2>
{''.join(cards)}
<div class="legend"><b>빨강=양봉(종가≥시가)</b> · <i>파랑=음봉</i> · 점선 ▼ = cap 정기변경 이벤트 · 좌측 = 가격(원)</div>

<div class="foot">
매도물량 = ETF 순자산(AUM) × max(0, 비중−cap)의 합산 추정(운용사·ETF비교 자료, 시점별 AUM 편차 있음, confidence medium). 풀종목 매수상쇄·신규설정 순유입 반영 시 실제 순매도는 더 작음.<br>
캔들은 키움 ka10081 수정주가 OHLC 실측. cap 이벤트일은 정기변경 추정일(한화에어로 2024-12, 조선 2025-09, 전력 2025-10) — 분기/반기 리밸런싱마다 반복되므로 단일일 아님.<br>
'이후 최고 +%'는 cap 이벤트 종가 대비 윈도 내 최고 고가. 투자판단 참고용, 매매권유 아님.
</div>
</div></body></html>"""

build_consolidated.py한울반도체 통합분석 엑셀 — 제품매출/비용성격별/판관비/임직원/수주잔고, 전부 26.1Q 포함.267줄 · 13KB · 2026-07-27
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""한울반도체 통합분석 엑셀 — 제품매출/비용성격별/판관비/임직원/수주잔고, 전부 26.1Q 포함."""
import sys, io, os, re
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)
import pdfplumber
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side

FILES = [
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체]사업보고서(2022.03.14).pdf", "FY2021"),
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체]사업보고서(2023.03.22).pdf", "FY2022"),
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체][정정]사업보고서(2024.03.28).pdf", "FY2023"),
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체][정정]사업보고서(2025.03.26).pdf", "FY2024"),
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체]사업보고서(2026.03.20).pdf", "FY2025"),
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체]분기보고서(2026.05.08).pdf", "2026Q1"),
]
ASSIGN={"FY2021":{"당기":"2021","전기":"2020"},"FY2022":{"당기":"2022"},"FY2023":{"당기":"2023"},
        "FY2024":{"당기":"2024"},"FY2025":{"당기":"2025"},"2026Q1":{"당기":"26.1Q"}}

def num(s):
    s=(s or "").strip().replace(",","").replace(" ","")
    if s in("","-","–"): return None
    neg=s.startswith("(") and s.endswith(")"); s=s.strip("()")
    if not re.match(r"^-?\d+$",s): return None
    v=int(s); return -v if neg else v
def norm_cost(it):
    it=it.replace(" ","")
    if it.startswith("원재료"): return "원재료 등의 사용"
    if it.startswith("재고자산"): return "재고자산의 변동"
    return it
def norm_sga(it):
    if it.replace(" ","").startswith("대손상각비"): return "대손상각비(환입)"
    return it.strip()
def parse_table(tb):
    out=[]
    for row in tb:
        cells=[(c or "").strip() for c in row]; nums=[]; labels=[]
        for c in cells:
            v=num(c)
            if v is not None or c in("-","–"): nums.append(num(c))
            elif c: labels.append(c)
        if not labels: continue
        item=labels[0]
        if item=="구분" or item.startswith("(단위"): continue
        if not nums: continue
        out.append((item,nums))
    return out

COST={}; SGA={}
def setv(D,y,it,v): D.setdefault(y,{})[it]=v
for path,label in FILES:
    with pdfplumber.open(path) as pdf:
        n=len(pdf.pages); ct=[]; st=[]
        for i in range(n):
            t=pdf.pages[i].extract_text() or ""
            isc="비용의 성격별 분류" in t
            iss=("판매비와관리비의 내역" in t) or ("판매비와관리비의 주요 내역" in t)
            if not(isc or iss): continue
            for p in (i,i+1):
                if p>=n: continue
                for tb in pdf.pages[p].extract_tables():
                    flat=" ".join((c or "") for r in tb for c in r)
                    if isc and "원재료" in flat and ("종업원급여" in flat or "재고자산" in flat): ct.append((p,tb))
                    if iss and "급여" in flat and ("복리후생" in flat or "감가상각" in flat) and "원재료" not in flat: st.append((p,tb))
        def dd(ts):
            seen=set(); o=[]
            for p,tb in ts:
                if p in seen: continue
                seen.add(p); o.append((p,tb))
            return sorted(o)
        ct=dd(ct); st=dd(st)
        def basis(ts): return (["연결","별도"] if len(ts)>=2 else ["별도"])
        for (p,tb),b in zip(ct,basis(ct)):
            for it,nm in parse_table(tb):
                ni=norm_cost(it)
                for col,yr in ASSIGN[label].items():
                    idx=0 if col=="당기" else 1
                    if idx<len(nm) and nm[idx] is not None:
                        yl=yr+"(연결)" if b=="연결" else yr
                        if b=="별도" or yr in("2025","26.1Q"): setv(COST,yl,ni,nm[idx])
        for (p,tb),b in zip(st,basis(st)):
            for it,nm in parse_table(tb):
                ni=norm_sga(it)
                for col,yr in ASSIGN[label].items():
                    idx=0 if col=="당기" else 1
                    if idx<len(nm) and nm[idx] is not None:
                        yl=yr+"(연결)" if b=="연결" else yr
                        if b=="별도" or yr in("2025","26.1Q"): setv(SGA,yl,ni,nm[idx])

# verify
for nm,D in [("COST",COST),("SGA",SGA)]:
    for y in ["2020","2021","2022","2023","2024","2025","26.1Q","26.1Q(연결)"]:
        d=D.get(y,{});
        if not d: continue
        s=sum(v for k,v in d.items() if k!="합계"); rep=d.get("합계")
        assert s==rep, f"{nm} {y} {s}!={rep}"
print("검증 통과: 모든 비용/판관비 항목 합 = 보고 합계")

# ---------- styles ----------
FONT="맑은 고딕"; NF='#,##0;(#,##0);"-"'; PCT='0.0%'
hdr=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="D9E1F2"); seg=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="F2F2F2")
tot=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="FCE4D6"); drv=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="E2EFDA")
cons=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="FFF2CC")
thin=Side(style="thin",color="BFBFBF"); BD=Border(left=thin,right=thin,top=thin,bottom=thin)
def F(b=False,sz=10,c="000000"): return Font(name=FONT,bold=b,size=sz,color=c)
def title(ws,r,txt,span,sz=12):
    ws.cell(r,1,txt).font=F(True,sz); ws.merge_cells(start_row=r,start_column=1,end_row=r,end_column=span)
def note(ws,r,txt,span,c="808080"):
    ws.cell(r,1,txt).font=F(sz=9,c=c); ws.merge_cells(start_row=r,start_column=1,end_row=r,end_column=span)
def H(ws,r,c,v,al="center",fill=hdr):
    x=ws.cell(r,c,v); x.font=F(True); x.border=BD; x.alignment=Alignment(horizontal=al,vertical="center",wrap_text=True)
    if fill: x.fill=fill
    return x
def V(ws,r,c,v,fmt=NF,b=False,fill=None,al="right"):
    x=ws.cell(r,c,v); x.font=F(b); x.number_format=fmt; x.border=BD; x.alignment=Alignment(horizontal=al,vertical="center")
    if fill: x.fill=fill
    return x

wb=Workbook()

# ===== Sheet 1: 제품매출 =====
ws=wb.active; ws.title="①제품매출"; ws.sheet_view.showGridLines=False

P={

for k,v in P.items():

H(ws,r,1,"합계",al="left",fill=tot)

    V(ws,r,2+j,f"=SUM({col}5:{col}{r-1})",b=True,fill=tot)

# ===== generic cost matrix writer =====
def cost_sheet(name,Dt,order,ycols,ylabels,title_txt,note_txt,derived=False,sales=None):
    ws=wb.create_sheet(name); ws.sheet_view.showGridLines=False
    title(ws,1,title_txt,1+len(ycols)); note(ws,2,note_txt,1+len(ycols))
    H(ws,4,1,"구분 (단위: 천원)",al="left")
    for j,yl in enumerate(ylabels):
        fill=cons if "연결" in yl else hdr
        H(ws,4,2+j,yl,fill=fill)
    r=5; items=[it for it in order if any(it in Dt.get(y,{}) for y in ycols)]
    tot_row=None
    for it in items:
        ist=(it=="합계"); H(ws,r,1,it,al="left",fill=(tot if ist else None))
        if not ist: ws.cell(r,1).font=F(False)
        for j,y in enumerate(ycols):
            v=Dt.get(y,{}).get(it); V(ws,r,2+j,v,b=ist,fill=(tot if ist else (cons if "연결" in ylabels[j] else None)))
        if ist: tot_row=r
        r+=1
    if derived and sales and tot_row:
        H(ws,r,1,"매출액 (참고)",al="left",fill=drv)
        for j,y in enumerate(ycols): V(ws,r,2+j,sales.get(y),b=True,fill=drv)
        srow=r; r+=1
        H(ws,r,1,"영업손익 (=매출−비용합계)",al="left",fill=drv)
        for j in range(len(ycols)):
            col=ws.cell(r,2+j).column_letter; V(ws,r,2+j,f"={col}{srow}-{col}{tot_row}",b=True,fill=drv)
        r+=1
    ws.freeze_panes="B5"; ws.column_dimensions['A'].width=24
    for j in range(len(ycols)): ws.column_dimensions[ws.cell(4,2+j).column_letter].width=12
    return ws

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""한울반도체 비용구조(비용성격별·판관비) 추출→파싱→검증→엑셀."""
import sys, io, os, re
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)
import pdfplumber
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side

FILES = [
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체]사업보고서(2022.03.14).pdf", "FY2021"),
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체]사업보고서(2023.03.22).pdf", "FY2022"),
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체][정정]사업보고서(2024.03.28).pdf", "FY2023"),
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체][정정]사업보고서(2025.03.26).pdf", "FY2024"),
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체]사업보고서(2026.03.20).pdf", "FY2025"),
    (r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\[한울반도체]분기보고서(2026.05.08).pdf", "2026Q1"),
]
# 당기/전기 -> 연도 라벨
ASSIGN = {"FY2021":{"당기":"2021","전기":"2020"},"FY2022":{"당기":"2022"},
          "FY2023":{"당기":"2023"},"FY2024":{"당기":"2024"},
          "FY2025":{"당기":"2025"},"2026Q1":{"당기":"26.1Q"}}
# 별도 매출(천원) — 제품현황 시트와 동일
SALES = {"2020":11239478,"2021":15405211,"2022":20269062,"2023":15967468,
         "2024":9453392,"2025":11462850,"26.1Q":3418011}
SALES_CONS = {"2025(연결)":11462850,"26.1Q(연결)":11332341}  # 2025 연결≈별도

def num(s):
    s=(s or "").strip().replace(",","").replace(" ","")
    if s in ("","-","–"): return None
    neg = s.startswith("(") and s.endswith(")")
    s=s.strip("()")
    if not re.match(r"^-?\d+$", s): return None
    v=int(s); return -v if neg else v

def norm_cost(it):
    it=it.replace(" ","")
    if it.startswith("원재료"): return "원재료 등의 사용"
    if it.startswith("재고자산"): return "재고자산의 변동"
    return {"종업원급여":"종업원급여","퇴직급여":"퇴직급여","복리후생비":"복리후생비","보험료":"보험료",
            "감가상각비":"감가상각비","무형자산상각비":"무형자산상각비","경상개발비":"경상개발비",
            "여비교통비":"여비교통비","소모품비":"소모품비","지급수수료":"지급수수료","접대비":"접대비",
            "기타비용":"기타비용","합계":"합계"}.get(it, it)

def norm_sga(it):
    k=it.replace(" ","")
    if k.startswith("대손상각비"): return "대손상각비(환입)"
    return it.strip()

def parse_table(tb):
    """return list of (item, [당기, 전기])"""
    out=[]
    for row in tb:
        cells=[(c or "").strip() for c in row]
        nums=[]; labels=[]
        for c in cells:
            v=num(c)
            if v is not None or c in ("-","–"):
                nums.append(num(c))
            elif c:
                labels.append(c)
        if not labels: continue
        item=labels[0]
        if item in ("구분",) or item.startswith("(단위"): continue
        if not nums: continue
        out.append((item, nums))
    return out

# ---- extract ----
COST={}; SGA={}  # year -> {item:val}
def setv(D, year, item, val):
    D.setdefault(year,{})[item]=val

for path,label in FILES:
    with pdfplumber.open(path) as pdf:
        n=len(pdf.pages)
        cost_tabs=[]; sga_tabs=[]
        for i in range(n):
            t=pdf.pages[i].extract_text() or ""
            isc="비용의 성격별 분류" in t
            iss=("판매비와관리비의 내역" in t) or ("판매비와관리비의 주요 내역" in t)
            if not(isc or iss): continue
            for p in (i,i+1):
                if p>=n: continue
                for tb in pdf.pages[p].extract_tables():
                    flat=" ".join((c or "") for r in tb for c in r)
                    if isc and "원재료" in flat and ("종업원급여" in flat or "재고자산" in flat):
                        cost_tabs.append((p,tb))
                    if iss and "급여" in flat and ("복리후생" in flat or "감가상각" in flat) and "원재료" not in flat:
                        sga_tabs.append((p,tb))
        # dedupe by page
        def dedupe(ts):
            seen=set(); o=[]
            for p,tb in ts:
                if p in seen: continue
                seen.add(p); o.append((p,tb))
            return sorted(o)
        cost_tabs=dedupe(cost_tabs); sga_tabs=dedupe(sga_tabs)
        has_cons = len(cost_tabs)>=2
        # assign: if 2 -> [연결,별도]; if1 -> [별도]
        def basis_list(ts):
            return (["연결","별도"] if len(ts)>=2 else ["별도"])
        for (p,tb),basis in zip(cost_tabs, basis_list(cost_tabs)):
            rows=parse_table(tb)
            for item,nums in rows:
                ni=norm_cost(item)
                for col,yr in ASSIGN[label].items():
                    idx=0 if col=="당기" else 1
                    if idx<len(nums) and nums[idx] is not None:
                        ylab = yr+"(연결)" if basis=="연결" else yr
                        if basis=="별도" or yr in ("2025","26.1Q"):
                            setv(COST, ylab, ni, nums[idx])
        for (p,tb),basis in zip(sga_tabs, basis_list(sga_tabs)):
            rows=parse_table(tb)
            for item,nums in rows:
                ni=norm_sga(item)
                for col,yr in ASSIGN[label].items():
                    idx=0 if col=="당기" else 1
                    if idx<len(nums) and nums[idx] is not None:
                        ylab = yr+"(연결)" if basis=="연결" else yr
                        if basis=="별도" or yr in ("2025","26.1Q"):
                            setv(SGA, ylab, ni, nums[idx])

# ---- verify: sum of items (excl 합계) == reported 합계 ----
print("== 비용성격별 검증 ==")
for yr in ["2020","2021","2022","2023","2024","2025","26.1Q","2025(연결)","26.1Q(연결)"]:
    d=COST.get(yr,{})
    if not d: continue
    rep=d.get("합계")
    s=sum(v for k,v in d.items() if k!="합계")
    print(f"  {yr}: sum={s:,} reported={rep:,} {'OK' if s==rep else 'DIFF '+str(s-rep)}")
print("== 판관비 검증 ==")
for yr in ["2020","2021","2022","2023","2024","2025","26.1Q","2025(연결)","26.1Q(연결)"]:
    d=SGA.get(yr,{})
    if not d: continue
    rep=d.get("합계")
    s=sum(v for k,v in d.items() if k!="합계")
    print(f"  {yr}: sum={s:,} reported={rep:,} {'OK' if s==rep else 'DIFF '+str(s-rep)}")

# ================= build Excel =================
FONT="맑은 고딕"; NUMFMT='#,##0;(#,##0);"-"'; PCT='0.0%'
hdr=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="D9E1F2"); seg=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="F2F2F2")
tot=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="FCE4D6"); drv=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="E2EFDA")
thin=Side(style="thin",color="BFBFBF"); bd=Border(left=thin,right=thin,top=thin,bottom=thin)
def F(b=False,sz=10,c="000000"): return Font(name=FONT,bold=b,size=sz,color=c)

def write_matrix(ws, title, note, D, years, ylabels, order, derived=False):
    ws.sheet_view.showGridLines=False
    ws.cell(1,1,title).font=F(True,12); ws.merge_cells(start_row=1,start_column=1,end_row=1,end_column=1+len(years))
    ws.cell(2,1,note).font=F(sz=9,c="808080"); ws.merge_cells(start_row=2,start_column=1,end_row=2,end_column=1+len(years))
    hr=4
    c=ws.cell(hr,1,"구분 (단위: 천원)"); c.font=F(True); c.fill=hdr; c.border=bd; c.alignment=Alignment(horizontal="left")
    for j,yl in enumerate(ylabels):
        c=ws.cell(hr,2+j,yl); c.font=F(True); c.fill=hdr; c.border=bd; c.alignment=Alignment(horizontal="center",wrap_text=True)
    # rows
    r=hr+1
    items=[it for it in order if any(it in D.get(y,{}) for y in years)]
    for it in items:
        istot=(it=="합계")
        c=ws.cell(r,1,it); c.font=F(istot); c.border=bd; c.alignment=Alignment(horizontal="left")
        if istot: c.fill=tot
        for j,y in enumerate(years):
            v=D.get(y,{}).get(it)
            cell=ws.cell(r,2+j, v if v is not None else None)
            cell.font=F(istot); cell.number_format=NUMFMT; cell.border=bd; cell.alignment=Alignment(horizontal="right")
            if istot: cell.fill=tot
        r+=1
    tot_row=r-1
    if derived:
        # 매출원가(파생)=합계-판관비 불가(판관비 다른시트) -> 대신 매출/영업손익 행
        # 매출
        c=ws.cell(r,1,"매출액 (별도, 참고)"); c.font=F(True); c.fill=drv; c.border=bd; c.alignment=Alignment(horizontal="left")
        for j,y in enumerate(years):
            sv = SALES.get(y) or SALES_CONS.get(y)
            cell=ws.cell(r,2+j, sv); cell.font=F(True); cell.number_format=NUMFMT; cell.fill=drv; cell.border=bd
        sales_row=r; r+=1

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
market_cache.json(일별 지수·시장투자자순매수) → 코스피/코스닥 수급 누적 엑셀.
스크린샷 레이아웃: 코스피|코스닥 각 [지수·등락률·외국인·기관·연기금·개인],
섹션 = 연간(2020~) / 월별(전년1월~) / 주간(이번주) / 일별(최근5거래일). 무채색 스타일.
"""
import sys, io, os, json, time, bisect
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Border, Side, Alignment
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
FONT = "맑은 고딕"
MARKETS = ["KOSPI", "KOSDAQ"]
INVK = ["frgn", "inst", "pens", "indi"]   # 외국인/기관/연기금/개인

# ---- 무채색 스타일 ----
TITLE_FONT = Font(name=FONT, bold=True, size=14, color="222222")
SUB_FONT   = Font(name=FONT, size=9, color="808080")
GRP_FILL   = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="404040")
GRP_FONT   = Font(name=FONT, color="FFFFFF", bold=True, size=11)
HDR_FILL   = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="595959")
HDR_FONT   = Font(name=FONT, color="FFFFFF", bold=True, size=10)
LBL_FILL   = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="ECECEC")
LBL_FONT   = Font(name=FONT, bold=True, size=10, color="222222")
CELL_FONT  = Font(name=FONT, size=10, color="222222")
NEG_FONT   = Font(name=FONT, size=10, color="666666")   # 음수도 무채색(연회색)
BAND       = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="F5F5F5")
SECT_FILL  = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="D9D9D9")
_thin = Side(style="thin", color="D9D9D9")
_med  = Side(style="medium", color="BFBFBF")
BORDER = Border(left=_thin, right=_thin, top=_thin, bottom=_thin)
C = Alignment("center", vertical="center")
R = Alignment("right", vertical="center")
L = Alignment("left", vertical="center")

F_IDX = '#,##0.00'
F_CHG = '+0.00"%";-0.00"%"'
F_AMT = '#,##0;-#,##0'


def load():
    return json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "market_cache.json"), encoding="utf-8"))


def prev_close(days, closes, dt):
    """dt 직전(미만) 거래일의 종가. 없으면 None."""
    i = bisect.bisect_left(days, dt)
    return closes[days[i - 1]] if i > 0 else None


def build_rows(cache):
    """각 행: {'label', 'KOSPI':{idx,chg,frgn,inst,pens,indi}, 'KOSDAQ':{...}} 목록을 섹션별로."""
    # 시장별 정렬 거래일/종가/플로우
    days = {mk: sorted(cache["index"][mk]) for mk in MARKETS}
    close = {mk: {d: cache["index"][mk][d]["idx"] for d in days[mk]} for mk in MARKETS}
    flu   = {mk: {d: cache["index"][mk][d]["flu"] for d in days[mk]} for mk in MARKETS}
    flows = {mk: cache["flows"][mk] for mk in MARKETS}
    start_year = int(cache.get("start_year", 2020))
    latest = max(days["KOSPI"][-1], days["KOSDAQ"][-1])
    cur_year = int(latest[:4])

    def sum_flows(mk, pred):
        s = {k: 0 for k in INVK}
        for d, v in flows[mk].items():
            if pred(d):
                for k in INVK: s[k] += v.get(k, 0)
        return s

    def cell(mk, idx_dt, chg_base_dt, pred, daily_flu=None):
        """idx_dt 종가, (chg_base_dt 직전종가 대비 등락 or daily_flu), pred 기간 순매수합."""
        c = close[mk]; d_idx = idx_dt if idx_dt in c else (max(x for x in days[mk] if x <= idx_dt) if days[mk] else None)
        idx = c.get(d_idx)
        if daily_flu is not None:
            chg = daily_flu
        else:
            base = prev_close(days[mk], c, chg_base_dt)
            chg = (idx / base - 1) * 100 if (idx and base) else None
        out = {"idx": idx, "chg": chg}
        out.update(sum_flows(mk, pred))
        return out

    def row(label, fn):
        r = {"label": label}
        for mk in MARKETS: r[mk] = fn(mk)
        return r

    sections = []

    # ===== 연간 =====
    yr_rows = []
    for yr in range(start_year, cur_year + 1):
        ys = str(yr)
        def fn(mk, ys=ys, yr=yr):
            mdays = [d for d in days[mk] if d[:4] == ys]
            if not mdays: return {"idx": None, "chg": None, **{k: 0 for k in INVK}}
            return cell(mk, mdays[-1], ys + "0101", lambda d, ys=ys: d[:4] == ys)
        yr_rows.append(row(f"{yr}년", fn))
    sections.append(("연간", yr_rows))

    # ===== 월별 (전년 1월 ~ 당월) =====
    mo_rows = []
    months = []
    y, m = start_year if (cur_year - 1) < start_year else cur_year - 1, 1
    y = max(start_year, cur_year - 1)
    for yy in range(y, cur_year + 1):
        for mm in range(1, 13):
            ym = f"{yy}{mm:02d}"
            if ym > latest[:6]: break
            months.append((yy, mm, ym))
    for yy, mm, ym in months:
        def fn(mk, ym=ym):
            mdays = [d for d in days[mk] if d[:6] == ym]
            if not mdays: return {"idx": None, "chg": None, **{k: 0 for k in INVK}}
            return cell(mk, mdays[-1], ym + "01", lambda d, ym=ym: d[:6] == ym)
        mo_rows.append(row(f"{str(yy)[2:]}년 {mm}월", fn))
    sections.append(("월별", mo_rows))

    # ===== 주간 (이번주: 최신거래일이 속한 주의 월요일~) =====
    import datetime as dt
    ld = dt.date(int(latest[:4]), int(latest[4:6]), int(latest[6:]))
    monday = ld - dt.timedelta(days=ld.weekday())
    mon_s = monday.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    def wfn(mk):
        wdays = [d for d in days[mk] if mon_s <= d <= latest]
        if not wdays: return {"idx": None, "chg": None, **{k: 0 for k in INVK}}
        return cell(mk, wdays[-1], mon_s, lambda d: mon_s <= d <= latest)
    sections.append(("주간", [row("주간", wfn)]))

    # ===== 일별 (최근 5거래일) =====
    d_rows = []
    last5 = sorted(set(days["KOSPI"][-5:] + days["KOSDAQ"][-5:]))[-5:]
    for d0 in last5:
        def fn(mk, d0=d0):
            if d0 not in close[mk]: return {"idx": None, "chg": None, **{k: 0 for k in INVK}}
            return cell(mk, d0, d0, lambda d, d0=d0: d == d0, daily_flu=flu[mk].get(d0))
        d_rows.append(row(f"{d0[:4]}-{d0[4:6]}-{d0[6:]}", fn))
    sections.append(("일별", d_rows))

    return sections, latest


def write_xlsx(sections, latest):
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active; ws.title = "수급누적"
    base_fmt = f"{latest[:4]}.{latest[4:6]}.{latest[6:]}"

    # 컬럼: A 라벨 + 코스피6 + 코스닥6
    sub = ["지수", "등락률", "외국인", "기관", "연기금", "개인"]
    widths = [11] + [11, 9, 10, 9, 9, 10] * 2
    for i, w in enumerate(widths, 1):
        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = w

    ws.cell(1, 1, "코스피 / 코스닥 수급 누적").font = TITLE_FONT
    ws.cell(2, 1, f"(단위: 억 원)  ·  기준일 {base_fmt}  ·  출처: 키움 REST API(ka20009 지수 / ka10051 시장투자자순매수)").font = SUB_FONT

    # 그룹 헤더(행3)
    gr = 3
    ws.cell(gr, 1, "")
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=gr, start_column=2, end_row=gr, end_column=7)
    ws.merge_cells(start_row=gr, start_column=8, end_row=gr, end_column=13)
    for col, name in [(2, "코스피"), (8, "코스닥")]:
        c = ws.cell(gr, col, name); c.fill = GRP_FILL; c.font = GRP_FONT; c.alignment = C; c.border = BORDER
    # 컬럼 헤더(행4)
    hr = 4
    h = ws.cell(hr, 1, "기간"); h.fill = HDR_FILL; h.font = HDR_FONT; h.alignment = C; h.border = BORDER
    for blk in range(2):
        for j, name in enumerate(sub):
            c = ws.cell(hr, 2 + blk * 6 + j, name)
            c.fill = HDR_FILL; c.font = HDR_FONT; c.alignment = C; c.border = BORDER

    r = hr + 1
    band = False
    for sect_name, rows in sections:
        # 섹션 구분 줄
        sc = ws.cell(r, 1, sect_name); sc.fill = SECT_FILL; sc.font = LBL_FONT; sc.alignment = L; sc.border = BORDER
        for col in range(2, 14):
            cc = ws.cell(r, col, ""); cc.fill = SECT_FILL; cc.border = BORDER
        r += 1
        for row in rows:
            lc = ws.cell(r, 1, row["label"]); lc.fill = LBL_FILL; lc.font = LBL_FONT; lc.alignment = L; lc.border = BORDER
            for blk, mk in enumerate(MARKETS):
                d = row[mk]
                vals = [(d["idx"], F_IDX), (d["chg"], F_CHG),
                        (d["frgn"], F_AMT), (d["inst"], F_AMT), (d["pens"], F_AMT), (d["indi"], F_AMT)]
                for j, (v, fmt) in enumerate(vals):
                    c = ws.cell(r, 2 + blk * 6 + j, v)
                    c.font = NEG_FONT if (isinstance(v, (int, float)) and v < 0) else CELL_FONT
                    c.alignment = R; c.border = BORDER
                    if band: c.fill = BAND
                    if isinstance(v, (int, float)): c.number_format = fmt
            if band:
                ws.cell(r, 1).fill = LBL_FILL  # 라벨은 항상 라벨색
            band = not band
            r += 1
        band = False

    # 캡쳐 친화
    ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
    ws.sheet_view.zoomScale = 110
    ws.freeze_panes = "B5"
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 22
    ws.sheet_properties.tabColor = "404040"

    out = os.path.join(HERE, "KRX_수급누적.xlsx")
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            wb.save(out)
            print(f"생성: {out} (기준일 {latest})")
            return
        except PermissionError:
            if attempt < 2:
                print(f"  엑셀 잠김, 재시도 {attempt+1}/2 ..."); time.sleep(3)
    print(f"경고: '{os.path.basename(out)}' 가 열려있어 갱신 못함. 닫고 다시 실행하세요.")


def main():
    cache = load()
    sections, latest = build_rows(cache)
    write_xlsx(sections, latest)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""eco_chart.json → 에코프로머티(베어 템플릿) vs 삼성전기 비교 대시보드."""
import os, json
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
E = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "eco_chart.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
S = E["series"]; ATH = E["ath"]["high"]

# 마커 (날짜→라벨)
MARK = {"20231117": "상장", "20240111": "ATH 244k", "20240517": "락업 블록딜", "20250527": "저점 41k"}

def chart():
    w, h, pl, pt, pr, pb = 1080, 320, 50, 16, 12, 24
    pw, ph = w - pl - pr, h - pt - pb
    vals = [r["c"] for r in S]
    hi, lo = max(vals), min(vals)
    n = len(S)
    def X(i): return pl + i * pw / (n - 1)
    def Y(v): return pt + (hi - v) / (hi - lo) * ph
    P = []
    for k in range(5):
        v = lo + (hi - lo) * k / 4; y = Y(v)
        P.append(f'<line x1="{pl}" y1="{y:.1f}" x2="{w-pr}" y2="{y:.1f}" stroke="#2a2f3a" stroke-width="0.5"/>')
        P.append(f'<text x="{pl-5}" y="{y+3:.1f}" fill="#6f7682" font-size="9" text-anchor="end">{int(v):,}</text>')
    # 마커
    dmap = {r["dt"]: i for i, r in enumerate(S)}
    for dt, lab in MARK.items():
        # 가장 가까운 인덱스
        cand = [i for d, i in dmap.items() if d >= dt]
        if not cand: continue
        i = min(cand); x = X(i); y = Y(S[i]["c"])
        P.append(f'<line x1="{x:.1f}" y1="{pt}" x2="{x:.1f}" y2="{h-pb}" stroke="#e8a33d" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-dasharray="3 2" opacity="0.6"/>')
        P.append(f'<circle cx="{x:.1f}" cy="{y:.1f}" r="2.6" fill="#e8a33d"/>')
        anchor = "start" if lab == "상장" else ("end" if lab.startswith("저점") else "middle")
        P.append(f'<text x="{x:.1f}" y="{pt-3 if lab!="락업 블록딜" else pt+8}" fill="#f1c47e" font-size="9" text-anchor="{anchor}" font-weight="700">{lab}</text>')
    pts = " ".join(f"{X(i):.1f},{Y(r['c']):.1f}" for i, r in enumerate(S))
    P.append(f'<polyline points="{pts}" fill="none" stroke="#ff8b8f" stroke-width="1.8"/>')
    step = max(1, n // 9)
    for i in range(0, n, step):
        dt = S[i]["dt"]; x = X(i)
        P.append(f'<text x="{x:.1f}" y="{h-2}" fill="#6f7682" font-size="8" text-anchor="middle">{dt[2:4]}/{dt[4:6]}</text>')
    return f'<svg viewBox="0 0 {w} {h}" style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block">' + "".join(P) + "</svg>"

# ATH 대비 드로다운 트랙
DD = [("ATH", 0), ("+1M", -14.1), ("+3M", -53.5), ("+6M", -62.1), ("+12M", -70.5), ("+18M", -80.2), ("저점", -83.2), ("현재", -76.0)]
track = "".join(f'<div class="tk"><div class="tkd">{l}</div><div class="tkv neg">{v:+.0f}%</div></div>' if v < 0 else f'<div class="tk"><div class="tkd">{l}</div><div class="tkv">0%</div></div>' for l, v in DD)

# 대비표
ROWS = [
    ("상승(런업)", "공모가→ATH <b>6.7배</b> (2개월·얇은 유통물량+패시브 기대 스퀴즈)", "저점→ATH <b>14배</b> (1년·AI기판/MLCC)"),
    ("패시브 이벤트", "락업해제 블록딜 오버행 + <b>MSCI 편출(강제매도)</b>", "<b>ETF 30%cap 강제매도 ~9,200억</b>(6/15~25)"),
    ("업황/펀더", "2차전지 캐즘·전구체 <b style='color:#ff8b8f'>적자전환 → 붕괴</b>", "AI기판 완판·증권사 <b style='color:#8fe3b8'>매수의견 → 생존</b>"),

]

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
주요품목별 수출정리(태린이아빠) 엑셀 -> 단일 HTML 대시보드
사용법: python build_export_html.py [엑셀경로]
출력: 주요품목 수출 대시보드 MMDD.html (같은 폴더)
"""
import sys, os, re, json, datetime
import openpyxl

DEFAULT_XLSX = r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\주요품목별수출정리 6월 잠정(태린이아빠)(매일).xlsx"
OUT_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

YM_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*(\d{4})년\s*(\d{1,2})월\s*$')
HEADER_WORDS = {'년월', '금액(달러)', '금액(원화)', '중량(kg)', '중량', 'refresh'}
PCT_HEADERS = {'qoq', 'yoy', 'mom', '판가 yoy', '판가yoy'}


def cell_clean(v):
    if v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, datetime.datetime):
        return v.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    if isinstance(v, float):
        if v != v or v in (float('inf'), float('-inf')):
            return None
        if v == int(v) and abs(v) < 1e15:
            return int(v)
        return float(f'{v:.6g}')
    if isinstance(v, str):
        s = v.strip()
        if s in ('', '#DIV/0!', '#REF!', '#N/A', '#VALUE!', '#NAME?', '0.0.0.0'):
            return None
        return s
    return v


def is_num(v):
    return isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool)


def parse_sheet(ws):
    rows = []
    for r in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
        rows.append([cell_clean(c) for c in r])
    # 뒤쪽 완전 빈 행 제거 + 각 행 뒤쪽 빈 칸 제거
    while rows and all(c is None for c in rows[-1]):
        rows.pop()
    rows = [list(r) for r in rows]
    ncol = 0
    for r in rows:
        while r and r[-1] is None:
            r.pop()
        ncol = max(ncol, len(r))
    for r in rows:
        r += [None] * (ncol - len(r))
    return rows, ncol


def find_header_row(rows):
    # 실제 헤더행은 '일평균수…' 와 '분기…'(또는 MoM)를 동시에 가짐.
    # '일평균수출데이터 샘플' 같은 메모가 헤더 위에 떠 있는 시트(태양광셀/모듈) 오인 방지.
    for i, r in enumerate(rows[:12]):
        cells = [c.replace(' ', '') for c in r if isinstance(c, str)]
        has_daily = any(c.startswith('일평균수') for c in cells)
        has_anchor = any(c.startswith('분기') for c in cells) or any(c.lower() == 'mom' for c in cells)
        if has_daily and has_anchor:
            return i
    # 폴백: 앵커 없이 '일평균수…'만 있는 경우
    for i, r in enumerate(rows[:12]):
        for c in r:
            if isinstance(c, str) and c.replace(' ', '').startswith('일평균수'):
                return i
    return None


def col_stats(rows, hr, ncol):
    """각 열의 년월 매치 수 / 숫자 수 (헤더 아래 행 기준)"""
    ym_cnt = [0] * ncol
    num_cnt = [0] * ncol
    for r in rows[hr + 1:]:
        for j in range(ncol):
            v = r[j]
            if isinstance(v, str) and YM_RE.match(v):
                ym_cnt[j] += 1
            elif is_num(v):
                num_cnt[j] += 1
    return ym_cnt, num_cnt


def extract_meta_texts(rows, hr, ncol):
    """헤더 위 행들에서 관련기업 / HS코드 추출"""
    comps, hs = [], []
    for r in rows[:hr]:
        for v in r:
            if not isinstance(v, str):
                continue
            s = v.strip()
            if not s or s.lower() in HEADER_WORDS:
                continue
            # 표 메모/헤더 잔재 제외 (예: '일평균수출데이터 샘플', 'MoM', '판가 yoy')
            if any(t in s for t in ('일평균', '데이터 샘플', '금액(', '중량', '판가', '분기')) \
                    or s.lower() in ('mom', 'yoy', 'qoq'):
                continue
            if re.search(r'\d{4}', s) or re.match(r'^[\d\s.,+~-]+$', s):
                if re.search(r'\d', s):
                    hs.append(s)
                continue
            comps.append(s)
    # 그룹셀("대웅제약, 메디톡스, 휴젤")에 이미 들어있는 단독 기업셀("메디톡스")만 제거.
    # 콤마는 분리자로 쓰되 출력은 원문 유지 → '10,000' 같은 천단위 콤마는 깨지지 않음.
    covered = set()
    for c in comps:
        parts = [p.strip() for p in c.split(',') if p.strip()]
        if len(parts) > 1:
            covered.update(parts)
    out, seen = [], set()
    for c in comps:
        c = c.strip()
        if c in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(c)
        if ',' not in c and c in covered:
            continue
        out.append(c)
    return ', '.join(out), ' / '.join(dict.fromkeys(hs))


def build_item(name, ws):
    rows, ncol = parse_sheet(ws)
    hr = find_header_row(rows)
    if hr is None:
        return None
    headers = [str(c).strip() if c is not None else '' for c in rows[hr]]
    ym_cnt, num_cnt = col_stats(rows, hr, ncol)

    # 날짜 열: 년월 패턴이 가장 많은 열
    date_col = max(range(ncol), key=lambda j: ym_cnt[j])
    if ym_cnt[date_col] < 3:
        return None

    daily_col = mom_col = yoy_col = None
    for j, h in enumerate(headers):
        if h.replace(' ', '').startswith('일평균수') and daily_col is None:
            daily_col = j
    if daily_col is None:
        return None
    if daily_col + 1 < ncol and headers[daily_col + 1].lower() == 'mom':
        mom_col = daily_col + 1
    if daily_col + 2 < ncol and headers[daily_col + 2].lower() == 'yoy':
        yoy_col = daily_col + 2

    # 판가 열: '금액(달러)/중량' 중 숫자 데이터가 가장 많은 열
    price_col = None
    cands = [j for j, h in enumerate(headers) if h == '금액(달러)/중량']
    if not cands:  # 헤더가 위 행(우측 블록)에 있을 수도
        for i in range(hr):
            for j, c in enumerate(rows[i]):
                if isinstance(c, str) and c.strip() == '금액(달러)/중량':
                    cands.append(j)
    cands = [j for j in cands if num_cnt[j] >= 5]
    if cands:
        price_col = max(cands, key=lambda j: num_cnt[j])

    # 분기 열
    q_avg = q_qoq = q_yoy = None
    for j, h in enumerate(headers):
        if h in ('분기(평균)', '분기(일평균)') and q_avg is None:
            q_avg = j
            if j + 1 < ncol and headers[j + 1].lower() == 'qoq':
                q_qoq = j + 1
            if j + 2 < ncol and headers[j + 2].lower() == 'yoy':
                q_yoy = j + 2

    comps, hs = extract_meta_texts(rows, hr, ncol)
    imp = any(h.replace(' ', '').startswith('일평균수입') for h in headers) or '수입' in name
    flow = '수출' if ('수출' in name or '수출' in comps) else ('수입' if imp else '수출')

    # 열 표시 포맷: pct / raw(년월·문자) / num
    fmts = []
    for j in range(ncol):
        h = headers[j].lower()
        if ym_cnt[j] >= 3:
            fmts.append('raw')
        elif h in PCT_HEADERS:
            fmts.append('pct')
        else:
            fmts.append('num')

    return {
        'name': name.strip(), 'companies': comps, 'hs': hs, 'flow': flow,
        'hr': hr, 'cols': {
            'date': date_col, 'daily': daily_col, 'mom': mom_col, 'yoy': yoy_col,
            'price': price_col, 'qAvg': q_avg, 'qQoQ': q_qoq, 'qYoY': q_yoy,
        },
        'fmts': fmts, 'table': rows,
    }


def build_special(name, ws):
    """첫 시트(반도체 수출 판가 증가율): 삼성전자 주가 vs 디램판가/수출 YoY"""
    rows, ncol = parse_sheet(ws)
    hr = None
    for i, r in enumerate(rows[:25]):
        if any(isinstance(c, str) and c.strip() == 'D A T E' for c in r):
            hr = i
            break
    if hr is None:
        return None
    notes = []
    for r in rows[:hr]:
        for v in r:
            if isinstance(v, str) and len(v.strip()) > 12 and 'Update' not in v and 'Time Series' not in v:
                notes.append(v.strip())
    fmts = ['raw', 'num', 'num', 'pct', 'num', 'pct', 'num', 'num', 'pct', 'num', 'num', 'raw'][:ncol]
    last_update = ''
    for v in rows[0]:
        if isinstance(v, str) and 'Last Update' in v:
            m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', v)
            if m:
                last_update = m.group(1)
    return {
        'name': name.strip(), 'special': True, 'notes': notes, 'lastUpdate': last_update,
        'hr': hr, 'fmts': fmts, 'table': rows,
    }, last_update


def main():
    xlsx = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else DEFAULT_XLSX
    print('loading', xlsx)
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(xlsx, data_only=True)
    items = []
    special = None
    last_update = ''
    skipped = []
    for name in wb.sheetnames:
        ws = wb[name]
        if special is None and name == wb.sheetnames[0]:
            res = build_special(name, ws)
            if res:
                special, last_update = res
                continue
        it = build_item(name, ws)
        if it:
            items.append(it)
        else:
            skipped.append(name)
    if skipped:
        print('skipped sheets:', skipped)

    data = {
        'built': datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'),
        'lastUpdate': last_update,
        'source': os.path.basename(xlsx),
        'special': special,
        'items': items,
    }
    payload = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).replace('</', '<\\/')

    tpl_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, 'export_template.html')
    with open(tpl_path, encoding='utf-8') as f:
        html = f.read()
    html = html.replace('/*__DATA__*/null', payload)

    mmdd = (last_update or datetime.date.today().isoformat())[5:].replace('-', '')
    out = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, f'주요품목 수출 대시보드 {mmdd}.html')
    with open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(html)
    print('items:', len(items), ' size:', f'{os.path.getsize(out)/1e6:.1f}MB')
    print('saved ->', out)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""한울반도체 '주요 제품 등의 현황' 엑셀 생성 (연도별/분기별/모델별 상세)."""
import sys, io
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side

OUT = r"C:\Users\smily\Downloads\한울반도체_주요제품현황.xlsx"
FONT = "맑은 고딕"
NUMFMT = '#,##0;(#,##0);"-"'
PCTFMT = '0.0%'

hdr_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="D9E1F2")
seg_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="F2F2F2")
tot_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FCE4D6")
thin = Side(style="thin", color="BFBFBF")
border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)

def base_font(b=False, sz=10, color="000000"):
    return Font(name=FONT, bold=b, size=sz, color=color)

def style_sheet(ws):
    ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

def hcell(ws, r, c, v, bold=True, fill=hdr_fill, align="center"):
    cell = ws.cell(r, c, v)
    cell.font = base_font(b=bold)
    if fill: cell.fill = fill
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal=align, vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
    cell.border = border
    return cell

def vcell(ws, r, c, v, fmt=NUMFMT, bold=False, fill=None, align="right", color="000000"):
    cell = ws.cell(r, c, v)
    cell.font = base_font(b=bold, color=color)
    cell.number_format = fmt
    if fill: cell.fill = fill
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal=align, vertical="center")
    cell.border = border
    return cell
