# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""주도주 분석 — KR 데이터 pull.
  ka10081 일봉(20240901~20260531, 전종목) + ka10059 수급(dt=20260131, Oct-Jan 창).
  시총·업종 = sector_cap.json, 세부테마 = ../sector-report/theme_map.json.
  → judo_data/kr_raw.json
"""
import sys, io, os, json, time, threading, argparse
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)
import requests
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from judo_kiwoom import get_token, fetch_daily, fetch_supply, get_universe

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUTDIR = os.path.join(HERE, "judo_data")
os.makedirs(OUTDIR, exist_ok=True)

PRICE_START = "20231201"   # RS250 룩백 시드 (2025-01 스냅샷 대비)
PRICE_BASE  = "20260721"   # 2025-01 ~ 현재 전체 커버
SUPPLY_A_DT = "20260131"   # ka10059 → 2025-09~2026-01 (Oct-Jan 창 수급)


def load_meta():
    sc = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "sector_cap.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    cap, sector, pref = {}, {}, {}
    for mk in sc["markets"]:
        for s in sc["markets"][mk]["sectors"]:
            for st in s["stocks"]:
                cap[st["code"]] = st.get("cap")          # 억원
                sector[st["code"]] = s["sector"]         # 광의 업종
                pref[st["code"]] = st.get("pref", False)
    tm = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "..", "sector-report", "theme_map.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    theme = tm.get("code2theme", {})
    return cap, sector, pref, theme


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=5)
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="테스트용 종목수 제한")
    ap.add_argument("--supply", type=int, default=0, help="1이면 ka10059 수급도 pull")
    ap.add_argument("--merge", action="store_true", help="기존 kr_raw에 최근 봉만 병합(딥 히스토리 보존)")
    ap.add_argument("--start", default=PRICE_START, help="일봉 need_start (병합시 최근일자 권장)")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    start = "20250101" if args.merge and args.start == PRICE_START else args.start

    t0 = time.time()
    token = get_token()
    print("token OK")
    cap, sector, pref, theme = load_meta()
    print(f"메타: cap {len(cap)}, sector {len(sector)}, theme {len(theme)}")

    uni_raw = get_universe(token)
    codes = list(uni_raw.keys())
    if args.limit:
        codes = codes[:args.limit]
    print(f"유니버스(보통주) {len(codes)}종목")

    universe = {}
    for c in codes:
        universe[c] = {"name": uni_raw[c]["name"], "market": uni_raw[c]["market"],
                       "cap": cap.get(c), "sector": sector.get(c), "theme": theme.get(c)}

    sess = requests.Session()
    sess.mount("https://", requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter(
        pool_connections=args.workers * 2, pool_maxsize=args.workers * 2))

    prices, supplyA = {}, {}
    lock = threading.Lock()
    cnt = {"p": 0, "s": 0}

    base_dt = time.strftime("%Y%m%d") if args.merge else PRICE_BASE
    def pull_price(code):
        ser = fetch_daily(token, code, start, base_dt=base_dt, max_pages=8, sess=sess)
        ser = [r for r in ser if r["dt"] >= start]
        with lock:
            cnt["p"] += 1
            if ser:
                prices[code] = {"dt": [r["dt"] for r in ser],
                                "c": [r["close"] for r in ser],
                                "h": [r["high"] for r in ser],
                                "l": [r["low"] for r in ser],
                                "v": [r["val"] for r in ser]}   # 거래대금(백만원)
            if cnt["p"] % 400 == 0:
                print(f"  가격 {cnt['p']}/{len(codes)}  {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")

    def pull_supply(code):
        s = fetch_supply(token, code, SUPPLY_A_DT, sess=sess)
        with lock:
            cnt["s"] += 1
            if s:
                supplyA[code] = {"dt": [d["dt"] for d in s],
                                 "frgn": [d["frgnr_invsr"] for d in s],
                                 "orgn": [d["orgn"] for d in s]}
            if cnt["s"] % 400 == 0:
                print(f"  수급A {cnt['s']}/{len(codes)}  {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")

    print("[1/2] ka10081 일봉 pull...")
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.workers) as ex:
        list(ex.map(pull_price, codes))
    print(f"  가격 완료 {len(prices)}종목  {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")

    if args.supply:
        print("[2/2] ka10059 수급(Oct-Jan) pull...")
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.workers) as ex:
            list(ex.map(pull_supply, codes))
        print(f"  수급A 완료 {len(supplyA)}종목  {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
    else:
        print("[2/2] 수급 pull 생략(--supply 0)")

    path = os.path.join(OUTDIR, "kr_raw.json")
    if args.merge and os.path.exists(path):
        old = json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))
        op = old.get("prices", {})
        merged = 0
        for code, fresh in prices.items():
            if code in op:
                m = dict(zip(op[code]["dt"], zip(op[code]["c"], op[code]["h"],
                                                 op[code]["l"], op[code]["v"])))
                for i, dt in enumerate(fresh["dt"]):     # 최근 봉으로 갱신/추가
                    m[dt] = (fresh["c"][i], fresh["h"][i], fresh["l"][i], fresh["v"][i])
                dts = sorted(m.keys())
                prices[code] = {"dt": dts, "c": [m[d][0] for d in dts], "h": [m[d][1] for d in dts],
                                "l": [m[d][2] for d in dts], "v": [m[d][3] for d in dts]}
                merged += 1
        # 이번에 안 잡힌(거래정지 등) 기존 종목도 보존
        for code in op:
            if code not in prices:
                prices[code] = op[code]
        print(f"  병합: {merged}종목 갱신, 총 {len(prices)}")
        universe = {**old.get("universe", {}), **universe}
        supplyA = old.get("supplyA", supplyA)

    out = {"price_start": start if not args.merge else PRICE_START, "price_base": base_dt,
           "supplyA_dt": SUPPLY_A_DT, "fetched_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
           "universe": universe, "prices": prices, "supplyA": supplyA}
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    print(f"저장: {path}  ({os.path.getsize(path)/1e6:.1f} MB)  총 {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""주차별 주도 섹터 (상대강도 기준, 한국). 섹터강도=구성종목(유동성) 평균 주간수익률,
  RS=코스피 대비 초과. 주차별 상위 1-2 섹터를 월별로 그룹핑해 출력.
   * judo_score import가 stdout UTF-8 래핑(1회) 수행 — 본 스크립트는 재래핑 안 함.
"""
import os, json, bisect, datetime, statistics
from collections import defaultdict
from judo_score import kr_theme

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(HERE, "judo_data")
TL_START = "20250101"
TODAY = "20260721"
LIQ = 3000        # 백만원/일 = 30억
MINC = 4          # 섹터 최소 유동종목수
TOPN = 2


def iso_weeks(cal):
    wk = defaultdict(list)
    for d in cal:
        dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(d, "%Y%m%d").date()
        y, w, _ = dt.isocalendar()
        wk[(y, w)].append(d)
    return wk


def week_label(days):
    reps = [datetime.datetime.strptime(d, "%Y%m%d").date() for d in days]
    thu = next((r for r in reps if r.weekday() == 3), reps[len(reps) // 2])
    return thu, f"{thu.month}월 {(thu.day - 1)//7 + 1}주차"


def main():
    kr = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "kr_raw.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    mc = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "market_cache.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    kospi = mc["index"]["KOSPI"]
    uni = kr["universe"]; prices = kr["prices"]

    # 종목별 dt/close/val + 섹터
    P = {}
    for c, p in prices.items():
        if c not in uni:
            continue
        P[c] = {"dt": p["dt"], "c": p["c"], "v": p["v"], "sec": kr_theme(c, uni[c])}

    cal = sorted(kospi.keys())
    cal_pos = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(cal)}

    def asof(c, d):
        arr = P[c]["dt"]; j = bisect.bisect_right(arr, d) - 1
        return j if j >= 0 else None

    weeks = iso_weeks(cal)
    out_by_month = defaultdict(list)   # "YYYY년 M월" -> [(wlabel, [(sec,rs,n),...])]
    for key in sorted(weeks.keys()):
        days = sorted(weeks[key])
        thu, wlabel = week_label(days)
        reps = thu.strftime("%Y%m%d")
        if not (TL_START <= reps <= TODAY):
            continue
        start, end = days[0], days[-1]
        si = cal_pos[start]
        base = cal[si - 1] if si > 0 else start
        # 코스피 주간수익률
        a = kospi.get(base); b = kospi.get(end)
        mret = (b["idx"] / a["idx"] - 1) * 100 if a and b and a["idx"] else 0.0

        sec_rets = defaultdict(list)
        for c in P:
            je = asof(c, end); jb = asof(c, base)
            if je is None or jb is None:
                continue
            ce = P[c]["c"][je]; cb = P[c]["c"][jb]
            if cb <= 0 or ce <= 0:
                continue
            # 유동성: 주중 일평균 거래대금
            vals = []
            for d in days:
                jd = asof(c, d)
                if jd is not None and P[c]["dt"][jd] == d:
                    vals.append(P[c]["v"][jd])
            if not vals or sum(vals) / len(vals) < LIQ:
                continue
            sec_rets[P[c]["sec"]].append((ce / cb - 1) * 100)

        ranked = []
        for sec, rets in sec_rets.items():
            if sec in ("기타",) or len(rets) < MINC:
                continue
            m = statistics.mean(rets)
            ranked.append((sec, m - mret, len(rets), statistics.median(rets)))
        ranked.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
        top = ranked[:TOPN]
        ym = f"{thu.year}년 {thu.month}월"
        out_by_month[ym].append((wlabel, top, mret))

    for ym in out_by_month:
        print(f"\n[{ym}]")
        for wlabel, top, mret in out_by_month[ym]:
            secs = "  ·  ".join(f"{s} (RS +{rs:.0f}%p)" for s, rs, n, med in top) if top else "(해당없음)"
            print(f"  {wlabel}: {secs}")

    # JSON도 저장
    js = {ym: [{"week": wl, "market_ret": round(mr, 1),
                "sectors": [{"sec": s, "rs": round(rs, 1), "n": n, "median": round(md, 1)}
                            for s, rs, n, md in top]}
               for wl, top, mr in rows]
          for ym, rows in out_by_month.items()}
    json.dump(js, open(os.path.join(DATA, "kr_lead_sectors.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8"),
              ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
judo_kr_supply.py주도주 풀버전 — KR 수급 pull (금액 기준, 양 구간).71줄 · 2KB · 2026-07-27
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""주도주 풀버전 — KR 수급 pull (금액 기준, 양 구간).
  ka10059 amt=0(금액,백만원): dt=20260131(A), dt=20260531(B).
  각 종목 구간 누적 (외국인+기관계) 순매수 금액(백만원) 저장.
  → judo_data/kr_supply.json
"""
import sys, io, os, json, time, threading
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)
import requests
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from judo_kiwoom import get_token, fetch_supply

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(HERE, "judo_data")

WINDOWS = {"A": ("20260131", "20251001", "20260131"),
           "B": ("20260531", "20260301", "20260531")}
WORKERS = 5


def main():
    token = get_token()
    print("token OK")
    raw = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "kr_raw.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    codes = list(raw["universe"].keys())
    print(f"대상 {len(codes)}종목")

    sess = requests.Session()
    sess.mount("https://", requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter(
        pool_connections=WORKERS * 2, pool_maxsize=WORKERS * 2))

    result = {}   # code -> {A: net_bmw, B: net_bmw}
    t0 = time.time()
    for wk, (base_dt, ws, we) in WINDOWS.items():
        net = {}
        lock = threading.Lock()
        cnt = {"n": 0}

        def pull(code):
            s = fetch_supply(token, code, base_dt, amt="0", sess=sess)
            v = None
            if s:
                tot = 0
                for d in s:
                    if ws <= d["dt"] <= we:
                        tot += d["frgnr_invsr"] + d["orgn"]   # 외국인+기관계 (백만원)
                v = tot
            with lock:
                cnt["n"] += 1
                if v is not None:
                    net[code] = v
                if cnt["n"] % 500 == 0:
                    print(f"  [{wk}] {cnt['n']}/{len(codes)}  {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")

        print(f"[{wk}] dt={base_dt} 수급 pull...")
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
            list(ex.map(pull, codes))
        for c, v in net.items():
            result.setdefault(c, {})[wk] = v
        print(f"  [{wk}] 완료 {len(net)}종목  {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")

    out = {"unit": "백만원(외국인+기관계 누적순매수)", "windows": {k: v[1:] for k, v in WINDOWS.items()},
           "net": result}
    path = os.path.join(DATA, "kr_supply.json")
    json.dump(out, open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    print(f"저장: {path}  ({os.path.getsize(path)/1e6:.1f} MB)  총 {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""주차별 주도주 정리 (KR).
  각 거래주(週)마다: 시장 초과수익 + 거래대금(유동성) + 지속모멘텀 + 신고가로
  주도주를 뽑아 테마(섹터)별로 묶어 텍스트 출력.
  기간: 2025-10~2026-01, 2026-03~2026-05.
"""
import sys, io, os, json, argparse, bisect, datetime
from collections import defaultdict
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(HERE, "judo_data")

PERIODS = [("2025-10 ~ 2026-01", "20251001", "20260131"),
           ("2026-03 ~ 2026-05", "20260301", "20260531")]

# ── 테마 오버레이 (GICS로 흩어지는 대표 테마만 큐레이션) ──
OVERLAY = {
    "원전": ["034020", "052690", "051600", "032820", "083650", "105840", "046120",
             "189860", "388050", "017960", "064820"],
    "2차전지": ["247540", "086520", "003670", "066970", "373220", "006400", "121600",
               "393890", "365340", "005070", "278280", "078600", "348370", "137400",
               "020150", "457190"],
    "로봇": ["454910", "277810", "058610", "388720", "348340", "056080", "108490"],
}
CODE2OVL = {c: th for th, cs in OVERLAY.items() for c in cs}

RELABEL = {
    "반도체와반도체장비": "반도체", "우주항공과국방": "방산", "게임엔터테인먼트": "게임",
    "방송과엔터테인먼트": "미디어/엔터", "양방향미디어와서비스": "인터넷/플랫폼",
    "생물공학": "바이오", "제약": "제약", "생명과학도구및서비스": "바이오",
    "디스플레이장비및부품": "디스플레이", "디스플레이패널": "디스플레이",
    "자동차부품": "자동차부품", "자동차": "자동차", "조선": "조선", "해운사": "해운",
    "은행": "은행", "증권": "증권", "손해보험": "보험", "생명보험": "보험",
    "화장품": "화장품", "철강": "철강", "비철금속": "비철금속", "화학": "화학",
    "기계": "기계", "전기제품": "전기제품", "전기장비": "전기장비", "건설": "건설",
    "식품": "음식료", "음료": "음식료", "소프트웨어": "소프트웨어", "IT서비스": "IT서비스",
    "통신장비": "통신장비", "핸드셋": "핸드셋", "전자장비와기기": "전자장비",
    "건강관리장비와용품": "의료기기", "건강관리업체및서비스": "헬스케어",
    "섬유,의류,신발,호화품": "의류/패션", "호텔,레스토랑,레저": "레저/여행",
    "석유와가스": "정유/에너지", "에너지장비및서비스": "정유/에너지",
}


def theme_of(code, uni):
    if code in CODE2OVL:
        return CODE2OVL[code]
    th = uni.get(code, {}).get("theme")
    if th:
        return RELABEL.get(th, th)
    return uni.get(code, {}).get("sector") or "기타"


def iso_weeks(cal):
    """cal(정렬된 YYYYMMDD) → {(isoyear,isoweek): [dts]}."""
    wk = defaultdict(list)
    for d in cal:
        dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(d, "%Y%m%d").date()
        y, w, _ = dt.isocalendar()
        wk[(y, w)].append(d)
    return wk


def week_label(days):
    """주(週)의 대표일(목요일 우선)로 '월 주차' 라벨."""
    reps = [datetime.datetime.strptime(d, "%Y%m%d").date() for d in days]
    thu = [r for r in reps if r.weekday() == 3]
    rep = thu[0] if thu else reps[len(reps) // 2]
    return rep, f"{rep.month}월 {(rep.day - 1)//7 + 1}주차"


def build_newhigh_sets(prices, win=60):
    """종목별 60일 신고가(고가기준) 달성 dt 집합."""
    out = {}
    for c, p in prices.items():
        h = p["h"]; dts = p["dt"]; s = set()
        mx = -1
        from collections import deque
        dq = deque()  # (idx) 유지 max — 단순 슬라이딩
        for i in range(len(h)):
            lo = max(0, i - win + 1)
            wmax = max(h[lo:i + 1]) if i - lo < win else None
            if h[i] >= (wmax if wmax is not None else h[i]):
                s.add(dts[i])
        out[c] = s
    return out


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--liq", type=float, default=10000, help="주 평균 일거래대금 최소(백만원). 10000=100억")
    ap.add_argument("--min-ret", type=float, default=3.0, help="주간 수익률 최소%")
    ap.add_argument("--w-turn", type=float, default=0.45, help="거래대금 가중(0~1), 나머지는 초과수익")
    ap.add_argument("--top-per-theme", type=int, default=4)
    ap.add_argument("--max-themes", type=int, default=5)
    ap.add_argument("--topn", type=int, default=28, help="주당 주도주 상한")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    raw = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "kr_raw.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    uni = raw["universe"]; prices = raw["prices"]
    mc = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "market_cache.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    idx = mc["index"]  # {KOSPI:{dt:{idx,flu}}, KOSDAQ:{...}}

    # 거래 캘린더 = KOSPI 지수 날짜
    cal = sorted(idx["KOSPI"].keys())
    cal_pos = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(cal)}

    # 종목별 정렬 dt + asof 조회 준비
    pdt = {c: p["dt"] for c, p in prices.items()}
    pc = {c: p["c"] for c, p in prices.items()}
    pv = {c: p["v"] for c, p in prices.items()}

    def asof(c, d):
        """d 이하 마지막 종가 (idx, dt, close). 없으면 None."""
        arr = pdt.get(c)
        if not arr:
            return None
        j = bisect.bisect_right(arr, d) - 1
        if j < 0:
            return None
        return j

    nh = build_newhigh_sets(prices)

    def mkt_ret(market, base, end):
        a = idx[market].get(base); b = idx[market].get(end)
        if not a or not b or not a["idx"]:
            return 0.0
        return (b["idx"] / a["idx"] - 1) * 100

    weeks = iso_weeks(cal)
    wk_keys = sorted(weeks.keys())

    periods_out = []
    for title, ps, pe in PERIODS:
        print("\n" + "=" * 46)
        print(f"■ {title}")
        print("=" * 46)
        weeks_out = []
        for key in wk_keys:
            days = sorted(weeks[key])
            rep, label = week_label(days)
            reps = rep.strftime("%Y%m%d")
            if not (ps <= reps <= pe):
                continue
            start = days[0]; end = days[-1]
            si = cal_pos[start]
            base = cal[si - 1] if si > 0 else start   # 전주 마지막 거래일
            ei = cal_pos[end]
            b4 = cal[max(0, ei - 20)]                  # ~4주 전

            cands = []
            for c, p in prices.items():
                je = asof(c, end); jb = asof(c, base)
                if je is None or jb is None:
                    continue
                ce = pc[c][je]; cb = pc[c][jb]
                if cb <= 0 or ce <= 0:
                    continue
                # 상장/거래정지로 base가 너무 과거면 스킵
                if pdt[c][jb] < base and (cal_pos.get(end, 0) - cal_pos.get(pdt[c][jb], 0)) > 8:
                    pass
                wret = (ce / cb - 1) * 100
                # 유동성: 주중 일평균 거래대금
                wk_days = [d for d in days if d in cal_pos]
                vals = []
                for d in wk_days:
                    jd = asof(c, d)
                    if jd is not None and pdt[c][jd] == d:
                        vals.append(pv[c][jd])
                if not vals:
                    continue
                avgval = sum(vals) / len(vals)
                if avgval < args.liq:
                    continue
                turn = sum(vals)  # 주간 총 거래대금(백만원)
                j4 = asof(c, b4)
                mom4 = (ce / pc[c][j4] - 1) * 100 if j4 is not None and pc[c][j4] > 0 else 0.0
                newhigh = any(d in nh.get(c, ()) for d in wk_days)
                mret = mkt_ret(uni[c]["market"], base, end)
                excess = wret - mret
                # 주도주 조건: 초과수익>0, 주간 수익률 충분, 지속(4주모멘텀>0) or 신고가
                if excess <= 0 or wret < args.min_ret:
                    continue
                if not (mom4 > 0 or newhigh):
                    continue
                cands.append({"c": c, "name": uni[c]["name"], "theme": theme_of(c, uni),
                              "wret": wret, "excess": excess, "avgval": avgval, "turn": turn,
                              "nh": newhigh, "mom4": mom4})
            if not cands:
                print(f"\n[{label}]  (주도주 없음)")
                weeks_out.append({"label": label, "date": reps, "sectors": []})
                continue
            # 주도주 스코어 = 초과수익 백분위 + 거래대금 백분위 (돈이 쏠린 대장 우선)
            exc_sorted = sorted(x["excess"] for x in cands)
            turn_sorted = sorted(x["turn"] for x in cands)
            def pctl(arr, v):
                return bisect.bisect_left(arr, v) / max(len(arr) - 1, 1) * 100
            for x in cands:
                x["score"] = ((1 - args.w_turn) * pctl(exc_sorted, x["excess"])
                              + args.w_turn * pctl(turn_sorted, x["turn"]))
            cands.sort(key=lambda x: -x["score"])
            cands = cands[:args.topn]

            by_theme = defaultdict(list)
            for x in cands:
                by_theme[x["theme"]].append(x)
            ordered = sorted(by_theme.items(),
                             key=lambda kv: -sum(i["score"] for i in kv[1]))
            print(f"\n[{label}]")
            sectors_out = []
            for th, items in ordered[:args.max_themes]:
                items.sort(key=lambda x: -x["score"])
                stocks = [{"n": i["name"], "wret": round(i["wret"], 0), "nh": i["nh"]}
                          for i in items[:args.top_per_theme]]
                sectors_out.append({"theme": th, "stocks": stocks})
                print(f"\n{th}:")
                for i in items[:args.top_per_theme]:
                    print(f"{i['name']}  (+{i['wret']:.0f}%{' ★' if i['nh'] else ''})")
            weeks_out.append({"label": label, "date": reps, "sectors": sectors_out})
        periods_out.append({"title": title, "weeks": weeks_out})

    out = {"generated": __import__("time").strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
           "params": {"liq": args.liq, "min_ret": args.min_ret, "w_turn": args.w_turn,
                      "top_per_theme": args.top_per_theme, "max_themes": args.max_themes},
           "periods": periods_out}
    jpath = os.path.join(DATA, "kr_weekly.json")
    json.dump(out, open(jpath, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
    print(f"\nJSON 저장: {jpath}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

judo_regime.py변동성 국면 로테이션 트래커 데이터.136줄 · 5KB · 2026-08-21
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""변동성 국면 로테이션 트래커 데이터.
  주간 코스피/코스닥 수익률·스프레드(국면시계) + 섹터RS 상위2 + 국면태그 + 월별 대형대장주(주봉).
  → judo_data/regime.json    * judo_score import가 stdout UTF-8 래핑 1회.
"""
import os, json, bisect, datetime, statistics
from collections import defaultdict
from judo_score import kr_theme

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(HERE, "judo_data")
TL_START = "20250101"
# 최신 거래일 = market_cache 지수 캘린더의 마지막 날짜 (매일 저녁 cron 갱신)
TODAY = max(json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "market_cache.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["index"]["KOSPI"])
LIQ = 3000; MINC = 4
SEMI_BROAD = {"반도체", "반도체장비", "전자장비", "전자부품"}


def phase(kospi, kosdaq, spread, topsecs, month_semi):
    tset = {s for s, _ in topsecs}
    if kospi is not None and kosdaq is not None and kospi <= -3 and kosdaq <= -3:
        return "shock", "공포·조정"
    semi_now = bool(tset & SEMI_BROAD) or month_semi
    if spread <= -2 and semi_now:
        return "semi", "반도체·대형 주도"
    if spread <= -5:
        return "semi", "대형(반도체·AI) 주도"
    if spread <= -2:
        return "large", "코스피 대형 확산"
    if spread >= 2:
        return "small", "코스닥·중소형 반등"
    return "mix", "혼조·전환"


NEXT_HINT = {
    "shock": "다음 국면: 낙폭과대 코스닥·중소형 우선 반등(①) 관찰",
    "small": "다음 국면: 큰돈 이동 → 코스피 대형 경기민감 확산(②)",
    "large": "다음 국면: 반도체·AI 대형 재주도(③)",
    "semi":  "다음 국면: 반도체 휴식·새 테마 확산(④) 또는 과열 경계",
    "mix":   "방향 탐색 국면 — 스프레드 부호 전환 대기",
}


def main():
    kr = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "kr_raw.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    mc = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "market_cache.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    KS = mc["index"]["KOSPI"]; KQ = mc["index"]["KOSDAQ"]
    uni = kr["universe"]; prices = kr["prices"]
    P = {}
    for c, p in prices.items():
        if c in uni:
            P[c] = {"dt": p["dt"], "c": p["c"], "v": p["v"], "sec": kr_theme(c, uni[c])}

    # 월별 대장주 → 그 달 반도체·전자 대형 리더 여부 (semi 국면 판정 보조)
    flow = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "flow.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    months = [{"label": mo["label"], "ym": mo["ym"], "reps": mo.get("reps", [])}
              for mo in flow["markets"]["KR"]["months"]]
    ym_semi = {mo["ym"]: any(r.get("theme") in SEMI_BROAD for r in mo["reps"]) for mo in months}

    cal = sorted(KS.keys()); pos = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(cal)}

    def asof(c, d):
        arr = P[c]["dt"]; j = bisect.bisect_right(arr, d) - 1
        return j if j >= 0 else None

    def iret(idx, base, end):
        a = idx.get(base); b = idx.get(end)
        return round((b["idx"] / a["idx"] - 1) * 100, 1) if a and b and a["idx"] else None

    weeks = defaultdict(list)
    for d in cal:
        dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(d, "%Y%m%d").date()
        y, w, _ = dt.isocalendar(); weeks[(y, w)].append(d)

    wout = []
    for key in sorted(weeks):
        days = sorted(weeks[key])
        reps = [datetime.datetime.strptime(d, "%Y%m%d").date() for d in days]
        thu = next((r for r in reps if r.weekday() == 3), reps[len(reps) // 2])
        ds = thu.strftime("%Y%m%d")
        if not (TL_START <= ds <= TODAY):
            continue
        start, end = days[0], days[-1]
        si = pos[start]; base = cal[si - 1] if si > 0 else start
        ks = iret(KS, base, end); kq = iret(KQ, base, end)
        spread = round((kq - ks), 1) if ks is not None and kq is not None else 0.0
        # 섹터 RS
        sec_rets = defaultdict(list)
        for c in P:
            je = asof(c, end); jb = asof(c, base)
            if je is None or jb is None:
                continue
            ce = P[c]["c"][je]; cb = P[c]["c"][jb]
            if cb <= 0 or ce <= 0:
                continue
            vals = [P[c]["v"][asof(c, d)] for d in days
                    if asof(c, d) is not None and P[c]["dt"][asof(c, d)] == d]
            if not vals or sum(vals) / len(vals) < LIQ:
                continue
            sec_rets[P[c]["sec"]].append((ce / cb - 1) * 100)
        ranked = []
        for sec, rets in sec_rets.items():
            if sec == "기타" or len(rets) < MINC:
                continue
            ranked.append((sec, round(statistics.mean(rets) - (ks or 0), 1)))
        ranked.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
        top = ranked[:2]
        ym = f"{thu.year}{thu.month:02d}"
        ph, phl = phase(ks, kq, spread, top, ym_semi.get(ym, False))
        wout.append({"date": ds, "ym": ym,
                     "wlabel": f"{int(start[4:6])}/{int(start[6:8])}~{int(end[4:6])}/{int(end[6:8])}",
                     "mlabel": f"{thu.year}.{thu.month:02d}", "ndays": len(days),
                     "kospi": ks, "kosdaq": kq, "spread": spread,
                     "sectors": [{"s": s, "rs": rs} for s, rs in top],
                     "phase": ph, "phaseLabel": phl})

    # 현재 국면 = 마지막 완결주(거래일 4일 이상)
    complete = [w for w in wout if w["ndays"] >= 4]
    cur = complete[-1] if complete else (wout[-1] if wout else None)
    cur_hint = NEXT_HINT.get(cur["phase"], "") if cur else ""

    cand = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "kr_candles.json"), encoding="utf-8"))

    out = {"generated": __import__("time").strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
           "weeks": wout, "current": cur, "current_hint": cur_hint,
           "months": months, "candles": cand}
    path = os.path.join(DATA, "regime.json")
    json.dump(out, open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    print("주수:", len(wout), "| 최신:", cur["wlabel"] if cur else None,
          cur["phaseLabel"] if cur else None)
    print("저장:", path, f"({os.path.getsize(path)/1024:.0f} KB)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

reg = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "regime.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
payload = json.dumps(reg, ensure_ascii=False)

</style></head><body><div class="wrap">
<h1>변동성 국면 로테이션 트래커</h1>
<div class="sub">공포(변동성) 고점 이후의 주도권 이동을 추적. 국면시계 = <b>코스닥−코스피 주간 스프레드</b> (＋ 코스닥·중소형 우위 → − 코스피 대형/반도체 우위).</div>
<div class="meta" id="meta"></div>

<div id="nowbox"></div>

<div class="sect">국면 시계</div>
<div class="card">
  <div class="ct">코스피 궤적 (누적, 100 기준)</div><div class="cs">급락 구간 = 공포/변동성 스파이크</div>
  <div id="cum"></div>
  <div class="ct" style="margin-top:12px">국면 스프레드 (코스닥−코스피, %p)</div>
  <div class="cs">막대 위(＋)=코스닥·중소형 우선 / 아래(−)=코스피 대형·반도체 우위 · 색=국면</div>
  <div id="clock"></div>
  <div class="legend" id="legend"></div>
</div>

<div class="sect">주간 로테이션 로그</div>
<div class="card" style="max-height:520px;overflow:auto;padding-top:4px">
<table><thead><tr><th class="l">주</th><th>코스피</th><th>코스닥</th><th>스프레드</th><th class="l">국면</th><th class="l">주도 섹터 (RS)</th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="wtable"></tbody></table>
</div>

<div class="sect">월별 대형 대장주 · 주봉 <button class="toggle" id="repToggle">펼치기</button></div>
<div id="reps" style="display:none"></div>
</div>
<script>
const D = __PAYLOAD__;
const PC = {shock:'--p-shock',small:'--p-small',large:'--p-large',semi:'--p-semi',mix:'--p-mix'};
const PL = {shock:'공포·조정',small:'코스닥·중소형 반등',large:'코스피 대형 확산',semi:'반도체·대형 주도',mix:'혼조·전환'};
document.getElementById('meta').textContent='생성 '+D.generated+' · 2025.01~현재 '+D.weeks.length+'주 · 규칙기반 국면(참고용)';

/* 현재 국면 콜아웃 */
(function(){
  const c=D.current; if(!c) return;
  const col='var('+PC[c.phase]+')';
  const secs=c.sectors.map(s=>s.s).join(' · ');
  document.getElementById('nowbox').innerHTML='<div class="now" style="border-left-color:'+col+'">'
    +'<div class="lab">현재 국면 · '+c.mlabel+' ('+c.wlabel+')</div>'
    +'<div class="ph" style="color:'+col+'">'+c.phaseLabel+'</div>'
    +'<div class="det">코스피 '+c.kospi+'% · 코스닥 '+c.kosdaq+'% · 스프레드 '+(c.spread>0?'+':'')+c.spread+'%p · 주도 '+secs+'</div>'
    +'<div class="hint">▶ '+D.current_hint+'</div></div>';
})();

/* 누적 코스피 라인 */
(function(){
  const W=880,H=96,PT=8,PB=10; const ws=D.weeks;
  let cum=100; const cums=ws.map(w=>{cum*=(1+(w.kospi||0)/100);return cum;});
  const lo=Math.min(...cums),hi=Math.max(...cums);
  const x=i=>i/(ws.length-1)*W, y=v=>PT+(hi-v)/((hi-lo)||1)*(H-PT-PB);
  let s='<svg viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" preserveAspectRatio="none">';
  ws.forEach((w,i)=>{ if(w.phase==='shock') s+='<rect x="'+(x(i)-2)+'" y="0" width="4" height="'+H+'" fill="rgba(198,95,82,.16)"/>'; });
  let pts=cums.map((v,i)=>x(i).toFixed(1)+','+y(v).toFixed(1)).join(' ');
  s+='<polyline points="'+pts+'" fill="none" stroke="var(--gold)" stroke-width="1.6"/>';
  s+='</svg>'; document.getElementById('cum').innerHTML=s;
})();

/* 국면 스프레드 막대 */
(function(){
  const W=880,H=118,ZY=59; const ws=D.weeks;
  const mx=Math.min(18,Math.max(...ws.map(w=>Math.abs(w.spread||0))))||10;
  const bw=W/ws.length;
  let s='<svg viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" preserveAspectRatio="none">';
  s+='<line x1="0" x2="'+W+'" y1="'+ZY+'" y2="'+ZY+'" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="1"/>';
  ws.forEach((w,i)=>{
    const sp=Math.max(-mx,Math.min(mx,w.spread||0)); const h=Math.abs(sp)/mx*(ZY-6);
    const yy=sp>=0?ZY-h:ZY; const col='var('+PC[w.phase]+')';
    s+='<rect x="'+(i*bw+bw*0.12).toFixed(1)+'" y="'+yy.toFixed(1)+'" width="'+(bw*0.76).toFixed(1)+'" height="'+Math.max(1,h).toFixed(1)+'" fill="'+col+'"><title>'+w.mlabel+' '+w.wlabel+'  스프레드 '+w.spread+'%p  '+w.phaseLabel+'</title></rect>';
  });
  // 월 라벨
  let lastM='';
  ws.forEach((w,i)=>{ if(w.ym!==lastM && w.ym.slice(4)==='01' || (w.ym!==lastM && i%8===0)){ lastM=w.ym; s+='<text x="'+(i*bw+2)+'" y="'+(H-2)+'" fill="var(--dim2)" font-size="8">'+w.ym.slice(0,4)+'.'+w.ym.slice(4)+'</text>'; }});
  s+='</svg>'; document.getElementById('clock').innerHTML=s;
  document.getElementById('legend').innerHTML=Object.keys(PL).map(k=>'<span><b style="background:var('+PC[k]+')"></b>'+PL[k]+'</span>').join('');
})();

/* 주간 표 (최신 먼저, 월 헤더) */
(function(){
  let h='',lastM='';
  D.weeks.slice().reverse().forEach(w=>{
    if(w.mlabel!==lastM){ lastM=w.mlabel; h+='<tr class="mrow"><td class="l" colspan="6">'+w.mlabel+'</td></tr>'; }
    const kc=w.kospi>=0?'pos':'neg', qc=w.kosdaq>=0?'pos':'neg', sc=w.spread>=0?'pos':'neg';
    const col='var('+PC[w.phase]+')';
    const secs=w.sectors.map(x=>x.s+' <span style="color:var(--dim2)">'+(x.rs>=0?'+':'')+x.rs+'</span>').join(' · ')||'-';
    h+='<tr><td class="l">'+w.wlabel+(w.ndays<4?' <span style="color:var(--dim2)">(부분)</span>':'')+'</td>'
      +'<td class="'+kc+'">'+(w.kospi>=0?'+':'')+w.kospi+'</td>'
      +'<td class="'+qc+'">'+(w.kosdaq>=0?'+':'')+w.kosdaq+'</td>'
      +'<td class="'+sc+'">'+(w.spread>=0?'+':'')+w.spread+'</td>'
      +'<td class="l"><span class="pchip" style="background:'+col+'">'+w.phaseLabel+'</span></td>'
      +'<td class="l secs">'+secs+'</td></tr>';
  });
  document.getElementById('wtable').innerHTML=h;
})();

/* 월별 대장주 + 주봉 (토글) */
function ymIdx(ym){return (+ym.slice(0,4))*12+(+ym.slice(4,6));}
function candlesFor(code,repYm){const rec=D.candles[code];if(!rec)return null;const ri=ymIdx(repYm);return rec.candles.filter(k=>{const i=ymIdx(k.ym);return i>=ri-4&&i<=ri+2;});}
function drawC(cs,repYm){if(!cs||cs.length<2)return'';const W=660,H=104,PT=8,PB=8;const lo=Math.min(...cs.map(c=>c.l)),hi=Math.max(...cs.map(c=>c.h));const y=v=>PT+(hi-v)/((hi-lo)||1)*(H-PT-PB);const cw=W/cs.length,bw=Math.max(2,cw*0.6);let s='<svg viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" preserveAspectRatio="none">';cs.forEach((c,i)=>{if(c.ym===repYm)s+='<rect x="'+(i*cw).toFixed(1)+'" y="0" width="'+cw.toFixed(1)+'" height="'+H+'" fill="var(--gold-soft)"/>';});cs.forEach((c,i)=>{const cx=i*cw+cw/2,up=c.c>=c.o,col=up?'var(--up)':'var(--dn)';s+='<line x1="'+cx.toFixed(1)+'" x2="'+cx.toFixed(1)+'" y1="'+y(c.h).toFixed(1)+'" y2="'+y(c.l).toFixed(1)+'" stroke="'+col+'" stroke-width="1"/>';const yo=y(c.o),yc=y(c.c);s+='<rect x="'+(cx-bw/2).toFixed(1)+'" y="'+Math.min(yo,yc).toFixed(1)+'" width="'+bw.toFixed(1)+'" height="'+Math.max(1.4,Math.abs(yo-yc)).toFixed(1)+'" fill="'+col+'"/>';});return s+'</svg>';}
function renderReps(){
  return D.months.slice().reverse().map(mo=>{
    const reps=(mo.reps||[]).map(r=>{
      const cs=candlesFor(r.code,mo.ym); const rc=r.monthret>=0?'up':'dn';
      const rv=r.monthret==null?'':(r.monthret>=0?'+':'')+r.monthret+'%';
      const capj=r.cap?(r.cap>=100000?Math.round(r.cap/10000):(r.cap/10000).toFixed(1))+'조':'';
      return '<div class="rep"><div class="rhd"><span class="rn">'+r.name+'</span><span class="rt">'+r.theme+'</span>'
        +(capj?'<span class="rc">시총 '+capj+'</span>':'')+'<span class="rr '+rc+'">'+rv+'</span><span class="rw">'+r.nweeks+'주</span></div>'
        +'<div class="chart">'+drawC(cs,mo.ym)+'</div></div>';
    }).join('');
    return '<div class="mcard"><div class="mhd">'+mo.label+'</div>'+reps+'</div>';
  }).join('');
}
const rt=document.getElementById('repToggle');
rt.onclick=()=>{const box=document.getElementById('reps');if(box.style.display==='none'){if(!box.innerHTML)box.innerHTML=renderReps();box.style.display='block';rt.textContent='접기';}else{box.style.display='none';rt.textContent='펼치기';}};
</script></body></html>"""

judo_rs_stocks_time.pyRS 타임머신 — 개별종목 스냅샷 (KR·US, 월말 2025.01~현재).165줄 · 6KB · 2026-07-27
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""RS 타임머신 — 개별종목 스냅샷 (KR·US, 월말 2025.01~현재).
  개별종목 RS(rs_build.build_kr_stocks 방식): RS종합 = 0.5·R60 + 0.3·R120 + 0.2·R250 백분위,
  주도주 = RS종합 상위, 떠오르는 = RS20≥70 & RS종합<85 & 거래대금 컷.
  → judo_data/rs_time_stocks.json
   * judo_score import가 stdout UTF-8 래핑 1회.
"""
import os, json, bisect, time
from collections import defaultdict
from judo_score import kr_theme, us_theme

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(HERE, "judo_data")
SNAP_FROM = "202501"
N_LEAD = 40
N_RISE = 15


import datetime
def snapshot_dates(bdts):
    """주말(각 ISO주 마지막 거래일) 스냅샷. 대표=목요일. 2025-01~. 마지막=현재주(당일)."""
    byw = {}
    for i, d in enumerate(bdts):
        dt = datetime.date(int(d[:4]), int(d[4:6]), int(d[6:8]))
        y, w, _ = dt.isocalendar(); byw[(y, w)] = i
    out = []
    for (y, w), i in sorted(byw.items()):
        thu = datetime.date.fromisocalendar(y, w, 4)
        if thu < datetime.date(2025, 1, 1):
            continue
        out.append({"i": i, "date": bdts[i],
                    "label": f"{thu.year % 100:02d}.{thu.month:02d} {(thu.day - 1)//7 + 1}주",
                    "ym": f"{thu.year}{thu.month:02d}"})
    if out:
        out[-1]["live"] = True
    return out


def _ddiff(a, b):
    """YYYYMMDD 두 날짜의 일수 차 |a-b|."""
    da = datetime.date(int(a[:4]), int(a[4:6]), int(a[6:8]))
    db = datetime.date(int(b[:4]), int(b[4:6]), int(b[6:8]))
    return abs((da - db).days)


def pct_rank(sorted_vals, v):
    n = len(sorted_vals)
    if n < 2:
        return 50.0
    return round(bisect.bisect_left(sorted_vals, v) / (n - 1) * 100, 1)


def build(prices, universe, bdts, theme_fn, val_of, liq_min, rise_liq, name_of, cap_of):
    """prices: code->{dt,c,...}; val_of(code,j)->거래대금(표시단위); 반환 스냅샷 리스트."""
    snaps_out = []
    for sn in snapshot_dates(bdts):
        snap_d = sn["date"]
        recs = []
        for code, p in prices.items():
            dts = p["dt"]; c = p["c"]
            j = bisect.bisect_right(dts, snap_d) - 1
            if j < 60 or _ddiff(dts[j], snap_d) > 12:   # 최근 미거래(상폐·장기정지) 제외
                continue
            if c[j] <= 0:
                continue
            def ret(w):
                return (c[j] / c[j - w] - 1) * 100 if j - w >= 0 and c[j - w] > 0 else None
            r20, r60, r120, r250 = ret(20), ret(60), ret(120), ret(250)
            if r20 is None or r60 is None:
                continue
            comp = 0.5 * r60 + 0.3 * (r120 if r120 is not None else r60) + 0.2 * (r250 if r250 is not None else r60)
            v20 = sum(val_of(code, k) for k in range(max(0, j - 19), j + 1)) / min(20, j + 1)
            if v20 < liq_min:
                continue
            recs.append({"c": code, "r20": r20, "r60": r60, "comp": comp, "v20": v20})
        if len(recs) < 50:
            continue
        a20 = sorted(r["r20"] for r in recs)
        ac = sorted(r["comp"] for r in recs)
        av = sorted(r["v20"] for r in recs)
        for r in recs:
            r["rs20"] = pct_rank(a20, r["r20"])
            r["rsc"] = pct_rank(ac, r["comp"])
            r["acc"] = round(r["rs20"] - r["rsc"], 1)
            vs = pct_rank(av, r["v20"])
            r["score"] = round(0.45 * r["rs20"] + 0.35 * min(max(50 + r["acc"], 0), 100) + 0.20 * vs, 1)
        def slim(r):
            u = universe[r["c"]]
            return {"c": r["c"], "n": name_of(r["c"]), "th": theme_fn(r["c"], u),
                    "cap": cap_of(r["c"]),
                    "r60": round(r["r60"], 0), "rsc": r["rsc"], "rs20": r["rs20"],
                    "acc": r["acc"], "v20": round(r["v20"], 0), "score": r["score"]}
        leaders = [slim(r) for r in sorted(recs, key=lambda x: -x["rsc"])[:N_LEAD]]
        lead_set = {r["c"] for r in leaders}
        risers = [slim(r) for r in sorted(
            (r for r in recs if r["c"] not in lead_set and r["rsc"] < 85
             and r["rs20"] >= 70 and r["v20"] >= rise_liq),
            key=lambda x: -x["score"])[:N_RISE]]
        snaps_out.append({"ym": sn["ym"], "label": sn["label"], "date": snap_d,
                          "n_uni": len(recs), "leaders": leaders, "risers": risers,
                          **({"live": True} if sn.get("live") else {})})
    print(f"  {len(snaps_out)}주 스냅샷")
    return snaps_out


METHOD = ("개별종목 RS: RS종합 = 0.5·R60 + 0.3·R120 + 0.2·R250 스냅샷 시점 백분위(룩백 부족분은 "
          "R60 대체) · 주도주 = RS종합 상위 · 떠오르는 = RS20 ≥ 70 & RS종합 < 85 & 거래대금 컷 · "
          "가속 = RS20 − RS종합 · 주말(주간) 스냅샷·현재주=당일 기준")


def cal_from_prices(prices):
    """가장 긴 종목 dt를 거래 캘린더로(당일 포함 보장)."""
    return max((p["dt"] for p in prices.values()), key=len)


def build_kr(out):
    kr = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "kr_raw.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    uni = kr["universe"]; pk = {c: p for c, p in kr["prices"].items() if c in uni}
    bdts = cal_from_prices(pk)
    print("KR 스냅샷:")
    out["kr"] = build(pk, uni, bdts, kr_theme,
                      val_of=lambda c, k: pk[c]["v"][k] / 100.0,       # 백만원 → 억원
                      liq_min=30, rise_liq=50,
                      name_of=lambda c: uni[c]["name"],
                      cap_of=lambda c: uni[c].get("cap"))


def build_us(out):
    us = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "us_raw.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    gspc = us["bench"].get("^GSPC") or us["bench"].get("SPY")
    bdts = gspc["dt"]
    uni = us["universe"]; pu = {t: p for t, p in us["prices"].items() if t in uni}
    print("US 스냅샷:")
    out["us"] = build(pu, uni, bdts, us_theme,
                      val_of=lambda t, k: pu[t]["c"][k] * pu[t]["v"][k] / 1e6,   # $M
                      liq_min=20, rise_liq=30,
                      name_of=lambda t: t, cap_of=lambda t: uni[t].get("capB"))
    for s in out["us"]:
        for r in s["leaders"] + s["risers"]:
            r["full"] = uni[r["c"]]["name"][:34]


def main():
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--market", choices=["all", "kr", "us"], default="all")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    path = os.path.join(DATA, "rs_time_stocks.json")
    cur = {}
    if os.path.exists(path):
        try: cur = json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception: cur = {}
    out = {"generated": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "method": METHOD,
           "kr": cur.get("kr", []), "us": cur.get("us", [])}
    if args.market in ("all", "kr"):
        build_kr(out)
    if args.market in ("all", "us"):
        build_us(out)
    json.dump(out, open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    print("저장:", path, f"({os.path.getsize(path)/1e6:.2f} MB) [{args.market}] KR {len(out['kr'])} · US {len(out['us'])}주")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def sortino(rets):
    r = np.asarray(rets, float)
    if len(r) < 5: return None
    mean = r.mean(); downs = np.minimum(r, 0.0)
    dd = np.sqrt((downs ** 2).mean())
    if dd <= 1e-12:
        return 0.0 if mean <= 0 else float(mean * np.sqrt(252) / 1e-6)
    return float(mean / dd * np.sqrt(252))


def sise_closes(code, start=START):
    end = time.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    r = requests.get("https://api.finance.naver.com/siseJson.naver",
                     params={"symbol": code, "requestType": 1, "startTime": start,
                             "endTime": end, "timeframe": "day"}, headers=UA, timeout=40)
    r.raise_for_status()
    rows = json.loads(re.sub(r"'", '"', r.text.strip()))
    out = []
    for row in rows[1:]:
        if row and isinstance(row[0], str) and row[4] not in (None, "", 0):
            out.append((row[0].replace("-", "").replace(".", ""), float(row[4])))
    return out


def kr_universe():
    r = requests.get("https://finance.naver.com/api/sise/etfItemList.nhn",
                     headers=UA, timeout=30).json()
    inc, exc = re.compile(KR_INCLUDE), re.compile(KR_EXCLUDE)
    picks = []
    for it in r["result"]["etfItemList"]:
        nm = it["itemname"]
        if inc.search(nm) and not exc.search(nm) and (it.get("marketSum") or 0) >= 100:
            picks.append({"code": it["itemcode"], "name": nm, "aum": it["marketSum"]})
    picks.sort(key=lambda x: -x["aum"])
    return picks[:120]


def snapshot_dates(bdts):
    """주말(각 ISO주의 마지막 거래일) 스냅샷. 대표=그 주 목요일. 2025-01~.
    마지막 원소=현재 진행 중인 주(당일 기준). 반환 dict 리스트."""
    byw = {}
    for i, d in enumerate(bdts):
        dt = datetime.date(int(d[:4]), int(d[4:6]), int(d[6:8]))
        y, w, _ = dt.isocalendar()
        byw[(y, w)] = i                # 그 주 마지막 거래일로 갱신
    out = []
    for (y, w), i in sorted(byw.items()):
        thu = datetime.date.fromisocalendar(y, w, 4)
        if thu < datetime.date(2025, 1, 1):
            continue
        out.append({"i": i, "date": bdts[i],
                    "label": f"{thu.year % 100:02d}.{thu.month:02d} {(thu.day - 1)//7 + 1}주",
                    "ym": f"{thu.year}{thu.month:02d}"})
    if out:
        out[-1]["live"] = True         # 진행 중(당일 기준)
    return out


def calc_snapshot(closes, bench, names, upto):
    """upto(포함) 인덱스까지 잘라 RS 계산. rs_build.calc_rows 동일 수식."""
    b = bench[:upto + 1]
    rows = []
    for key, cl in closes.items():
        c = cl[:upto + 1]
        # 상장 전(선두 결측 채움값) 감지: 유효 시작 후 60일 미만이면 제외
        row = {"t": key, "nm": names.get(key, key)}
        ok = False
        for w in WINDOWS:
            if len(c) > w and c[-1 - w] > 0 and b[-1 - w] > 0 and c[-1] > 0:
                rel = (c[-1] / c[-1 - w]) / (b[-1] / b[-1 - w]) - 1
                row[f"r{w}"] = round(rel * 100, 1); ok = True
            else:
                row[f"r{w}"] = None
        if not ok:
            continue
        rets = np.diff(np.log(np.asarray(c[-(SORTINO_WIN + 1):], float))) if len(c) > SORTINO_WIN else None
        st = sortino(rets) if rets is not None else None
        row["srt"] = round(st, 2) if st is not None else None
        rows.append(row)
    for w in WINDOWS:
        vals = sorted(r[f"r{w}"] for r in rows if r[f"r{w}"] is not None)
        n = len(vals)
        for r in rows:
            v = r[f"r{w}"]
            r[f"n{w}"] = round(sum(1 for x in vals if x < v) / max(n - 1, 1) * 100, 1) if v is not None and n > 1 else None
    for r in rows:
        nns = [r[f"n{w}"] for w in WINDOWS if r[f"n{w}"] is not None]
        r["navg"] = round(float(np.mean(nns)), 1) if nns else None
    svals = sorted(r["srt"] for r in rows if r["srt"] is not None)
    ns = len(svals)
    for r in rows:
        r["srk"] = round(sum(1 for x in svals if x < r["srt"]) / max(ns - 1, 1) * 100, 1) if r["srt"] is not None and ns > 1 else None
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -(r["navg"] if r["navg"] is not None else -1))
    return rows


def build_kr():
    uni = kr_universe()
    log(f"KR 유니버스 {len(uni)}개")
    bench = sise_closes("KOSPI")
    bdts = [d for d, _ in bench]; bmap = dict(bench)
    closes, names, first_valid = {}, {}, {}
    for i, e in enumerate(uni):
        try:
            ser = dict(sise_closes(e["code"]))
        except Exception:
            continue
        cl, last = [], None
        fv = None
        for j, d in enumerate(bdts):
            if d in ser:
                if fv is None: fv = j
                last = ser[d]
            cl.append(last)
        if fv is None or cl[-1] is None:
            continue
        first = next(v for v in cl if v is not None)
        closes[e["code"]] = [v if v is not None else first for v in cl]
        names[e["code"]] = e["name"]; first_valid[e["code"]] = fv
        if (i + 1) % 40 == 0: log(f"  KR {i+1}/{len(uni)}")
        time.sleep(0.07)
    benchv = [bmap[d] for d in bdts]
    out = []
    for sn in snapshot_dates(bdts):
        idx = sn["i"]
        sub = {k: v for k, v in closes.items() if idx - first_valid[k] >= 60}
        rows = calc_snapshot(sub, benchv, names, idx)
        out.append({"ym": sn["ym"], "label": sn["label"], "date": sn["date"],
                    "rows": rows, **({"live": True} if sn.get("live") else {})})
    log(f"KR 스냅샷 {len(out)}주 (ETF {len(closes)})")
    return out


def build_us():
    import yfinance as yf
    tickers = list(US_ETFS.keys()) + ["SPY"]
    df = yf.download(tickers, start="2023-11-01", interval="1d", auto_adjust=True,
                     progress=False)["Close"]
    df = df.dropna(subset=["SPY"])
    bdts = [d.strftime("%Y%m%d") for d in df.index]
    bench = df["SPY"].to_numpy()
    closes, names, first_valid = {}, dict(US_ETFS), {}
    for t in US_ETFS:
        if t not in df.columns: continue
        s = df[t]
        fv = s.first_valid_index()
        if fv is None: continue
        first_valid[t] = df.index.get_loc(fv)
        closes[t] = s.ffill().bfill().to_numpy()
    out = []
    for sn in snapshot_dates(bdts):
        idx = sn["i"]
        sub = {k: v for k, v in closes.items() if idx - first_valid[k] >= 60}
        rows = calc_snapshot(sub, bench, names, idx)
        out.append({"ym": sn["ym"], "label": sn["label"], "date": sn["date"],
                    "rows": rows, **({"live": True} if sn.get("live") else {})})
    log(f"US 스냅샷 {len(out)}주 (ETF {len(closes)}, {len(bdts)}일)")
    return out


METHOD = ("RS = 벤치마크(KOSPI/SPY) 대비 상대수익 60/120/250일, Norm = 스냅샷 시점 유니버스 내 "
          "백분위, navg ≥ 70 = 주도 · 소티노60 백분위. 주말(주간) 스냅샷·현재주=당일 기준. "
          "과거 스냅샷은 현재 ETF 목록 기준(상장 60일 미만 제외).")


def main():
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--market", choices=["all", "kr", "us"], default="all")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    path = os.path.join(DATA, "rs_time.json")
    cur = {}
    if os.path.exists(path):
        try: cur = json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception: cur = {}
    out = {"generated": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "method": METHOD,
           "kr": cur.get("kr", []), "us": cur.get("us", [])}
    if args.market in ("all", "kr"):
        try: out["kr"] = build_kr()
        except Exception as e:
            import traceback; traceback.print_exc(); log(f"!! KR 실패 {e}")
    if args.market in ("all", "us"):
        try: out["us"] = build_us()
        except Exception as e:
            import traceback; traceback.print_exc(); log(f"!! US 실패 {e}")
    json.dump(out, open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    log(f"저장: {path} ({os.path.getsize(path)/1e6:.2f} MB) [{args.market}] KR {len(out['kr'])} · US {len(out['us'])}주")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

</style></head><body><div class="wrap">

<script>
const RAW = __PAYLOAD__;
let mode='etf', mkt='kr', si=999;
const MK={kr:'한국',us:'미국'}, MD={etf:'ETF',stk:'개별종목'};
const SUB={etf:'섹터·테마 ETF 상대강도를 원하는 과거 시점(월말 스냅샷)으로 되감아 보기. RS = 벤치마크(KOSPI/SPY) 대비 상대수익, Norm 평균(navg) ≥ 70 = 주도.',
 stk:'개별종목 RS를 과거 시점으로 되감기. RS종합 = R60·R120·R250 가중(0.5/0.3/0.2) 백분위 — 상위 40 = 주도주 · RS20 ≥ 70 & RS종합 < 85 = 떠오르는 종목(선행 후보).'};

function snapsOf(){ return mode==='etf' ? RAW.etf[mkt] : RAW.stk[mkt]; }

const modetabs=document.getElementById('modetabs');
['etf','stk'].forEach(m=>{const b=document.createElement('div');b.className='tab'+(m===mode?' on':'');b.dataset.mode=m;b.textContent=MD[m];b.onclick=()=>{mode=m;render();};modetabs.appendChild(b);});
const tabs=document.getElementById('tabs');
['kr','us'].forEach(m=>{const b=document.createElement('div');b.className='tab'+(m===mkt?' on':'');b.dataset.m=m;b.textContent=MK[m];b.onclick=()=>{mkt=m;render();};tabs.appendChild(b);});

const slider=document.getElementById('slider');
slider.oninput=()=>{si=+slider.value;render();};
document.getElementById('prev').onclick=()=>{if(si>0){si--;render();}};
document.getElementById('next').onclick=()=>{if(si<snapsOf().length-1){si++;render();}};
document.getElementById('latest').onclick=()=>{si=snapsOf().length-1;render();};
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'&&si>0){si--;render();}else if(e.key==='ArrowRight'&&si<snapsOf().length-1){si++;render();}});

function fmt(v,signed){if(v==null)return'<span style="color:var(--dim2)">-</span>';const s=(signed&&v>0?'+':'')+v;return '<span class="'+(v>=0?'pos':'neg')+'">'+s+'</span>';}
function capf(c){if(c==null)return'';return mkt==='kr'?(c>=100000?Math.round(c/10000)+'조':c>=10000?(c/10000).toFixed(1)+'조':Math.round(c/1000)/10+'천억'):('$'+(c>=100?Math.round(c):c)+'B');}
function v20f(v){return mkt==='kr'? Math.round(v)+'억' : '$'+Math.round(v)+'M';}

/* ETF 테이블 */
function renderETF(s,prev){
  const prevRank={}; if(prev)prev.rows.forEach((r,i)=>prevRank[r.t]=i+1);
  let h='<div class="card"><table><thead><tr><th></th><th class="l">ETF / 테마</th><th>navg</th><th></th><th>RS60</th><th>RS120</th><th>RS250</th><th>소티노</th><th>순위Δ</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  s.rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const lead=r.navg!=null&&r.navg>=70;
    let dl='';
    if(prev){ if(prevRank[r.t]==null)dl='<span class="d-new">NEW</span>';
      else{const df=prevRank[r.t]-(i+1); dl=df>0?'<span class="d-up">▲'+df+'</span>':df<0?'<span class="d-dn">▼'+(-df)+'</span>':'<span class="d-same">-</span>';}}
    h+='<tr class="'+(lead?'lead':'')+'"><td class="rk">'+(i+1)+'</td><td class="l nm" title="'+r.nm+'">'+r.nm+'</td>'
      +'<td class="navg" style="color:'+(lead?'var(--gold-hi)':'var(--txt)')+'">'+(r.navg==null?'-':r.navg)+'</td>'
      +'<td class="l"><span class="nbar"><i style="width:'+(r.navg||0)+'%"></i></span></td>'
      +'<td>'+fmt(r.r60,true)+'</td><td>'+fmt(r.r120,true)+'</td><td>'+fmt(r.r250,true)+'</td>'
      +'<td style="color:var(--dim)">'+(r.srk==null?'-':r.srk)+'</td><td>'+dl+'</td></tr>';
  });
  h+='</tbody></table><div class="note">순위Δ = 직전 스냅샷 대비 · 과거 스냅샷도 현재 ETF 목록 기준(상장 60거래일 미만 제외)</div></div>';
  return h;
}

/* 개별종목 테이블 */
function stockRows(rows,prevRank,withScore){
  let h='';
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const lead=r.rsc>=90;
    let dl='';
    if(prevRank){ if(prevRank[r.c]==null)dl='<span class="d-new">NEW</span>';
      else{const df=prevRank[r.c]-(i+1); dl=df>0?'<span class="d-up">▲'+df+'</span>':df<0?'<span class="d-dn">▼'+(-df)+'</span>':'<span class="d-same">-</span>';}}
    const nm=mkt==='us'?r.c+'<small>'+(r.full||'')+'</small>':r.n;
    h+='<tr class="'+(lead?'lead':'')+'"><td class="rk">'+(i+1)+'</td>'
      +'<td class="l nm">'+nm+'<small>'+r.th+(r.cap?' · '+capf(r.cap):'')+'</small></td>'
      +'<td class="navg">'+r.rsc+'</td>'
      +'<td class="l"><span class="nbar"><i style="width:'+r.rsc+'%"></i></span></td>'
      +'<td>'+r.rs20+'</td>'
      +'<td><span class="'+(r.acc>=0?'accp':'accn')+'">'+(r.acc>=0?'+':'')+r.acc+'</span></td>'
      +'<td>'+fmt(r.r60,true)+'</td>'
      +'<td style="color:var(--dim)">'+v20f(r.v20)+'</td>'
      +(withScore?'<td style="color:var(--gold-hi);font-weight:700">'+r.score+'</td>':'')
      +'<td>'+dl+'</td></tr>';
  });
  return h;
}
function renderSTK(s,prev){
  const pl={}, pr={};
  if(prev){ prev.leaders.forEach((r,i)=>pl[r.c]=i+1); prev.risers.forEach((r,i)=>pr[r.c]=i+1); }
  let h='<div class="sect">주도주 TOP '+s.leaders.length+' — RS종합 순 <span style="color:var(--dim2);text-transform:none">(유니버스 '+s.n_uni+'종목)</span></div>';
  h+='<div class="card"><table><thead><tr><th></th><th class="l">종목</th><th>RS종합</th><th></th><th>RS20</th><th>가속</th><th>R60%</th><th>거래대금</th><th>순위Δ</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  h+=stockRows(s.leaders,prev?pl:null,false);
  h+='</tbody></table></div>';
  h+='<div class="sect">떠오르는 종목 — RS20 ≥ 70 & RS종합 &lt; 85 (스코어 순)</div>';
  h+='<div class="card"><table><thead><tr><th></th><th class="l">종목</th><th>RS종합</th><th></th><th>RS20</th><th>가속</th><th>R60%</th><th>거래대금</th><th>스코어</th><th>순위Δ</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  h+=stockRows(s.risers,prev?pr:null,true);
  h+='</tbody></table><div class="note">가속 = RS20 − RS종합 (단기 상대강도가 중기 대비 얼마나 빠른가, ＋ = 부상 중) · 거래대금 = 20일 평균 · 스냅샷 시점 데이터만 사용(미래정보 없음) · 유니버스는 현재 상장종목 기준</div></div>';
  return h;
}

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""RS 타임머신 자동 업데이트 오케스트레이터.
  --kr : KR 증분 병합 pull → KR ETF/개별 재계산 → HTML → git push  (시간 단위)
  --us : US 전체 pull → US ETF/개별 재계산 → HTML → git push        (하루 1회)
  --deep : KR 전체 딥 pull(히스토리 정정)                            (야간 1회 옵션)
  단일 인스턴스 락(update.lock). 시장별 부분 갱신이라 상대 시장 데이터 보존.
"""
import os, io, sys, time, subprocess, argparse
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SITE = os.path.join(HERE, "site")
PY = sys.executable
LOCK = os.path.join(HERE, "rs_update.lock")
LOG = os.path.join(HERE, "rs_update.log")


def log(m):
    line = f"[{time.strftime('%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}] {m}"
    print(line)
    try:
        open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8").write(line + "\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def run(args, timeout, label):
    t = time.time()
    r = subprocess.run([PY] + args, cwd=HERE, capture_output=True, text=True,
                       encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=timeout)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        log(f"!! {label} 실패 rc={r.returncode}: {(r.stderr or r.stdout)[-400:]}")
        raise SystemExit(1)
    log(f"  {label} OK ({time.time()-t:.0f}s)")


def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", SITE, *a], capture_output=True, text=True,
                          encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def push():
    git("add", "rs_time.html")
    st = git("status", "--porcelain", "rs_time.html").stdout.strip()
    if not st:
        log("  변경 없음 — push 생략"); return
    git("commit", "-m", "RS 타임머신 자동 갱신 " + time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"))
    stashed = git("stash", "push", "--", "data/research.json").stdout
    git("pull", "--rebase")
    r = git("push")
    if "stash" in stashed and "No local changes" not in stashed:
        git("stash", "pop")
    log("  push OK" if r.returncode == 0 else f"!! push 실패: {r.stderr[-300:]}")


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--kr", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--us", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--deep", action="store_true", help="KR 전체 딥 pull")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if not (args.kr or args.us):
        args.kr = True

    # 단일 인스턴스 락 (30분 넘은 락은 스톨로 간주)
    if os.path.exists(LOCK) and time.time() - os.path.getmtime(LOCK) < 1800:
        log("이전 인스턴스 실행 중 — 스킵"); return
    open(LOCK, "w").write(str(os.getpid()))
    try:
        t0 = time.time()
        if args.kr:
            log("=== KR 갱신 시작 ===")
            if args.deep:
                run(["judo_kr_fetch.py", "--workers", "6"], 1200, "KR 딥 pull")
            else:
                run(["judo_kr_fetch.py", "--merge", "--workers", "6"], 900, "KR 병합 pull")
            run(["judo_rs_time.py", "--market", "kr"], 400, "KR ETF RS")
            run(["judo_rs_stocks_time.py", "--market", "kr"], 400, "KR 개별 RS")
        if args.us:
            log("=== US 갱신 시작 ===")
            run(["judo_us_fetch.py"], 1200, "US pull")
            run(["judo_rs_time.py", "--market", "us"], 400, "US ETF RS")
            run(["judo_rs_stocks_time.py", "--market", "us"], 400, "US 개별 RS")
        run(["judo_rs_time_html.py"], 180, "HTML 빌드")
        push()
        log(f"=== 완료 ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s) ===")
    finally:
        try: os.remove(LOCK)
        except Exception: pass


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def asof_idx(arr, d):
    j = bisect.bisect_right(arr, d) - 1
    return j if j >= 0 else None


def sortino(lrets):
    if len(lrets) < 5:
        return None
    m = sum(lrets) / len(lrets)
    downs = [x for x in lrets if x < 0]
    dd = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in downs) / len(lrets)) if downs else 0.0
    if dd <= 1e-12:
        return 0.0 if m <= 0 else m * math.sqrt(252) / 1e-6
    return m / dd * math.sqrt(252)


def pctl(sorted_arr, v):
    if len(sorted_arr) < 2:
        return 50.0
    return bisect.bisect_left(sorted_arr, v) / (len(sorted_arr) - 1) * 100


def stock_metrics(dts, c, h, v, base, end, cal, ci):
    """구간 원지표. cal=거래일캘린더, ci=cal->pos. 반환 dict 또는 None."""
    je = asof_idx(dts, end); jb = asof_idx(dts, base)
    if je is None or jb is None or c[jb] <= 0 or c[je] <= 0:
        return None
    ret = (c[je] / c[jb] - 1) * 100
    # 구간 거래일 인덱스(종목 자체 배열 기준)
    ws_pos = None
    win_idx = [i for i in range(jb + 1, je + 1)]
    if not win_idx:
        win_idx = [je]
    vals = [v[i] for i in win_idx]
    avgval = sum(vals) / len(vals) if vals else 0
    turn = sum(vals)
    # 52주(250거래일) 신고가 달성일수
    nhd = 0
    for i in win_idx:
        lo = max(0, i - 249)
        if h[i] >= max(h[lo:i + 1]):
            nhd += 1
    nhratio = nhd / len(win_idx) * 100
    # 추세: 50DMA 상회비율 + 소티노
    above = 0
    for i in win_idx:
        if i >= 50:
            ma = sum(c[i - 50:i]) / 50
            if c[i] > ma:
                above += 1
        else:
            if c[i] > c[0]:
                above += 1
    above_pct = above / len(win_idx) * 100
    lrets = []
    for k in range(1, len(win_idx)):
        a = c[win_idx[k - 1]]; b = c[win_idx[k]]
        if a > 0 and b > 0:
            lrets.append(math.log(b / a))
    srt = sortino(lrets)
    return {"ret": ret, "avgval": avgval, "turn": turn, "nhd": nhd, "nhratio": nhratio,
            "above": above_pct, "sortino": srt if srt is not None else 0.0}


def score_market(prices, universe, cal, bench_ret, theme_fn, liq_gate,
                 supply=None, weights=None):
    """반환: {pkey:{'leaders':[...], 'themes':[...], 'idxret':..}}"""
    ci = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(cal)}
    out = {}
    for pk, plabel, ws, we in PERIODS:
        # base/end from calendar
        si = bisect.bisect_left(cal, ws)
        base = cal[si - 1] if si > 0 else cal[0]
        ei = bisect.bisect_right(cal, we) - 1
        end = cal[ei] if ei >= 0 else cal[-1]

        recs = []
        for code, p in prices.items():
            u = universe.get(code)
            if not u:
                continue
            m = stock_metrics(p["dt"], p["c"], p["h"], p["v"], base, end, cal, ci)
            if not m:
                continue
            if m["avgval"] < liq_gate or m["ret"] <= 0:
                continue
            bret = bench_ret(u, base, end)
            exc = m["ret"] - bret
            if exc <= 0:
                continue
            sup = None
            if supply is not None:
                sup = supply.get(code, {}).get(pk)
            recs.append({"code": code, "name": u["name"], "theme": theme_fn(code, u),
                         "cap": u.get("cap"), "ret": m["ret"], "excess": exc,
                         "turn": m["turn"], "nhd": m["nhd"], "nhratio": m["nhratio"],
                         "above": m["above"], "sortino": m["sortino"], "supply": sup})
        if not recs:
            out[pk] = {"leaders": [], "themes": [], "idxret": None, "label": plabel}
            continue
        # 백분위
        S = lambda key: sorted(r[key] for r in recs if r[key] is not None)
        a_ret = S("ret"); a_exc = S("excess"); a_nh = S("nhratio")
        a_turn = S("turn"); a_above = S("above"); a_srt = S("sortino")
        sup_vals = [r["supply"] for r in recs if r.get("supply") is not None]
        a_sup = sorted(sup_vals) if sup_vals else None
        for r in recs:
            rs = pctl(a_ret, r["ret"]); ex = pctl(a_exc, r["excess"])
            nh = pctl(a_nh, r["nhratio"]); tu = pctl(a_turn, r["turn"])
            trend = 0.5 * r["above"] + 0.5 * pctl(a_srt, r["sortino"])
            comp = {"rs": rs, "exc": ex, "nh": nh, "turn": tu, "trend": trend}
            if a_sup is not None and supply is not None:
                comp["sup"] = pctl(a_sup, r["supply"]) if r.get("supply") is not None else 50.0
            r["comp"] = {k: round(x, 1) for k, x in comp.items()}
            r["score"] = round(sum(weights[k] * comp[k] for k in weights), 2)
        recs.sort(key=lambda r: -r["score"])
        leaders = recs[:60]
        # 테마 집계 (상위 리더 기준)
        th_agg = {}
        for r in leaders:
            t = th_agg.setdefault(r["theme"], {"theme": r["theme"], "score": 0.0, "n": 0, "stocks": []})
            t["score"] += r["score"]; t["n"] += 1
            if len(t["stocks"]) < 6:
                t["stocks"].append(r["name"])
        themes = sorted(th_agg.values(), key=lambda t: -t["score"])
        for t in themes:
            t["score"] = round(t["score"], 1)
        # index return (KOSPI 대표로 base~end)
        out[pk] = {"label": plabel, "base": base, "end": end,
                   "leaders": [slim(r) for r in leaders], "themes": themes}
    return out


def slim(r):
    o = {"code": r["code"], "name": r["name"], "theme": r["theme"],
         "ret": round(r["ret"], 1), "excess": round(r["excess"], 1),
         "score": r["score"], "comp": r["comp"], "nhd": r["nhd"]}
    if r.get("cap") is not None:
        o["cap"] = r["cap"]
    if r.get("supply") is not None:
        o["supply"] = round(r["supply"] / 100.0, 0)   # 억원
    return o


def rotation(res):
    """테마·종목 로테이션(A→B)."""
    def topthemes(pk, n=8):
        return [t["theme"] for t in res[pk]["themes"][:n]]
    tA, tB = topthemes("A"), topthemes("B")
    sA, sB = set(tA), set(tB)
    cA = {r["code"]: r["name"] for r in res["A"]["leaders"][:40]}
    cB = {r["code"]: r["name"] for r in res["B"]["leaders"][:40]}
    return {
        "themes": {"carry": [t for t in tA if t in sB],
                   "new": [t for t in tB if t not in sA],
                   "faded": [t for t in tA if t not in sB]},
        "stocks": {"carry": [cA[c] for c in cA if c in cB],
                   "new": [cB[c] for c in cB if c not in cA],
                   "faded": [cA[c] for c in cA if c not in cB]},
    }


def kr_theme(code, u):
    if code in KR_C2O:
        return KR_C2O[code]
    th = u.get("theme")
    if th:
        return KR_RELABEL.get(th, th)
    return u.get("sector") or "기타"


def us_theme(code, u):
    if code in US_C2O:
        return US_C2O[code]
    ind = u.get("industry")
    if ind and ind != "?":
        return US_RELABEL.get(ind, ind)
    return u.get("sector") or "기타"


def main():
    import time
    result = {"generated": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "markets": {}, "rotation": {}}

    # ===== KR =====
    kr = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "kr_raw.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    mc = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "market_cache.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    idx = mc["index"]
    try:
        sup = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "kr_supply.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["net"]
    except Exception as e:
        print("!! kr_supply.json 없음 — 수급요소 제외:", e); sup = None
    cal_kr = sorted(idx["KOSPI"].keys())

    def kr_bench(u, base, end):
        mk = u["market"]
        a = idx[mk].get(base); b = idx[mk].get(end)
        if not a or not b or not a["idx"]:
            return 0.0
        return (b["idx"] / a["idx"] - 1) * 100

    W_KR = {"rs": .18, "exc": .16, "nh": .16, "turn": .16, "sup": .18, "trend": .16}
    W_KR_NOSUP = {"rs": .22, "exc": .20, "nh": .19, "turn": .19, "trend": .20}
    kr_res = score_market(kr["prices"], kr["universe"], cal_kr, kr_bench, kr_theme,
                          liq_gate=3000, supply=sup,
                          weights=W_KR if sup else W_KR_NOSUP)
    result["markets"]["KR"] = kr_res
    result["rotation"]["KR"] = rotation(kr_res)
    print("KR 완료:", {k: len(kr_res[k]["leaders"]) for k in kr_res})

    # ===== US =====
    try:
        us = json.load(open(os.path.join(DATA, "us_raw.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception as e:
        print("!! us_raw.json 없음 — US 스킵:", e); us = None
    if us:
        # 거래대금 = close*volume(달러). prices 구조 c/h/v. v를 달러거래대금으로 치환.
        usp = {}
        for t, p in us["prices"].items():
            dv = [round(p["c"][i] * p["v"][i], 0) for i in range(len(p["c"]))]
            usp[t] = {"dt": p["dt"], "c": p["c"], "h": p["h"], "v": dv}
        uni = us["universe"]
        gspc = us["bench"].get("^GSPC") or us["bench"].get("SPY")
        gser = {gspc["dt"][i]: gspc["c"][i] for i in range(len(gspc["dt"]))}
        cal_us = sorted(set().union(*[set(p["dt"]) for p in list(usp.values())[:200]]))
        cal_us = sorted(gser.keys())

        def us_bench(u, base, end):
            a = gser.get(base); b = gser.get(end)
            if not a or not b:
                # asof
                ks = sorted(gser.keys())
                ib = asof_idx(ks, base); ie = asof_idx(ks, end)
                if ib is None or ie is None:
                    return 0.0
                a = gser[ks[ib]]; b = gser[ks[ie]]
            return (b / a - 1) * 100

        W_US = {"rs": .24, "exc": .20, "nh": .19, "turn": .18, "trend": .19}
        us_res = score_market(usp, uni, cal_us, us_bench, us_theme,
                              liq_gate=10e6, supply=None, weights=W_US)
        result["markets"]["US"] = us_res
        result["rotation"]["US"] = rotation(us_res)
        print("US 완료:", {k: len(us_res[k]["leaders"]) for k in us_res})

    path = os.path.join(DATA, "result.json")
    json.dump(result, open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    print("저장:", path, f"({os.path.getsize(path)/1e6:.2f} MB)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""주도주 분석 — US 데이터 pull.
  TradingView 스캐너로 유니버스(시총 $500M+ · 30일평균거래량 10만주+) 확보,
  yfinance로 20240901~20260606 일봉(close/high/volume) + 벤치(^GSPC,^IXIC) + 테마 ETF.
  → judo_data/us_raw.json
"""
import sys, io, os, json, time, datetime
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)
import requests

# 90개 섹터·테마 ETF (rs_build.py US_ETFS 복제 — import 부작용 회피)
US_ETFS = {
    "SOXX": "Semiconductors", "SMH": "Semiconductors (VanEck)", "PSI": "Semiconductors - Dynamic",
    "XSD": "Semiconductors - Equal Weight", "QTEC": "Tech - NASDAQ Equal Weight", "XLK": "Technology",
    "VGT": "Technology (Vanguard)", "IGV": "Software", "SKYY": "Cloud Computing", "WCLD": "Cloud (WisdomTree)",
    "CIBR": "Cybersecurity", "HACK": "Cybersecurity (ETFMG)", "FDN": "Internet", "XLC": "Communication Services",
    "SOCL": "Social Media", "ESPO": "Video Games & Esports", "GAMR": "Gaming", "BOTZ": "Robotics & AI",
    "ROBO": "Robotics & Automation", "ARKQ": "Autonomous Tech", "ARKK": "ARK Innovation", "ARKW": "ARK Next Internet",
    "DRIV": "Autonomous & EV", "KARS": "Electric Vehicles", "CARZ": "Global Auto", "LIT": "Lithium & Battery",
    "REMX": "Rare Earth & Strategic Metals", "XLV": "Health Care", "XBI": "Biotech Equal Weight",
    "IBB": "Biotech (NASDAQ)", "ARKG": "Genomics", "PJP": "Pharma Dynamic", "IHE": "Pharmaceuticals",
    "IHF": "Health Care Providers", "XHS": "Health Care Services", "XHE": "Health Care Equipment",
    "XLF": "Financials", "KBE": "Banks", "KRE": "Regional Banks", "IAI": "Broker-Dealers & Exchanges",
    "KIE": "Insurance", "IXG": "Global Financials", "FINX": "FinTech", "IPAY": "Payments",
    "XLI": "Industrials", "AIRR": "American Industrial Renaissance", "PAVE": "US Infrastructure",
    "ITA": "Aerospace & Defense", "PPA": "Aerospace & Defense (Invesco)", "XAR": "Aerospace Equal Weight",
    "ARKX": "Space Exploration", "UFO": "Space (Procure)",
    "JETS": "Airlines", "IYT": "Transportation", "XTN": "Transportation Equal Weight",
    "XLE": "Energy", "XOP": "Oil & Gas E&P", "OIH": "Oil Services", "EMLP": "North American Energy Infra",
    "TAN": "Solar", "ICLN": "Clean Energy", "QCLN": "Clean Energy NASDAQ", "FAN": "Wind Energy",
    "URA": "Uranium", "URNM": "Uranium Miners", "NLR": "Nuclear Energy", "GRID": "Smart Grid Infra",
    "XLB": "Materials", "XME": "Metals & Mining", "PICK": "Global Metals & Mining", "SLX": "Steel",
    "COPX": "Copper Miners", "GDX": "Gold Miners", "GDXJ": "Junior Gold Miners", "SIL": "Silver Miners",
    "XLY": "Consumer Discretionary", "XRT": "Retail", "ITB": "Home Construction", "XHB": "Homebuilders",
    "PKB": "Building & Construction", "XLP": "Consumer Staples", "PBJ": "Food & Beverage",
    "ECON": "Emerging Markets Consumer", "XLU": "Utilities", "XLRE": "Real Estate",
    "TDIV": "Tech Dividend", "MOO": "Agribusiness", "PHO": "Water Resources", "WOOD": "Timber & Forestry",
    "BETZ": "Sports Betting & iGaming",
}

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUTDIR = os.path.join(HERE, "judo_data")
os.makedirs(OUTDIR, exist_ok=True)

START = "2023-12-01"
# yfinance end는 미포함이라 내일로 — 고정값을 쓰면 그 날짜 이후 데이터가 영원히 안 들어온다(2026-07-22 동결 사고)
END = (datetime.date.today() + datetime.timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
COLUMNS = ["name", "description", "sector", "industry", "market_cap_basic",
           "average_volume_30d_calc", "close", "exchange", "type"]


def fetch_universe():
    body = {
        "filter": [
            {"left": "market_cap_basic", "operation": "egreater", "right": 500_000_000},
            {"left": "average_volume_30d_calc", "operation": "egreater", "right": 100_000},
            {"left": "is_primary", "operation": "equal", "right": True},
            {"left": "type", "operation": "in_range", "right": ["stock", "dr"]},
        ],
        "columns": COLUMNS,
        "sort": {"sortBy": "market_cap_basic", "sortOrder": "desc"},
        "range": [0, 12000],
    }
    r = requests.post("https://scanner.tradingview.com/america/scan",
                      json=body, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}, timeout=60)
    r.raise_for_status()
    uni = {}
    for it in r.json().get("data", []):
        d = dict(zip(COLUMNS, it["d"]))
        tk = d.get("name")
        if not tk or (d.get("market_cap_basic") or 0) < 500_000_000:
            continue
        uni[tk] = {"name": d.get("description") or tk,
                   "sector": d.get("sector") or "?", "industry": d.get("industry") or "?",
                   "capB": round((d.get("market_cap_basic") or 0) / 1e9, 2),
                   "exch": d.get("exchange") or "?"}
    return uni


def yf_symbol(tk):
    return tk.replace(".", "-")


def pull_prices(tickers, label):
    import yfinance as yf
    out = {}
    CH = 120
    chunks = [tickers[i:i + CH] for i in range(0, len(tickers), CH)]
    for ci, ch in enumerate(chunks):
        ymap = {yf_symbol(t): t for t in ch}
        for attempt in range(3):
            try:
                df = yf.download(list(ymap.keys()), start=START, end=END, auto_adjust=True,
                                 progress=False, group_by="ticker", threads=True)
                break
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"    {label} chunk{ci} 재시도 {attempt}: {e}"); time.sleep(3); df = None
        if df is None:
            continue
        for ys, orig in ymap.items():
            try:
                if len(ymap) == 1:
                    sub = df
                else:
                    if ys not in df.columns.get_level_values(0):
                        continue
                    sub = df[ys]
                sub = sub.dropna(subset=["Close"])
                if len(sub) < 60:
                    continue
                dts = [d.strftime("%Y%m%d") for d in sub.index]
                out[orig] = {"dt": dts,
                             "c": [round(float(x), 4) for x in sub["Close"].tolist()],
                             "h": [round(float(x), 4) for x in sub["High"].tolist()],
                             "v": [int(x) if x == x else 0 for x in sub["Volume"].tolist()]}
            except Exception:
                continue
        print(f"  {label} {min((ci+1)*CH, len(tickers))}/{len(tickers)}  누적 {len(out)}")
        time.sleep(1.0)
    return out


def pull_full(tickers, label, retry_wait=45):
    """pull_prices + 누락분 1회 재시도. 야후 rate limit에 걸리면 청크가 빈 결과로
    조용히 돌아오므로(예외 없음), 누락 티커를 쉬었다가 다시 긁는다."""
    out = pull_prices(tickers, label)
    missing = [t for t in tickers if t not in out]
    if missing:
        print(f"  {label} 누락 {len(missing)}종목 — {retry_wait}s 후 재시도")
        time.sleep(retry_wait)
        out.update(pull_prices(missing, f"{label} 재시도"))
    return out


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    print("[1] TradingView 유니버스...")
    uni = fetch_universe()
    print(f"  유니버스 {len(uni)}종목  ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)")

    tickers = list(uni.keys())
    print("[2] yfinance 종목 일봉...")
    prices = pull_full(tickers, "종목")
    print(f"  종목 가격 {len(prices)}/{len(tickers)}  ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)")

    print("[3] 벤치 + 테마 ETF...")
    bench_etf = ["SPY", "^GSPC", "^IXIC", "^RUT"] + list(US_ETFS.keys())
    extra = pull_full(bench_etf, "ETF/벤치")
    bench = {k: extra[k] for k in ["SPY", "^GSPC", "^IXIC", "^RUT"] if k in extra}
    etfs = {k: extra[k] for k in US_ETFS if k in extra}
    print(f"  벤치 {len(bench)} · ETF {len(etfs)}")

    # 검증 게이트: 벤치 없음·커버리지 반토막이면 기존 us_raw.json을 덮지 않고 실패 처리
    # (rate limit로 뼈만 남은 파일을 저장하면 후속 RS 계산이 전부 오염된다)
    if not any(k in bench for k in ("^GSPC", "SPY")):
        print("!! 벤치(^GSPC/SPY) 누락 — us_raw.json 미갱신, 중단")
        sys.exit(1)
    if len(prices) < len(tickers) * 0.5:
        print(f"!! 종목 커버리지 부족 {len(prices)}/{len(tickers)} — us_raw.json 미갱신, 중단")
        sys.exit(1)

    out = {"start": START, "end": END, "fetched_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
           "universe": uni, "prices": prices, "bench": bench, "etfs": etfs,
           "etf_labels": US_ETFS}
    path = os.path.join(OUTDIR, "us_raw.json")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    print(f"저장: {path}  ({os.path.getsize(path)/1e6:.1f} MB)  총 {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

function tgText(w){
  let s='['+w.label+']\\n';
  for(const sec of w.sectors){ s+='\\n'+sec.theme+':\\n'; for(const st of sec.stocks){ s+=st.n+'\\n'; } }
  return s.replace(/\\n+$/,'');
}

      cb.onclick=()=>copy(tgText(w),cb);
      const hint=document.createElement('span'); hint.className='hint'; hint.textContent='텔레그램 붙여넣기용 (이모지·숫자 없음)';
      cr.appendChild(cb); cr.appendChild(hint); bd.appendChild(cr);
      w.sectors.forEach(sec=>{
        const sd=document.createElement('div'); sd.className='sec';
        let li=''; sec.stocks.forEach(st=>{
          li+='<li>'+st.n+'<span class="pc">+'+st.wret+'%</span></li>';
        });
        sd.innerHTML='<div class="th">'+sec.theme+'</div><ul>'+li+'</ul>';
        bd.appendChild(sd);
      });
    }
    d.appendChild(bd); pd.appendChild(d);
  });
  root.appendChild(pd);
});
function allTog(open){ document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d=>d.open=open); }
</script></body></html>"""

html = HTML.replace("__PAYLOAD__", payload)
out = os.path.join(HERE, "주도주_주차별.html")
with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(html)
print("저장:", out, f"({os.path.getsize(out)/1024:.0f} KB)")
