# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""증권사 의견/TP (KIS invest-opinion) + 리포트 제목 (한경컨센∪네이버리서치) 수집"""
import re
import time

import requests

import common as C


def fetch_kis_opinions(conn, codes):
    d2 = time.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    d1 = time.strftime("%Y%m%d", time.localtime(time.time() - 90 * 86400))
    for code in codes:
        try:
            j = C.kis_get("/uapi/domestic-stock/v1/quotations/invest-opinion",
                          "FHKST663300C0",
                          {"FID_COND_MRKT_DIV_CODE": "J", "FID_COND_SCR_DIV_CODE": "16633",
                           "FID_INPUT_ISCD": code,
                           "FID_INPUT_DATE_1": d1, "FID_INPUT_DATE_2": d2})
            for row in j.get("output", []):
                conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO opinions VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                             (row["stck_bsop_date"], code,
                              C.norm_broker(row["mbcr_name"]),
                              row["invt_opnn"], row["rgbf_invt_opnn"],
                              float(row.get("hts_goal_prc") or 0)))
            conn.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[KIS의견실패] {code}: {e}")
        time.sleep(1.2)


def fetch_hankyung_reports(conn, codeset):
    """한경컨센서스 최근 7일 기업 리포트 — 제목에서 (종목코드) 추출"""
    d2 = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    d1 = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.localtime(time.time() - 7 * 86400))
    try:
        r = requests.get("https://consensus.hankyung.com/analysis/list",
                         params={"sdate": d1, "edate": d2, "pagenum": 80,
                                 "report_type": "CO", "order_type": "", "search_text": ""},
                         headers=C.UA, timeout=15)
        rows = re.findall(r"<tr[^>]*>(.*?)</tr>", r.text, re.S)
        for row in rows:
            cells = [re.sub(r"<[^>]+>|\s+", " ", c).strip()
                     for c in re.findall(r"<td[^>]*>(.*?)</td>", row, re.S)]
            if len(cells) < 5:
                continue
            date, title_blob, broker = cells[0], cells[2], cells[4]
            m = re.search(r"\((\d{6})\)", title_blob)
            if not m or m.group(1) not in codeset:
                continue
            title = re.sub(r".*?\(\d{6}\)\s*", "", title_blob).strip()[:80]
            conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reports VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
                         (date.replace("-", ""), m.group(1), C.norm_broker(broker),
                          title, "hk"))
        conn.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[한경실패] {e}")


def fetch_naver_reports(conn, codeset):
    """네이버 리서치 종목분석 최근 2페이지"""
    for page in (1, 2):
        try:
            r = requests.get("https://finance.naver.com/research/company_list.naver",
                             params={"page": page}, headers=C.UA, timeout=15)
            html = r.content.decode("euc-kr", errors="ignore")
            rows = re.findall(r"<tr[^>]*>(.*?)</tr>", html, re.S)
            for row in rows:
                mcode = re.search(r"code=(\d{6})", row)
                mtitle = re.search(r"company_read\.naver[^>]*>([^<]+)<", row)
                cells = [re.sub(r"<[^>]+>|\s+", " ", c).strip()
                         for c in re.findall(r"<td[^>]*>(.*?)</td>", row, re.S)]
                mdate = next((c for c in cells if re.fullmatch(r"\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{2}", c)), None)
                if not (mcode and mtitle and mdate) or mcode.group(1) not in codeset:
                    continue
                broker = cells[2] if len(cells) > 2 else ""
                conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reports VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
                             ("20" + mdate.replace(".", ""), mcode.group(1),
                              C.norm_broker(broker), mtitle.group(1).strip()[:80], "nv"))
            conn.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[네이버실패] p{page}: {e}")
        time.sleep(1.5)


def main():
    conn = C.db()
    codes = C.universe()
    codeset = set(codes)
    fetch_kis_opinions(conn, codes)
    fetch_hankyung_reports(conn, codeset)
    fetch_naver_reports(conn, codeset)
    n_op = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opinions").fetchone()[0]
    n_rp = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports").fetchone()[0]
    print(f"의견 {n_op}건 / 리포트 {n_rp}건 적재")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
consensus_bot/intraday.py당일 변동 추적 (30분 주기 cron):59줄 · 2KB · 2026-08-05
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""당일 변동 추적 (30분 주기 cron):
1) KIS 의견 폴링 (전 유니버스, 인증 API라 차단 없음)
2) 한경/네이버 리포트 목록 폴링 (제목 확보)
3) 신규 이벤트 종목만 WiseReport 컨센 재수집 (--full이면 전체)
4) publish 로직 재사용 → 📝 신규 리포트 + 변동 알림
"""
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import os

import common as C
from fetch_consensus import fetch_one
from fetch_opinions import fetch_kis_opinions, fetch_hankyung_reports, fetch_naver_reports

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))


def main():
    full = "--full" in sys.argv
    dry = "--dry-run" in sys.argv
    today = time.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    dt = C.latest_bizdate()
    conn = C.db()
    codes = C.universe()
    codeset = set(codes)

    # 1) 의견/리포트 폴링 — 신규 이벤트 종목 감지
    before = set(conn.execute("SELECT date||code||broker FROM opinions WHERE date=?",
                              (today,)).fetchall())
    fetch_kis_opinions(conn, codes)
    after = set(conn.execute("SELECT date||code||broker, code FROM opinions WHERE date=?",
                             (today,)).fetchall())
    new_codes = {c for k, c in after if (k,) not in before}
    fetch_hankyung_reports(conn, codeset)
    fetch_naver_reports(conn, codeset)

    # 2) 컨센 재수집: 이벤트 종목만 (--full이면 전체)
    targets = codes if full else sorted(new_codes)
    for code in targets:
        try:
            fetch_one(conn, code, today, dt)
            conn.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[intraday 수집실패] {code}: {e}")
    conn.commit()

    # 3) 발행 (📝 신규 리포트는 전 종목 대상, 변동 알림은 publish가 alert_state로 판단)
    pub_args = [sys.executable, os.path.join(HERE, "publish.py")]
    if dry:
        pub_args.append("--dry-run")
    subprocess.run(pub_args, cwd=HERE)
    print(f"intraday 완료: 이벤트 {len(new_codes)}종목 / 수집 {len(targets)}종목 / full={full}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
consensus_bot/publish.py변동 감지 → 텔레그램 발행.366줄 · 14KB · 2026-08-06
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""변동 감지 → 텔레그램 발행.
사용법: publish.py [--dry-run] [--codes 005930,278470]
- 변동 알림: alert_state(마지막 발행값) 대비 ±threshold 이탈 시 (당일 재알림 가능)
- 📝 신규 리포트 알림: 당일 의견 중 미발송분 (sent_events로 1회)
"""
import sys
import time

import common as C

Q = C.TRACK_QUARTER


def q_label(q=Q):
    return f"{int(q[4:6])//3}Q{q[2:4]}"


def track_q(conn, code, today):
    """이 종목이 오늘 추적 중인 분기 (발표 종목은 fetch에서 자동 롤링됨). 없으면 전역 기본."""
    row = conn.execute("""SELECT period FROM snapshot WHERE code=? AND freq='Q' AND date=?
                          ORDER BY period LIMIT 1""", (code, today)).fetchone()
    return row[0] if row else Q


def prev_quarter(q):
    y, m = int(q[:4]), int(q[4:])
    return f"{y-1}12" if m == 3 else f"{y}{m-3:02d}"


def yoy_quarter(q):
    return f"{int(q[:4])-1}{q[4:]}"


def fmt_num(v):
    """1조(10,000억) 이상은 #.#조 (소수점 둘째자리 반올림), 미만은 억 단위 정수"""
    if abs(v) >= 10000:
        return f"{v / 10000:,.1f}조"
    return f"{v:,.0f}"


def fmt_eok(v):
    return fmt_num(v) + ("원" if abs(v) >= 10000 else "억원")


def growth_label(cur, base, base_est):
    if cur is None or base is None:
        return None
    tag = "(E)" if base_est else ""
    if base < 0 <= cur:
        return f"흑전{tag}"
    if base < 0 and cur < 0:
        return f"적자지속{tag}"
    if base >= 0 > cur:
        return f"적전{tag}"
    if base == 0:
        return None
    return f"{(cur / base - 1) * 100:+.1f}%{tag}"


def pct(cur, prev):
    if prev in (None, 0):
        return None
    if prev < 0:
        return "흑전" if cur >= 0 else "적자지속"
    if cur < 0:
        return "적전"
    return f"{(cur / prev - 1) * 100:+.1f}%"


def get_snap(conn, code, freq, period, date=None, before=None):
    if date:
        return conn.execute("""SELECT date,avg,min,max,band_asof FROM snapshot
                               WHERE code=? AND freq=? AND period=? AND date=?""",
                            (code, freq, period, date)).fetchone()
    return conn.execute("""SELECT date,avg,min,max,band_asof FROM snapshot
                           WHERE code=? AND freq=? AND period=? AND date<?
                           ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1""",
                        (code, freq, period, before)).fetchone()


def snap_near(conn, code, freq, period, days_ago):
    """(avg, src) — src='bf'면 API 백필 근사치 (WiseReport 월말 포인트는 소급 재계산됨)"""
    target = time.strftime("%Y%m%d", time.localtime(time.time() - days_ago * 86400))
    return conn.execute("""SELECT avg, src FROM snapshot
                           WHERE code=? AND freq=? AND period=? AND date<=?
                           ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1""",
                        (code, freq, period, target)).fetchone()


def get_state(conn, code, key):
    row = conn.execute("SELECT last_avg FROM alert_state WHERE code=? AND key=?",
                       (code, key)).fetchone()
    return row[0] if row else None


def set_state(conn, code, key, val):
    conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO alert_state VALUES(?,?,?,?)",
                 (code, key, val, time.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M")))


def moved(cur, base, tol=C.ALERT_THRESHOLD):
    """음수 안전 변동 판정. base가 음수일 때 `cur < base*0.999` 같은 비교는
    부등호가 뒤집혀 같은 값도 변동으로 오판하므로 절대차/스케일로 비교한다."""
    if cur is None or base is None:
        return False
    scale = max(abs(base), abs(cur), 1.0)
    return abs(cur - base) > tol * scale


def band_note(cur, base_min, base_max):
    """밴드 변화 문구. base_*는 마지막으로 알린 밴드값(alert_state) — 없으면 어제 스냅샷."""
    if not cur:
        return None, False
    cmin, cmax = cur[2], cur[3]
    notes, breakout = [], False
    if cmax is not None and base_max is not None and moved(cmax, base_max, 0.001):
        if cmax > base_max:
            notes.append(f"최고 {fmt_num(base_max)} → {fmt_num(cmax)} (상단 확장 🔥)")
            breakout = True
        else:
            notes.append(f"최고 {fmt_num(base_max)} → {fmt_num(cmax)} (상단 축소)")
    if cmin is not None and base_min is not None and moved(cmin, base_min, 0.001):
        if cmin < base_min:
            notes.append(f"최저 {fmt_num(base_min)} → {fmt_num(cmin)} (하단 이탈 🔥)")
            breakout = True
        else:
            notes.append(f"최저 {fmt_num(base_min)} → {fmt_num(cmin)} (하단 축소)")
    return (" · ".join(notes) if notes else None), breakout


def stock_name(conn, code):
    row = conn.execute("SELECT name FROM names WHERE code=?", (code,)).fetchone()
    return row[0] if row else code


def band_block(conn, code, today):
    """추정치 밴드 3줄: 26E / 27E / 진행분기 — '최고 / 컨센 / 최저'"""
    lines = ["추정치 밴드 (최고 / 컨센 / 최저)"]
    qp = track_q(conn, code, today)
    rows = []
    for freq, period, label in [("Y", C.FY_LIST[0], C.FY_LIST[0][2:4] + "E"),
                                ("Y", C.FY_LIST[1], C.FY_LIST[1][2:4] + "E"),
                                ("Q", qp, q_label(qp))]:
        s = get_snap(conn, code, freq, period, date=today) \
            or get_snap(conn, code, freq, period, before="99999999")
        if not s or s[1] is None:
            continue
        if s[2] is not None and s[3] is not None:
            note = ""
            if freq == "Q" and s[4] and s[4] < time.strftime(
                    "%Y%m%d", time.localtime(time.time() - 7 * 86400)):
                note = f" ({s[4][4:6]}/{s[4][6:8]} 기준)"
            rows.append(f"{label} : {fmt_num(s[3])} / {fmt_num(s[1])} / {fmt_num(s[2])}{note}")
        else:
            rows.append(f"{label} : 밴드 미제공 / {fmt_num(s[1])} / 밴드 미제공")
    return lines + rows if rows else []


def build_message(conn, code, today):
    name = stock_name(conn, code)
    lines, alerted_keys, any_breakout = [], {}, False

    # ── 연간 26E/27E 변동
    for period in C.FY_LIST:
        cur = get_snap(conn, code, "Y", period, date=today)
        prev = get_snap(conn, code, "Y", period, before=today)
        if not cur or cur[1] is None:
            continue
        key = "Y" + period
        base = get_state(conn, code, key)
        if base is None:
            base = prev[1] if prev else None
        if base is None:
            continue
        # 밴드 기준도 마지막 발행 상태 기준 — 없으면 어제 스냅샷 (같은 밴드 반복 발송 방지)
        bmin = get_state(conn, code, key + ":min")
        bmax = get_state(conn, code, key + ":max")
        if bmin is None and prev:
            bmin = prev[2]
        if bmax is None and prev:
            bmax = prev[3]
        val_moved = moved(cur[1], base)
        note, breakout = band_note(cur, bmin, bmax)
        if val_moved or breakout:
            alerted_keys[key] = cur[1]
            if cur[2] is not None:
                alerted_keys[key + ":min"] = cur[2]
            if cur[3] is not None:
                alerted_keys[key + ":max"] = cur[3]
            any_breakout |= breakout
            if val_moved:
                arrow = "▲" if cur[1] >= base else "▼"
                lines.append(f"• {period[:4]}년 OP : {fmt_eok(base)} → {fmt_eok(cur[1])} ({arrow} {pct(cur[1], base)})")
            else:
                lines.append(f"• {period[:4]}년 OP : {fmt_eok(cur[1])} (컨센 평균 유지)")
            if note:
                lines.append(f"   └ 밴드: {note}")

    # ── 분기 변동 (종목별 추적 분기 — 발표 종목은 자동 롤링)
    qp = track_q(conn, code, today)
    cur_q = get_snap(conn, code, "Q", qp, date=today)
    prev_q = get_snap(conn, code, "Q", qp, before=today)
    if cur_q and cur_q[1] is not None:
        key = "Q" + qp
        base = get_state(conn, code, key)
        if base is None:
            base = prev_q[1] if prev_q else None
        if base is not None and moved(cur_q[1], base):
            alerted_keys[key] = cur_q[1]
            arrow = "▲" if cur_q[1] >= base else "▼"
            lines.append(f"• {q_label(qp)} OP : {fmt_eok(base)} → {fmt_eok(cur_q[1])} ({arrow} {pct(cur_q[1], base)})")
            parts = []
            for ref_q, tag in [(prev_quarter(qp), "QoQ"), (yoy_quarter(qp), "YoY")]:
                row = conn.execute("SELECT op,is_est FROM actuals WHERE code=? AND quarter=?",
                                   (code, ref_q)).fetchone()
                if row:
                    g = growth_label(cur_q[1], row[0], row[1])
                    if g:
                        parts.append(f"{tag} {g} (vs {fmt_eok(row[0])})")
            if parts:
                lines.append("   └ " + " / ".join(parts))

    if not alerted_keys:
        return None, {}

    # ── 추정치 밴드 3줄
    bb = band_block(conn, code, today)
    if bb:
        lines.append("")
        lines.extend(bb)

    # ── Snapshot (26E·27E 다기간)
    snap_lines = []
    for period in C.FY_LIST:
        cur = get_snap(conn, code, "Y", period, date=today)
        if not cur or not cur[1]:
            continue
        snaps = []
        for label, d in [("1주 전", 7), ("1개월 전", 30), ("3개월 전", 91), ("1년 전", 365)]:
            row = snap_near(conn, code, "Y", period, d)
            if row and row[0]:
                p = pct(cur[1], row[0])
                if p:
                    approx = "≈" if row[1] != "live" else ""
                    snaps.append(f"{label} {approx}{p}")
        if snaps:
            snap_lines.append(f"{period[2:4]}E : " + " · ".join(snaps))
    if snap_lines:
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("Snapshot")
        lines.extend(snap_lines)

    # ── Revision History (26E·27E 각 6개)
    hist_has_bf = False
    for period in C.FY_LIST:
        hist = conn.execute("""SELECT date, avg, src FROM snapshot
                               WHERE code=? AND freq='Y' AND period=? AND avg IS NOT NULL
                               ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 6""", (code, period)).fetchall()
        if len(hist) > 1:
            lines.append("")
            lines.append(f"Revision History ({period[2:4]}E)")
            base_v = hist[0][1]
            for d, v, src in hist:
                approx = "≈" if src != "live" else ""
                hist_has_bf |= src != "live"
                lines.append(f"{d[2:4]}/{d[4:6]}/{d[6:8]} : {approx}{fmt_eok(v)} / {pct(base_v, v) or '+0.0%'}")
    if hist_has_bf:
        lines.append("※ ≈ 표시는 월말 백필 근사치 (일별 실측 축적 중)")

    # ── 리포트 발행이력
    ops = conn.execute("""SELECT date, broker, opinion, tp FROM opinions
                          WHERE code=? ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 5""", (code,)).fetchall()
    titles = dict(((d, b), t) for d, b, t in conn.execute(
        """SELECT date, broker, title FROM reports WHERE code=?
           ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 30""", (code,)).fetchall())
    lines.append("")
    if ops:
        lines.append("리포트 발행이력")
        for d, broker, opinion, tp in ops:
            tp_s = f"TP {tp:,.0f}원" if tp else "TP -"
            title = titles.get((d, broker), "")
            lines.append(f"{d[2:4]}/{d[4:6]}/{d[6:8]} | {broker} | {opinion} | {tp_s}"
                         + (f" | {title}" if title else ""))
    else:
        lines.append("리포트 미확인 — 집계 모집단 변경 가능성")

    emoji = "🔥" if any_breakout else "🚨"
    header = f"{emoji} [{name}] 영업이익(OP) 컨센서스 변동 감지"
    return header + "\n" + "\n".join(lines), alerted_keys


def notify_new_reports(conn, codes, dry):
    """당일 신규 의견/리포트 📝 알림 (sent_events 1회 보장)"""
    today = time.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    sent = 0
    for code in codes:
        rows = conn.execute("""SELECT o.date, o.broker, o.opinion, o.tp FROM opinions o
                               WHERE o.date=? AND o.code=? AND NOT EXISTS(
                                 SELECT 1 FROM sent_events s
                                 WHERE s.date=o.date AND s.code=o.code AND s.broker=o.broker)""",
                            (today, code)).fetchall()
        if not rows:
            continue
        name = stock_name(conn, code)
        titles = dict(((d, b), t) for d, b, t in conn.execute(
            "SELECT date, broker, title FROM reports WHERE code=? AND date=?",
            (code, today)).fetchall())
        lines = [f"📝 [{name}] 당일 신규 리포트 감지"]
        for d, broker, opinion, tp in rows:
            tp_s = f"TP {tp:,.0f}원" if tp else "TP -"
            title = titles.get((d, broker), "")
            lines.append(f"{d[2:4]}/{d[4:6]}/{d[6:8]} | {broker} | {opinion} | {tp_s}"
                         + (f" | {title}" if title else ""))
        bb = band_block(conn, code, today)
        if bb:
            lines.append("")
            lines.extend(["현재 " + bb[0]] + bb[1:])
        lines.append("※ 컨센서스 수치 반영 시 변동 알림 별도 발송")
        msg = "\n".join(lines)
        if dry:
            print("=" * 60)
            print(msg)
        else:
            if not C.tg_send(msg):
                continue
        for d, broker, _, _ in rows:
            conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO sent_events VALUES(?,?,?)", (d, code, broker))
        conn.commit()
        sent += 1
        time.sleep(1)
    return sent


def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    dry = "--dry-run" in args
    codes = C.universe()
    if "--codes" in args:
        subset = args[args.index("--codes") + 1].split(",")
        codes = [c for c in codes if c in subset]
    today = time.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    conn = C.db()
    n_rep = notify_new_reports(conn, codes, dry)
    sent = 0
    for code in codes:
        msg, keys = build_message(conn, code, today)
        if not msg:
            continue
        if dry:
            print("=" * 60)
            print(msg)
        else:
            if not C.tg_send(msg):
                continue
            for k, v in keys.items():
                set_state(conn, code, k, v)
            conn.commit()
        sent += 1
        time.sleep(1)
    print(f"발행: 변동 {sent}건 / 신규리포트 {n_rep}건 ({'dry' if dry else 'live'})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""아침 배치: 컨센 수집 → 의견/리포트 수집 → 변동 발행"""
import subprocess
import sys
import os

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
PY = sys.executable


def run(script, *args):
    r = subprocess.run([PY, os.path.join(HERE, script), *args], cwd=HERE)
    return r.returncode


def main():
    if run("fetch_consensus.py") != 0:
        print("수집 실패율 초과 — 발행 중단")
        sys.exit(1)
    run("fetch_opinions.py")
    run("publish.py", *sys.argv[1:])  # --dry-run 전달 가능


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
KIS OpenAPI 스모크 테스트 — 종목추정실적/투자의견 응답 구조 확인용 (1회성)
사전 준비 (터미널에서 직접 실행, 기존 kiwoom 패턴과 동일):
  security add-generic-password -a kis -s kis-appkey -w
  security add-generic-password -a kis -s kis-secret -w
실행:
  cd /Users/1ne/수급html && .venv/bin/python3 consensus_bot/smoke_kis.py 020000
확인 포인트:
  1) output에 2026E뿐 아니라 2027E 컬럼이 있는가
  2) 영업이익 값이 FnGuide(한섬 26E 939억 / 27E 1,057억)와 일치하는가
  3) invest-opbysec에 증권사명·의견·목표가·일자가 어디까지 나오는가
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

import requests

HOST = "https://openapi.koreainvestment.com:9443"
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
TOKEN_CACHE = os.path.join(HERE, ".kis_token.json")


def keychain(service):
    r = subprocess.run(["security", "find-generic-password", "-s", service, "-w"],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"키체인에 {service} 없음 — 파일 상단 주석의 add-generic-password 먼저 실행")
    return r.stdout.strip()


def get_token(app, sec):
    # KIS 토큰은 재발급 시 기존 토큰이 무효화되므로 반드시 파일 캐시 공유 (유효 24h)
    if os.path.exists(TOKEN_CACHE):
        c = json.load(open(TOKEN_CACHE))
        if time.time() < c.get("expires_at", 0) - 600:
            return c["access_token"]
    for attempt in range(3):
        r = requests.post(HOST + "/oauth2/tokenP",
                          json={"grant_type": "client_credentials", "appkey": app, "appsecret": sec},
                          timeout=10)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            break
        print(f"토큰 발급 실패 ({r.status_code}): {r.text[:150]} — 65초 후 재시도")
        time.sleep(65)
    r.raise_for_status()
    j = r.json()
    j["expires_at"] = time.time() + int(j.get("expires_in", 86400))
    json.dump(j, open(TOKEN_CACHE, "w"))
    os.chmod(TOKEN_CACHE, 0o600)
    return j["access_token"]


def call(token, app, sec, path, tr_id, params):
    h = {"content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
         "authorization": "Bearer " + token,
         "appkey": app, "appsecret": sec, "tr_id": tr_id, "custtype": "P"}
    r = requests.get(HOST + path, headers=h, params=params, timeout=10)
    print(f"\n{'='*70}\n{tr_id} {path}  HTTP {r.status_code}")
    try:
        j = r.json()
        print(json.dumps(j, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)[:4000])
        return j
    except Exception:
        print(r.text[:1000])


def main():
    code = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "020000"  # 한섬
    app, sec = keychain("kis-appkey"), keychain("kis-secret")
    token = get_token(app, sec)

    # 1) 종목추정실적 [국내주식-187] — 26E/27E OP 나오는지 확인
    call(token, app, sec, "/uapi/domestic-stock/v1/quotations/estimate-perform",
         "HHKST668300C0", {"SHT_CD": code})

    # 2) 종목투자의견 [국내주식-188] — 최근 3개월 의견 이력
    call(token, app, sec, "/uapi/domestic-stock/v1/quotations/invest-opinion",
         "FHKST663300C0",
         {"FID_COND_MRKT_DIV_CODE": "J", "FID_COND_SCR_DIV_CODE": "16633",
          "FID_INPUT_ISCD": code,
          "FID_INPUT_DATE_1": time.strftime("%Y%m%d", time.localtime(time.time() - 90 * 86400)),
          "FID_INPUT_DATE_2": time.strftime("%Y%m%d")})

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""연속 이미지 체인 감사: (1) 기준일 순서/중복 (2) N의 d2 == N-1의 d1 값 일치 (3) 결측일"""
import json, datetime as dt, collections
from build_series import load, period_keys
from parse_table import ROW_KEYS

raws = load()
print(f"이미지 {len(raws)}건 · 기준일 {raws[0]['asof']} ~ {raws[-1]['asof']}")

# 1) 기준일 중복/역순
seen = collections.Counter(r["asof"] for r in raws)
dup = {k: v for k, v in seen.items() if v > 1}
print("기준일 중복:", dup or "없음")

# 2) 체인 검증
prev = None
mismatch = []
gap = []
for r in raws:
    pk = period_keys(r)
    if prev is not None:
        pd1 = period_keys(prev)["d1"]
        if pk["d2"] != pd1:
            gap.append((prev["file"], prev["asof"], pd1, r["file"], r["asof"], pk["d2"]))
        else:
            for rk in ROW_KEYS:
                a = prev["rows"].get(rk, {}).get("d1")
                b = r["rows"].get(rk, {}).get("d2")
                if a and b and abs(a["v"] - b["v"]) > 1e-9:
                    mismatch.append((rk, pd1, prev["file"], a["v"], r["file"], b["v"]))
    prev = r

print(f"\n[체인 불일치] {len(mismatch)}건")
c = collections.Counter(m[0] for m in mismatch)
print("  행별:", c.most_common(10))
for m in mismatch[:25]:
    print("   ", m)

print(f"\n[연결 끊김(d2≠직전 d1 날짜)] {len(gap)}건")
for g in gap[:20]:
    print("   ", g)

# 3) 영업일 결측
days = sorted(dt.date.fromisoformat(r["asof"]) for r in raws)
missing = []
d = days[0]
while d < days[-1]:
    d += dt.timedelta(days=1)
    if d.weekday() < 5 and d not in set(days):
        missing.append(d.isoformat())
print(f"\n[평일 중 자료 없는 날] {len(missing)}일")
print("   ", missing[:40])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""raw_refined.json → 기간키 정규화 + 이미지간 교차검증 → observations.json / conflicts.json"""
import json, re, sys, collections, datetime as dt
from pathlib import Path
from parse_table import ROW_KEYS, DATA_ROWS, DIFF_ROWS

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MONTHS = {m: i + 1 for i, m in enumerate(
    ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"])}
ORD = {"1st": 1, "2nd": 2, "3rd": 3, "3th": 3, "4th": 4, "5th": 5, "2th": 2, "1th": 1}


def load():
    src = HERE / "merged.json"
    if not src.exists():
        src = HERE / "raw_refined.json"
    raws = json.load(open(src, encoding="utf-8"))
    fixes = json.load(open(HERE / "manual_fixes.json", encoding="utf-8"))
    for r in raws:
        f = fixes.get(r["file"])
        if not f:
            continue
        if "asof" in f:
            r["asof"] = f["asof"]
        for k, v in (f.get("col_labels") or {}).items():
            r["col_labels"][k] = v
        for rk, cells in (f.get("rows") or {}).items():
            for ck, v in cells.items():
                r["rows"].setdefault(rk, {})[ck] = {"v": v, "t": str(v), "c": 1.0, "src": "manual"}
    raws = [r for r in raws if r.get("asof")]
    raws.sort(key=lambda r: (r["asof"], r["msg_id"]))
    _drop_stale_daily(raws)
    return raws


def _drop_stale_daily(raws):
    """원본 미갱신 감지: 어떤 행의 (d1,d2,chg)가 직전 이미지와 완전히 동일한데
       오늘 d2(=어제 d1과 같은 날짜)가 어제 d1 관측과 모순되면 — 값이 하루 밀려
       실린 것이므로 그 행의 일별 3셀을 배제한다. (2026-08-25 유가 블록 사례)"""
    from parse_table import ROW_KEYS
    dropped = []
    for i in range(1, len(raws)):
        prev, cur = raws[i - 1], raws[i]
        pk_p, pk_c = period_keys(prev), period_keys(cur)
        if not pk_c.get("d2") or pk_c["d2"] != pk_p.get("d1"):
            continue
        for rk in ROW_KEYS:
            cp, cc = prev["rows"].get(rk, {}), cur["rows"].get(rk, {})
            vp = [cp.get(k, {}).get("v") for k in ("d1", "d2", "d_chg")]
            vc = [cc.get(k, {}).get("v") for k in ("d1", "d2", "d_chg")]
            if None in vp or None in vc:
                continue
            if vc == vp and vc[1] != vp[0]:      # 통째로 밀림 + 어제 관측과 모순
                for k in ("d1", "d2", "d_chg"):
                    cc.pop(k, None)
                dropped.append((cur["file"], rk))
    if dropped:
        import collections
        byf = collections.Counter(f for f, _ in dropped)
        print(f"[미갱신 배제] {len(dropped)}개 행-셀그룹: {dict(byf)}")
    return dropped


def period_keys(r):
    """이미지 1장의 열 → 정규화 기간키. 없으면 None"""
    a = dt.date.fromisoformat(r["asof"])
    L = r["col_labels"]
    out = {}

    def mmdd(lab):
        m = re.match(r"^(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})$", str(lab or ""))
        if not m:
            return None
        mo, dd = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        y = a.year - 1 if (mo - a.month) > 6 else a.year
        try:
            return dt.date(y, mo, dd).isoformat()
        except ValueError:
            return None
    out["d1"] = mmdd(L.get("d1")) or a.isoformat()
    out["d2"] = mmdd(L.get("d2"))

    def wk(lab):
        m = re.match(r"^(\d{1,2})-(\d)(st|nd|rd|th)$", str(lab or ""))
        if not m:
            return None
        mo, n = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        y = a.year - 1 if (mo - a.month) > 6 else a.year
        return f"{y}-{mo:02d}-W{n}"
    out["w1"], out["w2"] = wk(L.get("w1")), wk(L.get("w2"))

    def mn(lab):
        m = re.match(r"^([A-Z][a-z]{2})-(\d{2})$", str(lab or ""))
        return f"20{m.group(2)}-{MONTHS[m.group(1)]:02d}" if m and m.group(1) in MONTHS else None
    out["m1"], out["m2"] = mn(L.get("m1")), mn(L.get("m2"))

    def qt(lab):
        m = re.match(r"^(\d)Q(\d{2})$", str(lab or ""))
        return f"20{m.group(2)}-Q{m.group(1)}" if m else None
    out["q1"], out["q2"], out["q3"] = qt(L.get("q1")), qt(L.get("q2")), qt(L.get("q3"))

    def yr(lab):
        m = re.match(r"^'?(\d{2})$", str(lab or ""))
        return f"20{m.group(1)}" if m else None
    out["y1"], out["y2"] = yr(L.get("y1")), yr(L.get("y2"))
    return out


SERIES_OF = {"d1": "D", "d2": "D", "w1": "W", "w2": "W", "m1": "M", "m2": "M",
             "q1": "Q", "q2": "Q", "q3": "Q", "y1": "Y", "y2": "Y"}


def period_end(stype, key):
    """해당 기간의 종료일 (이후 관측은 확정치)."""
    try:
        if stype == "D":
            return dt.date.fromisoformat(key)
        if stype == "M":
            y, m = map(int, key.split("-"))
            return dt.date(y + (m == 12), (m % 12) + 1, 1) - dt.timedelta(days=1)
        if stype == "Q":
            y, q = int(key[:4]), int(key[-1])
            em = q * 3
            return dt.date(y + (em == 12), (em % 12) + 1, 1) - dt.timedelta(days=1)
        if stype == "Y":
            return dt.date(int(key), 12, 31)
        if stype == "W":
            y, m, w = int(key[:4]), int(key[5:7]), int(key[-1])
            d = min(w * 7, 28 if m == 2 else 30)
            return dt.date(y, m, d)
    except Exception:
        return None


def main():
    raws = load()
    obs = collections.defaultdict(list)     # (rk, stype, period) → [(asof, value, file, colkey)]
    for r in raws:
        pk = period_keys(r)
        for rk in ROW_KEYS:
            cells = r["rows"].get(rk, {})
            for ck, stype in SERIES_OF.items():
                cell = cells.get(ck)
                key = pk.get(ck)
                if cell is None or key is None:
                    continue
                obs[(rk, stype, key)].append(
                    {"asof": r["asof"], "v": cell["v"], "file": r["file"], "col": ck,
                     "c": cell.get("c", 1.0), "src": cell.get("src", "")})

    final, conflicts = {}, []
    for (rk, stype, key), lst in obs.items():
        end = period_end(stype, key)
        if stype == "D":
            # 일별: 다수결 → src 신뢰도(both 우선) → 나중 관측(원본 소급 정정 존중)
            TRUST = {"both": 3, "manual": 3, "strip": 2, "full": 2, "crop": 2}
            cnt = collections.Counter(o["v"] for o in lst)
            top = cnt.most_common(1)[0][1]
            tied = [v for v, n in cnt.items() if n == top]
            if len(tied) == 1:
                val, n, settled = tied[0], top, lst
            else:
                def rank(v):
                    os_ = [o for o in lst if o["v"] == v]
                    return (max(TRUST.get(o["src"], 1) for o in os_),
                            max(o["asof"] for o in os_))
                val = max(tied, key=rank)
                n, settled = top, lst
            final[f"{rk}|{stype}|{key}"] = {"v": val, "n": len(lst), "agree": n, "nobs": len(lst)}
            if len(cnt) > 1:
                conflicts.append({"row": rk, "stype": stype, "period": key,
                                  "counts": dict(cnt), "chosen": val,
                                  "obs": [{"asof": o["asof"], "v": o["v"], "f": o["file"], "col": o["col"]}
                                          for o in sorted(lst, key=lambda x: x["asof"])]})
            continue
        settled = [o for o in lst if end and dt.date.fromisoformat(o["asof"]) > end] or lst
        cnt = collections.Counter(o["v"] for o in settled)
        val, n = cnt.most_common(1)[0]
        final[f"{rk}|{stype}|{key}"] = {"v": val, "n": len(settled), "agree": n,
                                        "nobs": len(lst)}
        if len(cnt) > 1:
            conflicts.append({"row": rk, "stype": stype, "period": key,
                              "counts": dict(cnt), "chosen": val,
                              "obs": [{"asof": o["asof"], "v": o["v"], "f": o["file"], "col": o["col"]}
                                      for o in sorted(lst, key=lambda x: x["asof"])]})

    # ── 웹 백필 오버레이: 표에 관측이 없는 키만 채움 (표 관측이 항상 우선) ──
    wf_path = HERE / "web_fill.json"
    if wf_path.exists():
        n_used = 0
        for key, rec in json.load(open(wf_path, encoding="utf-8")).items():
            if key not in final:
                final[key] = {"v": rec["v"], "n": 0, "agree": 0, "nobs": 0, "src": rec.get("src", "web")}
                n_used += 1
        if n_used:
            print(f"[웹 백필] {n_used}개 키 적용 (표 미관측분만)")

    json.dump({"final": final}, open(HERE / "observations.json", "w", encoding="utf-8"),
              ensure_ascii=False)
    json.dump(conflicts, open(HERE / "conflicts.json", "w", encoding="utf-8"),
              ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)

    bys = collections.Counter(k.split("|")[1] for k in final)
    print("기간키 수:", dict(bys), "합계", len(final))
    print(f"복수관측 불일치 {len(conflicts)}건 / 전체 {len(final)} ({len(conflicts)/len(final)*100:.2f}%)")
    cs = collections.Counter((c["stype"]) for c in conflicts)
    print("  타입별:", dict(cs))
    cr = collections.Counter(c["row"] for c in conflicts)
    print("  행별 top:", cr.most_common(10))
    for c in conflicts[:10]:
        print("   ", c["row"], c["stype"], c["period"], c["counts"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""pass6: 이미지 간 체인 정보로 잔여 산술불일치 해소.
   이미지 N 의 d2 는 직전 이미지의 d1 과 같은 날짜 → 그 값을 고신뢰 후보로 추가."""
import json, itertools
from pathlib import Path
from parse_table import ROW_KEYS
from refine_pass import chg_ok, PAIRS
from refine2 import _fmt, failing_triples
from build_series import period_keys

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DST = HERE / "merged.json"


def main():
    raws = json.load(open(DST, encoding="utf-8"))
    fixes = json.load(open(HERE / "manual_fixes.json", encoding="utf-8"))
    # manual asof/label 반영한 순서로 정렬(값은 건드리지 않음)
    order = sorted(
        (r for r in raws if r.get("asof") or fixes.get(r["file"], {}).get("asof")),
        key=lambda r: (fixes.get(r["file"], {}).get("asof") or r["asof"], r["msg_id"]))
    nf = 0; unres = []
    for i, r in enumerate(order):
        tri = failing_triples(r)
        if not tri:
            continue
        prev = order[i - 1] if i else None
        for rk, a, b, c in tri:
            cells = r["rows"][rk]
            cand = {ck: {cells[ck]["v"]: 1} for ck in (a, b, c)}
            for v in list(cand[c]):
                cand[c].setdefault(-v, 0)
            if (a, b) == ("d1", "d2"):
                if prev is not None:
                    pv = prev["rows"].get(rk, {}).get("d1")
                    if pv:
                        cand[b][pv["v"]] = cand[b].get(pv["v"], 0) + 2
                if i + 1 < len(order):
                    nv = order[i + 1]["rows"].get(rk, {}).get("d2")
                    if nv:
                        cand[a][nv["v"]] = cand[a].get(nv["v"], 0) + 2
            combos = []
            for va, vb, vc in itertools.product(cand[a], cand[b], cand[c]):
                A = {"v": va, "t": _fmt(va, cells[a]["t"])}
                B = {"v": vb, "t": _fmt(vb, cells[b]["t"])}
                C = {"v": vc, "t": _fmt(vc, cells[c]["t"])}
                if chg_ok(rk, A, B, C):
                    score = cand[a][va] + cand[b][vb] + cand[c][vc]
                    nchg = sum(1 for ck, v in ((a, va), (b, vb), (c, vc)) if v != cells[ck]["v"])
                    combos.append((-nchg, score, va, vb, vc))
            if combos:
                combos.sort(reverse=True)
                _, _, va, vb, vc = combos[0]
                for ck, v in ((a, va), (b, vb), (c, vc)):
                    if v != cells[ck]["v"]:
                        print("  fix", r["file"], rk, ck, cells[ck]["v"], "→", v)
                        cells[ck] = {"v": v, "t": _fmt(v, cells[ck]["t"]), "c": 0.85, "src": "chain"}
                        nf += 1
            else:
                unres.append((r["file"], r["asof"], rk, c,
                              cells[a]["v"], cells[b]["v"], cells[c]["v"]))
    raws.sort(key=lambda r: r["msg_id"])
    DST.write_text(json.dumps(raws, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"체인수정 {nf}셀 / 미해결 {len(unres)}건")
    for u in unres:
        print("   ", u)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""산술 정합 + 결측 리포트 (raw_tables.json / raw_refined.json 공용)"""
import json, sys, collections
from pathlib import Path
from parse_table import ROW_KEYS, COL_KEYS
from refine_pass import chg_ok, PAIRS, expected_fill

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
src = HERE / (sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "raw_refined.json")
raws = json.load(open(src, encoding="utf-8"))
exp = expected_fill(raws)

n = bad = 0
by_row = collections.Counter(); by_img = collections.Counter(); samples = []
for r in raws:
    for rk in ROW_KEYS:
        cells = r["rows"].get(rk, {})
        for a, b, c in PAIRS:
            A, B, C = cells.get(a), cells.get(b), cells.get(c)
            if A and B and C:
                n += 1
                if chg_ok(rk, A, B, C) is False:
                    bad += 1; by_row[rk] += 1; by_img[r["file"]] += 1
                    if len(samples) < 30:
                        samples.append((r["file"], r["asof"], rk, a,
                                        A["t"], B["t"], C["t"]))
print(f"[{src.name}] 산술 {n:,}건 중 불일치 {bad}건 ({bad/max(n,1)*100:.3f}%)")
print("행별:", by_row.most_common(10))
print("이미지별:", by_img.most_common(10))
for s in samples: print("   ", s)

missing = collections.Counter()
for r in raws:
    for (rk, ck) in exp:
        if ck not in r["rows"].get(rk, {}):
            missing[(rk, ck)] += 1
print(f"\n[기대셀 결측] 총 {sum(missing.values())}개 / {len(raws)*len(exp):,}")
print("  top:", missing.most_common(12))
noasof = [r["file"] for r in raws if not r.get("asof")]
print("[기준일 없음]", len(noasof), noasof[:10])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""가격동향 표 이미지(993x1261)만 골라 다운로드. 증분 — 이미 받은 id는 스킵."""
import os, sys, json, asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv

TG = Path("/Users/1ne/수급html/telegram-digest")
load_dotenv(TG / ".env")
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
IMG = HERE / "images"
IMG.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

census = json.load(open(HERE / "media_census.json", encoding="utf-8"))
targets = [x for x in census if (x["w"], x["h"]) == (993, 1261)]
have = {p.stem for p in IMG.glob("*.jpg")}
todo = [x for x in targets if str(x["id"]) not in have]
print(f"대상 {len(targets)}건 / 기보유 {len(have)} / 다운로드 {len(todo)}")


async def main():
    from telethon import TelegramClient
    client = TelegramClient(str(TG / "user_session"), int(os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_ID"]),
                            os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_HASH"])
    await client.start()
    ent = await client.get_entity("@energy_youn")
    ids = [x["id"] for x in todo]
    done = 0
    for i in range(0, len(ids), 100):
        chunk = ids[i:i + 100]
        msgs = await client.get_messages(ent, ids=chunk)
        for m in msgs:
            if m is None or getattr(m, "photo", None) is None:
                continue
            await client.download_media(m, file=str(IMG / f"{m.id}.jpg"))
            done += 1
        print(f"  {done}/{len(ids)}", flush=True)
    await client.disconnect()
    meta = {str(x["id"]): {"dt": x["dt"], "id": x["id"]} for x in targets}
    (HERE / "images_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    print("완료")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""merged.json 의 '높은 기대충전율(≥95%)인데 비어있는' 셀을 다중변형 재판독으로 채움."""
import json, time, collections
from pathlib import Path
from multiprocessing import Pool
from PIL import Image
from parse_table import ROW_KEYS, COL_KEYS

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SRC = HERE / "merged.json"


def work(args):
    from reread import candidates
    fn, targets = args
    img = Image.open(HERE / "images" / fn)
    got = []
    for rk, ck in targets:
        votes, _ = candidates(img, rk, ck)
        if votes:
            v, n = votes.most_common(1)[0]
            if n >= 2:                       # 2표 이상만 신뢰
                got.append((rk, ck, v, n))
    return fn, got


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raws = json.load(open(SRC, encoding="utf-8"))
    n = len(raws)
    cnt = collections.Counter()
    for r in raws:
        for rk in ROW_KEYS:
            for ck in r["rows"].get(rk, {}):
                cnt[(rk, ck)] += 1
    expected = {k for k, v in cnt.items() if v >= 0.5 * n}
    jobs = []
    for r in raws:
        t = [(rk, ck) for (rk, ck) in expected if ck not in r["rows"].get(rk, {})]
        if t:
            jobs.append((r["file"], t))
    tot = sum(len(t) for _, t in jobs)
    print(f"채움 대상 {tot:,}셀 / {len(jobs)}이미지")
    t0 = time.time()
    idx = {r["file"]: r for r in raws}
    filled = 0
    with Pool(6) as pool:
        for i, (fn, got) in enumerate(pool.imap_unordered(work, jobs, chunksize=4), 1):
            for rk, ck, v, nn in got:
                idx[fn]["rows"].setdefault(rk, {})[ck] = {
                    "v": v, "t": str(v), "c": 0.8, "src": "fill"}
                filled += 1
            if i % 60 == 0:
                print(f"  {i}/{len(jobs)} filled {filled}  {time.time()-t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
    SRC.write_text(json.dumps(raws, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"완료 — {filled:,}/{tot:,}셀 채움 / {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
energy_price/final_fix.pypass7: 잔여 산술불일치를 제한된 오독모델로 해소.90줄 · 3KB · 2026-08-24
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""pass7: 잔여 산술불일치를 제한된 오독모델로 해소.
   오독모델: (1) 변동률 이탤릭 .7↔.1 (0.6 차이), 부호 소실
             (2) 피연산자 한 자리 오독 — 산술로 역산한 값이 현재 토큰과 ≤1자리 차이일 때만
   유일해일 때만 적용, 아니면 리포트."""
import json, itertools
from pathlib import Path
from parse_table import ROW_KEYS, DIFF_ROWS
from refine_pass import chg_ok, PAIRS
from refine2 import _fmt, failing_triples

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DST = HERE / "merged.json"


def digit_variants(cur_t, target_v):
    """target_v 가 cur 토큰과 같은 자릿수 & ≤1자리 차이인가"""
    a = str(cur_t).replace(",", "")
    b = _fmt(target_v, cur_t).replace(",", "")
    if len(a) != len(b):
        return False
    return sum(x != y for x, y in zip(a, b)) <= 1


def solve(rk, cells, a, b, c):
    va, vb, vc = cells[a]["v"], cells[b]["v"], cells[c]["v"]
    # 후보군
    cand_c = {vc}
    cand_c.add(-vc)
    frac = round(abs(vc) * 10) % 10
    if frac == 7:
        cand_c.add((abs(vc) - 0.6) * (1 if vc > 0 else -1))
    if frac == 1:
        cand_c.add((abs(vc) + 0.6) * (1 if vc > 0 else -1))
    cand_a, cand_b = {va}, {vb}
    for cc in cand_c:
        if rk in DIFF_ROWS:
            da, db = vb + cc, va - cc
        else:
            da, db = vb * (1 + cc / 100), va / (1 + cc / 100) if cc != -100 else None
        for dv, cur, pool in ((da, cells[a], cand_a), (db, cells[b], cand_b)):
            if dv is None:
                continue
            r = round(dv, 1) if abs(dv) < 100 else round(dv)
            if digit_variants(cur["t"], r):
                pool.add(float(r))
    sols = []
    for x, y, z in itertools.product(cand_a, cand_b, cand_c):
        A = {"v": x, "t": _fmt(x, cells[a]["t"])}
        B = {"v": y, "t": _fmt(y, cells[b]["t"])}
        C = {"v": z, "t": _fmt(z, cells[c]["t"])}
        if chg_ok(rk, A, B, C):
            nch = sum(1 for ck, v in ((a, x), (b, y), (c, z)) if v != cells[ck]["v"])
            sols.append((nch, x, y, z))
    if not sols:
        return None, "no_solution"
    m = min(s[0] for s in sols)
    best = [s for s in sols if s[0] == m]
    if len(best) > 1:
        return None, f"ambiguous({len(best)})"
    return best[0], None


def main():
    raws = json.load(open(DST, encoding="utf-8"))
    nf = 0; unres = []
    for r in raws:
        for rk, a, b, c in failing_triples(r):
            cells = r["rows"][rk]
            sol, err = solve(rk, cells, a, b, c)
            if sol:
                _, x, y, z = sol
                for ck, v in ((a, x), (b, y), (c, z)):
                    if v != cells[ck]["v"]:
                        print("  fix", r["file"], rk, ck, cells[ck]["v"], "→", v)
                        cells[ck] = {"v": v, "t": _fmt(v, cells[ck]["t"]), "c": 0.8, "src": "model"}
                        nf += 1
            else:
                unres.append((r["file"], r["asof"], rk, c, cells[a]["v"], cells[b]["v"],
                              cells[c]["v"], err))
    DST.write_text(json.dumps(raws, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"모델수정 {nf}셀 / 미해결 {len(unres)}")
    for u in unres:
        print("   ", u)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""헤더(기준일 + 기간 라벨) 결측/형식위반 셀만 확대 재OCR → raw_refined.json 갱신"""
import json, re, time
from pathlib import Path
from multiprocessing import Pool
from PIL import Image
from parse_table import COL_X

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DST = HERE / "raw_refined.json"
PAT = {"d1": r"^\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}$", "d2": r"^\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}$",
       "w1": r"^\d{1,2}-\d(st|nd|rd|th)$", "w2": r"^\d{1,2}-\d(st|nd|rd|th)$",
       "m1": r"^[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{2}$", "m2": r"^[A-Z][a-z]{2}-\d{2}$",
       "q1": r"^\dQ\d{2}$", "q2": r"^\dQ\d{2}$", "q3": r"^\dQ\d{2}$",
       "y1": r"^'?\d{2}$", "y2": r"^'?\d{2}$"}
MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]


def _crop_ocr(img, box, scale=8, langs=("en-US",)):
    from ocr_core import ocr_words
    c = img.crop(box)
    c = c.resize((c.width * scale, c.height * scale), Image.LANCZOS)
    ws = sorted(ocr_words(c, scale=1.0, langs=langs), key=lambda w: w["cx"])
    return " ".join(w["text"] for w in ws)


def fix_label(img, ck):
    x = COL_X[ck]
    txt = _crop_ocr(img, (int(x - 27), 82, int(x + 27), 102))
    t = txt.replace(" ", "").replace("−", "-")
    if ck in ("d1", "d2"):
        m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})[/\\|l](\d{1,2})", t)
        return f"{int(m.group(1))}/{int(m.group(2)):02d}" if m else None
    if ck in ("w1", "w2"):
        m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})-?(\d)(st|nd|rd|th)", t, re.I)
        return f"{int(m.group(1))}-{m.group(2)}{m.group(3).lower()}" if m else None
    if ck in ("m1", "m2"):
        m = re.search(r"([A-Za-z]{3})-?(\d{2})", t)
        if m:
            cand = [x for x in MONTHS if x.lower() == m.group(1).lower()]
            if cand:
                return f"{cand[0]}-{m.group(2)}"
        return None
    if ck in ("q1", "q2", "q3"):
        m = re.search(r"(\d)[QO0](\d{2})", t.upper())
        return f"{m.group(1)}Q{m.group(2)}" if m else None
    if ck in ("y1", "y2"):
        m = re.search(r"(\d{2})", t)
        return f"'{m.group(1)}" if m else None
    return None


def work(r):
    img = None
    ch = []
    for ck, pat in PAT.items():
        v = r["col_labels"].get(ck)
        if v and re.match(pat, str(v)):
            if ck in ("y1", "y2") and not str(v).startswith("'"):
                r["col_labels"][ck] = "'" + str(v)
            continue
        if img is None:
            img = Image.open(HERE / "images" / r["file"])
        nv = fix_label(img, ck)
        if nv:
            r["col_labels"][ck] = nv
            ch.append((ck, v, nv))
    if not r.get("asof"):
        if img is None:
            img = Image.open(HERE / "images" / r["file"])
        W = img.width
        t = _crop_ocr(img, (int(W * 0.58), 5, W - 5, 45), scale=6)
        m = re.search(r"(20\d{2})\D{0,3}(\d{1,2})\D{0,3}(\d{1,2})", t.replace(" ", ""))
        if m:
            r["asof"] = f"{m.group(1)}-{int(m.group(2)):02d}-{int(m.group(3)):02d}"
            ch.append(("asof", None, r["asof"]))
    return r, ch


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raws = json.load(open(DST, encoding="utf-8"))
    t0 = time.time(); out = []; n = 0
    with Pool(6) as pool:
        for r, ch in pool.imap_unordered(work, raws, chunksize=8):
            out.append(r); n += len(ch)
            if ch and len(ch) > 3:
                print(" ", r["file"], r["asof"], ch[:6])
    out.sort(key=lambda r: r["msg_id"])
    DST.write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"헤더 {n}개 보정 / {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
    bad = [(r["file"], r["asof"], {k: r["col_labels"].get(k) for k in PAT
            if not re.match(PAT[k], str(r["col_labels"].get(k) or ""))}) for r in out]
    bad = [b for b in bad if b[2]]
    print("잔여 형식위반", len(bad))
    for b in bad[:15]:
        print("  ", b)
    print("기준일 없음:", [r["file"] for r in out if not r.get("asof")])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""full-OCR(raw_refined) + strip-OCR(strip_tables) 병합 → merged.json
   - 두 값이 일치 → 확정 (매우 높은 신뢰)
   - 한쪽만 존재 → 채택
   - 불일치 → 다중변형 재판독(reread)으로 심판
"""
import json, time, collections
from pathlib import Path
from multiprocessing import Pool
from PIL import Image
from parse_table import ROW_KEYS, COL_KEYS

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def work(args):
    from reread import candidates
    fn, full, strip = args
    img = None
    rows, disp = {}, []
    for rk in ROW_KEYS:
        fc, sc = full.get(rk, {}), strip.get(rk, {})
        m = {}
        for ck in COL_KEYS:
            f, s = fc.get(ck), sc.get(ck)
            if f and s:
                if abs(f["v"] - s["v"]) < 1e-9:
                    m[ck] = {**f, "src": "both"}
                else:
                    if img is None:
                        img = Image.open(HERE / "images" / fn)
                    votes, _ = candidates(img, rk, ck)
                    if votes:
                        v = votes.most_common(1)[0][0]
                        pick = f if abs(f["v"] - v) < 1e-9 else (s if abs(s["v"] - v) < 1e-9 else None)
                        if pick is not None:
                            m[ck] = {**pick, "src": "vote"}
                        else:
                            m[ck] = {"v": v, "t": str(v), "c": 0.5, "src": "vote-new"}
                    else:
                        m[ck] = {**max((f, s), key=lambda x: x["c"]), "src": "conf"}
                    disp.append((rk, ck, f["v"], s["v"], m[ck]["v"]))
            elif f or s:
                m[ck] = {**(f or s), "src": (f or s).get("src", "one")}
        rows[rk] = m
    return fn, rows, disp


if __name__ == "__main__":
    refined = {r["file"]: r for r in json.load(open(HERE / "raw_refined.json", encoding="utf-8"))}
    strips = json.load(open(HERE / "strip_tables.json", encoding="utf-8"))
    jobs = [(fn, refined[fn]["rows"], strips.get(fn, {})) for fn in refined]
    t0 = time.time()
    stat = collections.Counter(); ndisp = 0
    out = []
    with Pool(6) as pool:
        for fn, rows, disp in pool.imap_unordered(work, jobs, chunksize=4):
            r = refined[fn]
            merged = dict(r); merged["rows"] = rows
            out.append(merged)
            ndisp += len(disp)
            for rk in rows:
                for ck, cell in rows[rk].items():
                    stat[cell["src"]] += 1
    out.sort(key=lambda r: r["msg_id"])
    json.dump(out, open(HERE / "merged.json", "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False)
    tot = sum(stat.values())
    print(f"병합 완료 {len(out)}건 / 셀 {tot:,} / {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
    for k, v in stat.most_common():
        print(f"  {k:10} {v:,} ({v/tot*100:.2f}%)")
    print("불일치(재판독) 셀", ndisp)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""macOS Vision 기반 표 이미지 OCR — 단어 단위 bbox 반환."""
import Vision, Quartz
from Foundation import NSURL, NSData
from PIL import Image
import io, os


def _cgimage_from_pil(img):
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buf, format="PNG")
    data = NSData.dataWithBytes_length_(buf.getvalue(), len(buf.getvalue()))
    src = Quartz.CGImageSourceCreateWithData(data, None)
    return Quartz.CGImageSourceCreateImageAtIndex(src, 0, None)


def ocr_words(pil_img, langs=("en-US", "ko-KR"), scale=2.0, min_h=0.0):
    """반환: [{'text','x0','x1','y0','y1','conf'}] — 좌표는 픽셀(원본 pil_img 기준, y는 위→아래)."""
    W0, H0 = pil_img.size
    img = pil_img if scale == 1 else pil_img.resize((int(W0 * scale), int(H0 * scale)), Image.LANCZOS)
    cg = _cgimage_from_pil(img)
    req = Vision.VNRecognizeTextRequest.alloc().init()
    req.setRecognitionLevel_(Vision.VNRequestTextRecognitionLevelAccurate)
    req.setUsesLanguageCorrection_(False)
    req.setRecognitionLanguages_(list(langs))
    handler = Vision.VNImageRequestHandler.alloc().initWithCGImage_options_(cg, None)
    ok, err = handler.performRequests_error_([req], None)
    out = []
    for obs in (req.results() or []):
        cand = obs.topCandidates_(1)
        if not cand:
            continue
        c = cand[0]
        s = c.string()
        # 단어 단위 분해: candidate 의 boundingBox(range) 로 각 토큰 위치 추출
        idx = 0
        for tok in s.split():
            start = s.find(tok, idx)
            idx = start + len(tok)
            try:
                rng = Vision.NSRange(start, len(tok))
                bb = c.boundingBoxForRange_error_(rng, None)
                box = bb[0] if isinstance(bb, tuple) else bb
                r = box.boundingBox()
                x0 = r.origin.x * W0
                x1 = (r.origin.x + r.size.width) * W0
                y0 = (1 - r.origin.y - r.size.height) * H0
                y1 = (1 - r.origin.y) * H0
            except Exception:
                r = obs.boundingBox()
                x0, x1 = r.origin.x * W0, (r.origin.x + r.size.width) * W0
                y0 = (1 - r.origin.y - r.size.height) * H0
                y1 = (1 - r.origin.y) * H0
            out.append({"text": tok, "x0": x0, "x1": x1, "y0": y0, "y1": y1,
                        "cx": (x0 + x1) / 2, "cy": (y0 + y1) / 2,
                        "conf": float(c.confidence())})
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys, json
    p = sys.argv[1]
    ws = ocr_words(Image.open(p))
    ws.sort(key=lambda w: (round(w["cy"] / 6), w["cx"]))
    for w in ws:
        print(f"{w['cy']:7.1f} {w['cx']:7.1f} {w['conf']:.2f} {w['text']}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""행 스트립 확대 OCR — 각 데이터 행을 통째로 잘라 4배 확대 후 인식, x위치로 열 배정.
   전체 이미지 OCR 보다 인식률이 훨씬 높다 (기초유분 블록 누락 문제 해결)."""
from PIL import Image
from ocr_core import ocr_words
from parse_table import ROW_KEYS, ROW_Y_MAP, COL_X, COL_KEYS, _num

X0, X1 = 176, 993          # 숫자 영역
SCALE = 4
PADY = 10
TOL = 24


def row_cells(img, rk, scale=SCALE):
    y = ROW_Y_MAP[rk]
    box = (X0, int(y - PADY), X1, int(y + PADY))
    c = img.crop(box)
    c = c.resize((c.width * scale, c.height * scale), Image.LANCZOS)
    pad = Image.new("RGB", (c.width + 40, c.height + 30), "white")
    pad.paste(c.convert("RGB"), (20, 15))
    out = {}
    for w in ocr_words(pad, scale=1.0, langs=("en-US",)):
        v = _num(w["text"])
        if v is None:
            continue
        x = (w["cx"] - 20) / scale + X0          # 원본 좌표로 환산
        ck = min(COL_KEYS, key=lambda k: abs(x - COL_X[k]))
        if abs(x - COL_X[ck]) > TOL:
            continue
        rec = {"v": v, "t": w["text"], "c": round(float(w["conf"]), 2), "src": "strip"}
        if ck not in out or rec["c"] > out[ck]["c"]:
            out[ck] = rec
    return out


def grid(path):
    img = Image.open(path)
    return {rk: row_cells(img, rk) for rk in ROW_KEYS}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys, json
    g = grid(sys.argv[1])
    for rk in ROW_KEYS[:8] if len(sys.argv) < 3 else [sys.argv[2]]:
        print(rk, {k: v["v"] for k, v in g[rk].items()})

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""가격표 이미지 1장 → 구조화 dict.
   pass1: 전체 이미지 Vision OCR → 행/열 고정격자 배정
   pass2: 누락/저신뢰/산술불일치 셀만 확대 크롭 재OCR
"""
import re, sys, json
from PIL import Image
from ocr_core import ocr_words

# ── 표 템플릿 (2024-01 ~ 현재 동일) ───────────────────────────────
ROWS = [
    ("SEC", "유가/납사"),
    ("Dubai", "Dubai($/bbl)"), ("OSP_AL", "OSP: Arab Light"), ("OSP_AM", "OSP: Arab Medium"),
    ("WTI", "WTI($/bbl)"), ("Naphtha", "Naphtha"),
    ("SimpleCrack", "Simple Crack"), ("ComplexCrack", "Complex Crack"), ("NaphthaCrack", "납사 Crack"),
    ("GasolineCrack", "가솔린 Crack"), ("KeroseneCrack", "등유 Crack"), ("DieselCrack", "경유 Crack"),
    ("BCCrack", "B-C Crack"),
    ("SEC", "기초유분"),
    ("Ethylene", "Ethylene"), ("EthyleneNaphthaSpread", "Ethylene-Naphtha Spread"),
    ("Propylene", "Propylene"), ("Butadiene", "Butadiene"), ("Benzene", "Benzene"),
    ("Toluene", "Toluene"), ("Xylene", "Xylene(ISO-MX)"),
    ("SEC", "Ethylene Chain"),
    ("HDPE", "HDPE"), ("HDPENaphthaSpread", "HDPE-Naphtha Spread"), ("LDPE", "LDPE"),
    ("LLDPE", "LLDPE"), ("MEG", "MEG"),
    ("SEC", "Propylene chain"),
    ("PP", "PP"), ("AN", "AN(Acrylonitrile)"), ("EH2", "2-EH"),
    ("SEC", "Rubber chain"),
    ("SBR", "SBR"), ("NaturalRubber", "Natural Rubber"),
    ("SEC", "Styrene chain"),
    ("SM", "Styrene(SM)"), ("PS", "PS"), ("EPS", "EPS"), ("ABS", "ABS"),
    ("SEC", "Vinyl chain"),
    ("EDC", "EDC"), ("VCM", "VCM"), ("CausticSoda", "Caustic Soda"), ("PVC", "PVC"),
    ("SEC", "Polyester chain"),
    ("PX", "PX"), ("TPA", "TPA"), ("PETBottle", "PET Bottle"),
    ("SEC", "Phenol chain"),
    ("Phenol", "Phenol"), ("Acetone", "Acetone"), ("BPA", "BPA"),
    ("SEC", "Polyurethane chain"),
    ("PO", "PO"), ("MDI", "MDI"), ("TDI", "TDI"),
    ("SEC", "ETC."),
    ("OX", "OX"), ("PA", "PA"), ("DOP", "DOP"), ("Caprolactam", "Caprolactam"),
]
DATA_ROWS = [r for r in ROWS if r[0] != "SEC"]
ROW_KEYS = [k for k, _ in DATA_ROWS]

# 변동폭이 %가 아니라 단순증감(차이)인 행
DIFF_ROWS = {"OSP_AL", "OSP_AM", "SimpleCrack", "ComplexCrack", "NaphthaCrack",
             "GasolineCrack", "KeroseneCrack", "DieselCrack", "BCCrack"}

# 열: (키, x중심) — 993px 기준
COLS = [("d1", 209), ("d2", 257), ("d_chg", 324),
        ("w1", 369), ("w2", 417), ("w_chg", 485),
        ("m1", 547), ("m2", 601), ("m_chg", 653),
        ("q1", 702), ("q2", 751), ("q3", 799), ("q_chg", 850),
        ("y1", 907), ("y2", 956)]
COL_X = dict(COLS)
COL_KEYS = [k for k, _ in COLS]
COL_TOL = 22
LABEL_X = 172

# 데이터 50개 행의 고정 y중심
ROW_Y = [128, 146.5, 164, 182, 200, 218, 236, 254, 272, 290, 308, 326,
         386.5, 404, 422, 440.5, 458, 476, 495,
         530, 548, 566, 584, 602,
         638, 656, 674,
         711, 729,
         764, 782, 800, 818,
         854, 872.5, 890, 908,
         944.5, 962, 979.5,
         1016, 1034, 1052.5,
         1089, 1106.5, 1125,
         1162, 1184.5, 1206, 1228]
ROW_Y_MAP = dict(zip(ROW_KEYS, ROW_Y))


def _num(tok):
    """OCR 토큰 → float. 천단위 구분자(, 또는 오독된 .) 처리."""
    t = tok.strip().replace("−", "-").replace("–", "-").replace("—", "-").replace("‑", "-")
    t = t.replace(" ", "").replace("O", "0").replace("o", "0").replace("l", "1").replace("I", "1")
    t = t.lstrip("*·•")
    if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d{1,3}[.,]\d{3}", t):          # 1,465 / 1.465 → 1465
        return float(t[:-4].replace(",", "").replace(".", "") + t[-3:])
    t = t.replace(",", "")
    if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?", t):
        return float(t)
    return None


def _cell_rect(rk, ck):
    x, y = COL_X[ck], ROW_Y_MAP[rk]
    return (int(x - 25), int(y - 9), int(x + 25), int(y + 9))


def _reocr_cell(img, rk, ck, pad=3, scale=8):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = _cell_rect(rk, ck)
    crop = img.crop((x0 - pad, y0 - pad, x1 + pad, y1 + pad))
    crop = crop.resize((crop.width * scale, crop.height * scale), Image.LANCZOS)
    ws = ocr_words(crop, scale=1.0)
    ws = [w for w in ws if _num(w["text"]) is not None]
    if not ws:
        return None
    if len(ws) > 1:                      # 인접 셀 침범 → 가운데 것
        cx = crop.width / 2
        ws.sort(key=lambda w: abs(w["cx"] - cx))
    w = ws[0]
    return {"v": _num(w["text"]), "t": w["text"], "c": round(float(w["conf"]), 2), "src": "crop"}


def parse_image(path, debug=False):
    img = Image.open(path)
    words = ocr_words(img)
    W, H = img.size

    # ── 기준일자 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    asof = None
    head = [w for w in words if w["cy"] < 60]
    joined = " ".join(w["text"] for w in sorted(head, key=lambda w: w["cx"]))
    m = re.search(r"(20\d{2})[-./](\d{1,2})[-./](\d{1,2})", joined)
    if not m:
        crop = img.crop((int(W * 0.60), 0, W, 55))
        crop = crop.resize((crop.width * 5, crop.height * 5), Image.LANCZOS)
        j2 = " ".join(x["text"] for x in sorted(ocr_words(crop, scale=1.0), key=lambda x: x["cx"]))
        m = re.search(r"(20\d{2})\D{0,3}(\d{1,2})\D{0,3}(\d{1,2})", j2)
    if m:
        asof = f"{m.group(1)}-{int(m.group(2)):02d}-{int(m.group(3)):02d}"

    # ── 열 라벨 (기간명) ─────────────────────────────────────
    hdr = [w for w in words if 82 <= w["cy"] <= 101]
    labels = {}
    for key in COL_KEYS:
        if key.endswith("chg"):
            continue
        cands = [w for w in hdr if abs(w["cx"] - COL_X[key]) <= COL_TOL + 8]
        if cands:
            labels[key] = min(cands, key=lambda w: abs(w["cx"] - COL_X[key]))["text"]

    # ── 행 클러스터링 ────────────────────────────────────────
    body = sorted([w for w in words if w["cy"] > 100], key=lambda w: w["cy"])
    lines, cur = [], []
    for w in body:
        if cur and w["cy"] - cur[-1]["cy"] > 8:
            lines.append(cur); cur = []
        cur.append(w)
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)

    parsed = []
    for ln in lines:
        cells = {}
        for w in ln:
            if w["cx"] < LABEL_X:
                continue
            key = min(COL_KEYS, key=lambda k: abs(w["cx"] - COL_X[k]))
            if abs(w["cx"] - COL_X[key]) > COL_TOL:
                continue
            v = _num(w["text"])
            if v is None:
                continue
            rec = {"v": v, "t": w["text"], "c": round(float(w["conf"]), 2), "src": "full"}
            if key not in cells or rec["c"] > cells[key]["c"]:
                cells[key] = rec
        if cells:
            parsed.append({"cells": cells, "cy": sum(w["cy"] for w in ln) / len(ln),
                           "label": " ".join(w["text"] for w in sorted(
                               [x for x in ln if x["cx"] < LABEL_X], key=lambda x: x["cx"]))})

    # ── 고정 y격자 정렬 ──────────────────────────────────────
    out, warn = {}, []
    if len(parsed) == len(DATA_ROWS):
        dev = max(abs(p["cy"] - y) for p, y in zip(parsed, ROW_Y))
        if dev > 6:
            warn.append(f"row_grid_dev={dev:.1f}")
        for rk, p in zip(ROW_KEYS, parsed):
            out[rk] = p["cells"]
    else:
        warn.append(f"row_count={len(parsed)}")
        for p in parsed:
            i = min(range(len(ROW_Y)), key=lambda j: abs(ROW_Y[j] - p["cy"]))
            if abs(ROW_Y[i] - p["cy"]) <= 7 and ROW_KEYS[i] not in out:
                out[ROW_KEYS[i]] = p["cells"]
        for rk in ROW_KEYS:
            out.setdefault(rk, {})

    return {"file": path, "asof": asof, "col_labels": labels, "rows": out,
            "warn": warn, "debug": parsed if debug else None, "_img": None}


def refine(path, res, targets):
    """targets: [(row_key, col_key)] 를 확대 재OCR 하여 res 를 갱신. 반환: 변경 목록"""
    img = Image.open(path)
    changed = []
    for rk, ck in targets:
        new = _reocr_cell(img, rk, ck)
        old = res["rows"].get(rk, {}).get(ck)
        if new is None:
            if old is not None and old.get("src") == "full":
                pass  # 크롭에서 못 읽음 → 기존 유지
            continue
        if old is None or abs(new["v"] - old["v"]) > 1e-9:
            res["rows"].setdefault(rk, {})[ck] = new
            changed.append((rk, ck, old["v"] if old else None, new["v"]))
    return changed


if __name__ == "__main__":
    r = parse_image(sys.argv[1])
    r.pop("debug", None); r.pop("_img", None)
    print(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""검증용: (file,row,col) 목록의 셀 주변을 크게 잘라 한 장으로 이어붙임."""
import sys, json
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from pathlib import Path
from parse_table import COL_X, ROW_Y_MAP

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def strip(items, out="/tmp/peek.png", scale=3, wide=True):
    tiles = []
    for f, rk, ck in items:
        img = Image.open(HERE / "images" / f)
        x, y = COL_X[ck], ROW_Y_MAP[rk]
        x0 = 172 if wide else int(x - 30)
        box = (x0, int(y - 11), int(x + 32), int(y + 11))
        c = img.crop(box).resize(((box[2] - box[0]) * scale, (box[3] - box[1]) * scale), Image.LANCZOS)
        lab = Image.new("RGB", (330, c.height), "white")
        ImageDraw.Draw(lab).text((4, c.height // 2 - 6), f"{f} {rk} {ck}", fill="black")
        row = Image.new("RGB", (lab.width + c.width, c.height), "white")
        row.paste(lab, (0, 0)); row.paste(c, (lab.width, 0))
        tiles.append(row)
    W = max(t.width for t in tiles); H = sum(t.height + 4 for t in tiles)
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#dddddd"); y = 0
    for t in tiles:
        canvas.paste(t, (0, y)); y += t.height + 4
    canvas.save(out)
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    items = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    print(strip([tuple(i) for i in items], sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "/tmp/peek.png"))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""@energy_youn 채널 이미지 메시지 census — 다운로드 없이 메타(크기/날짜/캡션)만 수집."""
import os, sys, json, asyncio
from datetime import timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv

TG = Path("/Users/1ne/수급html/telegram-digest")
load_dotenv(TG / ".env")
KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "media_census.json"


async def main():
    from telethon import TelegramClient
    from telethon.tl.types import PhotoSize, PhotoSizeProgressive

    client = TelegramClient(str(TG / "user_session"), int(os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_ID"]),
                            os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_HASH"])
    await client.start()
    ent = await client.get_entity("@energy_youn")
    rows = []
    async for m in client.iter_messages(ent):
        p = getattr(m, "photo", None)
        doc = getattr(m, "document", None)
        kind, w, h, size = None, None, None, None
        if p is not None:
            kind = "photo"
            best = None
            for s in getattr(p, "sizes", []):
                if isinstance(s, (PhotoSize, PhotoSizeProgressive)):
                    if best is None or (s.w or 0) * (s.h or 0) > (best.w or 0) * (best.h or 0):
                        best = s
            if best is not None:
                w, h = best.w, best.h
                size = getattr(best, "size", None) or (max(getattr(best, "sizes", [0]) or [0]))
        elif doc is not None:
            mt = getattr(doc, "mime_type", "") or ""
            if mt.startswith("image/"):
                kind = "doc:" + mt
                size = doc.size
                for a in doc.attributes:
                    if hasattr(a, "w"):
                        w, h = a.w, a.h
        if kind is None:
            continue
        rows.append({
            "id": m.id,
            "dt": m.date.astimezone(KST).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
            "kind": kind, "w": w, "h": h, "size": size,
            "grouped_id": getattr(m, "grouped_id", None),
            "text": (m.message or "").strip()[:120],
        })
    rows.reverse()
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    print("이미지 메시지", len(rows), "건 →", OUT)
    await client.disconnect()


asyncio.run(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""pass3: 산술 불일치 3쌍(a,b,chg)을 다중변형 재판독 + 산술제약으로 확정."""
import json, itertools, time, collections
from pathlib import Path
from multiprocessing import Pool
from PIL import Image
from parse_table import ROW_KEYS
from refine_pass import chg_ok, PAIRS

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DST = HERE / "raw_refined.json"


def failing_triples(r):
    out = []
    for rk in ROW_KEYS:
        cells = r["rows"].get(rk, {})
        for a, b, c in PAIRS:
            A, B, C = cells.get(a), cells.get(b), cells.get(c)
            if A and B and C and chg_ok(rk, A, B, C) is False:
                out.append((rk, a, b, c))
    return out


def work(r):
    from reread import candidates
    tri = failing_triples(r)
    if not tri:
        return r, [], []
    img = Image.open(HERE / "images" / r["file"])
    fixed, unresolved = [], []
    for rk, a, b, c in tri:
        cells = r["rows"][rk]
        cand = {}
        for ck in (a, b, c):
            votes, _ = candidates(img, rk, ck)
            cur = cells[ck]["v"]
            votes[cur] = votes.get(cur, 0) + 1
            cand[ck] = votes
        combos = []
        for va, vb, vc in itertools.product(cand[a], cand[b], cand[c]):
            A = {"v": va, "t": _fmt(va, cells[a]["t"])}
            B = {"v": vb, "t": _fmt(vb, cells[b]["t"])}
            C = {"v": vc, "t": _fmt(vc, cells[c]["t"])}
            if chg_ok(rk, A, B, C):
                score = cand[a][va] + cand[b][vb] + cand[c][vc]
                nchg = sum(1 for ck, v in ((a, va), (b, vb), (c, vc)) if v != cells[ck]["v"])
                combos.append((-nchg, score, va, vb, vc))
        if combos:
            combos.sort(reverse=True)
            _, _, va, vb, vc = combos[0]
            ch = []
            for ck, v in ((a, va), (b, vb), (c, vc)):
                if v != cells[ck]["v"]:
                    ch.append((rk, ck, cells[ck]["v"], v))
                    cells[ck] = {"v": v, "t": _fmt(v, cells[ck]["t"]), "c": 0.9, "src": "arith"}
            fixed += ch
        else:
            unresolved.append((r["file"], rk, a, cells[a]["v"], cells[b]["v"], cells[c]["v"],
                               {k: dict(v) for k, v in cand.items()}))
    return r, fixed, unresolved


def _fmt(v, like):
    """표시 정밀도 문자열 재구성 (prec() 판단용)"""
    if "." in str(like) and len(str(like).split(".")[-1]) in (1, 2):
        return f"{v:.{len(str(like).split('.')[-1])}f}"
    return str(int(v)) if float(v).is_integer() else str(v)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raws = json.load(open(DST, encoding="utf-8"))
    t0 = time.time(); out = []; nf = 0; unres = []
    with Pool(6) as pool:
        for r, fixed, un in pool.imap_unordered(work, raws, chunksize=8):
            out.append(r); nf += len(fixed); unres += un
            for f in fixed:
                print("  fix", r["file"], f)
    out.sort(key=lambda r: r["msg_id"])
    DST.write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\n{nf}개 셀 확정 / 미해결 {len(unres)}건 / {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
    json.dump(unres, open(HERE / "unresolved.json", "w", encoding="utf-8"),
              ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str)
    for u in unres[:20]:
        print("   ", u[:6])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""pass4: 같은 기간을 가리키는 관측들 중 '앞뒤가 일치하는데 혼자만 다른' 값을 재판독.
   (진짜 원본 수정은 어느 시점 이후 계속 유지되므로 샌드위치 조건에 안 걸린다)"""
import json, collections, time
from pathlib import Path
from multiprocessing import Pool
from PIL import Image
from parse_table import ROW_KEYS
from build_series import load, period_keys, SERIES_OF

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DST = HERE / "raw_refined.json"


def find_outliers(raws):
    obs = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i, r in enumerate(raws):
        pk = period_keys(r)
        for rk in ROW_KEYS:
            cells = r["rows"].get(rk, {})
            for ck, st in SERIES_OF.items():
                if st == "D":
                    continue                      # 일별은 관측 2개뿐 → 판정 불가
                cell, key = cells.get(ck), pk.get(ck)
                if cell and key:
                    obs[(rk, st, key)].append((i, ck, cell["v"]))
    out = []
    for k, lst in obs.items():
        if len(lst) < 3:
            continue
        lst.sort()
        for j, (i, ck, v) in enumerate(lst):
            before = [x for x in lst[:j] if x[2] != v]
            after = [x for x in lst[j + 1:] if x[2] != v]
            same = [x for x in lst if x[2] == v]
            if len(same) == 1 and before and after:
                bv = collections.Counter(x[2] for x in before).most_common(1)[0]
                av = collections.Counter(x[2] for x in after).most_common(1)[0]
                if bv[0] == av[0]:            # 앞뒤 값이 동일 → 혼자만 다름
                    out.append((i, k[0], ck, v, bv[0]))
    return out


def work(args):
    from reread import candidates
    fi, items = args
    img = Image.open(HERE / "images" / items[0]["file"])
    res = []
    for it in items:
        votes, _ = candidates(img, it["rk"], it["ck"])
        res.append((it["rk"], it["ck"], it["cur"], it["exp"], dict(votes)))
    return fi, res


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raws = load()
    outl = find_outliers(raws)
    print(f"고립 이상치 후보 {len(outl)}건")
    byimg = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i, rk, ck, v, exp in outl:
        byimg[i].append({"file": raws[i]["file"], "rk": rk, "ck": ck, "cur": v, "exp": exp})
    jobs = [(i, items) for i, items in byimg.items()]
    t0 = time.time()
    fixed, kept = [], []
    idx = {r["file"]: r for r in raws}
    with Pool(6) as pool:
        for fi, res in pool.imap_unordered(work, jobs, chunksize=4):
            r = raws[fi]
            for rk, ck, cur, exp, votes in res:
                if exp in votes and votes.get(exp, 0) >= votes.get(cur, 0):
                    fixed.append((r["file"], rk, ck, cur, exp, votes))
                else:
                    kept.append((r["file"], rk, ck, cur, exp, votes))
    print(f"재판독 {len(outl)}셀 / {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
    print(f"  → 이웃값으로 정정 {len(fixed)} / 원값 유지 {len(kept)}")
    for f in fixed[:30]:
        print("   fix", f[:5], f[5])
    for f in kept[:15]:
        print("   keep", f[:5], f[5])

    # 원본(raw_refined) 갱신 — manual_fixes 는 build 단계에서만 적용되므로 여기선 파일명 기준
    disk = {r["file"]: r for r in json.load(open(DST, encoding="utf-8"))}
    for fn, rk, ck, cur, exp, _ in fixed:
        c = disk[fn]["rows"][rk][ck]
        c.update({"v": exp, "t": str(exp), "c": 0.9, "src": "neighbor"})
    out = sorted(disk.values(), key=lambda r: r["msg_id"])
    DST.write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    json.dump([{"file": f, "row": rk, "col": ck, "kept": cur, "neighbor": exp, "votes": v}
               for f, rk, ck, cur, exp, v in kept],
              open(HERE / "outliers_kept.json", "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""pass2: 의심 셀(결측/저신뢰/산술불일치) 확대 재OCR → raw_refined.json"""
import json, sys, collections, time
from pathlib import Path
from multiprocessing import Pool
from parse_table import ROW_KEYS, COL_KEYS, DIFF_ROWS

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SRC = HERE / "raw_tables.json"
DST = HERE / "raw_refined.json"
PAIRS = [("d1", "d2", "d_chg"), ("w1", "w2", "w_chg"), ("m1", "m2", "m_chg"), ("q1", "q2", "q_chg")]


def prec(cell):
    """표시 정밀도의 반올림 오차 반경. 소수점 있으면 0.05, 정수면 0.5"""
    if cell is None:
        return None
    t = str(cell["t"])
    if "." in t and not t.endswith("."):
        dec = len(t.split(".")[-1])
        if dec == 3:      # 천단위 구분자 오독 → 정수 표기
            return 0.5
        return 0.5 * 10 ** (-dec)
    return 0.5


def chg_ok(rk, A, B, C):
    """A,B,C = cell dict. 표시 반올림을 감안해 C가 가능한 값인지"""
    a, b, c = A["v"], B["v"], C["v"]
    ea, eb, ec = prec(A), prec(B), prec(C)
    if rk in DIFF_ROWS:
        lo, hi = (a - ea) - (b + eb), (a + ea) - (b - eb)
    else:
        if b == 0:
            return None
        cands = [((a + sa) / (b + sb) - 1) * 100 for sa in (-ea, ea) for sb in (-eb, eb)]
        lo, hi = min(cands), max(cands)
    return (lo - ec - 1e-9) <= c <= (hi + ec + 1e-9)


def expected_fill(raws, thr=0.5):
    cnt = collections.Counter()
    for r in raws:
        for rk in ROW_KEYS:
            for ck in r["rows"].get(rk, {}):
                cnt[(rk, ck)] += 1
    n = len(raws)
    return {k for k, v in cnt.items() if v >= thr * n}


def suspicious(r, exp, conf_thr=0.75):
    s = set()
    for rk in ROW_KEYS:
        cells = r["rows"].get(rk, {})
        for ck in COL_KEYS:
            cell = cells.get(ck)
            if cell is None:
                if (rk, ck) in exp:
                    s.add((rk, ck))
            elif cell["c"] < conf_thr or cell.get("t", "").count(".") > 1:
                s.add((rk, ck))
        for a, b, c in PAIRS:
            A, B, C = cells.get(a), cells.get(b), cells.get(c)
            if A and B and C and chg_ok(rk, A, B, C) is False:
                s.update([(rk, a), (rk, b), (rk, c)])
    return sorted(s)


def work(args):
    from parse_table import refine
    rec, targets = args
    if not targets:
        return rec, []
    ch = refine(str(HERE / "images" / rec["file"]), rec, targets)
    return rec, ch


def main():
    raws = json.load(open(SRC, encoding="utf-8"))
    exp = expected_fill(raws)
    print(f"기대 채움 셀 {len(exp)}개 (행50 × 열15 = 750 중)")
    jobs = []
    tot = 0
    for r in raws:
        t = suspicious(r, exp)
        tot += len(t)
        jobs.append((r, t))
    print(f"의심 셀 {tot:,}개 / 전체 {len(raws)*len(exp):,} ({tot/(len(raws)*len(exp))*100:.2f}%)")
    t0 = time.time()
    out, nch = [], 0
    with Pool(6) as pool:
        for i, (rec, ch) in enumerate(pool.imap_unordered(work, jobs, chunksize=3), 1):
            out.append(rec); nch += len(ch)
            if i % 50 == 0:
                print(f"  {i}/{len(jobs)} 수정 {nch}  {time.time()-t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
    out.sort(key=lambda r: r["msg_id"])
    for r in out:
        r.pop("_img", None); r.pop("debug", None)
    DST.write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"완료 — 셀 {nch}개 갱신 → {DST}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""셀 다중변형 재판독 — 여러 배율/전처리로 OCR 후 후보 집합을 반환."""
from PIL import Image, ImageOps, ImageFilter
from ocr_core import ocr_words
from parse_table import COL_X, ROW_Y_MAP, _num
import collections

VARIANTS = [
    dict(scale=6, pad=(30, 10), mode="plain"),
    dict(scale=10, pad=(30, 10), mode="plain"),
    dict(scale=8, pad=(34, 11), mode="gray"),
    dict(scale=12, pad=(30, 10), mode="sharp"),
    dict(scale=8, pad=(26, 9), mode="plain"),
    dict(scale=16, pad=(32, 10), mode="gray"),
]


def _prep(c, mode):
    if mode == "gray":
        c = ImageOps.grayscale(c)
        c = ImageOps.autocontrast(c)
        return c.convert("RGB")
    if mode == "sharp":
        return c.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)
    return c


def candidates(img, rk, ck):
    x, y = COL_X[ck], ROW_Y_MAP[rk]
    votes = collections.Counter()
    detail = []
    for v in VARIANTS:
        px, py = v["pad"]
        box = (int(x - px), int(y - py), int(x + px), int(y + py))
        c = img.crop(box)
        c = _prep(c, v["mode"])
        c = c.resize((c.width * v["scale"], c.height * v["scale"]), Image.LANCZOS)
        # 좌우 여백 추가 (경계 글자 잘림 방지)
        pad = Image.new("RGB", (c.width + 60, c.height + 40), "white")
        pad.paste(c.convert("RGB"), (30, 20))
        ws = [w for w in ocr_words(pad, scale=1.0, langs=("en-US",)) if _num(w["text"]) is not None]
        if not ws:
            continue
        cx = pad.width / 2
        ws.sort(key=lambda w: abs(w["cx"] - cx))
        val = _num(ws[0]["text"])
        votes[val] += 1
        detail.append((v["mode"], v["scale"], ws[0]["text"], val, round(float(ws[0]["conf"]), 2)))
    return votes, detail


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys, json
    for f, rk, ck in json.loads(sys.argv[1]):
        img = Image.open("images/" + f)
        v, d = candidates(img, rk, ck)
        print(f, rk, ck, dict(v))
        for x in d:
            print("     ", x)
