# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""2단계: 캐시된 raw_html에서 본문을 재추출(이미지 위치 마커 포함)하고
이미지 원본을 images/{logNo}/ 에 다운로드, DB의 images 테이블에 기록.
collect_blog.py 완료 후 실행. 재실행 시 받은 이미지는 건너뜀 (resumable)
"""
import os, re, sqlite3, time
from urllib.parse import urlparse, unquote

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
RAW_DIR = os.path.join(BASE, "raw_html")
IMG_DIR = os.path.join(BASE, "images")
DB_PATH = os.path.join(BASE, "pillion21.db")

os.makedirs(IMG_DIR, exist_ok=True)

sess = requests.Session()
sess.headers.update({
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36",
    "Referer": "https://blog.naver.com/pillion21",
})


def original_url(src):
    """원본 화질 URL로 변환.
    postfiles.pstatic.net에서 ?type=만 지우면 초소형 썸네일이 오므로
    반드시 blogfiles.pstatic.net 도메인으로 바꾼 뒤 ?type= 제거"""
    src = src.replace("postfiles.pstatic.net", "blogfiles.pstatic.net")
    return re.sub(r"\?type=[^&]*$", "", src)


def guess_ext(url):
    path = unquote(urlparse(url).path)
    m = re.search(r"\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|bmp)$", path, re.I)
    return "." + m.group(1).lower() if m else ".jpg"


def extract(html):
    """본문 텍스트(이미지 마커 인라인) + 이미지 URL 목록"""
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
    container = soup.select_one("div.se-main-container")
    if container is None:
        container = soup.select_one("#postViewArea") or soup.select_one("div.post-view")
    if container is None:
        return None, []

    lines, images = [], []

    def add_imgs(scope, caption=None):
        for img in scope.select("img.se-image-resource, img._photoImage"):
            src = img.get("data-lazy-src") or img.get("src") or ""
            if not src.startswith("http"):
                continue
            images.append(original_url(src))
            marker = f"[이미지 {len(images)}]"
            if caption:
                marker += f" (설명: {caption})"
            lines.append(marker)

    if container.select_one(".se-component"):
        for comp in container.select(".se-component"):
            classes = comp.get("class", [])
            if "se-text" in classes or "se-quotation" in classes:
                for p in comp.select("p, .se-quote"):
                    lines.append(p.get_text(" ", strip=True))
            elif "se-image" in classes or "se-imageStrip" in classes:
                cap_el = comp.select_one(".se-caption")
                cap = cap_el.get_text(" ", strip=True) if cap_el else None
                add_imgs(comp, cap)
            elif "se-video" in classes:
                lines.append("[동영상]")
            elif "se-oglink" in classes:
                t = comp.get_text(" ", strip=True)
                if t:
                    lines.append(f"[링크: {t}]")
            elif "se-table" in classes:
                for tr in comp.select("tr"):
                    cells = [td.get_text(" ", strip=True) for td in tr.select("td, th")]
                    lines.append(" | ".join(cells))
            else:
                t = comp.get_text("\n", strip=True)
                if t:
                    lines.append(t)
    else:
        # 구에디터: 텍스트/이미지를 문서 순서대로
        for el in container.descendants:
            if getattr(el, "name", None) == "img":
                src = el.get("data-lazy-src") or el.get("src") or ""
                if (src.startswith("http") and "pstatic.net" in src
                        and "sticker" not in src and "dthumb" not in src):
                    images.append(original_url(src))
                    lines.append(f"[이미지 {len(images)}]")
            elif isinstance(el, str):
                t = el.strip()
                if t:
                    lines.append(t)

    out, blank = [], 0
    for ln in lines:
        ln = ln.replace("​", "").strip()
        if not ln:
            blank += 1
            if blank > 1:
                continue
        else:
            blank = 0
        out.append(ln)
    content = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", "\n".join(out)).strip()
    return content, images


def main():
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    con.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS images (
            log_no     TEXT,
            seq        INTEGER,
            url        TEXT,
            local_path TEXT,
            bytes      INTEGER,
            PRIMARY KEY (log_no, seq)
        )
    """)

    # 이미 처리 완료된 글(이미지 전부 다운로드됨)은 건너뜀 — 매일 재실행 대비
    done = set()
    for log_no, img_cnt, n_imgs in con.execute(
        "SELECT p.log_no, p.img_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM images i WHERE i.log_no = p.log_no) FROM posts p"
    ):
        if n_imgs == img_cnt:
            done.add(log_no)

    files = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(RAW_DIR) if f.endswith(".html"))
    targets = [f for f in files if f[:-5] not in done]
    print(f"대상 {len(targets)}건 (전체 {len(files)}건 중 기처리 {len(files)-len(targets)}건 스킵)", flush=True)
    total_img, fail = 0, []

    for i, fname in enumerate(targets, 1):
        log_no = fname[:-5]
        with open(os.path.join(RAW_DIR, fname), encoding="utf-8") as f:
            html = f.read()
        content, images = extract(html)
        if content is None:
            fail.append((log_no, "컨테이너 없음"))
            continue

        # 빈 추출 결과로 기존 본문(수동 복구분 포함)을 덮어쓰지 않음
        old = con.execute("SELECT char_cnt FROM posts WHERE log_no=?", (log_no,)).fetchone()
        if content or not (old and old[0] > 0):
            con.execute(
                "UPDATE posts SET content=?, char_cnt=?, img_cnt=? WHERE log_no=?",
                (content, len(content), len(images), log_no),
            )

        if images:
            post_dir = os.path.join(IMG_DIR, log_no)
            os.makedirs(post_dir, exist_ok=True)
        for seq, url in enumerate(images, 1):
            ext = guess_ext(url)
            local = os.path.join(post_dir, f"{seq:03d}{ext}")
            rel = f"images/{log_no}/{seq:03d}{ext}"
            if os.path.exists(local) and os.path.getsize(local) > 0:
                con.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO images VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                            (log_no, seq, url, rel, os.path.getsize(local)))
                continue
            data, used = None, url
            # 원본(blogfiles) 시도 → 실패 시 postfiles 큰 썸네일(w966)로 폴백
            fallback = url.replace("blogfiles.pstatic.net",
                                   "postfiles.pstatic.net") + "?type=w966"
            for cand in (url, fallback):
                try:
                    r = sess.get(cand, timeout=30)
                    if r.status_code == 200 and len(r.content) > 500:
                        data, used = r.content, cand
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if data is None:
                fail.append((f"{log_no}#{seq}", url))
                continue
            with open(local, "wb") as f:
                f.write(data)
            con.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO images VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                        (log_no, seq, used, rel, len(data)))
            total_img += 1
            time.sleep(0.15)

        if i % 25 == 0:
            con.commit()
            print(f"  {i}/{len(targets)} 글 처리, 이미지 {total_img}장 다운로드", flush=True)

    con.commit()
    n_img = con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM images").fetchone()[0]
    print(f"\n완료: 이미지 {n_img}장 기록 (신규 다운로드 {total_img}장)", flush=True)
    if fail:
        print(f"실패 {len(fail)}건:", flush=True)
        for k, msg in fail[:30]:
            print(f"  {k}: {msg}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""매일 21:00 자동 업데이트 오케스트레이터
collect_blog(새 글) → collect_images(새 이미지+마커) → JSON/검색HTML 재생성
→ 새 글이 있으면 텔레그램 Saved Messages로 검색 HTML 전송
"""
import json, os, sqlite3, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
PY = sys.executable

# 스케줄러 실행 대비: 콘솔 + update_log.txt 동시 기록
class _Tee:
    def __init__(self, *streams): self.streams = streams
    def write(self, s):
        for st in self.streams:
            try: st.write(s)
            except Exception: pass
    def flush(self):
        for st in self.streams:
            try: st.flush()
            except Exception: pass

_log = open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "update_log.txt"),
            "a", encoding="utf-8")
sys.stdout = sys.stderr = _Tee(sys.__stdout__, _log)
DB = os.path.join(BASE, "pillion21.db")
SEND = os.path.join(BASE, "..", "telegram-digest", "send_file_to_me.py")
VENV_PY = os.path.join(BASE, "..", "telegram-digest", ".venv", "bin", "python3")


def post_count():
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    n = con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts").fetchone()[0]
    con.close()
    return n


def run(script, *args):
    print(f"--- {script} ---", flush=True)
    r = subprocess.run([PY, "-X", "utf8", os.path.join(BASE, script), *args],
                       cwd=BASE, capture_output=True, text=True,
                       encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    print(r.stdout, flush=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(r.stderr, flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError(f"{script} 실패 (exit {r.returncode})")


def export_json():
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    imgs = {}
    for r in con.execute("SELECT log_no, seq, url, local_path FROM images ORDER BY log_no, seq"):
        imgs.setdefault(r["log_no"], []).append(
            {"seq": r["seq"], "url": r["url"], "file": r["local_path"]})
    posts = []
    for r in con.execute(
        "SELECT log_no,title,category,published_at,comment_cnt,sympathy_cnt,img_cnt,char_cnt,url,brief,content "
        "FROM posts ORDER BY add_date_ms DESC"
    ):
        d = dict(r)
        d["images"] = imgs.get(r["log_no"], [])
        posts.append(d)
    with open(os.path.join(BASE, "pillion21_posts.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(posts, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
    con.close()


def new_titles(since_count):
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    rows = con.execute(
        "SELECT title, published_at FROM posts ORDER BY add_date_ms DESC LIMIT ?",
        (post_count() - since_count,)).fetchall()
    con.close()
    return rows


def main():
    print(f"===== {datetime.now():%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} pillion21 업데이트 =====", flush=True)
    before = post_count()

    run("collect_blog.py")
    run("collect_images.py")
    export_json()
    run("build_search_html.py")

    after = post_count()
    added = after - before
    print(f"신규 글: {added}건 (총 {after}건)", flush=True)

    if added > 0:
        titles = new_titles(before)
        cap = f"pillion21 블로그 업데이트 (+{added}건, 총 {after}건)\n" + \
              "\n".join(f"· {t} ({d[:10]})" for t, d in titles[:10])
        r = subprocess.run(
            [VENV_PY, "-X", "utf8", SEND, os.path.join(BASE, "pillion21_검색.html"), cap],
            capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        print(r.stdout or r.stderr, flush=True)
    else:
        print("새 글 없음 — 전송 생략", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""ranto28.db → 메르검색.html 생성.

전체 글(제목+본문 텍스트)을 gzip+base64로 내장한 독립형 키워드 검색 뷰어.
수집이 갱신될 때마다 재실행하면 최신 데이터로 다시 만들어진다.
"""
import sqlite3
import json
import gzip
import base64
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

BASE = Path(__file__).parent
DB_PATH = BASE / 'ranto28.db'
OUT = BASE / '메르검색.html'

con = sqlite3.connect(f'file:{DB_PATH}?mode=ro', uri=True, timeout=60)
con.execute('PRAGMA busy_timeout=60000')
for attempt in range(5):
    try:
        rows = con.execute('''SELECT log_no, title, category, published, sympathy_cnt, comment_cnt,
                                     content_text, url
                              FROM posts ORDER BY add_date_ms DESC''').fetchall()
        break
    except sqlite3.OperationalError:
        if attempt == 4:
            raise
        import time
        time.sleep(5)
posts = []
for log_no, title, cat, pub, sym, cmt, text, url in rows:
    posts.append({
        'n': log_no, 't': title or '', 'c': cat or '', 'd': (pub or '')[:10],
        's': sym or 0, 'm': cmt or 0, 'x': text or '', 'u': url,
    })
con.close()

raw = json.dumps(posts, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')
packed = base64.b64encode(gzip.compress(raw, 9)).decode('ascii')
built = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
n_posts = len(posts)
n_text = sum(1 for p in posts if p['x'])
cats = sorted({p['c'] for p in posts if p['c']})

html = r'''<!DOCTYPE html>

  --sub: #8a867d; --line: #e8e5de; --hl: #ffe9a8;
}
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body {

}

}

}

}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
  <h1>메르 블로그 <span>키워드 검색</span></h1>
  <div class="meta">blog.naver.com/ranto28 · 글 __N_POSTS__건 (__BUILT__ 기준) · 띄어쓰기로 여러 키워드 AND 검색</div>
  <div class="searchbox">
    <input id="q" type="search" placeholder="키워드 검색 — 예: 순환매, 반도체 환율, 조선 …" autofocus>
    <div class="filters" id="filters"></div>
  </div>
  <div id="stat"></div>
  <div id="list"></div>
  <button id="more" style="display:none">더 보기</button>
</div>
<script>
const PACKED = "__PACKED__";
let POSTS = [];
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const CATS = __CATS__;
let activeCat = '', sortBy = 'date', shown = 0, results = [];
const PAGE = 50;

async function unpack() {
  const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(PACKED), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
  const ds = new DecompressionStream('gzip');
  const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(ds);
  const text = await new Response(stream).text();
  POSTS = JSON.parse(text);
  $('stat').textContent = '데이터 로드 완료 — 검색어를 입력하세요. (비워두면 전체 최신순)';
  buildFilters();
  run();
}

function buildFilters() {
  const f = $('filters');
  const mk = (label, val) => {
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'chip' + (val === activeCat ? ' on' : '');
    d.textContent = label;
    d.onclick = () => { activeCat = val; buildFilters(); run(); };
    return d;
  };
  f.innerHTML = '';
  f.appendChild(mk('전체', ''));
  CATS.forEach(c => f.appendChild(mk(c, c)));
  const s = document.createElement('select');
  [['date','최신순'],['sym','공감순'],['hits','언급 많은 순']].forEach(([v,l]) => {
    const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = v; o.textContent = l; s.appendChild(o);
  });
  s.value = sortBy;
  s.onchange = () => { sortBy = s.value; run(); };
  f.appendChild(s);
}

const esc = s => s.replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));

function highlight(s, terms) {
  let out = esc(s);
  terms.forEach(t => {
    out = out.replace(new RegExp(t.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'gi'), m => '' + m + '');
  });
  return out.replaceAll('', '<mark>').replaceAll('', '</mark>');
}

function countHits(hay, terms) {
  let n = 0;
  const low = hay.toLowerCase();
  terms.forEach(t => {
    let i = 0; const tl = t.toLowerCase();
    while ((i = low.indexOf(tl, i)) !== -1) { n++; i += tl.length; }
  });
  return n;
}

function snippets(text, terms, max) {
  const low = text.toLowerCase(); const out = []; const used = [];
  for (const t of terms) {
    let i = 0; const tl = t.toLowerCase();
    while ((i = low.indexOf(tl, i)) !== -1 && out.length < max) {
      const a = Math.max(0, i - 55), b = Math.min(text.length, i + tl.length + 55);
      if (!used.some(([ua, ub]) => a < ub && b > ua)) {
        used.push([a, b]);
        out.push((a > 0 ? '…' : '') + text.slice(a, b).replace(/\n+/g, ' ') + (b < text.length ? '…' : ''));
      }
      i += tl.length;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function run() {
  const terms = $('q').value.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(t => t.length >= 1 && t !== '');
  results = [];
  for (const p of POSTS) {
    if (activeCat && p.c !== activeCat) continue;
    if (terms.length === 0) { results.push({p, hits: 0}); continue; }
    const hay = (p.t + '\n' + p.x).toLowerCase();
    if (terms.every(t => hay.includes(t.toLowerCase()))) {
      results.push({p, hits: countHits(p.t + '\n' + p.x, terms)});
    }
  }
  if (sortBy === 'sym') results.sort((a, b) => b.p.s - a.p.s);
  else if (sortBy === 'hits') results.sort((a, b) => b.hits - a.hits);
  // date: POSTS가 이미 최신순
  $('stat').innerHTML = terms.length
    ? `<b>${results.length.toLocaleString()}</b>건 검색됨 · 키워드: ${terms.map(esc).join(', ')}`
    : `전체 ${results.length.toLocaleString()}건`;
  shown = 0;
  $('list').innerHTML = '';
  renderMore(terms);
}

function renderMore(terms) {
  const list = $('list');
  const slice = results.slice(shown, shown + PAGE);
  for (const {p, hits} of slice) {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'card';
    const snips = terms.length ? snippets(p.x, terms, 3) : [];
    card.innerHTML =
      `<h3>${terms.length ? highlight(p.t, terms) : esc(p.t)}</h3>` +
      `<div class="sub"><span>${p.d}</span><span>${esc(p.c)}</span>` +
      `<span>공감 ${p.s.toLocaleString()}</span><span>댓글 ${p.m.toLocaleString()}</span>` +
      (hits ? `<span class="cnt">언급 ${hits}회</span>` : '') + `</div>` +
      (snips.length ? `<div class="snip">${snips.map(s => '<div>' + highlight(s, terms) + '</div>').join('')}</div>` : '') +
      `<div class="full">${terms.length ? highlight(p.x, terms) : esc(p.x)}` +
      `<br><a class="origin" href="${p.u}" target="_blank">네이버 원문 보기 ↗</a></div>`;
    card.onclick = e => {
      if (e.target.closest('a')) return;
      card.classList.toggle('open');
    };
    list.appendChild(card);
  }
  shown += slice.length;
  $('more').style.display = shown < results.length ? 'block' : 'none';
  $('more').textContent = `더 보기 (${shown}/${results.length})`;
  if (!results.length) list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">검색 결과가 없습니다.</div>';
}

let timer;
$('q').addEventListener('input', () => { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(run, 250); });
$('more').onclick = () => {
  const terms = $('q').value.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  renderMore(terms);
};
unpack();
</script>
</body>
</html>
'''

html = (html.replace('__PACKED__', packed)
            .replace('__BUILT__', built)
            .replace('__N_POSTS__', f'{n_posts:,}')
            .replace('__CATS__', json.dumps(cats, ensure_ascii=False)))
OUT.write_text(html, encoding='utf-8')
print(f'생성: {OUT}')
print(f'글 {n_posts}건 (본문 있음 {n_text}건), 파일 {OUT.stat().st_size/1e6:.1f}MB')

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""메르 블로그(blog.naver.com/ranto28) 전체 글 아카이브 → SQLite DB + 이미지 파일.

1단계: 모바일 post-list API로 전체 글 메타데이터(제목/날짜/카테고리/공감/댓글/요약) 수집
2단계: 각 글 모바일 페이지에서 본문 HTML + 텍스트 추출, 이미지 전부 로컬 다운로드
재실행하면 이미 받은 글/이미지는 건너뛰고 새 것만 추가된다(증분 업데이트).

저장 구조:
  ranto28.db            posts 테이블(본문 텍스트/HTML 포함) + FTS5 전문검색
  images/{logNo}/N.jpg  글별 이미지 (posts.images JSON에 url→파일 매핑)
"""
import requests
import sqlite3
import json
import re
import sys
import time
import random
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

BLOG_ID = 'ranto28'
BASE = Path(__file__).parent
DB_PATH = BASE / 'ranto28.db'
IMG_DIR = BASE / 'images'

S = requests.Session()
S.headers.update({
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
    'Referer': f'https://m.blog.naver.com/{BLOG_ID}',
})


def get_db():
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    con.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (
        log_no TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        title TEXT,
        category TEXT,
        published TEXT,
        add_date_ms INTEGER,
        comment_cnt INTEGER,
        sympathy_cnt INTEGER,
        brief TEXT,
        content_text TEXT,
        images TEXT,
        url TEXT,
        error TEXT,
        fetched_at TEXT
    )''')
    cols = [r[1] for r in con.execute('PRAGMA table_info(posts)')]
    if 'content_html' not in cols:
        con.execute('ALTER TABLE posts ADD COLUMN content_html TEXT')
    try:
        con.execute('''CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts_fts USING fts5(
            title, content_text, content=posts, content_rowid=rowid)''')
        con.execute('''CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS posts_ai AFTER INSERT ON posts BEGIN
            INSERT INTO posts_fts(rowid, title, content_text)
            VALUES (new.rowid, new.title, new.content_text); END''')
        con.execute('''CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS posts_au AFTER UPDATE ON posts BEGIN
            INSERT INTO posts_fts(posts_fts, rowid, title, content_text)
            VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.title, old.content_text);
            INSERT INTO posts_fts(rowid, title, content_text)
            VALUES (new.rowid, new.title, new.content_text); END''')
    except sqlite3.OperationalError as e:
        print(f'[warn] FTS5 사용 불가: {e}')
    return con


def fetch_list_page(page, item_count=30, tries=3):
    for i in range(tries):
        try:
            r = S.get(f'https://m.blog.naver.com/api/blogs/{BLOG_ID}/post-list',
                      params={'categoryNo': 0, 'itemCount': item_count, 'page': page},
                      timeout=15)
            r.raise_for_status()
            return r.json().get('result', {}).get('items', [])
        except Exception as e:
            if i == tries - 1:
                raise
            time.sleep(2 * (i + 1))


def phase1_metadata(con):
    print('=== 1단계: 글 목록 수집 ===', flush=True)
    page, total = 1, 0
    while True:
        items = fetch_list_page(page)
        if not items:
            break
        for it in items:
            log_no = str(it['logNo'])
            add_ms = it.get('addDate') or 0
            published = datetime.fromtimestamp(add_ms / 1000).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') if add_ms else None
            con.execute('''INSERT INTO posts (log_no, title, category, published, add_date_ms,
                               comment_cnt, sympathy_cnt, brief, url)
                           VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
                           ON CONFLICT(log_no) DO UPDATE SET
                               title=excluded.title, category=excluded.category,
                               published=excluded.published, add_date_ms=excluded.add_date_ms,
                               comment_cnt=excluded.comment_cnt, sympathy_cnt=excluded.sympathy_cnt,
                               brief=excluded.brief''',
                        (log_no, it.get('titleWithInspectMessage', ''),
                         it.get('categoryName', ''), published, add_ms,
                         it.get('commentCnt', 0), it.get('sympathyCnt', 0),
                         it.get('briefContents', ''),
                         f'https://blog.naver.com/{BLOG_ID}/{log_no}'))
            total += 1
        con.commit()
        page += 1
        time.sleep(0.15)
    print(f'목록 수집 완료: {total}건', flush=True)


def extract_content(html):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'lxml')
    container = (soup.select_one('div.se-main-container')
                 or soup.select_one('#viewTypeSelector')
                 or soup.select_one('div.post_ct'))
    if container is None:
        return None, None, None
    for tag in container.select('script, style'):
        tag.decompose()
    # 이미지 URL 수집 (lazy-src가 실제 원본)
    img_urls = []
    for img in container.select('img'):
        src = img.get('data-lazy-src') or img.get('src') or ''
        if src.startswith('http') and 'pstatic.net' in src:
            img.attrs['src'] = src  # HTML에도 실제 URL 반영
            img.attrs.pop('data-lazy-src', None)
            if src not in img_urls:
                img_urls.append(src)
    text = container.get_text('\n')
    text = re.sub(r'[ \t​﻿]+', ' ', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+', '\n\n', text).strip()
    return text, str(container), img_urls


def ext_of(url):
    path = urlparse(url).path.lower()
    for e in ('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.gif', '.webp', '.bmp'):
        if path.endswith(e):
            return e
    return '.jpg'


def download_image(url, dest: Path, tries=2):
    if dest.exists() and dest.stat().st_size > 0:
        return True
    for i in range(tries):
        try:
            r = S.get(url, timeout=20)
            r.raise_for_status()
            dest.write_bytes(r.content)
            return True
        except Exception:
            if i == tries - 1:
                return False
            time.sleep(1)
    return False


def phase2_content(con):
    rows = con.execute('''SELECT log_no FROM posts
                          WHERE content_html IS NULL AND (error IS NULL OR error='')
                          ORDER BY add_date_ms DESC''').fetchall()
    print(f'=== 2단계: 본문+이미지 수집 ({len(rows)}건 남음) ===', flush=True)
    done = 0
    pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4)
    for (log_no,) in rows:
        url = f'https://m.blog.naver.com/{BLOG_ID}/{log_no}'
        try:
            r = S.get(url, timeout=20)
            r.raise_for_status()
            text, chtml, img_urls = extract_content(r.text)
            if text is None:
                con.execute('UPDATE posts SET error=?, fetched_at=? WHERE log_no=?',
                            ('본문 컨테이너 없음', datetime.now().isoformat(), log_no))
            else:
                img_map = []
                if img_urls:
                    pdir = IMG_DIR / log_no
                    pdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    jobs = []
                    for i, iu in enumerate(img_urls):
                        dest = pdir / f'{i:03d}{ext_of(iu)}'
                        jobs.append((iu, dest, pool.submit(download_image, iu, dest)))
                    for iu, dest, fut in jobs:
                        ok = fut.result()
                        img_map.append({'url': iu,
                                        'file': str(dest.relative_to(BASE)) if ok else None})
                con.execute('''UPDATE posts SET content_text=?, content_html=?, images=?,
                                   error=NULL, fetched_at=? WHERE log_no=?''',
                            (text, chtml, json.dumps(img_map, ensure_ascii=False),
                             datetime.now().isoformat(), log_no))
        except Exception as e:
            con.execute('UPDATE posts SET error=?, fetched_at=? WHERE log_no=?',
                        (str(e)[:200], datetime.now().isoformat(), log_no))
            print(f'  [err] {log_no}: {e}', flush=True)
        done += 1
        if done % 25 == 0:
            con.commit()
            print(f'  {done}/{len(rows)}', flush=True)
        time.sleep(0.15 + random.random() * 0.1)
    con.commit()
    pool.shutdown()
    print(f'본문 수집 완료: {done}건 처리', flush=True)


def summary(con):
    n = con.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts').fetchone()[0]
    ok = con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE content_html IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0]
    err = con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE error IS NOT NULL AND error != ''").fetchone()[0]
    dr = con.execute('SELECT MIN(published), MAX(published) FROM posts').fetchone()
    nimg = sum(1 for _ in IMG_DIR.rglob('*.*')) if IMG_DIR.exists() else 0
    print(f'\n=== 요약 ===\n전체 {n}건 / 본문 확보 {ok}건 / 오류 {err}건 / 이미지 {nimg}개\n기간: {dr[0]} ~ {dr[1]}', flush=True)
    for cat, cnt in con.execute('SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM posts GROUP BY category ORDER BY 2 DESC'):
        print(f'  {cat}: {cnt}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    con = get_db()
    if '--content-only' not in sys.argv:
        phase1_metadata(con)
    phase2_content(con)
    summary(con)
    con.close()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""메르검색.html을 텔레그램 Saved Messages(내게 보내기)로 전송.

telegram-digest의 Telethon 사용자 세션 재사용.
주의: user_session.session은 동시 실행 금지(다른 Telethon 프로세스와 겹치면 세션 리셋됨).
"""
import asyncio
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

TD = Path.home() / '수급html' / 'telegram-digest'
sys.path.insert(0, str(TD / '.venv' / 'Lib' / 'site-packages'))

from telethon import TelegramClient  # noqa: E402

ENV = {}
for line in (TD / '.env').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines():
    if '=' in line and not line.strip().startswith('#'):
        k, _, v = line.partition('=')
        ENV[k.strip()] = v.strip()

FILE = Path.home() / '수급html' / 'ranto28' / '메르검색.html'
CAPTION = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '메르 블로그 키워드 검색 (전체 아카이브)'


async def main():
    client = TelegramClient(str(TD / 'user_session'),
                            int(ENV['TELEGRAM_API_ID']), ENV['TELEGRAM_API_HASH'])
    await client.connect()
    if not await client.is_user_authorized():
        print('ERROR: 세션 인증 안 됨 — --login 재인증 필요')
        return 1
    print(f'전송 중: {FILE.name} ({FILE.stat().st_size/1e6:.1f}MB)')
    await client.send_file('me', str(FILE), caption=CAPTION, force_document=True)
    print('전송 완료 → 텔레그램 Saved Messages')
    await client.disconnect()
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""메르 블로그 일일 업데이트 (매일 21:00 작업 스케줄러).

1. 새 글 증분 수집 (ranto28_scrape 재사용)
2. 메르검색.html 재생성
3. 새 글이 있으면 텔레그램 Saved Messages로 HTML 전송
   — JNJ_TG_Feed_1H(:00)·JNJ_Taerin_30min(:05/:35)과 Telethon 세션이 겹치지 않도록
     분(minute) 12~27 / 42~57 대역까지 기다렸다가 전송한다.
"""
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

BASE = Path(__file__).parent
PY = sys.executable
LOG = BASE / 'update.log'


def log(msg):
    line = f'[{datetime.now():%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}] {msg}'
    print(line, flush=True)
    with open(LOG, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(line + '\n')


def wait_safe_window():
    """다른 Telethon 스케줄 작업과 겹치지 않는 시간대까지 대기."""
    while True:
        m = datetime.now().minute % 30
        if 12 <= m <= 27:
            return
        time.sleep(20)


def main():
    log('=== 일일 업데이트 시작 ===')
    sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE))
    import ranto28_scrape as sc

    con = sc.get_db()
    before = con.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE content_html IS NOT NULL').fetchone()[0]
    try:
        sc.phase1_metadata(con)
        sc.phase2_content(con)
    except Exception as e:
        log(f'수집 오류: {e}')
    after = con.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE content_html IS NOT NULL').fetchone()[0]
    new = after - before
    titles = []
    if new > 0:
        titles = [r[0] for r in con.execute(
            'SELECT title FROM posts ORDER BY add_date_ms DESC LIMIT ?', (min(new, 5),))]
    con.close()
    log(f'수집 완료: 전체 {after}건 (+{new})')

    r = subprocess.run([PY, '-X', 'utf8', str(BASE / 'build_search_html.py')],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8')
    log(f'HTML 재생성: {(r.stdout or r.stderr or "").strip().splitlines()[-1] if (r.stdout or r.stderr) else "?"}')

    if new <= 0:
        log('새 글 없음 → 전송 생략')
        return

    caption = f'메르 블로그 검색 업데이트 (+{new}건, 전체 {after:,}건)\n' + \
              '\n'.join(f'· {t}' for t in titles)
    wait_safe_window()
    r = subprocess.run([PY, '-X', 'utf8', str(BASE / 'send_to_phone.py'), caption],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8')
    log(f'텔레그램 전송: {(r.stdout or r.stderr or "").strip().splitlines()[-1] if (r.stdout or r.stderr) else "?"}')
    log('=== 완료 ===')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import os,io,sys,json,asyncio
from datetime import timezone,timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from telethon import TelegramClient
from telethon.tl.functions.messages import CheckChatInviteRequest
from telethon.tl.types import ChatInviteAlready
sys.stdout=io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer,encoding='utf-8')
ROOT=Path('.'); load_dotenv('.env')
KST=timezone(timedelta(hours=9))
INVITE='Zt5jnh-BPDRjNmFl'
async def main():
    aid=int(os.environ['TELEGRAM_API_ID']); ah=os.environ['TELEGRAM_API_HASH']
    async with TelegramClient('user_session',aid,ah) as c:
        res=await c(CheckChatInviteRequest(INVITE))
        ent=res.chat if isinstance(res,ChatInviteAlready) else (await c.get_entity(INVITE))
        allm=[]; auth=[]
        async for m in c.iter_messages(ent):
            t=(m.message or '').strip()
            if not t: continue
            fwd = m.forward is not None
            rec={'datetime':m.date.astimezone(KST).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'),'text':t,'fwd':fwd}
            allm.append(rec)
            if not fwd: auth.append(rec)
        allm.reverse(); auth.reverse()
        print('전체 텍스트:',len(allm),'건')
        print('포워딩 제외(글쓴이 원글):',len(auth),'건')
        ac=sum(len(m['text']) for m in auth)
        print('글쓴이 원글 글자수:',ac,'(~',round(ac/2.2/1000),'K토큰)')
        # 길이 분포
        import statistics
        L=sorted(len(m['text']) for m in auth)
        print('원글 길이 중앙값:',L[len(L)//2],'/ 평균:',round(statistics.mean(L)))
        for th in [50,100,200,350,500]:
            print(f'  >= {th}자: {sum(1 for x in L if x>=th)}건')
        json.dump({'count':len(auth),'messages':auth},open('output/_author_only.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
        # 평문
        out=[]
        for m in auth:
            out.append('['+m['datetime']+']'); out.append(m['text']); out.append('')
        open('output/_author_only.txt','w',encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(out))
        print('저장: output/_author_only.json|txt')
asyncio.run(main())

"""
채널 피드 뷰어 — collect_channel.py --media 로 받은 이미지+캡션을 텔레그램처럼 본다.
  output/<채널>_history.json (media 포함) → output/<채널>_feed.html
  같은 grouped_id(앨범)는 한 포스트로 묶고, 최신순 정렬. 캡션 키워드 검색 + 이미지 클릭 확대.

사용: python build_channel_feed.py --json "output/태린이아빠..._history.json"
      (미지정 시 output/ 에서 media 포함 최신 *_history.json 자동 선택)
"""
import os, io, sys, json, glob, argparse, html as _h
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", line_buffering=True)
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUTDIR = os.path.join(HERE, "output")


def pick_json():
    cands = []
    for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(OUTDIR, "*_history.json")):
        try:
            d = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            continue
        if d.get("media_dir") and any(m.get("media") for m in d.get("messages", [])):
            cands.append((os.path.getmtime(p), p))
    if not cands:
        sys.exit("media 포함 *_history.json 이 없습니다. 먼저 collect_channel.py --media 실행.")
    return max(cands)[1]


def group_posts(msgs):
    posts, i, n = [], 0, len(msgs)
    while i < n:
        m = msgs[i]; gid = m.get("grouped_id")
        grp = [m]
        if gid is not None:
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and msgs[j].get("grouped_id") == gid:
                grp.append(msgs[j]); j += 1
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
        text = "\n".join(x["text"] for x in grp if x.get("text"))
        imgs = [x["media"] for x in grp if x.get("media")]
        posts.append({"dt": grp[0]["datetime"], "date": grp[0]["date"],
                      "text": text, "imgs": imgs, "views": grp[0].get("views")})
    posts.reverse()  # 최신순
    return posts


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--json", help="대상 *_history.json (미지정 시 자동)")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    path = a.json or pick_json()
    d = json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))
    mbase = d.get("media_dir", "")
    posts = group_posts(d.get("messages", []))
    n_img = sum(len(p["imgs"]) for p in posts)
    dates = [p["date"] for p in posts]
    rng = f"{min(dates)} ~ {max(dates)}" if dates else "-"

    cards = []
    for p in posts:
        imgs_html = "".join(
            f'<img loading="lazy" src="{mbase}/{_h.escape(f)}" onclick="zoom(this.src)">'
            for f in p["imgs"])
        cap = _h.escape(p["text"]).replace("\n", "<br>")
        cards.append(
            f'<div class="post" data-t="{_h.escape(p["text"]).lower()}" data-d="{p["date"]}">'
            f'<div class="phead"><span class="pdt">{p["dt"]}</span>'
            f'{f"<span class=views>👁 {p['views']:,}</span>" if p.get("views") else ""}</div>'
            f'{f"<div class=cap>{cap}</div>" if cap else ""}'
            f'{f"<div class=imgs>{imgs_html}</div>" if imgs_html else ""}</div>')

    html = TEMPLATE.replace("__TITLE__", _h.escape(d.get("channel", "채널")))
    html = html.replace("__META__", f"포스트 {len(posts)} · 이미지 {n_img} · {rng}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""'피드백 모음' 덤프 JSON → 불렛포인트로 정리한 HTML + Markdown.
- 글 순서: 시간 오름차순 그대로
- 각 글: 날짜(+첫줄 헤더)를 제목으로, 나머지 줄을 불렛으로
- '»' 로 시작하는 줄은 하위 불렛, 앞의 '-'·'•' 글머리 기호는 제거
- 문구 자체는 원문 그대로 (요약/재작성 없음)
"""
import json
import html
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = ROOT / "output"
data = json.loads((OUT / "피드백_모음_history.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
channel = data["channel"]
msgs = data["messages"]
count = data["count"]


def split_post(text):
    """(title, [(level, text), ...]) 반환. 빈 줄 제거, » → level1."""
    nonempty = [ln.strip() for ln in text.split("\n") if ln.strip()]
    if not nonempty:
        return None, []
    title = None
    body = nonempty
    first = nonempty[0]
    if re.match(r"^\d{6}", first) or first.startswith("["):
        title = first
        body = nonempty[1:]
    items = []
    for s in body:
        level = 0
        if s.startswith("»"):
            level = 1
            s = s.lstrip("»").strip()
        else:
            s = re.sub(r"^[-•·]\s*", "", s)
        if s:
            items.append((level, s))
    return title, items


def items_to_html(items):
    parts = ["<ul>"]
    i, n = 0, len(items)
    while i < n:
        level, s = items[i]
        esc = html.escape(s)
        if level == 0:
            children = []
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and items[j][0] == 1:
                children.append(items[j][1])
                j += 1
            if children:
                parts.append(f"<li>{esc}<ul>")
                parts += [f"<li>{html.escape(c)}</li>" for c in children]
                parts.append("</ul></li>")
            else:
                parts.append(f"<li>{esc}</li>")
            i = j
        else:
            parts.append(f"<li>{esc}</li>")
            i += 1
    parts.append("</ul>")
    return "".join(parts)


# ---------- Markdown ----------
md = [f"# {channel}", "", f"> 총 {count}건 · 시간 오름차순 · 불렛 정리(원문 문구 그대로)", "", "---", ""]
for i, m in enumerate(msgs, 1):
    title, items = split_post(m["text"])
    head = f"## {i}. {m['datetime']}"
    if title:
        head += f" — {title}"
    md.append(head)
    v = m.get("views")
    if v is not None:
        md.append(f"`조회 {v}`")
    md.append("")
    for level, s in items:
        md.append(f"{'  ' * level}- {s}")
    md.append("")
    md.append("---")
    md.append("")
(OUT / "피드백_모음_불렛.md").write_text("\n".join(md), encoding="utf-8")

# ---------- HTML ----------
cards = []
for i, m in enumerate(msgs, 1):
    title, items = split_post(m["text"])
    v = m.get("views")
    vtxt = f" · 조회 {v}" if v is not None else ""
    ttxt = f'<span class="title">{html.escape(title)}</span>' if title else ""
    cards.append(f"""    <article class="post">
      <div class="meta"><span class="num">#{i}</span><span class="dt">{html.escape(m['datetime'])}</span>{ttxt}<span class="views">{vtxt}</span></div>
      {items_to_html(items)}
    </article>""")

doc = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>{html.escape(channel)} · 불렛 정리</title>
<style>
  :root {{ color-scheme: light dark; }}
  * {{ box-sizing: border-box; }}
  body {{ margin:0; padding:0 16px 64px; line-height:1.65; color:#1a1a1a; background:#f4f5f7;
    font-family:-apple-system,"Segoe UI","Apple SD Gothic Neo","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif; }}
  .wrap {{ max-width:780px; margin:0 auto; }}
  header.page {{ position:sticky; top:0; z-index:2; background:#f4f5f7; padding:20px 0 12px;
    margin-bottom:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #d9dce1; }}
  header.page h1 {{ margin:0; font-size:22px; }}
  header.page .sub {{ color:#6b7280; font-size:13px; margin-top:4px; }}
  .post {{ background:#fff; border:1px solid #e3e6ea; border-radius:12px; padding:14px 18px 16px;
    margin:14px 0; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04); }}
  .meta {{ display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; flex-wrap:wrap; font-size:12.5px;
    color:#6b7280; margin-bottom:10px; padding-bottom:8px; border-bottom:1px dashed #eceef1; }}
  .meta .num {{ font-weight:700; color:#2563eb; }}
  .meta .dt {{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }}
  .meta .title {{ font-weight:700; color:#111827; font-size:14px; }}
  .post ul {{ margin:0; padding-left:20px; }}
  .post > ul > li {{ margin:5px 0; font-size:15px; }}
  .post ul ul {{ margin:4px 0; padding-left:18px; }}
  .post ul ul li {{ color:#374151; font-size:14.3px; list-style:'» '; }}
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {{
    body {{ color:#e6e6e6; background:#16181d; }}
    header.page {{ background:#16181d; border-bottom-color:#2a2e36; }}
    header.page .sub {{ color:#9aa3af; }}
    .post {{ background:#1e2127; border-color:#2a2e36; box-shadow:none; }}
    .meta {{ color:#9aa3af; border-bottom-color:#2a2e36; }}
    .meta .num {{ color:#6ea8fe; }}
    .meta .title {{ color:#f3f4f6; }}
    .post ul ul li {{ color:#c2c8d0; }}
  }}
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="wrap">
    <header class="page">
      <h1>{html.escape(channel)} · 불렛 정리</h1>
      <div class="sub">총 {count}건 · 시간 오름차순 · 원문 문구 그대로</div>
    </header>
{chr(10).join(cards)}
  </div>
</body>
</html>
"""
(OUT / "피드백_모음_불렛.html").write_text(doc, encoding="utf-8")

print(f"OK  {count}건")
print(f"  HTML: {OUT / '피드백_모음_불렛.html'}")
print(f"  MD  : {OUT / '피드백_모음_불렛.md'}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""'피드백 모음' 채널 덤프 JSON → 순서 그대로 HTML + Markdown 두 버전 생성.
원문 가공 없음(텍스트 그대로). 시간 오름차순.
"""
import json
import html
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = ROOT / "output"
SRC = OUT / "피드백_모음_history.json"

data = json.loads(SRC.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
channel = data["channel"]
msgs = data["messages"]
count = data["count"]

# ---------- Markdown (원문 그대로) ----------
md = [f"# {channel}", "", f"> 총 {count}건 · 시간 오름차순 · 원문 그대로", "", "---", ""]
for i, m in enumerate(msgs, 1):
    md.append(f"## {i}. {m['datetime']}")
    views = m.get("views")
    if views is not None:
        md.append(f"`조회 {views}`")
    md.append("")
    md.append(m["text"])
    md.append("")
    md.append("---")
    md.append("")
(OUT / "피드백_모음.md").write_text("\n".join(md), encoding="utf-8")

# ---------- HTML (원문 그대로, self-contained) ----------
cards = []
for i, m in enumerate(msgs, 1):
    views = m.get("views")
    vtxt = f" · 조회 {views}" if views is not None else ""
    body = html.escape(m["text"]).replace("\n", "<br>")
    cards.append(f"""    <article class="post">
      <div class="meta"><span class="num">#{i}</span><span class="dt">{html.escape(m['datetime'])}</span><span class="views">{vtxt}</span></div>

html_doc = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>

{chr(10).join(cards)}

"""

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
build_thememap.py — 고잉 채널 관련주 신경망 맵 데이터 빌드
입력: output/extract_result_*.json (MAP 종목 추출), output/sched_result_*.json (일정 이벤트),
      output/one_going_all_raw.json (메시지 원본)
출력: ../site/data/thememap.json
규칙: 같은 테마 = 최신판 채택 + 구버전 전용 종목 합집합(legacy 플래그) / DAILY 제외
신규 게시물 반영 절차:
  1) 채널 덤프 갱신 → one_going_all_raw.json
  2) 신규 후보 분류(MAP/DAILY/OTHER) + MAP 종목 추출 → extract_result_*.json에 추가
  3) 일정표 신규분 → sched_result_*.json에 추가
  4) 본 스크립트 실행 → site push
"""
import json, re, glob, os, sys
from collections import defaultdict

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT = os.path.join(BASE, "output")
SITE = os.path.join(BASE, "..", "site", "data", "thememap.json")

def norm_theme(t):
    t = re.sub(r"[\u25a0\[\]()\u00b7,'\"]", " ", t)
    t = re.sub(r"관련주|관련종목|관련 종목|밸류체인|서플라이 ?체인|분류|요약|정리|원페이퍼|한장|모음|모아보기|핵심|참고|국내|간단히|다시보기|업데이트|저장", " ", t)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", "", t).strip()

ALIAS = json.load(open(os.path.join(BASE, "thememap_alias.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
GROUPS_FIX = ALIAS.pop("_group_fix", {})
GROUP_RULES = ALIAS.pop("_group_rules", [])

def theme_key(t):
    n = norm_theme(t); return ALIAS.get(n, n)
def norm_stock(s):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", "", s.replace("?", "").strip())
def group_of(name, key):
    k = re.sub(r"[\s\u00b7'\-]", "", key)
    for fk, g in GROUPS_FIX.items():
        if fk in k or k in fk: return g
    s = name + key
    for g, pat in GROUP_RULES:
        if re.search(pat, s, re.I): return g
    return "기타"

msgs = {m["id"]: m for m in json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT, "one_going_all_raw.json"), encoding="utf-8"))}
ex = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(OUT, "extract_result_*.json"))):
    ex += json.load(open(f, encoding="utf-8"))
fam = defaultdict(list)
for e in ex: fam[theme_key(e["theme"])].append(e)

themes_out = []
for key, posts in fam.items():
    posts.sort(key=lambda e: msgs[e["id"]]["date"], reverse=True)
    latest = posts[0]; seen = {}; cats_out = []
    for c in latest["categories"]:
        st = [{"name": s["name"].replace("?",""), "note": s.get("note"), "legacy": False,
               "src": latest["id"], "src_date": msgs[latest["id"]]["date"][:10]}
              for s in c["stocks"] if norm_stock(s["name"]) and not seen.setdefault(norm_stock(s["name"]), False)]
        for s in c["stocks"]: seen[norm_stock(s["name"])] = True
        st = [s for s in st if s["name"].strip()]
        if st: cats_out.append({"name": c.get("name"), "stocks": st})
    extras = []
    for old in posts[1:]:
        for c in old["categories"]:
            for s in c["stocks"]:
                k = norm_stock(s["name"])
                if not k or seen.get(k): continue
                seen[k] = True
                extras.append({"name": s["name"].replace("?",""), "note": s.get("note"), "legacy": True,
                               "src": old["id"], "src_date": msgs[old["id"]]["date"][:10], "cat_hint": c.get("name")})
    if extras: cats_out.append({"name": "이전 버전 종목", "stocks": extras})
    name = latest["theme"].strip()
    themes_out.append({"key": key, "name": name, "group": group_of(name, key),
        "latest": {"id": latest["id"], "date": msgs[latest["id"]]["date"][:10]},
        "versions": [{"id": p["id"], "date": msgs[p["id"]]["date"][:10]} for p in posts],
        "n_stocks": sum(1 for v in seen.values() if v), "categories": cats_out})
themes_out.sort(key=lambda t: -t["n_stocks"])

ev = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(OUT, "sched_result_*.json"))):
    for item in json.load(open(f, encoding="utf-8")):
        for e in item.get("events", []):
            if e.get("date") and re.match(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", e["date"]): ev.append({**e, "src": item["id"]})
def norm_title(t): return re.sub(r"[\s()\u00b7\-_,.'\"]", "", t)[:20]
seen_e = {}
for e in sorted(ev, key=lambda x: x["src"]):
    seen_e.setdefault((e["date"], norm_title(e["title"])), e)
events = [e for e in sorted(seen_e.values(), key=lambda x: x["date"]) if "2024-01" <= e["date"] <= "2031-12"]
for t in themes_out:
    for v in t["versions"]:
        events.append({"date": v["date"], "title": f"테마맵: {t['name']}", "category": "테마맵",
                       "precision": "day", "src": v["id"], "theme_key": t["key"]})
events.sort(key=lambda x: x["date"])

from datetime import date
out = {"updated": date.today().isoformat(),
       "source": "텔레그램 @one_going (요약하는 고잉)",
       "themes": themes_out, "events": events}
json.dump(out, open(SITE, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
print(f"themes {len(themes_out)} / events {len(events)} -> {SITE}")

"""
'버틀러 - 오늘의 실적'(@butler_disclosures) 신규 메시지 조회 (Telethon, .venv 전용).

사용:  python butler_fetch.py <min_id> [limit]
출력:  stdout 에 JSON 배열 [{id, datetime, text}, ...] (id 오름차순).
       실패 시 {"error": "..."}.

세션 동시접근 금지 — fetch_estimate_table.py / send_text_to_me.py 와 동일한
telethon.lock 규약을 공유한다(user_session 은 SQLite 라 동시접근 시 락 충돌).
"""
import os, sys, json, time, asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import timezone, timedelta
try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
except Exception:
    pass
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from telethon import TelegramClient

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
load_dotenv(HERE / ".env")
KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))
SESSION = str(HERE / "user_session")
LOCK = HERE / "telethon.lock"
CHANNEL = os.environ.get("EARNINGS_FEED_CHANNEL", "@darthacking")   # 실적 피드(버틀러 탈락)


def acquire_lock(timeout=90):
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            if LOCK.exists() and time.time() - LOCK.stat().st_mtime > 600:
                LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            fd = os.open(LOCK, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
            os.write(fd, str(os.getpid()).encode())
            os.close(fd)
            return True
        except FileExistsError:
            time.sleep(5)
    return False


async def run(min_id, limit):
    client = TelegramClient(SESSION, int(os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_ID"]),
                            os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_HASH"])
    out = []
    try:
        await client.connect()
        if not await client.is_user_authorized():
            print(json.dumps({"error": "unauthorized"})); return
        ent = await client.get_entity(CHANNEL)
        async for m in client.iter_messages(ent, min_id=min_id, limit=limit):
            t = (m.message or "").strip()
            if t:
                out.append({"id": m.id,
                            "datetime": m.date.astimezone(KST).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
                            "text": t})
    finally:
        try:
            await client.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
    out.sort(key=lambda x: x["id"])
    print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    _min = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0
    _lim = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 60
    if not acquire_lock():
        print(json.dumps({"error": "lock"}))
        sys.exit(0)
    try:
        asyncio.run(run(_min, _lim))
    finally:
        LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
텔레그램 채널 과거 글 전체/기간 덤프 (철학 매뉴얼 등 분석용)
  telegram_digest.py 와 같은 user_session 세션 + .env 를 공유한다.
  봇/Anthropic 키 불필요 — Telethon 읽기(api_id/api_hash)만 사용.

사용 예:
  # 비공개 초대링크로 (이미 멤버면 그대로 읽고, 아니면 가입 후 읽음)
  python collect_channel.py --invite https://t.me/+Zt5jnh-BPDRjNmFl

  # 특정 날짜 이후만
  python collect_channel.py --invite https://t.me/+Zt5jnh-BPDRjNmFl --since 2025-01-01

  # 공개/가입済 채널은 username 또는 id 로
  python collect_channel.py --channel @some_channel --limit 2000

결과:
  output/<채널명>_history.json   원문(시간 오름차순, 구조화)
  output/<채널명>_history.txt    사람이 읽기 좋은 평문 (Claude 가 직접 읽고 분석)
"""
import os
import re
import sys
import json
import argparse
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from dotenv import load_dotenv

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")

KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))
SESSION = str(ROOT / "user_session")
OUTPUT_DIR = ROOT / "output"


def env(key, required=True, default=None):
    v = os.environ.get(key, default)
    if required and not v:
        sys.exit(f"[설정 오류] .env 에 {key} 가 비어 있습니다. .env.example 참고.")
    return v


def invite_hash(s):
    """https://t.me/+HASH  /  t.me/joinchat/HASH  /  HASH  → HASH"""
    s = s.strip()
    m = re.search(r"(?:joinchat/|/\+|^\+)?([A-Za-z0-9_-]{12,})$", s)
    return m.group(1) if m else s


def safe_name(s):
    s = re.sub(r"[^\w가-힣 .-]", "_", str(s)).strip().replace(" ", "_")
    return (s or "channel")[:60]


async def resolve_entity(client, args):
    """초대링크/username/id 로 엔티티 확보 (필요 시 가입)."""
    from telethon.tl.functions.messages import (
        CheckChatInviteRequest,
        ImportChatInviteRequest,
    )
    from telethon.tl.types import ChatInviteAlready

    if args.invite:
        h = invite_hash(args.invite)
        res = await client(CheckChatInviteRequest(h))
        if isinstance(res, ChatInviteAlready):
            print(f"  이미 멤버인 채널: {getattr(res.chat, 'title', '')}")
            return res.chat
        # 미가입 → 가입
        print(f"  미가입 채널 → 초대링크로 가입 시도: {getattr(res, 'title', '')}")
        upd = await client(ImportChatInviteRequest(h))
        return upd.chats[0]

    target = args.channel
    if target and re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", target):
        target = int(target)
    return await client.get_entity(target)


async def fetch_all(client, entity, since=None, limit=None, media_dir=None, media_limit=None):
    out = []
    kwargs = {}
    if limit:
        kwargs["limit"] = limit
    dl = 0
    # 증분: 이미 받은 이미지(파일명이 msgid로 시작)는 재다운로드 스킵
    have = {}
    if media_dir and media_dir.exists():
        for fn in os.listdir(media_dir):
            have[fn.split(".")[0]] = fn
    async for m in client.iter_messages(entity, **kwargs):
        if since and m.date < since:
            break
        text = (m.message or "").strip()
        has_img = _is_image(m)
        if not text and not (media_dir and has_img):
            continue  # 텍스트도 없고 (미디어수집 아님/이미지 아님)이면 스킵
        rec = {
            "id": m.id,
            "datetime": m.date.astimezone(KST).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
            "date": m.date.astimezone(KST).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            "text": text,
            "grouped_id": getattr(m, "grouped_id", None),
            "views": getattr(m, "views", None),
        }
        if media_dir and has_img:
            if str(m.id) in have:
                rec["media"] = have[str(m.id)]           # 이미 받음 → 재사용
            elif media_limit is None or dl < media_limit:
                try:
                    path = await client.download_media(m, file=str(media_dir / f"{m.id}"))
                    if path:
                        rec["media"] = os.path.basename(path)
                        dl += 1
                except Exception as e:
                    rec["media_err"] = str(e)
        out.append(rec)
    out.reverse()  # 시간 오름차순
    print(f"  이미지 {dl}건 다운로드" if media_dir else "")
    return out


def _is_image(m):
    """사진 또는 이미지 문서(mime image/*) 여부."""
    if getattr(m, "photo", None) is not None:
        return True
    doc = getattr(m, "document", None)
    if doc is not None:
        mt = getattr(doc, "mime_type", "") or ""
        return mt.startswith("image/")
    return False


async def run(args):
    from telethon import TelegramClient

    api_id = int(env("TELEGRAM_API_ID"))
    api_hash = env("TELEGRAM_API_HASH")

    since = None
    if args.since:
        d = datetime.strptime(args.since, "%Y-%m-%d")
        since = datetime(d.year, d.month, d.day, tzinfo=KST)

    async with TelegramClient(SESSION, api_id, api_hash) as client:
        if not await client.is_user_authorized():
            sys.exit("세션 없음/만료. 먼저  python telegram_digest.py --login  으로 인증하세요.")
        print("=== 엔티티 확인 중 ===")
        entity = await resolve_entity(client, args)
        title = getattr(entity, "title", None) or getattr(entity, "username", "channel")
        print(f"=== '{title}' 수집 중"
              + (f" (since {args.since})" if since else " (전체)")
              + (f", limit {args.limit}" if args.limit else "")
              + (", +이미지" if args.media else "") + " ===")

        OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        safe = safe_name(title)
        media_dir = None
        if args.media:
            media_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / "media" / safe
            media_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        msgs = await fetch_all(client, entity, since=since, limit=args.limit,
                               media_dir=media_dir, media_limit=args.media_limit)
        n_img = sum(1 for m in msgs if m.get("media"))
        print(f"  메시지 {len(msgs)}건 (이미지 포함 {n_img}건)")

        base = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{safe}_history"
        base.with_suffix(".json").write_text(
            json.dumps({"channel": title, "count": len(msgs),
                        "media_dir": (f"media/{safe}" if media_dir else None),
                        "messages": msgs}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        lines = [f"채널: {title}", f"메시지 수: {len(msgs)}건 (이미지 {n_img})", "=" * 50, ""]
        for m in msgs:
            lines.append(f"[{m['datetime']}]")
            if m.get("media"):
                lines.append(f"[이미지: media/{safe}/{m['media']}]")
            if m["text"]:
                lines.append(m["text"])
            lines.append("")
        base.with_suffix(".txt").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"  저장: {base}.json / {base}.txt"
              + (f" / {media_dir}\\ (이미지)" if media_dir else ""))


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="텔레그램 채널 과거 글 덤프")
    g = p.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    g.add_argument("--invite", help="비공개 초대링크 (https://t.me/+HASH)")
    g.add_argument("--channel", help="@username 또는 채널 id")
    p.add_argument("--since", help="YYYY-MM-DD 이후 글만")
    p.add_argument("--limit", type=int, help="최근 N건만")
    p.add_argument("--media", action="store_true", help="사진/이미지 문서도 다운로드(output/media/<채널>/)")
    p.add_argument("--media-limit", type=int, default=500, help="이미지 최대 다운로드 수(기본 500)")
    args = p.parse_args()
    asyncio.run(run(args))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
특정 날짜(KST) 1회성 수집 — 주말/누락 보정용.
  python collect_date.py 2026-06-19
  → site/data/telegram.json (피드, 해당일자) + output/wrap_input.txt (시황 4채널 해당일자)
  git push 는 호출자가 따로 (이 스크립트는 파일만 생성, --push 주면 telegram.json push)
"""
import os, sys, json, asyncio, subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")
KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))
SESSION = str(ROOT / "user_session")
SITE = ROOT.parent / "site"
OUT = SITE / "data" / "telegram.json"
RAW = ROOT / "output" / "wrap_input.txt"

# collect_today_feed.py 와 동일 채널 목록
FEED = [
    {"id": 3696130570, "key": "taerin", "title": "태린이아빠"},
    "aicorporateanalysisdeepdive","shmstory","bornlupin","d_ticker","ehdwl",
    "Macrojunglemicrolens","aetherjapanresearch","athletes_village","sunstudy2222",
    "HANAchina","cahier_de_market","skitteam","free_life59","Jstockclass",
    "ked_epic_ai","kkkontemp","Joorini34",
]
WRAP = ["ked_epic_ai","daishinstrategy","chacha_881","shmstory"]


async def msgs_on(client, ref, lo, hi, limit=400):
    out = []
    async for m in client.iter_messages(ref, limit=limit):
        if m.date < lo:
            break
        if m.date >= hi:
            continue
        t = (m.message or "").strip()
        if t:
            out.append((m.id, m.date.astimezone(KST), t))
    out.reverse()
    return out


async def run(day):
    from telethon import TelegramClient
    from telethon.tl.types import PeerChannel
    lo = datetime(day.year, day.month, day.day, tzinfo=KST)
    hi = lo + timedelta(days=1)
    api_id = int(os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_ID"]); api_hash = os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_HASH"]

    posts, channels_meta, wrap_blocks = [], [], []
    async with TelegramClient(SESSION, api_id, api_hash) as client:
        for ch in FEED:
            priv = isinstance(ch, dict)
            key = ch["key"] if priv else ch
            ref = PeerChannel(ch["id"]) if priv else ch
            try:
                ent = await client.get_entity(ref)
                title = getattr(ent, "title", None) or (ch.get("title") if priv else key)
                ms = await msgs_on(client, ent, lo, hi)
                for mid, dt, t in ms:
                    link = (f"https://t.me/c/{ent.id}/{mid}" if priv else f"https://t.me/{key}/{mid}")
                    posts.append({"ch": key, "id": mid, "ts": dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
                                  "epoch": int(dt.timestamp()), "text": t, "link": link})
                channels_meta.append({"handle": key, "title": title, "count": len(ms), "private": priv})
                print(f"  feed @{key:<28} {len(ms):>3}")
            except Exception as e:
                channels_meta.append({"handle": key, "title": key, "count": 0, "private": priv})
                print(f"  feed @{key:<28} 오류 {e}")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.6)

        for h in WRAP:
            try:
                ent = await client.get_entity(h)
                title = getattr(ent, "title", None) or h
                ms = await msgs_on(client, ent, lo, hi)
                body = "\n\n".join(f"[{dt.strftime('%H:%M')}]\n{t}" for _, dt, t in ms)
                wrap_blocks.append(f"───── 채널: {title} (@{h}, {len(ms)}건) ─────\n\n{body}")
                print(f"  wrap @{h:<28} {len(ms):>3}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  wrap @{h:<28} 오류 {e}")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.6)

    posts.sort(key=lambda p: p["epoch"], reverse=True)
    ds = day.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps({"date": ds, "updated": ds + " 18:00",
                               "channels": channels_meta, "posts": posts, "errors": []},
                              ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    RAW.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    RAW.write_text("\n\n".join(wrap_blocks), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\n피드 {len(posts)}건 → {OUT}\n시황원문 → {RAW}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    d = datetime.strptime(sys.argv[1], "%Y-%m-%d")
    asyncio.run(run(d))
    if "--push" in sys.argv:
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(SITE), "add", "data/telegram.json"])
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(SITE), "commit", "-m", f"telegram feed {sys.argv[1]} snapshot"])
        r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(SITE), "push"], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
        print("push:", "OK" if r.returncode == 0 else r.stderr[-200:])

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""지정 채널들에서 최근 N일 내 키워드(종목명) 언급 메시지를 수집해 JSON으로 저장.
신고가 텔레그램 봇(newhigh_tg.py)의 코멘트 참고자료용.
사용: python collect_recent_mentions.py <config.json> <out.json>
config: {"keywords": ["와이지-원", ...],
         "channels": [{"name": "DOC_POOL", "days": 14, "scan_cap": 9000},
                      {"name": "tazastock", "days": 7}]}
telethon.lock 직렬화 규약 준수 (세션 동시접근 금지)."""
import os, sys, re, json, time, asyncio, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from telethon import TelegramClient

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
load_dotenv(HERE / ".env")
LOCK = HERE / "telethon.lock"
SCAN_CAP = 3000       # 채널당 최대 스캔 메시지 수
PER_KEY_CAP = 4       # 채널당 키워드당 최대 수집 건수
TEXT_CAP = 1200       # 메시지당 텍스트 길이 제한


def acquire_lock(timeout=300):
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            if LOCK.exists() and time.time() - LOCK.stat().st_mtime > 600:
                LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            fd = os.open(LOCK, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
            os.write(fd, str(os.getpid()).encode())
            os.close(fd)
            return True
        except FileExistsError:
            time.sleep(5)
    return False


def norm(s):
    return re.sub(r"[^0-9a-zA-Z가-힣]", "", s or "").lower()


async def main():
    cfg = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    out_path = sys.argv[2]
    keys = [(k, norm(k)) for k in cfg["keywords"]]
    if not acquire_lock():
        print("ERROR: telethon.lock 획득 실패"); return 1
    results = []
    client = None
    try:
        client = TelegramClient(str(HERE / "user_session"),
                                int(os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_ID"]),
                                os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_HASH"])
        await client.connect()
        if not await client.is_user_authorized():
            print("ERROR: not authorized"); return 1
        for ch in cfg["channels"]:
            name, days = ch["name"], ch.get("days", 7)
            scan_cap = ch.get("scan_cap", SCAN_CAP)
            since = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) - datetime.timedelta(days=days)
            counts = {k: 0 for k, _ in keys}
            try:
                entity = await client.get_entity(name)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"WARN: {name} 접근 실패 - {e}")
                continue
            scanned = 0
            async for msg in client.iter_messages(entity, limit=scan_cap):
                scanned += 1
                if msg.date < since:
                    break
                text = msg.message or ""
                fname = ""
                if msg.file and getattr(msg.file, "name", None):
                    fname = msg.file.name
                hay = norm(text + " " + fname)
                if not hay:
                    continue
                for k, nk in keys:
                    if nk and nk in hay and counts[k] < PER_KEY_CAP:
                        counts[k] += 1
                        results.append({
                            "keyword": k, "channel": name,
                            "date": msg.date.astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
                            "file": fname,
                            "text": text[:TEXT_CAP],
                        })
            print(f"{name}: {scanned}건 스캔, 매칭 {sum(counts.values())}건")
    finally:
        if client is not None:
            try:
                await client.disconnect()
            except Exception:
                pass
        LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    json.dump(results, open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8"),
              ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
    print(f"OK {len(results)}건 저장 -> {out_path}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

"""
Research Hub 텔레그램 피드 수집기

"""
import os
import sys
import json
import asyncio
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from dotenv import load_dotenv

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")

KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))
SESSION = str(ROOT / "user_session")
SITE_DIR = ROOT.parent / "site"
OUT_FILE = SITE_DIR / "data" / "telegram.json"

# 항목: "공개핸들" 또는 {"id": 채널ID, "key": 표시키, "title": 기본이름} (비공개 채널)
CHANNELS = [
    {"id": 3696130570, "key": "taerin", "title": "태린이아빠"},  # 비공개 — 초대링크 가입済
    "aicorporateanalysisdeepdive",

def env(key):
    v = os.environ.get(key)
    if not v:
        sys.exit(f"[설정 오류] .env 에 {key} 가 비어 있습니다.")
    return v


async def fetch_today(client, ch, since):
    """채널에서 since(KST 자정) 이후 글 수집. 공개=핸들 / 비공개=ID(가입済)."""
    from telethon.tl.types import PeerChannel
    private = isinstance(ch, dict)
    if private:
        key, ref = ch["key"], PeerChannel(ch["id"])
    else:
        key, ref = ch, ch
    entity = await client.get_entity(ref)
    title = getattr(entity, "title", None) or (ch.get("title") if private else key)
    posts = []
    async for m in client.iter_messages(entity, limit=300):
        if m.date < since:
            break
        text = (m.message or "").strip()
        if not text:
            continue
        link = (f"https://t.me/c/{entity.id}/{m.id}" if private
                else f"https://t.me/{key}/{m.id}")
        posts.append({
            "ch": key,
            "id": m.id,
            "ts": m.date.astimezone(KST).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
            "epoch": int(m.date.timestamp()),
            "text": text,
            "link": link,
        })
    return key, title, private, posts


async def collect():
    from telethon import TelegramClient

    api_id = int(env("TELEGRAM_API_ID"))
    api_hash = env("TELEGRAM_API_HASH")

    now = datetime.now(KST)
    since = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)

    channels_meta, all_posts, errors = [], [], []
    async with TelegramClient(SESSION, api_id, api_hash) as client:
        if not await client.is_user_authorized():
            sys.exit("세션 없음/만료. python telegram_digest.py --login 으로 재인증 필요.")
        for ch in CHANNELS:
            name = ch["key"] if isinstance(ch, dict) else ch
            try:
                key, title, private, posts = await fetch_today(client, ch, since)
                channels_meta.append({"handle": key, "title": title,
                                      "count": len(posts), "private": private})
                all_posts.extend(posts)
                print(f"  @{name:<30} {len(posts):>3}건  ({title})")
            except Exception as e:
                channels_meta.append({"handle": name, "title": name, "count": 0, "private": False})
                errors.append(f"@{name}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
                print(f"  @{name:<30} 오류: {e}")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.7)  # FloodWait 예방

    all_posts.sort(key=lambda p: p["epoch"], reverse=True)  # 최신순
    data = {
        "date": now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "updated": now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
        "channels": channels_meta,
        "posts": all_posts,
        "errors": errors,
    }
    OUT_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OUT_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\n저장: {OUT_FILE}  (총 {len(all_posts)}건, 오류 {len(errors)}건)")
    return len(all_posts)


def git_push():
    def run(*args):
        return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(SITE_DIR), *args],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    st = run("status", "--porcelain", "data/telegram.json")
    if not st.stdout.strip():
        print("git: 변경 없음 — push 생략")
        return
    run("add", "data/telegram.json")
    now = datetime.now(KST).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    run("commit", "-m", f"tg feed {now}")
    r = run("push")
    print("git push:", "OK" if r.returncode == 0 else r.stderr.strip()[:300])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(collect())
    if "--no-push" not in sys.argv:
        git_push()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""시간 윈도우 지정 채널 수집기 (us_wrap_tg.py 등에서 venv 프로세스로 호출).
사용: python collect_window.py <cfg.json> <out.json>
cfg: {"channels": ["handle", ...],           # 공개 채널 핸들
      "start": "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM",           # KST, 이상
      "end":   "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM",           # KST, 미만
      "per_channel_cap": 400}                # 채널당 최대 메시지 수(최신 우선)
out: {"channels": [{handle,title,count}], "messages": [{ch,title,ts,epoch,text}], "errors": []}
send_text_to_me.py와 동일한 telethon.lock 규약 — 세션 동시접근 금지."""
import os, sys, json, time, asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from dotenv import load_dotenv

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
load_dotenv(HERE / ".env")
KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))
LOCK = HERE / "telethon.lock"


def acquire_lock(timeout=300):
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            if LOCK.exists() and time.time() - LOCK.stat().st_mtime > 600:
                LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            fd = os.open(LOCK, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
            os.write(fd, str(os.getpid()).encode())
            os.close(fd)
            return True
        except FileExistsError:
            time.sleep(5)
    return False


async def fetch(client, handle, start, end, cap):
    entity = await client.get_entity(handle)
    title = getattr(entity, "title", None) or handle
    out = []
    async for m in client.iter_messages(entity, offset_date=end):
        if m.date < start:
            break
        if m.date >= end:
            continue
        text = (m.message or "").strip()
        if not text:
            continue
        out.append({"ch": handle, "title": title,
                    "ts": m.date.astimezone(KST).strftime("%m-%d %H:%M"),
                    "epoch": int(m.date.timestamp()), "text": text})
        if len(out) >= cap:
            break
    out.reverse()  # 시간 오름차순
    return title, out


async def main():
    cfg = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    start = datetime.strptime(cfg["start"], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M").replace(tzinfo=KST)
    end = datetime.strptime(cfg["end"], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M").replace(tzinfo=KST)
    cap = int(cfg.get("per_channel_cap", 400))

    if not acquire_lock():
        print("ERROR: telethon.lock 획득 실패 (5분 대기 초과)")
        return 1
    try:
        from telethon import TelegramClient
        api_id = int(os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_ID"])
        api_hash = os.environ["TELEGRAM_API_HASH"]
        meta, messages, errors = [], [], []
        # async with(=start())는 미인증 세션에서 전화번호 input() 프롬프트로 영원히
        # 블로킹됨(숨김 콘솔에서 EOF 안 옴 — 2026-07-23 새벽 20분 행의 원인).
        # connect()+명시적 인증 체크로 즉시 실패시킨다.
        client = TelegramClient(str(HERE / "user_session"), api_id, api_hash)
        await client.connect()
        try:
            if not await client.is_user_authorized():
                print("ERROR: not authorized — telegram_digest.py --login 재인증 필요")
                return 1
            for h in cfg["channels"]:
                try:
                    title, msgs = await fetch(client, h, start, end, cap)
                    meta.append({"handle": h, "title": title, "count": len(msgs)})
                    messages.extend(msgs)
                    print(f"  @{h:<24} {len(msgs):>3}건  ({title})")
                except Exception as e:
                    errors.append(f"@{h}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
                    print(f"  @{h:<24} 오류: {e}")
                await asyncio.sleep(0.7)  # FloodWait 예방
        finally:
            try:
                await client.disconnect()
            except Exception:
                pass
        messages.sort(key=lambda m: m["epoch"])
        Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(
            {"channels": meta, "messages": messages, "errors": errors},
            ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"OK 총 {len(messages)}건 / 오류 {len(errors)}건")
        return 0
    finally:
        LOCK.unlink(missing_ok=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
수출 데이터 탭 반자동화 — Downloads의 태린이아빠 수출정리 엑셀을 감시해 자동 빌드·배포.
  엑셀 원본은 회원 전용 폴더 링크로 공유되어 자동 수신 불가(채널에 문서 없음, 2026-07-21 확인)
  → 공자가 다운로드만 하면 이 워처가 새 파일을 감지해:
  ① build_export_html.py <엑셀> (주요품목 수출 대시보드 MMDD.html 생성)
  ② daily_close.py --publish-only (site/export.html 재배포)
감시 대상: Downloads\주요품목별수출정리*.xlsx (수정시각 최신 1개, state로 중복 방지)
스케줄: 평일 09:30부터 30분 간격(작업 KRX_수출대시보드_감시).
"""
import os
import sys
import io
import json
import time
import glob
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, "buffer"):
    sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", line_buffering=True)

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = ROOT.parent                       # 수급 html
STATE = ROOT / "export_watch_state.json"
DOWNLOADS = Path.home() / "Downloads"
PY = sys.executable


def log(m): print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] {m}")


def main():
    files = glob.glob(str(DOWNLOADS / "주요품목별수출정리*.xlsx"))
    if not files:
        log("Downloads에 수출정리 엑셀 없음"); return
    latest = max(files, key=os.path.getmtime)
    mt = os.path.getmtime(latest)
    st = {}
    if STATE.exists():
        try: st = json.load(open(STATE, encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception: pass
    if st.get("file") == latest and abs(st.get("mtime", 0) - mt) < 1:
        return  # 새 파일 없음 — 조용히 종료(30분 폴링)
    log(f"새 엑셀 감지: {os.path.basename(latest)} ({time.strftime('%m-%d %H:%M', time.localtime(mt))})")
    r = subprocess.run([PY, str(BASE / "build_export_html.py"), latest],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", cwd=str(BASE))
    if r.returncode != 0:
        log(f"!! 대시보드 생성 실패: {(r.stderr or r.stdout)[-300:]}"); return
    log("대시보드 생성 완료")
    r = subprocess.run([PY, str(BASE / "daily_close.py"), "--publish-only"],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", cwd=str(BASE))
    if r.returncode != 0:
        log(f"!! 재배포 실패: {(r.stderr or r.stdout)[-200:]}"); return
    log("site 재배포 완료")
    json.dump({"file": latest, "mtime": mt}, open(STATE, "w", encoding="utf-8"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
