# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Amazon K-뷰티 랭킹 트래커 (소비재 봇)
- 마켓별 Amazon Best Sellers > Beauty 를 긁어 K-뷰티 브랜드 침투도/순위변동을 텔레그램으로 발송.
- 데이터: /gp/bestsellers/beauty/ 페이지의 data-client-recs-list JSON(순위+ASIN 전체) + 화면 렌더 카드(상품명).
- 상품명은 렌더 밴드(1-30, 51-80)에서 수집 + ASIN→상품명 캐시로 누적.
- 히스토리(일별 스냅샷)로 순위변동 화살표 / 7일평균 / NEW 판정.

사용:
  py amazon_kbeauty.py            # 전 마켓 수집·저장·콘솔출력 (텔레그램 미발송)
  py amazon_kbeauty.py --send     # 위 + 텔레그램 발송 (config.json 필요)
  py amazon_kbeauty.py --market US
"""
import sys, os, re, json, time, html as htmlmod, argparse, datetime as dt
import requests

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
BASE_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "data")
os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 설정
MARKETS = {
    "US": {"flag": "🇺🇸", "name": "미국",   "domain": "www.amazon.com",    "topn": 100, "pages": [1, 2]},
    "UK": {"flag": "🇬🇧", "name": "영국",   "domain": "www.amazon.co.uk",  "topn": 30,  "pages": [1]},
    "DE": {"flag": "🇩🇪", "name": "독일",   "domain": "www.amazon.de",     "topn": 30,  "pages": [1]},
    "ES": {"flag": "🇪🇸", "name": "스페인", "domain": "www.amazon.es",     "topn": 30,  "pages": [1]},
    "FR": {"flag": "🇫🇷", "name": "프랑스", "domain": "www.amazon.fr",     "topn": 30,  "pages": [1]},
}
CAT_PATH = "/gp/bestsellers/beauty/"
UNCLASSIFIED_SCAN = 30   # 미분류 브랜드는 상위 N위 안에서만 표기
HISTORY_KEEP_DAYS = 45

UA = ("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
      "(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36")

def headers(domain):
    return {
        "User-Agent": UA,
        "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9",
        "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
        "Referer": f"https://{domain}/",
    }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 브랜드 사전
def load_brands():
    with open(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "brands.json"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)["brands"]

def brand_label(b):
    """🏷 표기용: 상장 모회사만 괄호 표기('메디큐브(에이피알)').
    자기명 상장사(브이티)·비상장(바이오던스)은 브랜드명만."""
    p, tk = b.get("parent", ""), b.get("ticker", "")
    if tk and p and p != b["display"]:
        return f"{b['display']}({p})"
    return b["display"]

def match_brand(title, brands):
    if not title:
        return None
    t = title.lower()
    for key, b in brands.items():
        for a in b["aliases"]:
            if a.lower() in t:
                return key
    return None

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ASIN→상품명 캐시
def cache_path():
    return os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "asin_titles.json")

def load_cache():
    p = cache_path()
    return json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8")) if os.path.exists(p) else {}

def save_cache(cache):
    json.dump(cache, open(cache_path(), "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 수집/파싱
def parse_recs(html):
    """data-client-recs-list JSON → [(rank, asin)] (해당 페이지 50개 전체)."""
    m = re.search(r'data-client-recs-list="(.+?)"', html, re.S)
    if not m:
        return []
    arr = json.loads(htmlmod.unescape(m.group(1)))
    out = []
    for x in arr:
        try:
            out.append((int(x["metadataMap"]["render.zg.rank"]), x["id"]))
        except (KeyError, ValueError):
            continue
    return out

def parse_titles(html):
    """화면 렌더된 카드에서 asin→상품명 추출(밴드 1-30 / 51-80 등)."""
    titles = {}
    for block in html.split("gridItemRoot")[1:]:
        block = block[:4000]
        am = re.search(r"/dp/([A-Z0-9]{10})", block)
        tm = re.search(r'<img[^>]*\balt="([^"]{4,200})"', block)
        if am and tm:
            titles[am.group(1)] = htmlmod.unescape(tm.group(1)).strip()
    return titles

def fetch_market(mk, cfg, cache):
    """반환: [{rank, asin, title}] 상위 topn (순위정렬)."""
    ranks, titles = {}, {}
    for pg in cfg["pages"]:
        url = f"https://{cfg['domain']}{CAT_PATH}" + (f"?pg={pg}" if pg > 1 else "")
        html = get_with_retry(url, cfg["domain"])
        for rank, asin in parse_recs(html):
            ranks.setdefault(rank, asin)
        titles.update(parse_titles(html))
        time.sleep(2.5)
    # 이번 수집 상품명으로 캐시 갱신
    cache.update(titles)
    items = []
    for rank in sorted(ranks):
        if rank > cfg["topn"]:
            continue
        asin = ranks[rank]
        items.append({"rank": rank, "asin": asin, "title": titles.get(asin) or cache.get(asin) or ""})
    return items

def get_with_retry(url, domain, tries=3):
    last = None
    for i in range(tries):
        try:
            r = requests.get(url, headers=headers(domain), timeout=25)
            low = r.text.lower()
            if r.status_code == 200 and "captcha" not in low and "robot check" not in low:
                return r.text
            last = f"status={r.status_code} captcha={'captcha' in low}"
        except Exception as e:
            last = repr(e)
        time.sleep(3 + i * 3)
    raise RuntimeError(f"fetch failed {url}: {last}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 히스토리
def hist_path(mk):
    return os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"{mk}.json")

def load_hist(mk):
    p = hist_path(mk)
    return json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8")) if os.path.exists(p) else {}

def save_hist(mk, hist):
    cutoff = (dt.date.today() - dt.timedelta(days=HISTORY_KEEP_DAYS)).isoformat()
    hist = {d: v for d, v in hist.items() if d >= cutoff}
    json.dump(hist, open(hist_path(mk), "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=0)

def prev_dates(hist, today, n):
    return sorted([d for d in hist if d < today])[-n:]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 리포트 조립
def arrow(delta):
    """순위 변동: 순위 숫자가 줄면(개선) ▲, 늘면 ▼."""
    if delta is None:
        return "✨NEW"
    if delta > 0:
        return f"▲{delta}"
    if delta < 0:
        return f"▼{-delta}"
    return "→"

def count_arrow(today_c, y_c):
    if y_c is None:
        return "—"
    d = today_c - y_c
    return f"▲{d}" if d > 0 else (f"▼{-d}" if d < 0 else "—")

def build_report(mk, cfg, items, hist, brands, today):
    # asin → 어제 순위
    ydates = prev_dates(hist, today, 1)
    yrank = {}
    if ydates:
        for it in hist[ydates[0]]:
            yrank[it["asin"]] = it["rank"]
    # 브랜드별 그룹
    groups = {}
    matched_asins = set()
    for it in items:
        key = match_brand(it["title"], brands)
        if not key:
            continue
        matched_asins.add(it["asin"])
        y = yrank.get(it["asin"])
        delta = (y - it["rank"]) if y is not None else None  # +면 순위상승
        groups.setdefault(key, []).append({"rank": it["rank"], "arrow": arrow(delta)})
    # 브랜드별 7일평균 제품수 & 어제 제품수
    weekdates = prev_dates(hist, today, 7)
    def brand_count_on(day, key):
        c = 0
        for it in hist.get(day, []):
            if match_brand(it.get("title", "") or "", brands) == key:
                c += 1
        return c
    report_brands = []
    for key, prods in groups.items():
        prods.sort(key=lambda p: p["rank"])
        today_c = len(prods)
        hist_counts = [brand_count_on(d, key) for d in weekdates]
        avg = (sum(hist_counts) + today_c) / (len(hist_counts) + 1) if hist_counts else today_c
        y_c = brand_count_on(ydates[0], key) if ydates else None
        report_brands.append({
            "key": key, "label": brand_label(brands[key]),
            "best": prods[0]["rank"], "count": today_c,
            "avg": avg, "cavg": count_arrow(today_c, y_c),
            "prods": prods,
        })
    report_brands.sort(key=lambda b: b["best"])
    # 미분류(상위 N위 중, K-뷰티 사전 미매칭) 브랜드 추정
    unclassified = []
    seen = set()
    for it in items:
        if it["rank"] > UNCLASSIFIED_SCAN or it["asin"] in matched_asins:
            continue
        guess = guess_brand_token(it["title"])
        if guess and guess.lower() not in seen:
            seen.add(guess.lower())
            unclassified.append(guess)
    n_prod = sum(b["count"] for b in report_brands)
    return {"brands": report_brands, "n_brand": len(report_brands),
            "n_prod": n_prod, "unclassified": unclassified}

def guess_brand_token(title):
    if not title:
        return None
    w = re.split(r"[\s,|]+", title.strip())
    return w[0] if w else None

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 포맷
def format_message(mk, cfg, rep, today):
    url = f"https://{cfg['domain']}{CAT_PATH}"
    L = []
    L.append(f"{cfg['flag']} {cfg['name']} Amazon K-뷰티 랭킹 (Top{cfg['topn']} 중) {today}")
    L.append(f"브랜드 {rep['n_brand']}개 · 제품 {rep['n_prod']}개   🔗 원본 ({url})")
    L.append("")
    for b in rep["brands"]:
        L.append(f"🏷 {b['label']} ({b['count']}개, 7일평균 {b['avg']:.1f}개 {b['cavg']})")
        for p in b["prods"]:
            L.append(f" • {p['rank']}위 {p['arrow']}")
        L.append("")
    if rep["unclassified"]:
        L.append(f"❓ 상위{UNCLASSIFIED_SCAN} 미분류(K-뷰티면 알려줘→추가): " + ", ".join(rep["unclassified"]))
    return "\n".join(L).rstrip()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 텔레그램
def load_config():
    p = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "config.json")
    return json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8")) if os.path.exists(p) else {}

def send_telegram(text, cfg):
    tok, chat = cfg.get("bot_token"), cfg.get("chat_id")
    if not tok or not chat:
        print("[telegram] config.json 의 bot_token/chat_id 없음 → 발송 스킵")
        return
    for attempt in range(3):   # 일시 네트워크 오류 3회 재시도(2026-08-25)
        try:
            r = requests.post(f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{tok}/sendMessage",
                              data={"chat_id": chat, "text": text, "disable_web_page_preview": "true"},
                              timeout=20)
            break
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            if attempt == 2:
                print("[telegram] 전송 실패(3회 소진):", e)
                return
            time.sleep(5 * (attempt + 1))
    print("[telegram]", r.status_code, r.text[:120])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 메인
def run(markets, do_send):
    brands = load_brands()
    cache = load_cache()
    cfg_tele = load_config()
    today = dt.date.today().isoformat()
    outputs = []
    for mk in markets:
        cfg = MARKETS[mk]
        try:
            items = fetch_market(mk, cfg, cache)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[{mk}] 수집 실패: {e}")
            continue
        hist = load_hist(mk)
        rep = build_report(mk, cfg, items, hist, brands, today)
        msg = format_message(mk, cfg, rep, today)
        outputs.append(msg)
        print("\n" + "=" * 60 + f"\n{mk}\n" + "=" * 60)
        print(msg)
        # 스냅샷 저장(브랜드매칭 재계산 위해 title 포함)
        hist[today] = [{"rank": it["rank"], "asin": it["asin"], "title": it["title"]} for it in items]
        save_hist(mk, hist)
    save_cache(cache)
    if do_send:
        for msg in outputs:
            send_telegram(msg, cfg_tele)
            time.sleep(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--market", help="US/UK/DE/ES/FR (미지정=전체)")
    ap.add_argument("--send", action="store_true", help="텔레그램 발송")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    mks = [a.market.upper()] if a.market else list(MARKETS)
    run(mks, a.send)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
불닭볶음면 글로벌(해외) 트렌드 트래커 (소비재 봇 - 삼양식품 003230)
- 해외/외국인 인기도 중심. 인스타 해시태그 수는 공개 데이터 없음 → 3개 공개 소스 조합:
  1) YouTube: 24시간 신규 'buldak' 영상/쇼츠 수 + 조회수 (gl=US 앵커, ytInitialData, 키 불필요)
  2) Google Trends: 'buldak' 검색관심도 + 국가별 TOP + 한국 순위(해외주도 검증) (pytrends)
  3) Amazon 4개국(US/UK/DE/JP): 면류 베스트셀러 내 삼양·불닭 순위 + 누적 리뷰수 (zgbs)
- 히스토리(data/buldak.json)로 7일평균·순위변동·리뷰증가 → 특이점 자동.

사용:
  py buldak_trend.py            # 수집·저장·콘솔출력
  py buldak_trend.py --send     # + 텔레그램 발송 (config.json)
"""

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 유틸
def views_int(s):
    s = (s or "").lower().replace(",", "")
    m = re.search(r"(\d+)", s)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m and "view" in s else 0

def fmt(n):
    if n >= 10**8: return f"{n/10**8:.1f}억"
    if n >= 10**5: return f"{round(n/10**4):,}만"
    if n >= 10**4: return f"{n/10**4:.1f}만"
    return f"{n:,}"

def delta_tag(cur, avg):
    if avg is None or avg == 0: return ""
    r = cur / avg
    if r >= 1.5: return f" 🔥(7일평균 {avg:.0f} 대비 +{(r-1)*100:.0f}%)"
    if r >= 1.15: return f" ▲(7일평균 {avg:.0f})"
    if r <= 0.7: return f" ▼(7일평균 {avg:.0f})"
    return f" (7일평균 {avg:.0f})"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1) YouTube (해외 앵커: gl=US)
def yt_search(query, sp):
    r = requests.get("https://www.youtube.com/results",
                     params={"search_query": query, "sp": sp, "gl": "US", "hl": "en"},
                     headers={"User-Agent": UA, "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9"}, timeout=25)
    h = r.text
    vids, seen = [], set()
    for chunk in h.split('"videoRenderer":')[1:]:
        chunk = chunk[:3000]
        vid = re.search(r'"videoId":"([^"]+)"', chunk)
        title = re.search(r'"title":\{"runs":\[\{"text":"(.*?)"\}', chunk)
        vc = re.search(r'"viewCountText":\{"simpleText":"([^"]+)"', chunk)
        pub = re.search(r'"publishedTimeText":\{"simpleText":"([^"]+)"', chunk)
        if vid and vid.group(1) not in seen:
            seen.add(vid.group(1))
            t = title.group(1) if title else ""
            try:
                t = json.loads(f'"{t}"')
            except Exception:
                pass
            vids.append({"id": vid.group(1), "title": t[:80],
                         "views": views_int(vc.group(1) if vc else ""),
                         "pub": pub.group(1) if pub else ""})
    return vids

def fetch_youtube():
    out = {}
    try:
        g = yt_search("buldak", "EgIIAg==")          # 오늘 업로드
        out["global"] = {"n": len(g), "views": sum(v["views"] for v in g),
                         "top": max(g, key=lambda v: v["views"]) if g else None}
    except Exception as e:
        out["global"] = None; print("[yt-global]", repr(e))
    time.sleep(1.5)
    try:
        s = yt_search("buldak", "EgQIAhgB")          # 오늘 + 4분 미만(쇼츠)
        out["shorts"] = {"n": len(s), "views": sum(v["views"] for v in s)}
    except Exception as e:
        out["shorts"] = None; print("[yt-shorts]", repr(e))
    return out

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2) Google Trends
def fetch_trends():
    try:
        from pytrends.request import TrendReq
        pt = TrendReq(hl="en-US", tz=540, timeout=(10, 25))
        pt.build_payload(["buldak"], timeframe="today 3-m")
        df = pt.interest_over_time()
        if not len(df):
            return None
        vals = df["buldak"].tolist()
        dates = [d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") for d in df.index]
        cur = vals[-2] if len(vals) >= 2 else vals[-1]      # 마지막 행=당일 부분집계
        cur_date = dates[-2] if len(vals) >= 2 else dates[-1]
        prev7 = vals[-9:-2] if len(vals) >= 9 else vals[:-2]
        out = {"cur": int(cur), "cur_date": cur_date,
               "avg7": round(sum(prev7) / len(prev7), 1) if prev7 else None,
               "max3m": int(max(vals)), "max_date": dates[vals.index(max(vals))],
               "regions": None, "kr_rank": None, "n_countries": None}
        try:
            time.sleep(1.5)
            rg = pt.interest_by_region(resolution="COUNTRY", inc_low_vol=True)
            rg = rg[rg["buldak"] > 0].sort_values("buldak", ascending=False)
            out["n_countries"] = len(rg)
            out["regions"] = [(idx, int(v)) for idx, v in rg["buldak"].head(6).items()]
            if "South Korea" in rg.index:
                out["kr_rank"] = list(rg.index).index("South Korea") + 1
        except Exception as e:
            print("[trends-region]", repr(e)[:100])
        return out
    except Exception as e:
        print("[trends]", repr(e)[:120])
        return None

                rv = re.search(r"([\d,\.]{2,})\s*ratings", b) or \
                     re.search(r'a-icon-star-small.*?<span[^>]*class="a-size-small"[^>]*>([\d,\.]+)</span>', b, re.S)
                if am and tm:
                    cache[am.group(1)] = hm.unescape(tm.group(1)).strip()
                    if BRAND_RE.search(tm.group(1)):
                        rows.append({"mkt": mkt, "flag": flag, "cat": cat, "asin": am.group(1),
                                     "rank": rank_of.get(am.group(1), 0),
                                     "title": cache[am.group(1)][:70],
                                     "reviews": int(re.sub(r"[,\.]", "", rv.group(1))) if rv else None})
            listed = {(r0["mkt"], r0["asin"]) for r0 in rows}
            for asin, rank in rank_of.items():
                if (mkt, asin) not in listed and BRAND_RE.search(cache.get(asin, "")):
                    rows.append({"mkt": mkt, "flag": flag, "cat": cat, "asin": asin, "rank": rank,
                                 "title": cache.get(asin, "")[:70], "reviews": None})
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[amzn-{mkt}-{cat}]", repr(e)[:120])
        time.sleep(2.5)
    json.dump(cache, open(cache_p, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=0)
    rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x["mkt"], x["cat"], x["rank"] or 99))
    return rows

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 히스토리
def load_hist():
    return json.load(open(HIST_PATH, encoding="utf-8")) if os.path.exists(HIST_PATH) else {}

def save_hist(hist):
    cutoff = (dt.date.today() - dt.timedelta(days=120)).isoformat()
    json.dump({d: v for d, v in hist.items() if d >= cutoff},
              open(HIST_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False)

def avg7(hist, today, getter):
    vals = []
    for d in sorted(hist):
        if d < today:
            v = getter(hist[d])
            if v is not None:
                vals.append(v)
    vals = vals[-7:]
    return sum(vals) / len(vals) if vals else None

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 리포트
def build_message(today, yt, tr, az, hist):
    L = ["🌶 불닭볶음면 해외 트렌드 (삼양식품 003230)", f"기준일: {today}", ""]
    notes = []

    # YouTube
    L.append("📺 YouTube 'buldak' 신규 업로드(24h, 글로벌):")
    if yt.get("global"):
        g = yt["global"]
        a = avg7(hist, today, lambda d: (d.get("yt") or {}).get("global", {}).get("n") if (d.get("yt") or {}).get("global") else None)
        L.append(f"- 영상 {g['n']}{'+' if g['n'] >= 20 else ''}개{delta_tag(g['n'], a)} · 조회수 합계 {fmt(g['views'])}")
        if g["top"] and g["top"]["views"] >= 10000:
            L.append(f"  🔥 최고: \"{g['top']['title'][:45]}…\" {fmt(g['top']['views'])}회 ({g['top']['pub']})")
            notes.append(f"업로드 당일 {fmt(g['top']['views'])}회 영상 등장 — 바이럴 체크")
        if a and g["n"] >= a * 1.5:
            notes.append(f"유튜브 신규영상 급증 ({g['n']}개 vs 7일평균 {a:.0f}개)")
    if yt.get("shorts"):
        s = yt["shorts"]
        L.append(f"- 쇼츠(4분 미만) {s['n']}{'+' if s['n'] >= 20 else ''}개 · {fmt(s['views'])}회")
    L.append("")

    # Google Trends
    L.append("🔍 Google 검색관심도 'buldak':")
    if tr:
        line = f"- 글로벌 {tr['cur']} ({tr['cur_date']})"
        if tr["avg7"]:
            line += delta_tag(tr["cur"], tr["avg7"])
        L.append(line)
        L.append(f"- 3개월 최고 {tr['max3m']} ({tr['max_date']})")
        if tr.get("regions"):
            tops = " · ".join(f"{FLAG.get(n, '')}{n} {v}" for n, v in tr["regions"])
            L.append(f"- 국가별 TOP(검색비중): {tops}")
        if tr.get("kr_rank"):
            L.append(f"- 🇰🇷 한국 {tr['kr_rank']}위/{tr['n_countries']}개국 → 사실상 전부 해외 수요")
        if tr["cur"] >= tr["max3m"] * 0.95:
            notes.append(f"검색관심도 3개월 최고권 ({tr['cur']}/{tr['max3m']})")
    else:
        L.append("- (금일 수집 실패 — 내일 재시도)")
    L.append("")

    # Amazon 4개국
    L.append("🛒 Amazon 면류 베스트셀러 내 삼양·불닭:")
    yrows = {}
    ydates = sorted(d for d in hist if d < today)
    if ydates:
        for r0 in hist[ydates[-1]].get("amazon", []):
            yrows[(r0.get("mkt", "US"), r0["cat"], r0["asin"])] = r0
    if az:
        seen_line = []
        for flag, mkt, dom, cat, path, al in AMZN_MKTS:
            sub = [r0 for r0 in az if r0["mkt"] == mkt and r0["cat"] == cat]
            if not sub:
                continue
            parts = []
            for r0 in sub:
                y = yrows.get((mkt, cat, r0["asin"]))
                d = (y["rank"] - r0["rank"]) if (y and y.get("rank") and r0["rank"]) else None
                arrow = "✨" if (y is None and ydates) else ("→" if d == 0 else (f"▲{d}" if d and d > 0 else (f"▼{-d}" if d else "")))
                rv = ""
                if r0["reviews"] is not None:
                    dr = (r0["reviews"] - y["reviews"]) if (y and y.get("reviews") is not None) else None
                    rv = f" 리뷰{r0['reviews']:,}" + (f"(+{dr:,})" if dr and dr > 0 else "")
                    if dr and dr >= 50:
                        notes.append(f"{flag}{cat} #{r0['rank']} 리뷰 하루 +{dr}개 급증")
                parts.append(f"#{r0['rank']}{arrow}{rv}")
                if r0["rank"] and y and y.get("rank") and (y["rank"] - r0["rank"]) >= 3:
                    notes.append(f"{flag}Amazon {cat} 순위 급상승 #{y['rank']}→#{r0['rank']}")
            label = f"{flag} {cat}" if mkt != "US" else f"{flag} {cat}"
            L.append(f"- {label}: " + " · ".join(parts) + f" ({len(sub)}개)")
            seen_line.append(mkt)
        # 4개국 커버리지 요약
        n_mkt = len(set(r0["mkt"] for r0 in az))
        n_prod = len(az)
        L.append(f"→ {n_mkt}개국 합계 {n_prod}개 제품 차트인")
    else:
        L.append("- (금일 수집 실패)")
    L.append("")

    L.append("👀 특이점:")
    if notes:
        for n in notes[:5]:
            L.append(f"- {n}")
    else:
        L.append("- 특이 변동 없음")
    return "\n".join(L)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 텔레그램/메인
def load_config():
    p = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "config.json")
    return json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8")) if os.path.exists(p) else {}

def send_telegram(text, cfg):
    tok = cfg.get("bot_token")
    chat = cfg.get("chat_id_buldak") or cfg.get("chat_id")
    if not tok or not chat:
        print("[telegram] config 없음 → 스킵"); return
    r = requests.post(f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{tok}/sendMessage",
                      data={"chat_id": chat, "text": text, "disable_web_page_preview": "true"}, timeout=20)
    print("[telegram]", r.status_code, r.text[:100])

def run(do_send):
    today = dt.date.today().isoformat()
    yt = fetch_youtube()
    tr = fetch_trends()
    az = fetch_amazon()
    hist = load_hist()
    msg = build_message(today, yt, tr, az, hist)
    print(msg)
    hist[today] = {"yt": yt, "trends": {k: v for k, v in (tr or {}).items() if k != "regions"} if tr else None,
                   "amazon": az}
    save_hist(hist)
    if do_send:
        send_telegram(msg, load_config())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--send", action="store_true")
    run(ap.parse_args().send)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
K-Pop Spotify Monthly Listeners 트래커 (소비재 봇 - 음악)
- 4대 소속사(HYBE/YG/SM/JYP) 아티스트의 Spotify 월간청취자(ML)를 조회.
- 소속사별 ML 합계 / ML 1위 / 특이점(일간·주간 급변동)을 텔레그램 발송.
- 데이터: musicmetricsvault.com (아티스트별, Spotify ID 키, 정확 ML + 일별 시계열 임베드).

사용:
  py spotify_kpop.py            # 수집·저장·콘솔출력
  py spotify_kpop.py --send     # + 텔레그램 발송 (config.json)
"""
import sys, os, re, json, time, datetime as dt, argparse, unicodedata
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import requests

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
BASE_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "data")
os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)

MMV = "https://www.musicmetricsvault.com/artists/x/{id}"
UA = ("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
      "(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36")
WORKERS = 6

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 숫자 포맷(억/만)
def kor(n):
    n = int(round(n))
    eok, man = n // 10**8, round((n % 10**8) / 10**4)
    if eok and man:
        return f"{eok}억 {man:,}만"
    return f"{eok}억" if eok else f"{man:,}만"

def kor_d(n):
    return f"{'+' if n >= 0 else ''}{round(n / 10**4, 1)}만"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- MMV 수집
def fetch_mmv(aid, tries=3):
    """반환: {ml, daily, weekly, asof} 또는 None."""
    for i in range(tries):
        try:
            r = requests.get(MMV.format(id=aid), headers={"User-Agent": UA, "Accept": "text/html"}, timeout=20)
            if r.status_code != 200:
                return None
            series = None
            for arg in re.findall(r"JSON\.parse\('(.*?)'\)", r.text, re.S):
                dec = arg.encode().decode("unicode_escape")
                if '"listeners"' in dec:
                    try:
                        series = json.loads(dec)
                        break
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            series = sorted((p for p in (series or []) if isinstance(p.get("listeners"), int)), key=lambda p: p["date"])
            if series:
                cur = series[-1]["listeners"]
                daily = cur - series[-2]["listeners"] if len(series) >= 2 else None
                weekly = cur - series[-8]["listeners"] if len(series) >= 8 else None
                return {"ml": cur, "daily": daily, "weekly": weekly, "asof": series[-1]["date"], "exact": True}
            # 폴백: meta 설명의 반올림 ML ("41.3 million monthly listeners")
            m = re.search(r'([\d\.]+)\s*(million|thousand|billion)\s*monthly listeners', r.text, re.I)
            if m:
                mult = {"billion": 10**9, "million": 10**6, "thousand": 10**3}[m.group(2).lower()]
                return {"ml": int(float(m.group(1)) * mult), "daily": None, "weekly": None,
                        "asof": None, "exact": False}
            return None
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(2 + i * 2)
    return None

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 로스터/집계
def load_roster():
    with open(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "roster.json"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)["labels"]

def prior_snapshot(today):
    """가장 최근 과거 스냅샷 {id: ml} (전일 대비 계산용)."""
    p = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "kpop_ml.json")
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return {}
    hist = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
    past = sorted(d for d in hist if d < today)
    return hist[past[-1]] if past else {}

def build(roster, today):
    # (label, artist) 평탄화 → id 병렬 조회
    pairs = [(label, a) for label, arts in roster.items() for a in arts]
    ids = [a.get("id") for _, a in pairs]
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
        results = list(ex.map(lambda i: fetch_mmv(i) if i else None, ids))

    prior = prior_snapshot(today)
    labels, all_a, unresolved = {}, [], []
    for (label, a), data in zip(pairs, results):
        labels.setdefault(label, {"rows": [], "sum": 0, "count": 0})
        if not data:
            unresolved.append(f"{label}:{a['name']}")
            continue
        aid = a.get("id")
        daily = data["daily"]
        if daily is None and aid in prior:   # 차트 없으면 내 전일 스냅샷으로 보정
            daily = data["ml"] - prior[aid]
        rec = {"name": a["name"], "type": a.get("type", "group"), "ml": data["ml"],
               "daily": daily if daily is not None else 0, "weekly": data["weekly"],
               "asof": data["asof"], "exact": data["exact"], "id": aid}
        labels[label]["rows"].append(rec)
        all_a.append((label, rec))
    for L in labels.values():
        L["rows"].sort(key=lambda r: -r["ml"])
        L["sum"] = sum(r["ml"] for r in L["rows"])
        L["count"] = len(L["rows"])
    order = sorted(labels, key=lambda L: -labels[L]["sum"])
    overall = max(all_a, key=lambda x: x[1]["ml"]) if all_a else None
    return {"labels": labels, "order": order, "all": all_a, "overall": overall, "unresolved": unresolved}

def anomalies(rep):
    out, all_a = [], rep["all"]
    if not all_a:
        return out
    ol_label, ol = rep["overall"]
    top_group = max((x for x in all_a if x[1]["type"] == "group"), key=lambda x: x[1]["ml"], default=None)
    if ol["type"] == "solo" and top_group:
        out.append(f"👑 {ol['name']} 솔로가 전체 ML 1위 — 최고 그룹 {top_group[1]['name']}({kor(top_group[1]['ml'])}) 상회")
    else:
        out.append(f"👑 전체 ML 1위: {ol['name']} ({ol_label}) {kor(ol['ml'])}")
    risers = sorted((x for x in all_a if x[1]["daily"] > 0), key=lambda x: -x[1]["daily"])[:3]
    if risers:
        out.append("📈 일간 급상승: " + ", ".join(f"{r['name']} {kor_d(r['daily'])}({L})" for L, r in risers))
    fallers = sorted((x for x in all_a if x[1]["daily"] < 0), key=lambda x: x[1]["daily"])[:2]
    if fallers:
        out.append("📉 일간 급락: " + ", ".join(f"{r['name']} {kor_d(r['daily'])}({L})" for L, r in fallers))
    wk = sorted((x for x in all_a if x[1]["weekly"]), key=lambda x: -x[1]["weekly"])[:2]
    if wk and wk[0][1]["weekly"] > 0:
        out.append("📅 주간 상승: " + ", ".join(f"{r['name']} {kor_d(r['weekly'])}({L})" for L, r in wk if r["weekly"] > 0))
    for L in rep["order"]:
        solos = [r for r in rep["labels"][L]["rows"] if r["type"] == "solo" and r["ml"] >= 10**7]
        if len(solos) >= 2:
            out.append(f"💫 {L} 솔로 1000만+: " + ", ".join(f"{r['name']}({kor(r['ml'])})" for r in solos))
    return out

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 포맷
def format_message(rep, today):
    total = sum(v["count"] for v in rep["labels"].values())
    L = ["🎧 K-Pop Spotify Monthly Listeners", f"기준일: {today} · 총 {total}팀 (정확값)", ""]
    L.append("📊 소속사별 ML 합계:")
    for i, lab in enumerate(rep["order"], 1):
        v = rep["labels"][lab]
        L.append(f"{i}. {lab}: {kor(v['sum'])} ({v['count']}팀)")
    L.append("")
    L.append("🏆 소속사별 ML 1위:")
    ol_label = rep["overall"][0] if rep["overall"] else None
    for lab in rep["order"]:
        rows = rep["labels"][lab]["rows"]
        if rows:
            t = rows[0]
            tag = " (전체 1위!!)" if lab == ol_label else ""
            L.append(f"- {lab}: {t['name']} {kor(t['ml'])}{tag}")
    L += ["", "👀 특이점:"]
    for a in anomalies(rep):
        L.append(f"- {a}")
    if rep["unresolved"]:
        L += ["", f"❓ 미집계({len(rep['unresolved'])}팀): " + ", ".join(rep["unresolved"])]
    return "\n".join(L)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 히스토리/텔레그램
def save_snapshot(today, rep):
    p = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "kpop_ml.json")
    hist = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8")) if os.path.exists(p) else {}
    hist[today] = {r["id"]: r["ml"] for _, r in rep["all"]}
    cutoff = (dt.date.today() - dt.timedelta(days=90)).isoformat()
    hist = {d: v for d, v in hist.items() if d >= cutoff}
    json.dump(hist, open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False)

def load_config():
    p = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "config.json")
    return json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8")) if os.path.exists(p) else {}

def send_telegram(text, cfg):
    tok, chat = cfg.get("bot_token"), cfg.get("chat_id_kpop") or cfg.get("chat_id")
    if not tok or not chat:
        print("[telegram] config.json 없음 → 발송 스킵")
        return
    for attempt in range(3):   # 일시 네트워크 오류 3회 재시도(2026-08-25)
        try:
            r = requests.post(f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{tok}/sendMessage",
                              data={"chat_id": chat, "text": text, "disable_web_page_preview": "true"},
                              timeout=20)
            break
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            if attempt == 2:
                print("[telegram] 전송 실패(3회 소진):", e)
                return
            time.sleep(5 * (attempt + 1))
    print("[telegram]", r.status_code, r.text[:120])

def run(do_send):
    roster = load_roster()
    today = dt.date.today().isoformat()
    rep = build(roster, today)
    msg = format_message(rep, today)
    print(msg)
    save_snapshot(today, rep)
    if do_send:
        send_telegram(msg, load_config())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--send", action="store_true")
    run(ap.parse_args().send)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
raw_sector.json -> sector-report.html + stocks/{code}.json·-trading·-investor + stocks/stock-detail.html
키움 데이터만으로 산업별(27업종) 등락 리포트 생성. 컨센서스/추정/세그먼트는 키움에 없어 비움(프론트 자동 생략).
"""
import sys, io, os, json, time
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
STOCKS_SUBDIR = "stocks"                       # 상세 페이지/JSON 하위폴더 (NXT는 stocks_nxt)
STOCKS = os.path.join(HERE, STOCKS_SUBDIR)     # main()에서 변형별로 재설정
LIQ_FLOOR = 10 * 1e8   # 급등락주 거래대금 하한 10억

# ---------- 지표 계산 ----------

def pct(a, b):
    if not b:
        return None
    return round((a - b) / b * 100, 2)


def chg_n(days, n):
    """days: 최신순. n거래일 전 대비 등락률(%)."""
    if len(days) <= n:
        return None
    c0, cn = days[0]["close"], days[n]["close"]
    return pct(c0, cn)


def build_stock(code, uni, days, basic):
    close = days[0]["close"]
    mktcap = uni["listCount"] * close
    b = basic.get(code) or {}
    return {
        "code": code, "name": uni["name"], "market": uni["market"],
        "sector": uni["sector"], "close": close, "mktcap": mktcap,
        "chg_1d": chg_n(days, 1), "chg_5d": chg_n(days, 5), "chg_10d": chg_n(days, 10),
        "val": days[0]["val"],  # 백만원
        "per": b.get("per"), "pbr": b.get("pbr"), "roe": b.get("roe"),
    }


# ---------- 종목별 JSON (상세 페이지용) ----------

def write_detail_json(code, st, uni, days, basic):
    # trading.json (옛->새), value는 KRW
    series = [{"date": d["dt"], "close": d["close"], "value": d["val"] * 1_000_000}
              for d in reversed(days) if d.get("dt")]
    with open(os.path.join(STOCKS, f"{code}-trading.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"code": code, "series": series, "updated": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")},
                  f, ensure_ascii=False)

    # investor.json: 외국인/기관/개인 누적 순매수(KRW) + 종가
    def dot(dt):
        return f"{dt[:4]}.{dt[4:6]}.{dt[6:8]}" if dt and len(dt) == 8 else dt
    rev = [d for d in reversed(days) if d.get("dt")]
    cum = {"frgnr_invsr": 0, "orgn": 0, "ind_invsr": 0}
    fo, ins, ind, closes = [], [], [], []
    for d in rev:
        date = dot(d["dt"])
        for k, lst in (("frgnr_invsr", fo), ("orgn", ins), ("ind_invsr", ind)):
            v = d.get(k, 0) * 1_000_000
            cum[k] += v
            lst.append({"date": date, "value": v, "accumulatedValue": cum[k]})
        closes.append({"date": date, "value": d["close"]})
    with open(os.path.join(STOCKS, f"{code}-investor.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"code": code, "foreigners": fo, "institutions": ins,
                   "individuals": ind, "closes": closes}, f, ensure_ascii=False)

    # main {code}.json — 밸류에이션을 fnguide 형태로, 컨센서스는 비움
    b = basic.get(code) or {}
    fn = {"headline": None}
    if b.get("per") is not None: fn["per"] = f'{b["per"]:.2f}'
    if b.get("pbr") is not None: fn["pbr"] = f'{b["pbr"]:.2f}'
    if b.get("roe") is not None: fn["roe"] = f'{b["roe"]:.1f}'
    if b.get("eps") is not None: fn["eps"] = f'{int(b["eps"]):,}'
    if b.get("bps") is not None: fn["bps"] = f'{int(b["bps"]):,}'
    if b.get("for_rt") is not None: fn["foreign_pct"] = f'{b["for_rt"]:.2f}'
    if b.get("hi250") and b.get("lo250"):
        fn["w52"] = f'{b["hi250"]:,} / {b["lo250"]:,}'
    main = {
        "code": code,
        "estimate": {"header": {"item_kor_nm": uni["name"]}, "periods": []},
        "analysts": {"summary": {"total_reports": 0, "unique_brokers": 0,
                                 "avg_target": None, "max_target": None, "min_target": None},
                     "by_broker": []},
        "naver": {"overview": None},
        "fnguide": fn,
        "consensus_trend": {},
    }
    with open(os.path.join(STOCKS, f"{code}.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(main, f, ensure_ascii=False)


# ---------- HTML 조립 ----------

def fmt_mktcap(m):
    if m >= 1e12: return f"{m/1e12:.1f}조"
    if m > 0:     return f"{round(m/1e8)}억"
    return "-"


def color(v):
    if v is None: return "var(--dim)"
    return "var(--up)" if v >= 0 else "var(--dn)"


def chg_str(v):
    if v is None: return "-"
    return ("+" if v > 0 else "") + f"{v}%"


def sector_table(sectors, key, tid_prefix):
    """sectors: list of dict(name, chg_1d/5d/10d, up, down, total, top). key: 정렬·표시 등락률 필드."""
    head = ('<thead><tr><th>업종 <span style="font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--dim)">(클릭→종목)</span></th>'
            '<th>등락률</th><th>종목수</th><th>주요 종목</th></tr></thead>')
    rows = []
    for i, s in enumerate(sectors):
        tid = f"{tid_prefix}-{i}"
        v = s[key]
        top = " · ".join(f'{n} {chg_str(c)}' for n, c in s["top"])
        rows.append(
            f'<tr class="theme-row" onclick="toggleStocks(\'{tid}\',\'{s["name"]}\')">'
            f'<td class="theme-name">{s["name"]} <span class="arrow" id="arrow-{tid}">▸</span></td>'
            f'<td class="chg" style="color:{color(v)}">{chg_str(v)}</td>'
            f'<td class="count">{s["total"]} <span style="color:var(--up)">▲{s["up"]}</span> '
            f'<span style="color:var(--dn)">▼{s["down"]}</span></td>'
            f'<td class="top-stocks">{top}</td></tr>'
            f'<tr class="stock-detail"><td colspan="4"><div class="stock-list" id="list-{tid}" '
            f'style="display:none"></div></td></tr>')
    return f'<table>{head}<tbody>{"".join(rows)}</tbody></table>'


def flat_stock_table(stocks, built):
    head = ('<thead><tr><th>#</th><th>종목명</th><th>업종</th><th>시장</th><th>종가</th>'
            '<th>등락률</th><th>시총</th></tr></thead>')
    rows = []
    for i, s in enumerate(stocks):
        name = s["name"]
        if s["code"] in built:
            name = (f'<a href="{STOCKS_SUBDIR}/stock-detail.html?code={s["code"]}" '
                    f'style="color:#7a9fff;text-decoration:none">{s["name"]} ↗</a>')
        rows.append(
            f'<tr><td style="color:var(--dim)">{i+1}</td>'
            f'<td style="font-weight:600">{name}</td>'
            f'<td style="color:var(--dim)">{s["sector"]}</td>'
            f'<td style="color:var(--dim)">{s["market"]}</td>'
            f'<td>{s["close"]:,}</td>'
            f'<td style="color:{color(s["chg_1d"])};font-weight:700">{chg_str(s["chg_1d"])}</td>'
            f'<td style="color:var(--dim)">{fmt_mktcap(s["mktcap"])}</td></tr>')
    return f'<table>{head}<tbody>{"".join(rows)}</tbody></table>'


CSS = """
:root { --bg:#0f1117; --card:#1a1d29; --border:#2a2d3a; --text:#e1e4ea; --dim:#8b8fa3; --up:#27ae60; --dn:#e74c3c; }
* { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
body { font-family:'Pretendard',-apple-system,sans-serif; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); padding:20px; max-width:1400px; margin:0 auto; }
h1 { font-size:1.5rem; margin-bottom:8px; }
.subtitle { color:var(--dim); margin-bottom:24px; }
.section { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px; padding:20px; margin-bottom:20px; }
h3 { font-size:1.1rem; margin-bottom:12px; color:#fff; }
table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:0.85rem; }
th { text-align:left; padding:8px 12px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--border); color:var(--dim); font-weight:500; }
td { padding:8px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); }
.theme-name { font-weight:600; }
.chg { font-weight:700; font-size:0.95rem; }
.count { color:var(--dim); font-size:0.8rem; }
.top-stocks { color:var(--dim); font-size:0.8rem; }
.market-tag { color:var(--dim); font-size:0.8rem; }
.grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:20px; }
@media(max-width:768px) { .grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
.summary { display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:20px; }
.stat-card { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; padding:16px 20px; flex:1; min-width:150px; }
.stat-card .label { color:var(--dim); font-size:0.75rem; }
.stat-card .value { font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:700; margin-top:4px; }
.theme-row { cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.15s; }
.theme-row:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
.arrow { font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--dim); transition:transform 0.2s; display:inline-block; }
.arrow.open { transform:rotate(90deg); }
.stock-detail td { padding:0; border-bottom:none; }
.stock-list { background:#12141d; border-radius:8px; margin:4px 8px 12px; padding:12px; max-height:400px; overflow-y:auto; }
.stock-list table { font-size:0.8rem; }
.stock-list th { padding:6px 10px; font-size:0.75rem; }
.stock-list td { padding:5px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #1e2030; }
.stock-list tr:last-child td { border-bottom:none; }
tr.stock-row { cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.12s; }
tr.stock-row:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }
tr.stock-row.open td:first-child { border-left:2px solid #5c8aff; padding-left:8px; }
tr.stock-info td { padding:0 !important; border-bottom:1px solid #1e2030 !important; }
.stock-info-box { background:#0d1018; border-radius:6px; margin:4px 8px 8px; padding:10px 14px; font-size:0.78rem; line-height:1.45; }
.stock-info-box .row1 { display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:6px; }
.stock-info-box .pill { display:inline-block; background:#1c2030; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:10px; color:#cdd2e0; }
.stock-info-box .pill.up { color:#27ae60; } .stock-info-box .pill.dn { color:#e74c3c; } .stock-info-box .pill.dim { color:var(--dim); }
.stock-info-box a { color:#7a9fff; text-decoration:none; } .stock-info-box a:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
footer { color:var(--dim); font-size:0.72rem; text-align:center; margin-top:10px; }
"""

JS = """
function toggleStocks(tid, themeName) {
  const list = document.getElementById('list-' + tid);
  const arrow = document.getElementById('arrow-' + tid);
  if (list.style.display === 'none') {
    if (list.innerHTML === '') {
      const stocks = THEME_DATA[themeName] || [];
      let h = '<table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>종목명</th><th>시장</th><th>종가</th><th>1D</th><th>5D</th><th>10D</th><th>시총</th><th>PER</th><th>PBR</th><th>ROE</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
      stocks.forEach((s, i) => {
        const c1 = s.chg_1d>=0?'var(--up)':'var(--dn)', c5 = s.chg_5d>=0?'var(--up)':'var(--dn)', c10 = s.chg_10d>=0?'var(--up)':'var(--dn)';
        const sg = v => v==null?'-':((v>0?'+':'')+v+'%');
        const mc = s.mktcap>=1e12?(s.mktcap/1e12).toFixed(1)+'조':(s.mktcap>0?Math.round(s.mktcap/1e8)+'억':'-');
        const num = v => v==null?'-':v;
        const rowId = tid + '-r' + i;
        h += `<tr class="stock-row" id="${rowId}" onclick="toggleStockInfo('${rowId}','${themeName.replace(/'/g,'&#39;')}',${i})">
          <td style="color:var(--dim)">${i+1}</td>
          <td style="font-weight:600">${s.name}</td>
          <td style="color:var(--dim)">${s.market}</td>
          <td>${s.close?s.close.toLocaleString():'-'}</td>
          <td style="color:${c1};font-weight:600">${sg(s.chg_1d)}</td>
          <td style="color:${c5}">${sg(s.chg_5d)}</td>
          <td style="color:${c10}">${sg(s.chg_10d)}</td>
          <td style="color:var(--dim)">${mc}</td>
          <td>${num(s.per)}</td><td>${num(s.pbr)}</td><td>${num(s.roe)}</td>
        </tr>`;
      });
      h += '</tbody></table>';
      list.innerHTML = h;
    }
    list.style.display = ''; arrow.classList.add('open');
  } else {
    list.style.display = 'none'; arrow.classList.remove('open');
  }
}

function toggleStockInfo(rowId, themeName, idx) {
  const tr = document.getElementById(rowId);
  const next = tr.nextElementSibling;
  if (next && next.classList.contains('stock-info')) { next.remove(); tr.classList.remove('open'); return; }
  const s = (THEME_DATA[themeName] || [])[idx];
  if (!s) return;
  tr.classList.add('open');
  const cols = tr.children.length;
  const naver = s.code ? ('https://finance.naver.com/item/main.naver?code=' + s.code) : '#';
  const v = (lbl, val) => `<span class="pill">${lbl}: <b>${val==null?'-':val}</b></span>`;
  const html = `<tr class="stock-info"><td colspan="${cols}"><div class="stock-info-box">
    <div class="row1">
      ${v('업종', s.sector)} ${v('PER', s.per)} ${v('PBR', s.pbr)} ${v('ROE', s.roe!=null?s.roe+'%':null)}
      <span class="pill dim">${s.code}</span>
      ${s.code && BUILT_CODES.has(s.code) ? `<a href="${STOCKS_DIR}/stock-detail.html?code=${s.code}"><b>📊 상세 ↗</b></a>` : ''}
      ${s.code ? `<a href="${naver}" target="_blank">네이버금융 ↗</a>` : ''}
    </div>
    <div style="color:var(--dim)">컨센서스/추정실적은 키움 API 미제공 — 상세 페이지에서 시세·수급·밸류에이션 차트 제공</div>
  </div></td></tr>`;
  tr.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', html);
}
"""


def build_detail_template():
    src = os.path.join(HERE, "_ref", "orig-stock-detail.html")
    with open(src, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        html = f.read()
    rep = {
        "데이터 출처: KIS Open API (컨센서스/추정실적), 네이버금융, FnGuide 무료영역":
            "데이터 출처: 키움증권 REST API — ka10059(시세·수급) · ka10001(밸류에이션)",
        "출처: KRX MDCSTAT01501 · 매일 18:00 KST 갱신":
            "출처: 키움 ka10059 · 매일 16:30 KST 갱신",
        "출처: butler.works</span>": "출처: 키움 ka10059</span>",
        "투자자별 누적 순매수 금액 (외국인/기관/개인) + 종가(우) · 최근":
            "투자자별 누적 순매수 (외국인/기관/개인) + 종가(우) · 키움 · 최근",
    }
    for a, b in rep.items():
        html = html.replace(a, b)
    # 밸류에이션 섹션에 ROE/EPS/BPS pill 추가
    html = html.replace(
        "  if (fn.pbr)          bits.push(`<span class=\"pill\">PBR <b>${fn.pbr}</b></span>`);",
        "  if (fn.pbr)          bits.push(`<span class=\"pill\">PBR <b>${fn.pbr}</b></span>`);\n"
        "  if (fn.roe)          bits.push(`<span class=\"pill\">ROE <b>${fn.roe}%</b></span>`);\n"
        "  if (fn.eps)          bits.push(`<span class=\"pill\">EPS <b>${fn.eps}</b></span>`);\n"
        "  if (fn.bps)          bits.push(`<span class=\"pill\">BPS <b>${fn.bps}</b></span>`);")
    with open(os.path.join(STOCKS, "stock-detail.html"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(html)


def main():
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--raw", default="raw_sector.json", help="입력 raw 파일명")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="sector-report.html", help="출력 HTML 파일명")
    ap.add_argument("--stocks-subdir", default="stocks", help="상세 페이지/JSON 하위폴더")
    ap.add_argument("--label", default="", help="변형 라벨 (예: 'NXT 통합')")
    ap.add_argument("--source-note", default="", help="기준 설명 (subtitle에 표기)")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    global STOCKS, STOCKS_SUBDIR
    STOCKS_SUBDIR = args.stocks_subdir
    STOCKS = os.path.join(HERE, STOCKS_SUBDIR)

    raw = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, args.raw), encoding="utf-8"))
    uni, series, basic = raw["universe"], raw["series"], raw["basic"]
    built = set(raw["built"])
    base_dt = raw["base_dt"]
    os.makedirs(STOCKS, exist_ok=True)

    # 종목 지표 + 상세 JSON
    stocks = {}
    for code, days in series.items():
        if not days or code not in uni:
            continue
        st = build_stock(code, uni[code], days, basic)
        stocks[code] = st
        if code in built:
            write_detail_json(code, st, uni[code], days, basic)
    build_detail_template()
    print(f"종목 지표 {len(stocks)} / 상세 JSON {len(built)}")

    # 업종 집계
    by_sector = {}
    for st in stocks.values():
        by_sector.setdefault(st["sector"], []).append(st)

    sectors = []
    for name, members in by_sector.items():
        members.sort(key=lambda x: x["mktcap"], reverse=True)
        agg = {"name": name, "total": len(members),
               "up": sum(1 for m in members if (m["chg_1d"] or 0) > 0),
               "down": sum(1 for m in members if (m["chg_1d"] or 0) < 0),
               "top": [(m["name"], m["chg_1d"]) for m in members[:3]]}
        for key in ("chg_1d", "chg_5d", "chg_10d"):
            num = sum(m[key] * m["mktcap"] for m in members if m[key] is not None)
            den = sum(m["mktcap"] for m in members if m[key] is not None)
            agg[key] = round(num / den, 2) if den else None
        sectors.append(agg)

    # THEME_DATA: 업종 -> 종목(시총순)
    theme_data = {name: [{k: m[k] for k in
                          ("code", "name", "market", "sector", "close", "mktcap",
                           "chg_1d", "chg_5d", "chg_10d", "per", "pbr", "roe")}
                         for m in members]
                  for name, members in by_sector.items()}

    rising = sorted([s for s in sectors if (s["chg_1d"] or 0) > 0], key=lambda x: x["chg_1d"], reverse=True)
    falling = sorted([s for s in sectors if (s["chg_1d"] or 0) < 0], key=lambda x: x["chg_1d"])
    by5 = sorted([s for s in sectors if s["chg_5d"] is not None], key=lambda x: x["chg_5d"], reverse=True)
    by10 = sorted([s for s in sectors if s["chg_10d"] is not None], key=lambda x: x["chg_10d"], reverse=True)

    liq = [s for s in stocks.values() if s["val"] * 1e6 >= LIQ_FLOOR and s["chg_1d"] is not None]
    gainers = sorted(liq, key=lambda x: x["chg_1d"], reverse=True)[:30]
    losers = sorted(liq, key=lambda x: x["chg_1d"])[:30]

    n_stocks, n_sectors = len(stocks), len(sectors)
    dt_disp = f"{base_dt[:4]}.{base_dt[4:6]}.{base_dt[6:8]}"
    label_sfx = f" ({args.label})" if args.label else ""
    src_note = f" | {args.source_note}" if args.source_note else ""

    html = [f"""<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ko"><head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>산업별 등락 리포트{label_sfx} | {dt_disp}</title><style>{CSS}</style></head><body>
<h1>📊 산업별 등락 리포트{label_sfx}</h1>
<p class="subtitle">{dt_disp} | 코스피+코스닥 {n_stocks}개 종목 | {n_sectors}개 업종 | 키움 REST API{src_note}</p>
<div class="summary">
  <div class="stat-card"><div class="label">분석 종목</div><div class="value">{n_stocks}개</div></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><div class="label">업종</div><div class="value">{n_sectors}개</div></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><div class="label">상세 페이지</div><div class="value">{len(built)}개</div></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><div class="label">기준일</div><div class="value">{dt_disp}</div></div>
</div>
<div class="grid">
  <div class="section"><h3>🔺 전일 상승 업종</h3>{sector_table(rising, "chg_1d", "rise")}</div>
  <div class="section"><h3>🔻 전일 하락 업종</h3>{sector_table(falling, "chg_1d", "fall")}</div>
  <div class="section"><h3>📈 5거래일 등락 (업종)</h3>{sector_table(by5, "chg_5d", "d5")}</div>
  <div class="section"><h3>📉 10거래일 등락 (업종)</h3>{sector_table(by10, "chg_10d", "d10")}</div>
</div>
<div class="section"><h3>🚀 전일 급등주 TOP30 <span style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--dim)">(거래대금 10억↑)</span></h3>{flat_stock_table(gainers, built)}</div>
<div class="section"><h3>💥 전일 급락주 TOP30 <span style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--dim)">(거래대금 10억↑)</span></h3>{flat_stock_table(losers, built)}</div>
<footer>Generated by 키움 REST API | 업종=KRX 표준분류(ka10099 upName) | 등락률=시총가중 평균 | 생성 {raw["fetched_at"]}</footer>
<script>
const STOCKS_DIR = {json.dumps(STOCKS_SUBDIR)};
const THEME_DATA = {json.dumps(theme_data, ensure_ascii=False)};
const BUILT_CODES = new Set({json.dumps(sorted(built))});
{JS}
</script></body></html>"""]

    out = os.path.join(HERE, args.out)
    with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("".join(html))
    print(f"저장: {out} ({os.path.getsize(out)/1e6:.2f} MB)  업종 {n_sectors} · 급등락 {len(liq)}후보")


if __name__ == "__main__":

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
산업 테마(72개) 버전 — aibot-macmini 원본 sector-report.html과 동일 레이아웃/택소노미.
원본의 종목→테마 매핑(theme_map.json)을 그대로 재사용하고, 시세/등락률은 키움(raw_sector.json)으로 계산.
원본 대비 변경: 종목 인라인 박스에서 '상세' 하이퍼링크 제거, 네이버금융 링크만 유지.
KIS 전용 필드(투자의견/목표주가/상승여력/기업개요)는 키움 미제공이라 PER/PBR/ROE로 대체.

  python build_theme.py [--raw raw_sector.json] [--out sector-report-theme.html] [--label ''] [--source-note '']
"""
import sys, io, os, json, time, argparse
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
MIN_THEME_STOCKS = 3          # '산업 테마'로 집계·랭킹할 최소 구성종목 수 (원본=72개 기준)
CAP_1D = 15                   # 전일 섹션 표시 상한
CAP_N = 10                    # 5/10거래일 섹션 표시 상한
LIQ_FLOOR = 10 * 1e8         # TOP10 종목 거래대금 하한 10억

# ---------- 지표 ----------

def pct(a, b):
    return round((a - b) / b * 100, 2) if b else None


def chg_n(days, n):
    if len(days) <= n:
        return None
    return pct(days[0]["close"], days[n]["close"])


def sg(v, dec=2):
    if v is None:
        return "-"
    return ("+" if v > 0 else "") + f"{v:.{dec}f}%"


def color(v):
    return "#27ae60" if (v is not None and v >= 0) else "#e74c3c"


def fmt_mktcap(m):
    if m >= 1e12:
        return f"{m/1e12:.1f}조"
    return f"{round(m/1e8)}억" if m > 0 else "-"


# ---------- HTML ----------

def theme_section(themes, key, dec, cap, tid_counter):
    """themes: 이미 정렬·필터된 리스트. key=표시 등락률 필드."""
    head = ('<thead><tr><th>테마 <span style="font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--dim)">(클릭→종목)</span></th>'
            '<th>등락률</th><th>종목수</th><th>주요 종목</th></tr></thead>')
    rows = []
    for s in themes[:cap]:
        tid = f"theme-{tid_counter[0]}"
        tid_counter[0] += 1
        v = s[key]
        top = ", ".join(f'{n}({sg(c,1)})' for n, c in s["top"])
        rows.append(
            f'<tr class="theme-row" onclick="toggleStocks(\'{tid}\', \'{s["name"].replace(chr(39), "&#39;")}\')">'
            f'<td class="theme-name">{s["name"]} <span class="arrow" id="arrow-{tid}">▸</span></td>'
            f'<td class="chg" style="color:{color(v)}">{sg(v,dec)}</td>'
            f'<td class="count">{s["total"]}개 (↑{s["up"]} ↓{s["down"]})</td>'
            f'<td class="top-stocks">{top}</td></tr>'
            f'<tr class="stock-detail" id="{tid}" style="display:none">'
            f'<td colspan="4"><div class="stock-list" id="list-{tid}"></div></td></tr>')
    return f'<table>{head}<tbody>{"".join(rows)}</tbody></table>'


def top_stock_table(stocks):
    head = ('<thead><tr><th>#</th><th>종목명</th><th>테마</th><th>시장</th><th>종가</th>'
            '<th>등락률</th><th>시총</th></tr></thead>')
    rows = []
    for i, s in enumerate(stocks):
        naver = f'https://finance.naver.com/item/main.naver?code={s["code"]}'
        rows.append(
            f'<tr><td style="color:var(--dim)">{i+1}</td>'
            f'<td class="nm"><a href="{naver}" target="_blank" '
            f'style="color:#e1e4ea;text-decoration:none">{s["name"]}</a></td>'
            f'<td style="color:var(--dim)">{s["theme"]}</td>'
            f'<td style="color:var(--dim)">{s["market"]}</td>'
            f'<td>{s["close"]:,}</td>'
            f'<td style="color:{color(s["chg_1d"])};font-weight:700">{sg(s["chg_1d"],2)}</td>'
            f'<td style="color:var(--dim)">{fmt_mktcap(s["mktcap"])}</td></tr>')
    return f'<table>{head}<tbody>{"".join(rows)}</tbody></table>'


CSS = """
:root { --bg: #0f1117; --card: #1a1d29; --border: #2a2d3a; --text: #e1e4ea; --dim: #8b8fa3; --up: #27ae60; --dn: #e74c3c; }
* { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
body { font-family:'Pretendard',-apple-system,sans-serif; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); padding:20px; max-width:1400px; margin:0 auto; }
h1 { font-size:1.5rem; margin-bottom:8px; }
.subtitle { color:var(--dim); margin-bottom:24px; }
.section { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px; padding:20px; margin-bottom:20px; }
h3 { font-size:1.1rem; margin-bottom:12px; color:#fff; }
table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:0.85rem; }
th { text-align:left; padding:8px 12px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--border); color:var(--dim); font-weight:500; }
td { padding:8px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); }
.theme-name { font-weight:600; }
.chg { font-weight:700; font-size:0.95rem; }
.count { color:var(--dim); font-size:0.8rem; }
.top-stocks { color:var(--dim); font-size:0.8rem; }
.market-tag { color:var(--dim); font-size:0.8rem; }
.grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:20px; }
@media(max-width:768px) { .grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
.summary { display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:20px; }
.stat-card { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; padding:16px 20px; flex:1; min-width:150px; }
.stat-card .label { color:var(--dim); font-size:0.75rem; }
.stat-card .value { font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:700; margin-top:4px; }
.theme-row { cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.15s; }
.theme-row:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
.arrow { font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--dim); transition:transform 0.2s; display:inline-block; }
.arrow.open { transform:rotate(90deg); }
.stock-detail td { padding:0; border-bottom:none; }
.stock-list { background:#12141d; border-radius:8px; margin:4px 8px 12px; padding:12px; max-height:400px; overflow-y:auto; }
.stock-list table { font-size:0.8rem; }
.stock-list th { padding:6px 10px; font-size:0.75rem; }
.stock-list td { padding:5px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #1e2030; }
.stock-list tr:last-child td { border-bottom:none; }
.nm { min-width:200px; white-space:nowrap; font-weight:600; }
tr.stock-row { cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.12s; }
tr.stock-row:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }
tr.stock-row.open td:first-child { border-left:2px solid #5c8aff; padding-left:8px; }
tr.stock-info td { padding:0 !important; border-bottom:1px solid #1e2030 !important; }
.stock-info-box { background:#0d1018; border-radius:6px; margin:4px 8px 8px; padding:10px 14px; font-size:0.78rem; line-height:1.45; }
.stock-info-box .row1 { display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:6px; }
.stock-info-box .pill { display:inline-block; background:#1c2030; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:10px; color:#cdd2e0; }
.stock-info-box .pill.up { color:#27ae60; }
.stock-info-box .pill.dn { color:#e74c3c; }
.stock-info-box .pill.dim { color:var(--dim); }
.stock-info-box .nodata { color:var(--dim); font-style:italic; }
.stock-info-box a { color:#7a9fff; text-decoration:none; }
.stock-info-box a:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
footer { color:var(--dim); font-size:0.72rem; text-align:center; margin-top:10px; }
"""

# 원본 toggleStocks 재사용 + 키움필드(PER/PBR/ROE)로 의견/목표가/↑여력 치환.
# toggleStockInfo: 상세 링크 제거, 네이버금융만. 투자의견/목표주가/상승여력/개요 → 업종/PER/PBR/ROE.
JS = """
function toggleStocks(tid, themeName) {
    const row = document.getElementById(tid);
    const arrow = document.getElementById('arrow-' + tid);
    const list = document.getElementById('list-' + tid);
    if (row.style.display === 'none') {
        const stocks = THEME_DATA[themeName] || [];
        if (list.innerHTML === '') {
            let html = '<table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>종목명</th><th>시장</th><th>종가</th><th>1D</th><th>1W</th><th>2W</th><th>시총</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
            stocks.forEach((s, i) => {
                const c1 = s.chg_1d >= 0 ? 'var(--up)' : 'var(--dn)';
                const c5 = s.chg_5d >= 0 ? 'var(--up)' : 'var(--dn)';
                const c10 = s.chg_10d >= 0 ? 'var(--up)' : 'var(--dn)';
                const sg = v => v==null ? '-' : ((v>0?'+':'') + v + '%');
                const mktcap = s.mktcap >= 1e12 ? (s.mktcap/1e12).toFixed(1)+'조' : s.mktcap > 0 ? Math.round(s.mktcap/1e8)+'억' : '-';
                const close = s.close ? s.close.toLocaleString() : '-';
                const rowId = tid + '-r' + i;
                html += `<tr class="stock-row" id="${rowId}" onclick="toggleStockInfo('${rowId}', '${themeName.replace(/'/g,"&#39;")}', ${i})">
                    <td style="color:var(--dim)">${i+1}</td>
                    <td class="nm">${s.name}</td>
                    <td style="color:var(--dim)">${s.market}</td>
                    <td>${close}</td>
                    <td style="color:${c1};font-weight:600">${sg(s.chg_1d)}</td>
                    <td style="color:${c5}">${sg(s.chg_5d)}</td>
                    <td style="color:${c10}">${sg(s.chg_10d)}</td>
                    <td style="color:var(--dim)">${mktcap}</td>
                </tr>`;
            });
            html += '</tbody></table>';
            list.innerHTML = html;
        }
        row.style.display = '';
        arrow.classList.add('open');
    } else {
        row.style.display = 'none';
        arrow.classList.remove('open');
    }
}

function toggleStockInfo(rowId, themeName, idx) {
    const tr = document.getElementById(rowId);
    const next = tr.nextElementSibling;
    if (next && next.classList.contains('stock-info')) {
        next.remove();
        tr.classList.remove('open');
        return;
    }
    const s = (THEME_DATA[themeName] || [])[idx];
    if (!s) return;
    tr.classList.add('open');
    const cols = tr.children.length;
    const naverUrl = s.code ? ('https://finance.naver.com/item/main.naver?code=' + s.code) : '#';
    const v = (lbl, val) => `<span class="pill">${lbl}: <b>${val==null?'-':val}</b></span>`;
    const html = `<tr class="stock-info"><td colspan="${cols}"><div class="stock-info-box">
        <div class="row1">
            ${v('테마', s.theme)}
            ${s.code ? `<span class="pill dim">${s.code}</span>` : ''}
            ${s.code ? `<a href="${naverUrl}" target="_blank">네이버금융 ↗</a>` : ''}
        </div>
        <div class="nodata">투자의견/목표주가/추정실적은 키움 API 미제공 — 네이버금융에서 확인</div>
    </div></td></tr>`;
    tr.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', html);
}
"""


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--raw", default="raw_sector.json")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="sector-report-theme.html")
    ap.add_argument("--close-label", default="KRX", help="기준 종가 라벨 (KRX / NXT). 기준일에 'YYYY. MM.DD. {라벨} 종가'로 표기")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    raw = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, args.raw), encoding="utf-8"))
    uni, series, basic = raw["universe"], raw["series"], raw["basic"]
    base_dt = raw["base_dt"]
    tmap = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "theme_map.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    code2theme = tmap["code2theme"]
    order = tmap["order"]  # 원본 테마 등장 순서

    # 종목 지표
    stocks = {}
    for code, days in series.items():
        if not days or code not in uni:
            continue
        theme = code2theme.get(code)
        if not theme:
            continue  # 원본 매핑에 없는 종목 제외 (원본 택소노미와 동일 유지)
        close = days[0]["close"]
        stocks[code] = {
            "code": code, "name": uni[code]["name"], "market": uni[code]["market"],
            "theme": theme, "close": close, "mktcap": uni[code]["listCount"] * close,
            "chg_1d": chg_n(days, 1), "chg_5d": chg_n(days, 5), "chg_10d": chg_n(days, 10),
            "val": days[0]["val"],
        }

    # 테마 집계
    by_theme = {}
    for st in stocks.values():
        by_theme.setdefault(st["theme"], []).append(st)

    themes = []
    for name, members in by_theme.items():
        if len(members) < MIN_THEME_STOCKS:
            continue  # 산업 테마 = 구성종목 3개 이상 (원본 72개 기준)
        members.sort(key=lambda x: x["mktcap"], reverse=True)
        agg = {"name": name, "total": len(members),
               "up": sum(1 for m in members if (m["chg_1d"] or 0) > 0),
               "down": sum(1 for m in members if (m["chg_1d"] or 0) < 0)}
        for key in ("chg_1d", "chg_5d", "chg_10d"):
            num = sum(m[key] * m["mktcap"] for m in members if m[key] is not None)
            den = sum(m["mktcap"] for m in members if m[key] is not None)
            agg[key] = round(num / den, 2) if den else None
        # 주요 종목: 해당 기간 등락률 상위 3 (섹션별로 top 재계산 위해 1d 기준 기본)
        agg["_members"] = members
        themes.append(agg)

    def with_top(theme_list, key):
        out = []
        for t in theme_list:
            ms = sorted([m for m in t["_members"] if m[key] is not None],
                        key=lambda x: x[key], reverse=True)
            t2 = dict(t)
            t2["top"] = [(m["name"], m[key]) for m in ms[:3]]
            out.append(t2)
        return out

    rise = with_top(sorted([t for t in themes if (t["chg_1d"] or 0) > 0], key=lambda x: x["chg_1d"], reverse=True), "chg_1d")
    fall = with_top(sorted([t for t in themes if (t["chg_1d"] or 0) < 0], key=lambda x: x["chg_1d"]), "chg_1d")
    up5 = with_top(sorted([t for t in themes if t["chg_5d"] is not None and t["chg_5d"] > 0], key=lambda x: x["chg_5d"], reverse=True), "chg_5d")
    dn5 = with_top(sorted([t for t in themes if t["chg_5d"] is not None and t["chg_5d"] < 0], key=lambda x: x["chg_5d"]), "chg_5d")
    up10 = with_top(sorted([t for t in themes if t["chg_10d"] is not None and t["chg_10d"] > 0], key=lambda x: x["chg_10d"], reverse=True), "chg_10d")
    dn10 = with_top(sorted([t for t in themes if t["chg_10d"] is not None and t["chg_10d"] < 0], key=lambda x: x["chg_10d"]), "chg_10d")

    # 개별 종목 TOP10 (거래대금 10억↑)
    liq = [s for s in stocks.values() if s["val"] * 1e6 >= LIQ_FLOOR and s["chg_1d"] is not None]
    g10 = sorted(liq, key=lambda x: x["chg_1d"], reverse=True)[:10]
    l10 = sorted(liq, key=lambda x: x["chg_1d"])[:10]

    # THEME_DATA (테마 -> 종목, 시총순). 원본 등장순서 유지.
    theme_data = {}
    for name in order:
        ms = by_theme.get(name)
        if not ms or len(ms) < MIN_THEME_STOCKS:
            continue
        theme_data[name] = [{k: m[k] for k in
                             ("code", "name", "market", "theme", "close", "mktcap",
                              "chg_1d", "chg_5d", "chg_10d")} for m in ms]

    n_themes = len(theme_data)
    n_stocks = len(stocks)
    dt = f"{base_dt[:4]}. {base_dt[4:6]}.{base_dt[6:8]}."          # 예: 2026. 06.04.
    dt_full = f"{dt} {args.close_label} 종가"                       # 예: 2026. 06.04. KRX 종가
    tc = [1]

    body = f"""<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ko"><head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>산업별 등락 리포트 | {dt_full}</title><style>{CSS}</style></head><body>
<h1>📊 산업별 등락 리포트</h1>
<p class="subtitle">{dt_full} | 코스피+코스닥 {n_stocks}개 종목 | {n_themes}개 산업</p>
<div class="summary">
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="label">분석 종목</div><div class="value">{n_stocks}개</div></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="label">산업 테마</div><div class="value">{n_themes}개</div></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><div class="label">기준일</div><div class="value">{dt_full}</div></div>
</div>
<div class="grid">
    <div class="section"><h3>🔺 기준일 상승 테마</h3>{theme_section(rise, "chg_1d", 1, CAP_1D, tc)}</div>
    <div class="section"><h3>🔻 기준일 하락 테마</h3>{theme_section(fall, "chg_1d", 1, CAP_1D, tc)}</div>
    <div class="section"><h3>📈 1주(1W) 상승 테마</h3>{theme_section(up5, "chg_5d", 1, CAP_N, tc)}</div>
    <div class="section"><h3>📉 1주(1W) 하락 테마</h3>{theme_section(dn5, "chg_5d", 1, CAP_N, tc)}</div>
    <div class="section"><h3>📈 2주(2W) 상승 테마</h3>{theme_section(up10, "chg_10d", 1, CAP_N, tc)}</div>
    <div class="section"><h3>📉 2주(2W) 하락 테마</h3>{theme_section(dn10, "chg_10d", 1, CAP_N, tc)}</div>
</div>
<div class="grid">
    <div class="section"><h3>🚀 전일 상승 TOP 10 <span style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--dim)">(거래대금 10억↑)</span></h3>{top_stock_table(g10)}</div>
    <div class="section"><h3>💥 전일 하락 TOP 10 <span style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--dim)">(거래대금 10억↑)</span></h3>{top_stock_table(l10)}</div>
</div>
<footer>Generated by 키움 REST API | 테마 택소노미=원본 sector-report 매핑(72개 산업) | 등락률=시총가중 평균 | 생성 {raw["fetched_at"]}</footer>
<script>
const THEME_DATA = {json.dumps(theme_data, ensure_ascii=False)};
{JS}
</script></body></html>"""

    out = os.path.join(HERE, args.out)
    with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(body)
    print(f"저장: {out} ({os.path.getsize(out)/1e6:.2f} MB)  산업 {n_themes}개 · 종목 {n_stocks} · "
          f"상승{len(rise)}/하락{len(fall)} 테마(1D)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
키움 REST API로 산업별 등락 리포트용 데이터를 수집해 raw_sector.json 으로 저장.
  ka10099(종목리스트 + upName 업종)  -> 보통주 유니버스 + 업종 태깅
  ka10059(종목별투자자기관별, 100일)  -> 종가/거래대금/투자자순매수 시계열  [전종목]
  ka10001(주식기본정보)               -> PER/PBR/ROE/EPS/BPS/외국인% 등 밸류에이션 [상세대상 종목만]
상세대상(BUILT) = 시총 >= 3000억 OR 당일거래대금 >= 50억.
"""
import sys, io, os, json, time, threading, argparse
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', line_buffering=True)
import requests
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from collections import Counter

HOST = "https://api.kiwoom.com"
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

# ka10059 투자자 순매수 필드(백만원). 외국인/기관계/개인만 필요.
INV_FIELDS = {"frgnr_invsr": "외국인", "orgn": "기관", "ind_invsr": "개인"}

# 상세 페이지 생성 기준(BUILT_CODES)
BUILT_MKTCAP = 3000 * 1e8      # 시총 3000억
BUILT_VALUE  = 50 * 1e8        # 당일 거래대금 50억 (val 백만원 -> *1e6 후 비교)

ETF_TOKENS = ("KODEX","TIGER","KBSTAR","ARIRANG","HANARO","KOSEF","SOL ","ACE ","PLUS ",
              "RISE","TIMEFOLIO","WON ","마이티","FOCUS","파워","TREX","히어로즈","BNK ",
              "KCGI","UNICORN","1Q ","에셋플러스","KIWOOM ")


def get_token():
    from creds import get_credentials
    app, sec = get_credentials()
    r = requests.post(HOST + "/oauth2/token",
        json={"grant_type": "client_credentials", "appkey": app, "secretkey": sec},
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json;charset=UTF-8"}, timeout=20)
    j = r.json()
    if j.get("return_code") != 0:
        raise SystemExit("토큰 발급 실패: " + str(j))
    return j["token"]


def post(token, apiid, body):
    h = {"Content-Type": "application/json;charset=UTF-8", "authorization": "Bearer " + token,
         "cont-yn": "N", "next-key": "", "api-id": apiid}
    return requests.post(HOST + "/api/dostk/stkinfo", json=body, headers=h, timeout=20)


def is_common(rec):
    name, code = rec.get("name", ""), rec.get("code", "")
    if not code or len(code) != 6 or not code.endswith("0"):
        return False
    try:
        if int(rec.get("listCount", "0")) <= 0:
            return False
    except ValueError:
        return False
    if any(t in name for t in ("ETN", "ETF", "스팩", "선물")):
        return False
    if any(t in name for t in ETF_TOKENS):
        return False
    if "거래정지" in rec.get("state", ""):
        return False
    return True


def get_universe(token):
    uni = {}
    for mk, label in [("0", "KOSPI"), ("10", "KOSDAQ")]:
        j = post(token, "ka10099", {"mrkt_tp": mk}).json()
        rows = j.get("list", [])
        kept = 0
        for rec in rows:
            if is_common(rec):
                uni[rec["code"]] = {
                    "name": rec["name"], "market": label,
                    "listCount": int(rec["listCount"]),
                    "sector": (rec.get("upName") or "기타").strip() or "기타",
                    "size": (rec.get("upSizeName") or "").strip(),
                }
                kept += 1
        print(f"  {label}: 전체 {len(rows)} -> 보통주 {kept}")
    return uni


def parse_int(s):
    if s is None: return 0
    s = str(s).strip().replace("+", "")
    if s in ("", "-"): return 0
    try: return int(s)
    except ValueError:
        try: return int(float(s))
        except ValueError: return 0


def parse_num(s):
    """숫자 문자열(부호/콤마 포함) -> float 또는 None."""
    if s is None: return None
    s = str(s).strip().replace(",", "").replace("+", "")
    if s in ("", "-", "N/A"): return None
    try: return float(s)
    except ValueError: return None


def make_session(workers):
    sess = requests.Session()
    ad = requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter(pool_connections=workers * 2, pool_maxsize=workers * 2)
    sess.mount("https://", ad)
    return sess


def scan(codes, worker_fn, workers, label):
    results = {}
    lock = threading.Lock()
    cnt = {"done": 0}
    t0 = time.time()
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as ex:
        for code, val in ex.map(worker_fn, codes):
            with lock:
                cnt["done"] += 1
                if val is not None:
                    results[code] = val
                if cnt["done"] % 500 == 0:
                    print(f"  [{label}] {cnt['done']}/{len(codes)} ... {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
    print(f"  [{label}] 완료 {len(results)}/{len(codes)} ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)")
    return results


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--dt", default=time.strftime("%Y%m%d"))
    ap.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=3)
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="스모크 테스트용: 앞 N종목만")
    ap.add_argument("--suffix", default="", help="ka10059 종목코드 접미사 (''=KRX, '_AL'=통합, '_NX'=NXT단독)")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="raw_sector.json", help="출력 raw 파일명")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    t_start = time.time()
    token = get_token()
    print("토큰 OK. 종목 리스트 수집...")
    uni = get_universe(token)
    codes = list(uni.keys())
    if args.limit:
        codes = codes[:args.limit]
        uni = {c: uni[c] for c in codes}
        print(f"[LIMIT] 앞 {len(codes)}종목만 수집")
    print(f"대상 종목: {len(codes)}개. ka10059 스캔 (dt={args.dt}, workers={args.workers})")

    sess = make_session(args.workers)

    def fetch_series(code):
        body = {"dt": args.dt, "stk_cd": code + args.suffix, "amt_qty_tp": "1", "trde_tp": "0", "unit_tp": "1000"}
        h = {"Content-Type": "application/json;charset=UTF-8", "authorization": "Bearer " + token,
             "cont-yn": "N", "next-key": "", "api-id": "ka10059"}
        backoff = 0.3
        for _ in range(12):
            try:
                r = sess.post(HOST + "/api/dostk/stkinfo", json=body, headers=h, timeout=20)
                if r.status_code == 429:
                    time.sleep(backoff); backoff = min(backoff * 1.4, 2.0); continue
                j = r.json()
                if j.get("return_code") != 0:
                    if "초과" in str(j.get("return_msg", "")):
                        time.sleep(backoff); backoff = min(backoff * 1.4, 2.0); continue
                    return code, None
                rows = j.get("stk_invsr_orgn", [])
                days = []
                for row in rows:
                    d = {"dt": row.get("dt"),
                         "close": abs(parse_int(row.get("cur_prc"))),
                         "val": parse_int(row.get("acc_trde_prica"))}  # 거래대금(백만원)
                    for f in INV_FIELDS:                                # 순매수(백만원)
                        d[f] = parse_int(row.get(f))
                    days.append(d)
                return code, (days or None)
            except Exception:
                time.sleep(backoff); backoff = min(backoff * 1.4, 2.0)
        return code, None

    series = scan(codes, fetch_series, args.workers, "ka10059")

    # 기준일 = 최신 날짜 최빈값
    base_counter = Counter(d[0]["dt"] for d in series.values() if d)
    base_dt = base_counter.most_common(1)[0][0] if base_counter else args.dt

    # BUILT_CODES 선정 (시총/거래대금)
    built = []
    for code, days in series.items():
        if not days:
            continue
        close = days[0]["close"]
        mktcap = uni[code]["listCount"] * close
        val_krw = days[0]["val"] * 1e6
        if mktcap >= BUILT_MKTCAP or val_krw >= BUILT_VALUE:
            built.append(code)
    print(f"상세대상 BUILT_CODES: {len(built)}개. ka10001 밸류에이션 스캔...")

    def fetch_basic(code):
        h = {"Content-Type": "application/json;charset=UTF-8", "authorization": "Bearer " + token,
             "cont-yn": "N", "next-key": "", "api-id": "ka10001"}
        backoff = 0.3
        for _ in range(10):
            try:
                r = sess.post(HOST + "/api/dostk/stkinfo", json={"stk_cd": code}, headers=h, timeout=20)
                if r.status_code == 429:
                    time.sleep(backoff); backoff = min(backoff * 1.4, 2.0); continue
                j = r.json()
                if j.get("return_code") != 0:
                    if "초과" in str(j.get("return_msg", "")):
                        time.sleep(backoff); backoff = min(backoff * 1.4, 2.0); continue
                    return code, None
                return code, {
                    "per": parse_num(j.get("per")), "pbr": parse_num(j.get("pbr")),
                    "roe": parse_num(j.get("roe")), "eps": parse_num(j.get("eps")),
                    "bps": parse_num(j.get("bps")), "for_rt": parse_num(j.get("for_exh_rt")),
                    "hi250": abs(parse_int(j.get("250hgst"))), "lo250": abs(parse_int(j.get("250lwst"))),
                    "sale": parse_int(j.get("sale_amt")), "op": parse_int(j.get("bus_pro")),
                }
            except Exception:
                time.sleep(backoff); backoff = min(backoff * 1.4, 2.0)
        return code, None

    basic = scan(built, fetch_basic, args.workers, "ka10001")

    out = {
        "base_dt": base_dt,
        "fetched_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "universe": uni,
        "series": series,
        "basic": basic,
        "built": built,
        "inv_fields": INV_FIELDS,
        "suffix": args.suffix,
    }
    path = os.path.join(HERE, args.out)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=False)
    print(f"완료: 시세 {len(series)} / 밸류 {len(basic)} / 기준일 {base_dt} / {time.time()-t_start:.0f}s")
    print(f"저장: {path} ({os.path.getsize(path)/1e6:.1f} MB)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""일별 업데이트 오케스트레이터: fetch_sector.py(수집) -> build_sector.py(생성).
작업 스케줄러가 매일 실행. 진행/오류는 update_sector.log 에 기록.

  python update_sector.py            # KRX 종가 기준 (평일 16:00 작업)
  python update_sector.py --variant nxt   # NXT 통합(애프터마켓 20:00 포함) 기준 (평일 20:30 작업)
"""
import os, sys, io, time, subprocess, argparse
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8')

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
LOG = os.path.join(HERE, "update_sector.log")

# 변형별 fetch/build 인자. KRX=기본(접미사 없음), NXT=_AL 통합 시세.
# 빌더는 build_theme.py(산업 테마 72개, 원본 레이아웃·상세링크 없음·네이버만).
BUILDER = "build_theme.py"
VARIANTS = {
    "krx": {
        "fetch": [],
        "build": ["--out", "sector-report.html"],
    },
    "nxt": {
        "fetch": ["--suffix", "_AL", "--out", "raw_sector_nxt.json"],
        "build": ["--raw", "raw_sector_nxt.json", "--out", "sector-report-nxt.html",
                  "--close-label", "NXT"],
    },
}


def log(msg):
    line = f"[{time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}] {msg}"
    print(line)
    with open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


def run(script, extra=None):
    extra = extra or []
    log(f"실행: {script} {' '.join(extra)}".strip())
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(HERE, script), *extra],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    if r.stdout:
        log(script + " stdout:\n" + r.stdout.strip())
    if r.returncode != 0:
        log(f"!! {script} 실패 (rc={r.returncode})\n" + (r.stderr or "").strip())
        raise SystemExit(r.returncode)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--variant", choices=list(VARIANTS), default="krx")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    v = VARIANTS[args.variant]

    log(f"===== 산업별 등락 리포트 업데이트 시작 [{args.variant.upper()}] =====")
    t0 = time.time()
    run("fetch_sector.py", v["fetch"])
    run(BUILDER, v["build"])
    log(f"완료 [{args.variant.upper()}] ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
