/* ───────── 홈: 실시간 시세 카드 + 지수 스트립 ───────── */
.quote-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
@media(max-width:640px){.quote-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.quote-card{background:var(--surface);border-radius:20px;padding:24px 26px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.quote-card .qhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.quote-card .qname{font-size:15px;font-weight:700}
.quote-card .qname small{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--faint)}
.badge-live{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft);
  padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px}
.quote-card .price-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.quote-card .qprice{font-size:36px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.quote-card .qprice small{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;color:var(--faint)}
.quote-card .qchange{font-size:16px;font-weight:700}
.quote-card .qmeta{display:flex;gap:18px;font-size:13px;color:var(--sub);flex-wrap:wrap}
.index-strip{background:var(--surface);border-radius:16px;padding:16px 22px;margin-top:14px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;gap:32px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.index-strip .item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.index-strip .label{font-size:12px;color:var(--faint)}
.index-strip .value{font-size:18px;font-weight:700}
.index-strip .value span{font-size:13px}
.section{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;margin-top:34px}
.section h2{margin:0;font-size:19px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.section h2 small{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--faint)}
.hgroup{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.04em;margin:22px 2px 12px}

/* ───────── 카드 그리드 ───────── */
.grid{display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr))}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:none;border-radius:16px;padding:20px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:box-shadow .15s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.card h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.card p{color:var(--sub);font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;margin:0}
button.card{width:100%;text-align:left;font-family:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
button.card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);transform:none}
.tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--faint);background:var(--bg);
  border:none;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;flex:none;letter-spacing:0}
.tag.soon{color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft)}

.empty{border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:52px 24px;text-align:center;
  color:var(--faint);font-size:13.5px;background:var(--surface)}
.empty b{display:block;font-size:15px;color:var(--sub);margin-bottom:6px}

/* ───────── 텔레그램 피드 ───────── */
.tgwrap{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:flex-start}
.tglist{width:216px;flex:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;
  position:sticky;top:16px;max-height:calc(100vh - 170px);overflow-y:auto}
.tgitem{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 11px;border:none;background:transparent;
  color:var(--sub);font-family:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;border-radius:10px;
  cursor:pointer;text-align:left;transition:.12s;white-space:nowrap}
.tgitem:hover{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--text)}
.tgitem.on{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
.tgitem .tname{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.tgitem .cnt{margin-left:auto;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);font-weight:600;flex:none}
.tgitem.on .cnt{color:var(--accent)}
.tgfeed{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
.post{background:var(--surface);border:none;border-radius:16px;padding:15px 18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.post .ph{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-width:0}
.post .av{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.post .who{min-width:0}
.post .nm{font-weight:700;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.post .hd{color:var(--faint);font-size:11px}
.post .tm{margin-left:auto;color:var(--faint);font-size:11.5px;flex:none;padding-left:8px}
.post .tx{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:13px;line-height:1.62;margin-top:9px}
.post .tx a{color:var(--accent);word-break:break-all}
.post .tx.clamp{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:10;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.post .more,.feedmore{margin-top:7px;background:none;border:none;color:var(--accent);
  font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.feedmore{align-self:center;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:999px;padding:9px 22px}
.feedmore:hover{border-color:var(--accent-line)}
.post .pf{margin-top:8px}
.post .pf a{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);text-decoration:none}
.post .pf a:hover{color:var(--accent)}
@media(max-width:860px){
  .tgwrap{flex-direction:column}
  .tglist{position:static;width:100%;max-height:none;flex-direction:row;
    flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:6px}
  .tgitem{flex:none}
}

/* ───────── 종목 분석 (서브탭 레일) ───────── */
#qtLayout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:196px 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:start}
#qtSubNav{position:sticky;top:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.qtnav{border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 14px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;color:var(--sub);transition:.12s}
.qtnav b{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.qtnav small{display:block;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:2px;font-weight:400}
.qtnav.on{background:var(--hover);border-color:rgba(77,125,245,.4);color:var(--text)}
.qtnav:hover{color:var(--text)}
.qtchip{font-size:12px;color:var(--sub);background:var(--hover);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px}
@media(max-width:900px){#qtLayout{grid-template-columns:1fr}#qtSubNav{position:static;flex-direction:row;overflow-x:auto}.qtnav small{display:none}}

/* ───────── 韓/美 시황 ───────── */
.mwtxt{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:13px;line-height:1.74;color:var(--text)}
.mwtxt .mwhead{display:block;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px}
.mwtxt .mwsec{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.wrapbody{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;max-width:880px}
.wrapsec{background:var(--surface);border:none;border-radius:16px;padding:18px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.wrapsec h3{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.wrapsec ul{margin:11px 0 0 18px;padding:0}
.wrapsec li{font-size:13px;line-height:1.72;margin-bottom:7px;color:var(--text)}
.wrapsec li:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.wrapsec li b{font-weight:700;color:var(--accent)}
.wrapsrc{color:var(--faint);font-size:11.5px;margin-top:2px}
.wrapdiv{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.04em;margin-top:16px}
.wrapday{background:var(--surface);border:none;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
.wrapday summary{padding:13px 20px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--sub);list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;user-select:none}
.wrapday summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.wrapday summary::after{content:'▸';margin-left:auto;color:var(--faint);transition:transform .15s}
.wrapday[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(90deg);color:var(--accent)}
.wrapday summary:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--hover)}
.wrapday[open] summary{color:var(--accent);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.wrapday .inner{padding:4px 20px 16px}
.wrapday .inner .wrapsec{background:transparent;box-shadow:none;border-radius:0;padding:14px 2px 0}
.wrapday .inner .wrapsec+.wrapsec{border-top:1px dashed var(--line);margin-top:14px}
.wrapday .inner .wrapsrc{margin-top:12px}

/* ───────── raoni류 공용 ───────── */
.rngwrap{display:inline-flex;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:3px;gap:2px}
.rng{border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--sub);font-family:inherit;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;
  padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.rng:hover{color:var(--text)}
.rng.on{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.pairwrap{display:flex;gap:8px}
.pair{flex:1;max-width:340px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--sub);
  font-family:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer}
.pair:hover{color:var(--text)}
.pair.on{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent-line);font-weight:700}
.statrow{display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr))}
.stc{background:var(--surface);border:none;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.stc .k{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:4px}
.stc .v{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stc .s{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:3px}
.stc .s.up{color:var(--up)}.stc .s.down{color:var(--down)}
.cbar{width:74px;border-radius:10px 10px 4px 4px;margin:8px auto 0;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
main canvas{display:block;width:100%}
.clegend{font-size:11px;color:var(--sub);margin-top:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.clegend i{display:inline-block;width:12px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:middle}
.gauge{position:relative;height:7px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;margin-top:12px}
.gzero{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-3px;bottom:-3px;width:1.5px;background:var(--faint)}
.gmark{position:absolute;top:-3.5px;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35);border:2px solid var(--surface)}
.brandpill{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#fff;background:var(--accent);
  border-radius:8px;padding:2.5px 9px}
.ddt{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ddt th{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);font-weight:700;text-align:right;padding:7px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}
.ddt th:first-child,.ddt td:first-child{text-align:left}
.ddt td{padding:7px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line2);text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.ddt tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.ddt tr:hover td{background:var(--hover)}
.ddt td.up{color:var(--up)}.ddt td.down{color:var(--down)}
.termgrid{display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr 250px;align-items:start}
.termgrid2{display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));margin-top:12px;align-items:start}
@media(max-width:1100px){.termgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.kvrow{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--sub);margin-top:3px}
.kvrow b{color:var(--text);font-weight:700}
.tlist{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.titem{padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line2)}
.titem:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.ttag{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft);border:none;
  border-radius:6px;padding:2px 6px;margin-right:5px}
.nt{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;line-height:1.5}
.nt:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.nmeta{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:2px}

/* ───────── 실시간 한국주식 (Hyperliquid) ───────── */
.rgrid2{display:grid;gap:14px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(380px,1fr))}
.rcard{background:var(--surface);border:none;border-radius:20px;padding:24px 26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.rtop{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
.rname{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.rtk{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);font-weight:500;margin-top:2px}
.rlinks{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:6px}
.rlink{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--sub);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:999px;padding:5px 11px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
.rlink:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent-line)}
.rprice{font-size:34px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:4px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.rprice .won{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--faint)}
.rkimp{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;margin-left:8px;
  color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft);border:none;vertical-align:middle}
.rchg{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.rchg .lbl{color:var(--faint);font-weight:500;font-size:12px}
.rusd{color:var(--sub);font-size:13px;margin-top:6px}
.rhr{border-top:1px dashed var(--line);margin:18px 0}
.rstats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px 20px}
.rst .k{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:3px}
.rst .v{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.rst .v.pos{color:var(--up)} .rst .v.neg{color:var(--down)}
.rprem{margin-top:18px;font-size:12.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rprem .pv{font-size:15px;font-weight:800}
.rprem .sub{color:var(--faint)}
.up{color:var(--up)} .down{color:var(--down)}

footer{flex:none;padding:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--faint);font-size:12px}

/* ───────── 모바일 ───────── */
@media(max-width:860px){
  #menuBtn{display:inline-flex}
  nav{position:fixed;top:58px;left:0;bottom:0;z-index:40;transform:translateX(-100%);
    transition:transform .2s;box-shadow:4px 0 22px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
  nav.open{transform:none}
  .panel{padding:14px 20px 56px}
  .panel.embed{padding:0}
  .quote-card .qprice{font-size:30px}
}
</style>
<script>
(function(){var t=localStorage.getItem("rl-theme")||"dark";if(t==="dark")document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");})();
</script>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <button class="hbtn" id="menuBtn">☰</button>
  <div class="brand" id="hdrBrand">Research Lab</div>
  <div class="spacer"></div>
  <div class="clock num" id="clock"></div>
  <button class="theme-toggle" id="themeToggle" type="button">라이트 모드</button>
</header>

<div class="layout">

  <!-- ───────── 사이드바 ───────── -->
  <nav id="nav">
    <div class="sbrand"><b>Research Lab</b><span>KRX · 실시간 리서치 데스크</span></div>
    <button class="navitem on" data-tab="home">홈</button>
    <div class="navgroup">실시간</div>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="raoni">실시간 한국주식 <small>5초</small></button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="term">전닉 터미널</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="quote">종목 분석</button>
    <div class="navgroup">시황</div>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="weekly">주간 일정 <small>매주</small></button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="krwrap">韓 시황</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="uswrap">美 시황</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="sector">산업별 등락</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="disparity">50일 이격도</button>
    <div class="navgroup">수급 · 모멘텀</div>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="supply">투자자별 수급/거래량 증감</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="streak">수급 연속 <small>새벽</small></button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="krhigh">韓 신고가 (20·60일·52주)</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="ushigh">美 신고가 (20·60일·52주)</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="rs">RS 분석</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="semietf">반도체 ETF 수혜</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="align">정배열 트래커</button>
    <div class="navgroup">비교 · 밸류</div>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="caps">시총비교</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="basket7">업종 시총비중</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="gap">괴리율</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="etfgap">ETF 괴리율</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="dd">전고대비</button>
    <div class="navgroup">매크로 데이터</div>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="ram">메모리 가격</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="semiexport">반도체/전기전자 수출 추이</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="export">수출 데이터</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="corpexport">기업별 수출</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="trade10">수출입데이터</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="taiwan">대만 테크 실적 모음</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="chem">에너지/화학 가격 동향</button>
    <div class="navgroup">리서치</div>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="telegram">텔레그램 채널 요약</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="taerin">태린이아빠</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="thememap">관련주 신경망 맵</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="deepresearch">심층 리서치</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="leadflow">변동성 로테이션</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="rstime">RS 타임머신</button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="backlog">수주잔고 <small>DART</small></button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="worklog">작업 기록 <small>book</small></button>
    <div class="navgroup">Locked</div>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="rrgsec">수급 로테이션 맵 (업종) <small>🔒</small></button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="rrgstk">수급 로테이션 맵 (종목) <small>🔒</small></button>
    <button class="navitem" data-tab="leaders">주도 섹터 · 주도주 <small>🔒</small></button>
    <button class="archhead" id="archHead" type="button" style="display:none"><span class="arr">▸</span> 보관 <span id="archCnt"></span></button>
    <div class="archlist" id="archList"></div>
    <button class="archmanage" id="archManage" type="button">⚙ 보관 관리</button>
    <div class="archhint">탭을 클릭하면 보관 ↔ 해제됩니다. (홈 제외)</div>
  </nav>

  <!-- ───────── 메인 콘텐츠 ───────── -->
  <main>

    <section class="panel on" id="tab-home">
      <div class="quote-grid" id="homeQuotes">
        <div class="quote-card"><div class="qhead"><div class="qname">코스피 <small>KOSPI</small></div><div class="badge-live">지수</div></div>
          <div class="price-row"><div class="qprice num">—</div></div>
          <div class="qmeta num">불러오는 중…</div></div>
        <div class="quote-card"><div class="qhead"><div class="qname">코스닥 <small>KOSDAQ</small></div><div class="badge-live">지수</div></div>
          <div class="price-row"><div class="qprice num">—</div></div>
          <div class="qmeta num">불러오는 중…</div></div>
        <div class="quote-card"><div class="qhead"><div class="qname">삼성전자 <small>005930</small></div><div class="badge-live">5초 갱신</div></div>

<script>
/* ── 韓/美 시황: 마감시황 봇 출력 원문(data/krwrap.json·uswrap.json) 렌더 ── */
const MW={
  krwrap:{url:'data/krwrap.json',label:'韓 시황',note:'평일 15:50 한국 마감시황 봇이 작성'},
  uswrap:{url:'data/uswrap.json',label:'美 시황',note:'매일 아침 미국 모닝시황 봇이 작성'}
};
async function loadMW(k){
  const c=MW[k];
  if(c.days&&Date.now()-c.at<300000)return;
  const meta=document.getElementById(k+'Meta'),body=document.getElementById(k+'Body');
  try{
    const res=await fetch(c.url+'?t='+Date.now(),{cache:'no-store'});
    if(!res.ok)throw new Error(res.status);
    const j=await res.json();c.days=j.days||[];c.at=Date.now();
  }catch(e){
    meta.textContent=c.note+'합니다.';
    body.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>아직 게시된 시황이 없습니다</b>봇이 발행하면 30분 내 자동 업로드됩니다.</div>';
    return;
  }
  const wd=ds=>['일','월','화','수','목','금','토'][new Date('20'+ds.slice(0,2)+'-'+ds.slice(2,4)+'-'+ds.slice(4,6)+'T00:00:00+09:00').getDay()];
  const fmt=t=>esc(t).split('\n').map((ln,i)=>{
    const s=ln.trim();
    if(i===0)return `<b class="mwhead">${ln}</b>`;
    if(/^&lt;.+&gt;/.test(s)||/^\[.+\]/.test(s)||/^[■◆▶]/.test(s))return `<b class="mwsec">${ln}</b>`;
    return ln;
  }).join('\n');
  const dayHtml=d=>`<div class="wrapsec"><div class="mwtxt">${fmt(d.text)}</div></div>`;
  const days=c.days,latest=days[0];
  if(!latest){meta.textContent=c.note+'합니다.';body.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>아직 게시된 시황이 없습니다</b></div>';return;}
  meta.innerHTML=`<b>${latest.date}(${wd(latest.date)})</b> · ${esc(latest.mtime||'')} 게시 · ${c.note} · 최근 ${days.length}일 보관`;
  let html=dayHtml(latest);
  if(days.length>1){
    html+='<div class="wrapdiv">지난 시황</div>';
    days.slice(1).forEach(d=>{
      html+=`<details class="wrapday"><summary>📅 ${esc(d.date)} (${wd(d.date)}) ${c.label}</summary><div class="inner">${dayHtml(d)}</div></details>`;
    });
  }
  body.innerHTML=html;
}

/* ── 텔레그램 피드: data/telegram.json 을 읽어 좌측 채널 목록 + 최신순 피드 렌더 ── */
let TG=null,tgSel='all',tgFetchedAt=0,tgShown=0;
const PAGE=150;
const esc=s=>s.replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const linkify=s=>s.replace(/(https?:\/\/[^\s<]+)/g,'<a href="$1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">$1</a>');
const hue=s=>{let h=0;for(const c of s)h=(h*31+c.charCodeAt(0))%360;return h};

async function loadTG(force){
  if(!force&&TG&&Date.now()-tgFetchedAt<120000){return}
  const prevUpdated=TG&&TG.updated;
  try{
    const res=await fetch('data/telegram.json?t='+Date.now(),{cache:'no-store'});
    if(!res.ok)throw new Error(res.status);
    TG=await res.json();tgFetchedAt=Date.now();
  }catch(e){TG=null}
  if(TG&&TG.updated===prevUpdated&&document.getElementById('tgList').children.length)return;
  renderTG();
}
setInterval(()=>{
  if(document.getElementById('tab-telegram').classList.contains('on'))loadTG(true);
},5*60*1000);
function renderTG(){
  const meta=document.getElementById('tgMeta'),list=document.getElementById('tgList'),feed=document.getElementById('tgFeed');
  if(!TG){
    meta.textContent='주요 텔레그램 채널의 당일 게시글을 자동 수집합니다.';
    feed.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>아직 수집된 데이터가 없습니다</b>첫 수집 이후 게시글이 표시됩니다.</div>';
    list.innerHTML='';return;
  }
  meta.textContent=`${TG.date} 게시글 ${TG.posts.length}건 · 마지막 수집 ${TG.updated.slice(11)} · 매시간 자동 업데이트`;
  const chs=[...TG.channels].sort((a,b)=>b.count-a.count);
  let html=`<button class="tgitem${tgSel==='all'?' on':''}" data-ch="all"><span class="tname">전체</span><span class="cnt">${TG.posts.length}</span></button>`;
  chs.forEach(c=>{html+=`<button class="tgitem${tgSel===c.handle?' on':''}" data-ch="${c.handle}" title="@${c.handle}"><span class="tname">${esc(c.title)}</span><span class="cnt">${c.count}</span></button>`});
  list.innerHTML=html;
  const posts=tgSel==='all'?TG.posts:TG.posts.filter(p=>p.ch===tgSel);
  tgShown=Math.min(PAGE,posts.length);
  feed.innerHTML=posts.length?'':'<div class="empty"><b>오늘 올라온 글이 없습니다</b></div>';
  appendPosts(posts,0,tgShown);
  if(posts.length>tgShown){
    const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.className='feedmore';
    btn.textContent=`더 보기 (${posts.length-tgShown}건 남음)`;
    btn.onclick=()=>{const from=tgShown;tgShown=posts.length;btn.remove();appendPosts(posts,from,posts.length)};
    feed.appendChild(btn);
  }
}
function appendPosts(posts,from,to){
  const feed=document.getElementById('tgFeed');
  const titleOf={},privOf={};
  TG.channels.forEach(c=>{titleOf[c.handle]=c.title;privOf[c.handle]=c.private;});
  const frag=document.createDocumentFragment();
  for(let i=from;i<to;i++){
    const p=posts[i];
    const long=p.text.length>700||p.text.split('\n').length>12;
    const el=document.createElement('article');el.className='post';
    el.innerHTML=`<div class="ph">
        <div class="av" style="background:hsl(${hue(p.ch)},42%,42%)">${esc((titleOf[p.ch]||p.ch)[0])}</div>
        <div class="who"><div class="nm">${esc(titleOf[p.ch]||p.ch)}</div><div class="hd">${privOf[p.ch]?'비공개 채널':'@'+p.ch}</div></div>
        <div class="tm">${p.ts.slice(11)}</div></div>
      <div class="tx${long?' clamp':''}">${linkify(esc(p.text))}</div>
      ${long?'<button class="more">더보기</button>':''}
      <div class="pf"><a href="${p.link}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">원문 보기 ↗</a></div>`;
    if(long){const b=el.querySelector('.more'),tx=el.querySelector('.tx');
      b.onclick=()=>{const c=tx.classList.toggle('clamp');b.textContent=c?'더보기':'접기'};}
    frag.appendChild(el);
  }
  const moreBtn=feed.querySelector('.feedmore');
  feed.insertBefore(frag,moreBtn);
}
document.getElementById('tgList').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const it=e.target.closest('.tgitem');if(!it)return;
  tgSel=it.dataset.ch;renderTG();
  document.querySelector('main').scrollTo({top:0});
});

/* ── 실시간 한국주식: Hyperliquid(직접) × raoni.json(환율·네이버가) ── */
const RA_TICKERS=[{tk:'SMSN',key:'SMSN'},{tk:'SKHX',key:'SKHX'}];
let raRef=null,raTimer=null,raRefAt=0;
const fmtWon=n=>'₩'+Math.round(n).toLocaleString('ko-KR');
const fmtEok=n=>{const e=n/1e8;return e>=10000?'₩'+(e/10000).toFixed(2)+'조':'₩'+Math.round(e).toLocaleString('ko-KR')+'억';};
async function raLoadRef(){
  if(raRef&&Date.now()-raRefAt<60000)return raRef;
  try{const r=await fetch('data/raoni.json?t='+Date.now(),{cache:'no-store'});raRef=await r.json();raRefAt=Date.now();}catch(e){}
  return raRef;
}
async function raTick(){
  const meta=document.getElementById('raMeta'),body=document.getElementById('raBody');
  const ref=await raLoadRef();
  let hl;
  try{
    const r=await fetch('https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info',{method:'POST',
      headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({type:'metaAndAssetCtxs',dex:'xyz'})});
    hl=await r.json();
  }catch(e){meta.textContent='Hyperliquid 연결 실패 — 잠시 후 재시도합니다.';return;}
  const names=hl[0].universe.map(u=>u.name),ctxs=hl[1];
  const rate=(ref&&ref.usdt_krw)||null;
  meta.innerHTML=`업비트 USDT <b style="color:var(--gold-hi)">${rate?fmtWon(rate):'-'}</b>`
    +(ref&&ref.naver_fx?` · 네이버 환율 ${fmtWon(ref.naver_fx)}`:'')
    +` · 5초마다 갱신 · <span style="color:var(--dim2)">${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('ko-KR')}</span>`;
  let html='';
  for(const {tk,key} of RA_TICKERS){
    const i=names.indexOf('xyz:'+tk); if(i<0)continue;
    const c=ctxs[i], mark=parseFloat(c.markPx), prev=parseFloat(c.prevDayPx);
    const st=(ref&&ref.stocks&&ref.stocks[key])||{};
    const won=rate?mark*rate:null;
    const chg=mark-prev, chgpct=prev?chg/prev*100:0;
    const funding=parseFloat(c.funding), apr=funding*24*365*100;
    const oi=parseFloat(c.openInterest), vlm=parseFloat(c.dayNtlVlm);
    const nvPrice=st.price||null;
    const prem=(won&&nvPrice)?(won-nvPrice)/nvPrice*100:null;
    const premWon=(won&&nvPrice)?won-nvPrice:null;
    const up=chg>=0;
    html+=`<div class="rcard">
      <div class="rtop"><div><div class="rname">${st.name||tk}</div><div class="rtk">xyz:${tk}${st.code?' · '+st.code:''}</div></div>
        <div class="rlinks"><a class="rlink" href="https://app.hyperliquid.xyz/trade/${tk}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">하이퍼리퀴드 ↗</a>
        ${st.code?`<a class="rlink" href="https://finance.naver.com/item/main.naver?code=${st.code}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">네이버 ↗</a>`:''}</div></div>
      <div class="rprice">${won?fmtWon(won):'—'}<span class="won">원</span>${rate&&nvPrice?'<span class="rkimp">● 김프 ON</span>':''}</div>
      <div class="rchg"><span class="lbl">전일 대비</span><span class="${up?'up':'down'}">${up?'▲':'▼'} ${Math.abs(chg).toFixed(2)} · ${up?'+':''}${chgpct.toFixed(2)}%</span></div>
      <div class="rusd">≈ $${mark.toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2})} USD</div>
      <div class="rhr"></div>
      <div class="rstats">
        <div class="rst"><div class="k">네이버 현재가</div><div class="v">${nvPrice?fmtWon(nvPrice):'-'}</div></div>
        <div class="rst"><div class="k">24H 거래대금</div><div class="v">${rate?fmtEok(vlm*rate):'-'}</div></div>
        <div class="rst"><div class="k">미결제약정</div><div class="v">${Math.round(oi).toLocaleString('ko-KR')}</div></div>
        <div class="rst"><div class="k">펀딩비 (1H)</div><div class="v ${funding>=0?'pos':'neg'}">${funding>=0?'+':''}${(funding*100).toFixed(4)}% · APR ${apr>=0?'+':''}${apr.toFixed(2)}%</div></div>
      </div>
      ${prem!=null?`<div class="rprem"><span class="pv ${prem>=0?'up':'down'}">${prem>=0?'+':''}${prem.toFixed(2)}%</span>
        <span class="sub">프리미엄 · ${premWon>=0?'+':''}${fmtWon(premWon)}</span>
        <span class="sub">· 네이버 ${fmtWon(nvPrice)}</span></div>`:''}</div>`;
  }
  body.innerHTML=html||'<div class="empty"><b>티커를 찾을 수 없습니다</b></div>';
}
function raStart(){raTick();idxTick();clearInterval(raTimer);raTimer=setInterval(()=>{
  if(document.getElementById('tab-raoni').classList.contains('on')){raTick();idxTick();}else clearInterval(raTimer);
},5000);}

/* ══════════ 공용: 캔버스 라인차트 + 유틸 ══════════ */
function lineChart(cv,cfg){
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1,W=cv.clientWidth||800,H=cfg.h||280;
  cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;cv.style.height=H+'px';
  const x=cv.getContext('2d');x.scale(dpr,dpr);x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const P={l:cfg.pl||58,r:14,t:12,b:22},IW=W-P.l-P.r,IH=H-P.t-P.b;
  let lo=Infinity,hi=-Infinity;
  cfg.series.forEach(s=>s.data.forEach(v=>{if(v!=null&&isFinite(v)){lo=Math.min(lo,v);hi=Math.max(hi,v)}}));
  (cfg.hlines||[]).forEach(l=>{lo=Math.min(lo,l.y);hi=Math.max(hi,l.y)});
  if(!isFinite(lo)){return}
  const pad=(hi-lo)*0.07||1;lo-=pad;hi+=pad;
  const n=cfg.labels.length;
  const px=i=>P.l+IW*(n>1?i/(n-1):0.5), py=v=>P.t+IH*(1-(v-lo)/(hi-lo));
  const yfmt=cfg.yfmt||(v=>v.toLocaleString('ko-KR'));
  const _cs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);x.strokeStyle=_cs.getPropertyValue('--line').trim()||'#272930';x.fillStyle=_cs.getPropertyValue('--faint').trim()||'#8b95a1';x.font='10.5px Pretendard, sans-serif';x.lineWidth=1;
  const ticks=4;
  for(let i=0;i<=ticks;i++){const v=lo+(hi-lo)*i/ticks,y=py(v);
    x.beginPath();x.moveTo(P.l,y);x.lineTo(W-P.r,y);x.globalAlpha=.5;x.stroke();x.globalAlpha=1;
    x.textAlign='right';x.fillText(yfmt(v),P.l-7,y+3.5);}
  const step=Math.max(1,Math.floor(n/6));x.textAlign='center';
  for(let i=0;i<n;i+=step){const d=cfg.labels[i];
    x.fillText(cfg.xfmt?cfg.xfmt(d):d,px(i),H-6);}
  (cfg.hlines||[]).forEach(l=>{x.strokeStyle=l.color||'#c9a24a';x.setLineDash(l.dash||[5,4]);
    x.beginPath();x.moveTo(P.l,py(l.y));x.lineTo(W-P.r,py(l.y));x.stroke();x.setLineDash([]);
    if(l.label){x.fillStyle=l.color||'#c9a24a';x.textAlign='left';x.fillText(l.label,P.l+4,py(l.y)-4)}});
  cfg.series.forEach(s=>{
    if(s.fill){x.beginPath();let started=false;
      for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const v=s.data[i];if(v==null)continue;
        if(!started){x.moveTo(px(i),py(v));started=true}else x.lineTo(px(i),py(v));}
      x.lineTo(px(n-1),py(cfg.fillBase!=null?cfg.fillBase:lo));x.lineTo(px(0),py(cfg.fillBase!=null?cfg.fillBase:lo));
      x.closePath();x.fillStyle=s.fill;x.fill();}
    x.beginPath();x.strokeStyle=s.color;x.lineWidth=s.w||1.6;let st=false;
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const v=s.data[i];if(v==null)continue;
      if(!st){x.moveTo(px(i),py(v));st=true}else x.lineTo(px(i),py(v));}
    x.stroke();});
}
const RANGES={'1M':21,'3M':63,'6M':126,'1Y':245,'3Y':735,'5Y':1225,'10Y':2450,'ALL':1e9};
function sliceR(arr,code){const k=RANGES[code]||1e9;return arr.length>k?arr.slice(-k):arr;}
const fmtDate8=d=>d.slice(2,4)+'.'+d.slice(4,6)+'.'+d.slice(6,8);
const xYear=d=>d.slice(0,4);
const fmtJo=n=>{const j=n/1e12;return j>=1?j.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:1})+'조':(n/1e8).toFixed(0)+'억';};
function rngBar(el,cur,codes,onsel){el.innerHTML=codes.map(c=>`<button class="rng${c===cur?' on':''}" data-r="${c}">${c==='ALL'?'전체':c}</button>`).join('');
  el.onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('.rng');if(b)onsel(b.dataset.r);};}
async function getJson(path){const r=await fetch(path+'?t='+Date.now(),{cache:'no-store'});if(!r.ok)throw 0;return r.json();}
let CAPS=null,DD=null,MEM=null;
async function needCaps(){if(!CAPS)CAPS=await getJson('data/caps.json');return CAPS;}
async function needRa(){await raLoadRef();return raRef;}

/* ══════════ 지수 (Hyperliquid EWY·KR200) ══════════ */
let idxTimer=null;
async function idxTick(){
  const body=document.getElementById('idxBody'),meta=document.getElementById('idxMeta');
  if(!body)return;
  const ref=await needRa();
  let hl;try{const r=await fetch('https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({type:'metaAndAssetCtxs',dex:'xyz'})});hl=await r.json();}catch(e){meta.textContent='Hyperliquid 연결 실패';return;}
  const names=hl[0].universe.map(u=>u.name),ctxs=hl[1];
  const C=t=>ctxs[names.indexOf('xyz:'+t)]||{};
  const ewy=C('EWY'),kr=C('KR200');
  const coef=ref&&ref.kospi_coef, kospiNv=ref&&ref.indices&&ref.indices.KOSPI;
  const em=parseFloat(ewy.markPx),ep=parseFloat(ewy.prevDayPx);
  const est=coef?em*coef:null, prevEst=coef?ep*coef:null;
  const km=parseFloat(kr.markPx),kp=parseFloat(kr.prevDayPx);
  if(meta)meta.innerHTML=`USD/KRW <b style="color:var(--gold-hi)">${ref&&ref.naver_fx?'₩'+ref.naver_fx.toLocaleString():'-'}</b> · 5초 갱신 · ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('ko-KR')}`;
  const card=(t,tk,big,chg,pct,rows)=>`<div class="rcard"><div class="rtop"><div><div class="rname">${t}</div><div class="rtk">${tk}</div></div></div>
    <div class="rprice" style="font-size:32px">${big}</div>
    <div class="rchg"><span class="${chg>=0?'up':'down'}">${chg>=0?'▲':'▼'} ${Math.abs(chg).toFixed(2)} · ${chg>=0?'+':''}${pct.toFixed(2)}%</span></div>
    <div class="rhr"></div><div class="rstats">${rows.map(r=>`<div class="rst"><div class="k">${r[0]}</div><div class="v">${r[1]}</div></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
  let html='';
  if(est){html+=card('코스피','xyz:EWY × 계수',est.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:2}),est-prevEst,(est-prevEst)/prevEst*100,[
    ['EWY 마크 (USD)','$'+em.toFixed(2)],['환산 계수',coef.toFixed(3)],
    ['현재 코스피 (네이버)',kospiNv?kospiNv.value.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:2}):'-'],
    ['EWY 24H 거래대금','$'+(parseFloat(ewy.dayNtlVlm)/1e6).toFixed(2)+'M']]);}
  html+=card('코스피200 선물','xyz:KR200 perp',km.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:2}),km-kp,(km-kp)/kp*100,[
    ['오라클',parseFloat(kr.oraclePx).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:2})],
    ['미드',parseFloat(kr.midPx).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:2})],
    ['24H 거래대금','$'+(parseFloat(kr.dayNtlVlm)/1e3).toFixed(1)+'K'],
    ['미결제약정',parseFloat(kr.openInterest).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:1})]]);
  body.innerHTML=html;
}
/* idxStart 폐지 — 지수는 실시간 한국주식(raoni) 탭에 병합, raStart가 idxTick 구동 */

/* ══════════ 시총비교 ══════════ */
let capsRange='1Y',capsPref=true;
async function capsLoad(){
  const d=await needCaps(),ref=await needRa();
  const el=document.getElementById('capsBody');
  const sh=d.shares;
  const dates=d.dates, s=d.close.s, sp=d.close.sp, h=d.close.h;
  const sam=dates.map((_,i)=>s[i]!=null?(s[i]*sh.s+(capsPref&&sp[i]!=null?sp[i]*sh.sp:0)):null);
  const hyn=dates.map((_,i)=>h[i]!=null?h[i]*sh.h:null);
  const L=sliceR(dates,capsRange),S=sliceR(sam,capsRange),Hy=sliceR(hyn,capsRange);
  const liveS=(ref&&ref.stocks&&ref.stocks.SMSN&&ref.stocks.SMSN.price)||s[s.length-1];
  const liveH=(ref&&ref.stocks&&ref.stocks.SKHX&&ref.stocks.SKHX.price)||h[h.length-1];
  const capS=liveS*sh.s+(capsPref?sp[sp.length-1]*sh.sp:0), capH=liveH*sh.h;
  const gapArr=S.map((v,i)=>v!=null&&Hy[i]!=null?v-Hy[i]:null).filter(v=>v!=null);
  const maxGap=Math.max(...gapArr),minGap=Math.min(...gapArr);
  const need=capS/sh.h;
  const ratio=S.map((v,i)=>v!=null&&Hy[i]?v/Hy[i]:null);
  document.getElementById('capsMeta').innerHTML=`기준: 네이버 일봉 종가 × 현재 발행주식수 · 마지막 빌드 ${CAPS.updated} · 현재가는 5분 피드`;
  el.innerHTML=`
  <div class="rcard" style="text-align:center">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:60px;align-items:flex-end;margin:6px 0 14px">
      <div><div style="font-size:24px;font-weight:800">${fmtJo(capS)}</div>
        <div class="cbar" style="height:${Math.round(150*capS/Math.max(capS,capH))}px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4d7df5,#3168f0)"></div>
        <div style="margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">🏆 삼성${capsPref?' +우':''}</div></div>
      <div><div style="font-size:24px;font-weight:800">${fmtJo(capH)}</div>
        <div class="cbar" style="height:${Math.round(150*capH/Math.max(capS,capH))}px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f59e0b,#d97706)"></div>
        <div style="margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">SK하이닉스</div></div>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size:15px">격차 <b style="color:var(--gold-hi)">${capS>capH?'삼성':'하이닉스'} +${fmtJo(Math.abs(capS-capH))}</b>
      <span style="color:var(--dim)"> · ${capS>capH?'삼성':'하이닉스'}이 ${(Math.abs(capS/capH-1)*100).toFixed(1)}% 큼</span></div>
    <div style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:6px">삼성${capsPref?'(+우)':''} 추월까지 → 하이닉스 <b style="color:var(--txt)">₩${Math.round(need).toLocaleString()}</b> 필요 (${((need/liveH-1)*100).toFixed(1)>0?'+':''}${((need/liveH-1)*100).toFixed(1)}% · 현재 ₩${Math.round(liveH).toLocaleString()})</div>
  </div>
  <div class="statrow">
    <div class="stc"><div class="k">삼성 시총</div><div class="v">${fmtJo(capS)}</div></div>
    <div class="stc"><div class="k">SK하이닉스 시총</div><div class="v">${fmtJo(capH)}</div></div>
    <div class="stc"><div class="k">격차 (삼성 − 하닉)</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--gold-hi)">${capS-capH>=0?'+':''}${fmtJo(capS-capH)}</div></div>
    <div class="stc"><div class="k">기간 최대 격차</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--down)">+${fmtJo(maxGap)}</div></div>
    <div class="stc"><div class="k">기간 최소 격차</div><div class="v">${fmtJo(minGap)}</div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px">시가총액 추이 <span style="color:var(--dim2);font-size:11px;font-weight:500">단위 조 · 삼성 = 보통주${capsPref?' + 우선주':''}</span></h3>
    <canvas id="capsCv1"></canvas>
    <div class="clegend"><i style="background:#3168f0"></i>삼성전자${capsPref?'+우':''} <i style="background:#f59e0b;margin-left:14px"></i>SK하이닉스</div></div>
  <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px">시총 비율 (삼성 ÷ 하이닉스) <span style="color:var(--dim2);font-size:11px;font-weight:500">1.00 미만 = 하이닉스가 더 큼</span></h3>
    <canvas id="capsCv2"></canvas></div>`;
  lineChart(document.getElementById('capsCv1'),{labels:L,series:[
    {data:S.map(v=>v/1e12),color:'#3168f0',w:1.8},{data:Hy.map(v=>v/1e12),color:'#f59e0b',w:1.8}],
    yfmt:v=>Math.round(v).toLocaleString()+'조',xfmt:capsRange==='1M'||capsRange==='3M'?fmtDate8:xYear});
  lineChart(document.getElementById('capsCv2'),{labels:L,series:[
    {data:sliceR(ratio,capsRange),color:'#3168f0',fill:'rgba(49,104,240,.12)',w:1.6}],
    hlines:[{y:1,color:'#f59e0b',label:'동률 1.00'}],
    yfmt:v=>v.toFixed(2)+'×',xfmt:capsRange==='1M'||capsRange==='3M'?fmtDate8:xYear});
}
function capsInit(){
  rngBar(document.getElementById('capsRng'),capsRange,['1M','3M','6M','1Y','3Y','5Y','10Y','ALL'],r=>{capsRange=r;capsInit();});
  document.getElementById('capsPref').onclick=()=>{capsPref=!capsPref;capsInit();};
  document.getElementById('capsPref').textContent='우선주 포함 '+(capsPref?'ON':'OFF');
  document.getElementById('capsPref').classList.toggle('on',capsPref);
  capsLoad();
}

/* ══════════ 괴리율 ══════════ */
let gapRange='1Y',gapPair='sam';
async function gapLoad(){
  const d=await needCaps();
  const el=document.getElementById('gapBody');
  const dates=d.dates;
  let series,aName,bName,aArr,bArr,fml;
  if(gapPair==='sam'){
    aName='삼성전자(005930)';bName='삼성전자우(005935)';
    aArr=d.close.s;bArr=d.close.sp;
    series=dates.map((_,i)=>aArr[i]&&bArr[i]?(aArr[i]-bArr[i])/aArr[i]*100:null);
    fml='괴리율 = (보통주 − 우선주) ÷ 보통주 × 100';
  }else{
    aName='SK하이닉스 지분가치(20.07%)';bName='SK스퀘어(402340)';
    aArr=dates.map((_,i)=>d.close.h[i]?d.close.h[i]*d.shares.h*d.sq_stake_hynix:null);
    bArr=dates.map((_,i)=>d.close.sq[i]?d.close.sq[i]*d.shares.sq:null);
    series=dates.map((_,i)=>aArr[i]&&bArr[i]?(aArr[i]-bArr[i])/aArr[i]*100:null);
    fml='NAV 할인율 = (하이닉스 지분가치 − 스퀘어 시총) ÷ 지분가치 × 100';
  }
  const idxs=dates.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>series[i]!=null);
  const rIdx=sliceR(idxs,gapRange);
  const L=rIdx.map(i=>dates[i]),V=rIdx.map(i=>series[i]);
  const cur=V[V.length-1],avg=V.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/V.length;
  const sd=Math.sqrt(V.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b-avg)**2,0)/V.length);
  const mx=Math.max(...V),mn=Math.min(...V);
  const mxD=L[V.indexOf(mx)],mnD=L[V.indexOf(mn)];
  document.getElementById('gapMeta').textContent=`출처: 네이버 일봉 종가 · 마지막 빌드 ${CAPS.updated} · ${fml}`;
  el.innerHTML=`
  <div class="statrow">
    <div class="stc"><div class="k">현재 ${gapPair==='sam'?'괴리율':'할인율'}</div><div class="v" style="font-size:19px;color:var(--gold-hi)">${cur.toFixed(2)}%</div><div class="s">${fmtDate8(L[L.length-1])}</div></div>
    <div class="stc"><div class="k">기간 평균</div><div class="v">${avg.toFixed(2)}%</div><div class="s">σ ${sd.toFixed(2)}pp</div></div>
    <div class="stc"><div class="k">최대</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--down)">${mx.toFixed(2)}%</div><div class="s">${fmtDate8(mxD)}</div></div>
    <div class="stc"><div class="k">최소</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--up)">${mn.toFixed(2)}%</div><div class="s">${fmtDate8(mnD)}</div></div>
    <div class="stc"><div class="k">데이터 일수</div><div class="v">${V.length}일</div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px">${gapPair==='sam'?'괴리율':'NAV 할인율'} 추이</h3><canvas id="gapCv1"></canvas>
    <div class="clegend"><i style="background:#3168f0"></i>${gapPair==='sam'?'괴리율':'할인율'} <i style="background:#c9a24a;margin-left:14px"></i>평균 ${avg.toFixed(2)}%</div></div>
  <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px">${gapPair==='sam'?'종가 비교':'가치 비교'}</h3><canvas id="gapCv2"></canvas>
    <div class="clegend"><i style="background:#3168f0"></i>${aName} <i style="background:#f59e0b;margin-left:14px"></i>${bName}</div></div>`;
  lineChart(document.getElementById('gapCv1'),{labels:L,series:[
    {data:V,color:'#3168f0',fill:'rgba(49,104,240,.13)',w:1.7}],
    hlines:[{y:avg,color:'#f59e0b'}],yfmt:v=>v.toFixed(1)+'%',
    xfmt:['1M','3M','6M'].includes(gapRange)?fmtDate8:xYear});
  const aV=rIdx.map(i=>aArr[i]),bV=rIdx.map(i=>bArr[i]);
  lineChart(document.getElementById('gapCv2'),{labels:L,series:[
    {data:aV,color:'#3168f0',w:1.6},{data:bV,color:'#f59e0b',w:1.6}],
    yfmt:gapPair==='sam'?(v=>Math.round(v/1000)+'천'):(v=>Math.round(v/1e12)+'조'),
    xfmt:['1M','3M','6M'].includes(gapRange)?fmtDate8:xYear});
}
function gapInit(){
  const pb=document.getElementById('gapPair');
  pb.innerHTML=`<button class="pair${gapPair==='sam'?' on':''}" data-p="sam">삼성 보통/우선</button><button class="pair${gapPair==='sq'?' on':''}" data-p="sq">하이닉스 / SK스퀘어</button>`;
  pb.onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('.pair');if(b){gapPair=b.dataset.p;gapInit();}};
  rngBar(document.getElementById('gapRng'),gapRange,['1M','3M','6M','1Y','3Y','5Y','10Y','ALL'],r=>{gapRange=r;gapInit();});
  gapLoad();
}

/* ══════════ ETF 괴리율 ══════════ */
async function etfgLoad(){
  const ref=await needRa();
  const el=document.getElementById('etfgBody');
  if(!ref||!ref.etf||!ref.etf.length){el.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>ETF 데이터 없음</b></div>';return;}
  document.getElementById('etfgMeta').innerHTML=`단일종목 레버리지·인버스 ETF — 현재가 · NAV(장중 iNAV 추정) · 괴리율 · 5분 갱신 (${ref.updated.slice(11,16)}) · 출처 네이버금융`;
  const groups={'삼성전자':[],'SK하이닉스':[]};
  ref.etf.forEach(e=>groups[e.under]&&groups[e.under].push(e));
  const stPct=u=>{const k=u==='삼성전자'?'SMSN':'SKHX';const s=ref.stocks&&ref.stocks[k];
    if(!s||!s.price||!s.prevClose)return'';
    const p=(s.price-s.prevClose)/s.prevClose*100;
    return `<span class="${p>=0?'up':'down'}" style="font-size:13px;margin-left:8px">${p>=0?'▲+':'▼'}${p.toFixed(2)}%</span>`;};
  let html='';
  for(const u of ['삼성전자','SK하이닉스']){
    html+=`<div class="hgroup" style="margin-top:4px">■ ${u} ${stPct(u)}</div><div class="rgrid2" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr))">`;
    for(const e of groups[u]){
      const pos=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,e.gap||0));
      html+=`<div class="rcard" style="padding:16px 18px">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px">
          <span class="brandpill">${e.brand}</span><span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim)">단일종목 ${e.type}</span>
          <span style="margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2)">괴리율</span></div>
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between">
          <div><span style="font-size:23px;font-weight:800">₩${e.price?e.price.toLocaleString():'-'}</span><span style="color:var(--dim);font-size:12px"> 원</span>
            <div class="rchg" style="margin-top:4px"><span class="${(e.chgVal||0)>=0?'up':'down'}" style="font-size:12px">${(e.chgVal||0)>=0?'▲':'▼'} ${Math.abs(e.chgVal||0).toLocaleString()} · ${(e.chgPct||0)>=0?'+':''}${(e.chgPct||0).toFixed(2)}%</span><span class="lbl">전일 대비</span></div></div>
          <div style="font-size:21px;font-weight:800;color:${(e.gap||0)>=0?'var(--up)':'var(--down)'}">${(e.gap||0)>=0?'+':''}${(e.gap||0).toFixed(2)}%</div></div>
        <div class="gauge"><div class="gmark" style="left:${50+pos*50}%;background:${(e.gap||0)>=0?'var(--up)':'var(--down)'}"></div><div class="gzero"></div></div>
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:3px"><span>할인 −1%</span><span>0 · NAV ₩${e.nav?e.nav.toLocaleString():'-'}</span><span>+1% 할증</span></div>
      </div>`;}
    html+='</div>';}
  el.innerHTML=html;
}

  let html='';
  DD.stocks.forEach((s,si)=>{
    html+=`<div class="rcard">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px">
        <span style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800">${s.name}</span><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2)">${s.code} · ${s.tk}</span>
        <span style="margin-left:auto;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--down);background:rgba(239,68,68,.1);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.3);border-radius:99px;padding:3px 11px">전고대비 ${s.cur_dd}%${s.cur_dd<=-20?' · 조정장':''}</span></div>
      <div class="rstats" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);margin-bottom:14px">
