        <div class="rst"><div class="k">전고점 (장중 사상최고)</div><div class="v">₩${s.ath.toLocaleString()} <span style="color:var(--dim2);font-weight:500;font-size:11px">${fmtDate8(s.ath_date)}</span></div></div>
        <div class="rst"><div class="k">현재 낙폭 (종가)</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--down)">${s.cur_dd}%</div></div>
        <div class="rst"><div class="k">-15% 진입 횟수</div><div class="v">${s.n_episodes}회</div></div></div>
      <canvas id="ddCv${si}"></canvas>
      <div style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:4px">전고점(=0%) 대비 종가 낙폭 추이 · 점선 = -15% (2010~현재)</div>
      <div class="hgroup" style="margin-top:16px">전고대비 -15% 이상 하락 구간 · 최신순 ${s.n_episodes}건</div>
      <div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="ddt"><thead><tr><th>-15% 진입일</th><th>최저점 (날짜·장중저가)</th><th>최대 낙폭</th><th>회복일</th><th>지속(거래일)</th></tr></thead><tbody>
      ${s.episodes.map(e=>`<tr><td>${fmtDate8(e.enter)}</td><td><b>${fmtDate8(e.trough_d)}</b> (₩${Math.round(e.trough_p).toLocaleString()})</td>
        <td style="color:var(--down);font-weight:700">${e.max_dd}%</td>
        <td>${e.recover?`<span style="color:var(--up)">${fmtDate8(e.recover)}</span>`:'<span style="color:var(--gold-hi);font-weight:700">진행중</span>'}</td>
        <td>${e.days}일</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
  });
  el.innerHTML=html;
  DD.stocks.forEach((s,si)=>{
    lineChart(document.getElementById('ddCv'+si),{labels:s.dates,h:230,series:[
      {data:s.dd,color:'#f04452',fill:'rgba(240,68,82,.14)',w:1}],fillBase:0,
      hlines:[{y:-15,color:'#f04452',dash:[4,4],label:'-15%'}],
      yfmt:v=>v.toFixed(0)+'%',xfmt:xYear});
  });
}

/* ══════════ 터미널 ══════════ */
let termTimer=null,termRange='6M';
async function termLoad(){
  const ref=await needRa();const d=await needCaps();
  const el=document.getElementById('termBody');
  if(!ref){el.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>피드 없음</b></div>';return;}
  document.getElementById('termMeta').innerHTML=`업데이트 ${ref.updated.slice(11,16)} · 삼성전자·SK하이닉스 · 출처: 네이버·Hyperliquid·DART`;
  const t=ref.terminal||{};
  const stCard=(key,color)=>{
    const s=ref.stocks[key]||{},ti=t[key]||{};
    const chg=s.price&&s.prevClose?s.price-s.prevClose:0,pct=s.prevClose?chg/s.prevClose*100:0;
    const tgt=ti.target?parseFloat(String(ti.target).replace(/,/g,'')):null;
    const ups=tgt&&s.price?(tgt/s.price-1)*100:null;
    return `<div class="rcard" style="border-left:3px solid ${color};padding:16px 18px">
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--dim2)">${s.name} <span style="color:var(--dim2)">${s.code}</span></div>
      <div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin:4px 0">₩${s.price?s.price.toLocaleString():'-'} <span class="${chg>=0?'up':'down'}" style="font-size:13px">${chg>=0?'▲':'▼'}${Math.abs(chg).toLocaleString()} (${pct>=0?'+':''}${pct.toFixed(2)}%)</span></div>
      <div class="kvrow">PER <b>${ti.per||'-'}</b> · 추정PER <b>${ti.cnsPer||'-'}</b> · PBR <b>${ti.pbr||'-'}</b></div>
      <div class="kvrow">배당 <b>${ti.dvr||'-'}</b> · 외인 <b>${ti.frgnRate||'-'}</b> · 시총 <b>${ti.marketValue||'-'}</b></div>
      ${tgt?`<div class="kvrow" style="margin-top:6px">목표주가 <b style="color:var(--gold-hi)">₩${tgt.toLocaleString()}</b> <span class="${ups>=0?'up':'down'}">${ups>=0?'+':''}${ups.toFixed(1)}%</span></div>`:''}
      <div class="kvrow" style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2)">52주 ${ti.high52||'-'} / ${ti.low52||'-'}</div></div>`;};
  const idx=ref.indices||{};
  const miniIdx=(nm,o)=>o?`<div class="stc" style="min-width:0"><div class="k">${nm}</div><div class="v" style="font-size:15px">${o.value.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:2})}</div>
    <div class="s ${o.chg>=0?'up':'down'}">${o.chg>=0?'▲':'▼'}${Math.abs(o.chg).toLocaleString()} (${o.pct>=0?'+':''}${o.pct}%)</div></div>`:'';
  el.innerHTML=`
  <div class="termgrid">
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px">${stCard('SMSN','#3168f0')}${stCard('SKHX','#f59e0b')}</div>
    <div class="rcard"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px">
      <h3 style="font-size:13.5px">📊 삼성전자 vs SK하이닉스 상대수익률 (기준일=0%)</h3>
      <div class="rngwrap" id="termRng" style="margin-left:auto"></div></div>
      <canvas id="termCv" style="width:100%"></canvas>
      <div class="clegend"><i style="background:#3168f0"></i>삼성전자 <i style="background:#f59e0b;margin-left:14px"></i>SK하이닉스</div></div>
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px">
      <div class="statrow" style="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px">${miniIdx('코스피',idx.KOSPI)}${miniIdx('코스닥',idx.KOSDAQ)}
        <div class="stc"><div class="k">원/달러</div><div class="v" style="font-size:15px">${ref.naver_fx?ref.naver_fx.toLocaleString():'-'}</div></div>
        <div class="stc"><div class="k">업비트 USDT</div><div class="v" style="font-size:15px">${ref.usdt_krw?ref.usdt_krw.toLocaleString():'-'}</div></div></div>
      <div class="hgroup" style="margin:2px 0 0">🌐 글로벌 반도체 (HL·USD)</div>
      <div class="statrow" style="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px" id="termGlb"><div class="stc"><div class="k">로딩…</div></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="termgrid2">
    <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:10px">📰 뉴스</h3><div class="tlist">
      ${(ref.news||[]).slice(0,14).map(n=>`<div class="titem"><a class="nt" style="font-size:12.5px" href="${n.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(n.title)}</a>
        <div class="nmeta">${(n.tags||[]).map(tg=>`<span class="ttag">${tg}</span>`).join('')} ${esc(n.source)} · ${n.ts}</div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="nmeta">뉴스 없음</div>'}</div></div>
    <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:10px">🎯 컨센서스 · 목표주가</h3>
      ${['SMSN','SKHX'].map(k=>{const ti=t[k]||{};const nm=(ref.stocks[k]||{}).name||k;
        return `<div style="margin-bottom:12px"><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px">${nm} <span style="color:var(--gold-hi)">${ti.target?'₩'+ti.target:'-'}</span> <span style="color:var(--dim2);font-size:10.5px">투자의견 ${ti.recomm||'-'}</span></div>
        <div class="tlist">${(ti.researches||[]).slice(0,4).map(r=>`<div class="titem" style="padding:5px 0"><span style="font-size:12px">${esc(r.title)}</span><div class="nmeta">${esc(r.broker)} · ${r.date}</div></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;}).join('')}</div>
    <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:10px">📄 공시 (DART)</h3><div class="tlist">
      ${(ref.filings||[]).length?(ref.filings||[]).slice(0,12).map(f=>`<div class="titem"><a class="nt" style="font-size:12.5px" href="${f.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(f.title)}</a><div class="nmeta">${f.ts}</div></div>`).join(''):'<div class="nmeta">최근 공시 수집분 없음 (당일 RSS 누적)</div>'}</div></div>
    <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:10px">💰 수급 (외국인·기관·개인 순매수)</h3>
      ${['SMSN','SKHX'].map(k=>{const ti=t[k]||{};const nm=(ref.stocks[k]||{}).name||k;
        return `<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin:6px 0 4px">${nm}</div>
        <table class="ddt" style="font-size:11.5px"><thead><tr><th>일자</th><th>외국인</th><th>기관</th><th>개인</th></tr></thead><tbody>
        ${(ti.deal||[]).map(r=>{
          const c=v=>{const s=String(v||'');const neg=s.startsWith('-');return `<td class="${neg?'down':'up'}">${s.replace(/[+-]/,'')?(neg?'-':'+')+Math.round(Math.abs(parseFloat(s.replace(/[,+]/g,'')))/1e4).toLocaleString()+'만':'-'}</td>`;};
          return `<tr><td>${(r.date||'').slice(4,6)}/${(r.date||'').slice(6,8)}</td>${c(r.frgn)}${c(r.org)}${c(r.indi)}</tr>`;}).join('')}</tbody></table>`;}).join('')}</div>
  </div>`;
  rngBar(document.getElementById('termRng'),termRange,['1M','3M','6M','1Y'],r=>{termRange=r;termChart();});
  termChart();termGlobal();
}
async function termChart(){
  const d=await needCaps();
  const idxs=d.dates.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>d.close.s[i]!=null&&d.close.h[i]!=null);
  const r=sliceR(idxs,termRange);
  const L=r.map(i=>d.dates[i]);
  const base_s=d.close.s[r[0]],base_h=d.close.h[r[0]];
  lineChart(document.getElementById('termCv'),{labels:L,h:300,series:[
    {data:r.map(i=>(d.close.s[i]/base_s-1)*100),color:'#3168f0',w:1.7},
    {data:r.map(i=>(d.close.h[i]/base_h-1)*100),color:'#f59e0b',w:1.7}],
    hlines:[{y:0,color:'#8b95a1',dash:[3,4]}],yfmt:v=>(v>=0?'+':'')+v.toFixed(0)+'%',
    xfmt:['1M','3M'].includes(termRange)?fmtDate8:d8=>d8.slice(4,6)+'월'});
}
async function termGlobal(){
  try{
    const r=await fetch('https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({type:'metaAndAssetCtxs',dex:'xyz'})});
    const hl=await r.json();const names=hl[0].universe.map(u=>u.name),ctxs=hl[1];
    const cell=(nm,tk)=>{const c=ctxs[names.indexOf('xyz:'+tk)];if(!c)return'';
      const m=parseFloat(c.markPx),p=parseFloat(c.prevDayPx),pct=(m-p)/p*100;
      return `<div class="stc"><div class="k">${nm}</div><div class="v" style="font-size:15px">${m.toLocaleString('en-US',{maximumFractionDigits:2})}</div>
        <div class="s ${pct>=0?'up':'down'}">${pct>=0?'▲+':'▼'}${pct.toFixed(2)}%</div></div>`;};
    document.getElementById('termGlb').innerHTML=cell('엔비디아','NVDA')+cell('마이크론','MU')+cell('TSMC','TSM')+cell('인텔','INTC');
  }catch(e){}
}
function termStart(){termLoad();clearInterval(termTimer);termTimer=setInterval(()=>{
  if(document.getElementById('tab-term').classList.contains('on')){raRefAt=0;termLoad();}else clearInterval(termTimer);},60000);}

/* ══════════ 메모리 가격 (DRAM·NAND 현물/고정) ══════════ */
let memMode='dsp',memRng='6M',memSel={};
const MEM_MODES=[['dsp','DRAM 현물'],['nsp','NAND 현물'],['dfx','DRAM 고정가'],['nfx','NAND 고정가']];
const MEM_DAYS=864e5;
async function ramLoad(){
  if(!MEM)MEM=await getJson('data/memory.json').catch(()=>null);
  const meta=document.getElementById('ramMeta');
  if(!MEM){meta.textContent='DRAM·NAND 현물가/고정가 · 출처 DRAMeXchange';
    document.getElementById('ramBody').innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>아직 수집된 데이터가 없습니다</b>다음 일별 빌드에서 채워집니다.</div>';return;}
  meta.innerHTML=`현물가(세션평균)·고정가(컨트랙트) · 단위 USD · 출처 DRAMeXchange · 업데이트 ${MEM.updated} · <span style="color:var(--dim2)">DRAM 현물 추이 2025-07~ · NAND 현물/고정가 추이는 2026-07-20부터 누적</span>`;
  memRender();
}
function memRender(){
  const el=document.getElementById('ramBody');
  const spot=memMode==='dsp'||memMode==='nsp';
  const kind=(memMode==='dsp'||memMode==='dfx')?'dram':'nand';
  const items=(spot?MEM.spot[kind]:MEM.fixed[kind])||[];
  const hist=(MEM.history[spot?'spot':'fixed']||[]).filter(h=>h[kind]&&Object.keys(h[kind]).length);
  const fc=v=>v==null?'<span style="color:var(--dim2)">—</span>':`<span class="${v>=0?'up':'down'}">${v>=0?'▲':'▼'}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(2)}%</span>`;
  const histAt=days=>{const cut=new Date(Date.now()-days*MEM_DAYS).toISOString().slice(0,10);
    for(let i=hist.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(hist[i].date<=cut)return hist[i];return null;};
  const chgOf=(nm,days)=>{const e=histAt(days),cur=items.find(i=>i.name===nm);
    const past=e&&e[kind]&&e[kind][nm];return past&&cur?(cur.avg/past-1)*100:null;};
  const fmt$=v=>'$'+v.toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:3});

  let html=`<div class="rngwrap" id="memModeBar" style="margin-bottom:14px">${MEM_MODES.map(([k,l])=>`<button class="rng${k===memMode?' on':''}" data-m="${k}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
  if(!items.length){
    html+='<div class="empty"><b>이 구분의 데이터가 아직 없습니다</b>다음 일별 빌드에서 채워집니다.</div>';
    el.innerHTML=html;bindMemBar();return;}

  html+='<div class="rgrid2" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr))">';
  for(const it of items.slice(0,3)){
    html+=`<div class="rcard" style="padding:16px 18px"><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:6px">${esc(it.name)}</div>
      <div style="font-size:26px;font-weight:800">${fmt$(it.avg)} <span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--dim2)">USD</span></div>
      <div style="font-size:11.5px;margin-top:6px">${spot
        ?`세션 ${fc(it.chg)} · 30일 ${fc(chgOf(it.name,30))} · 1년 ${fc(chgOf(it.name,365))}`
        :`전월 ${fc(it.chg)} · 고가 ${fmt$(it.hi)} · 저가 ${fmt$(it.lo)} · 공표 ${esc(it.day||'—')}`}</div></div>`;}
  html+='</div>';

  const sel=memSel[memMode]||(memSel[memMode]=new Set(items.slice(0,4).map(i=>i.name)));
  html+=`<div class="rcard" style="margin-top:14px">
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px">
      <h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin:0">📈 ${spot?'현물가 추이 (세션평균)':'고정가 추이 (공표 평균가)'}</h3>
      <div class="rngwrap" id="memRngBar" style="margin-left:auto"></div></div>
    <div id="memChips" style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px">${items.map(i=>
      `<button class="rng${sel.has(i.name)?' on':''}" data-n="${esc(i.name)}" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px">${esc(i.name)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <canvas id="memCv"></canvas><div class="clegend" id="memLg"></div></div>`;

  html+=`<div class="rcard" style="margin-top:14px"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:8px">💾 ${spot?'현물가 전체 시세':'고정가 전체 시세'}</h3>
    <div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="ddt"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">품목</th>${spot
      ?'<th>세션평균</th><th>세션변동</th><th>30일</th><th>90일</th><th>1년</th>'
      :'<th>고가</th><th>저가</th><th>평균</th><th>전월대비</th><th>공표일</th>'}</tr></thead><tbody>
    ${items.map(it=>`<tr><td style="text-align:left;font-weight:600">${esc(it.name)}</td>${spot
      ?`<td>${fmt$(it.avg)}</td><td>${fc(it.chg)}</td><td>${fc(chgOf(it.name,30))}</td><td>${fc(chgOf(it.name,91))}</td><td>${fc(chgOf(it.name,365))}</td>`
      :`<td>${fmt$(it.hi)}</td><td>${fmt$(it.lo)}</td><td>${fmt$(it.avg)}</td><td>${fc(it.chg)}</td><td style="color:var(--dim)">${esc(it.day||'—')}</td>`}</tr>`).join('')}
    </tbody></table></div></div>`;
  el.innerHTML=html;
  bindMemBar();
  document.getElementById('memChips').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-n]');if(!b)return;
    const s=memSel[memMode];const n=b.dataset.n;
    if(s.has(n)){if(s.size>1)s.delete(n);}else s.add(n);
    memRender();};
  rngBar(document.getElementById('memRngBar'),memRng,['1M','3M','6M','1Y','ALL'],r=>{memRng=r;memRender();});
  memChart(hist,kind,items);
}
function bindMemBar(){
  document.getElementById('memModeBar').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-m]');if(b){memMode=b.dataset.m;memRender();}};
}
function memChart(hist,kind,items){
  const cutDays={'1M':31,'3M':92,'6M':184,'1Y':366,'ALL':1e5}[memRng];
  const cut=new Date(Date.now()-cutDays*MEM_DAYS).toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const H=hist.filter(h=>h.date>=cut);
  if(!H.length)return;
  const colors=['#3168f0','#f59e0b','#f04452','#8ab4f8','#b08ad6','#56d4dd','#f0a860','#7fd18a','#e07ab8'];
  const names=items.map(i=>i.name).filter(n=>memSel[memMode].has(n));
  const series=names.map((n,i)=>({label:n,color:colors[i%colors.length],w:1.6,
    data:H.map(h=>h[kind][n]!=null?h[kind][n]:null)}));
  lineChart(document.getElementById('memCv'),{labels:H.map(h=>h.date),h:280,series,
    yfmt:v=>'$'+(v>=100?v.toFixed(0):v.toFixed(1)),xfmt:d=>d.slice(2,7)});
  document.getElementById('memLg').innerHTML=series.map(s=>`<i style="background:${s.color}"></i>${esc(s.label)}&nbsp;&nbsp;`).join('');
}

/* ══════════ 수급 연속 (data/streak.json — streak3_tg.py 평일 06:30) ══════════
   텔레그램으로는 사모만 나가고, 4주체 전체 + 일자별 아카이브는 여기에만 있다. */
let SK=null,skCat='samo',skDate=null;
async function skLoad(){
  const meta=document.getElementById('skMeta');
  if(!SK){
    try{SK=await getJson('data/streak.json');}
    catch(e){meta.textContent='데이터가 아직 없습니다 — 평일 06:30 빌드 후 이용 가능합니다.';return;}
    skDate=SK.base_dt;
  }
  skRender();
}
function skRender(){
  const meta=document.getElementById('skMeta'),body=document.getElementById('skBody');
  const dates=Object.keys(SK.history).sort().reverse();
  if(!dates.length){meta.textContent='기록이 없습니다.';return;}
  if(!SK.history[skDate])skDate=dates[0];
  const e=SK.history[skDate],rows=e[skCat]||[];
  const ymd=s=>s.slice(0,4)+'-'+s.slice(4,6)+'-'+s.slice(6);
  const span=e.dts?`${ymd(e.dts[e.dts.length-1])} ~ ${ymd(e.dts[0])}`:ymd(skDate);
  meta.innerHTML=`기준일 <b>${esc(ymd(skDate))}</b> · 연속 <b>${e.days}거래일</b> (${esc(span)}) · `
    +`${esc(SK.criteria)} · ${esc(SK.updated)} 갱신`;
  const f1=v=>v.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{minimumFractionDigits:1,maximumFractionDigits:1});
  const cap=v=>v>=10000?(v/10000).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:1})+'조'
                       :v.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:0})+'억';
  body.innerHTML=`
  <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px">
    <div class="rngwrap" id="skCatBar">${SK.cats.map(c=>
      `<button class="rng${skCat===c.key?' on':''}" data-c="${c.key}">${c.icon} ${esc(c.label)} ${(e[c.key]||[]).length}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="rngwrap" id="skDateBar" style="margin-left:auto;max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto">${
      dates.slice(0,12).map(d=>`<button class="rng${d===skDate?' on':''}" data-d="${d}">${d.slice(4,6)}/${d.slice(6)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>
  <div class="rcard"><div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="ddt"><thead><tr>
    <th>#</th><th style="text-align:left">종목</th><th>종가</th><th>등락률</th>
    <th>시총대비 누적</th><th>순매수</th><th>시총</th><th style="text-align:left">일별 시총대비 (과거→최근)</th>
    </tr></thead><tbody>
    ${rows.length?rows.map((r,i)=>`<tr><td style="color:var(--dim2)">${i+1}</td>
      <td style="text-align:left;font-weight:700"><a href="#" data-qc="${r.code}" style="color:var(--text);text-decoration:none">${esc(r.name)}</a> <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--dim2);font-size:11px">${r.code} · ${esc(r.mkt)}</span></td>
      <td>${r.close.toLocaleString('ko-KR')}</td><td>${qtChg(r.ch)}</td>
      <td class="up" style="font-weight:700">+${f1(r.sum_ratio)}%</td>
      <td>${cap(r.sum_eok)}</td><td>${cap(r.mcap_eok)}</td>
      <td style="text-align:left;color:var(--dim2);font-size:11.5px">${r.ratios.map(v=>f1(v)).join(' · ')}</td></tr>`).join('')
      :'<tr><td colspan="8" style="color:var(--dim2);padding:18px">해당 종목 없음</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div>
    <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:9px">${esc(SK.note||'')} · 종목명 클릭 시 종목 분석 탭으로 이동</div></div>`;
  document.getElementById('skCatBar').onclick=ev=>{const b=ev.target.closest('[data-c]');if(b){skCat=b.dataset.c;skRender();}};
  document.getElementById('skDateBar').onclick=ev=>{const b=ev.target.closest('[data-d]');if(b){skDate=b.dataset.d;skRender();}};
  body.querySelectorAll('[data-qc]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',ev=>{
    ev.preventDefault();qtSel=a.dataset.qc;openTab('quote');qtRender();}));
}

/* ══════════ 韓 신고가 60일·52주 (data/krhigh.json — 키움 ka10081 전수판정) ══════════ */
let KH=null,khMkt='all',khSort='flu',khWin='d60';
async function khLoad(){
  const meta=document.getElementById('khMeta');
  if(!KH){
    try{KH=await getJson('data/krhigh.json');}
    catch(e){meta.textContent='데이터가 아직 없습니다 — 평일 21:35 빌드 후 이용 가능합니다.';return;}
  }
  khRender();
}
function khRender(){
  const meta=document.getElementById('khMeta'),body=document.getElementById('khBody');
  const has52=!!(KH.w52&&KH.w52.kospi),has20=!!(KH.d20&&KH.d20.kospi);
  if((khWin==='w52'&&!has52)||(khWin==='d20'&&!has20))khWin='d60';
  const src=khWin==='w52'?KH.w52:khWin==='d20'?KH.d20:KH;
  const judge=khWin==='w52'?'당일 종가가 최근 250거래일(52주) 최고 종가와 일치'
    :`당일 장중 고가가 최근 ${khWin==='d20'?'20':'60'}거래일 최고 고가와 일치`;
  const all=[...src.kospi.map(r=>({...r,mkt:'코스피'})),...src.kosdaq.map(r=>({...r,mkt:'코스닥'}))];
  const show=(khMkt==='all'?all:all.filter(r=>r.mkt===khMkt))
    .sort((a,b)=>khSort==='flu'?b.flu-a.flu:b.val_eok-a.val_eok);
  meta.innerHTML=`기준일 <b>${esc(KH.base_dt)}</b> · <b>${all.length}종목</b> (코스피 ${src.kospi.length} · 코스닥 ${src.kosdaq.length}) · ${esc(src.criteria||KH.criteria)} · ${KH.updated} 갱신`;
  const f0=v=>v==null?'—':v.toLocaleString('ko-KR');
  body.innerHTML=`
  <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px">
    <div class="rngwrap" id="khWinBar">
      <button class="rng${khWin==='d20'?' on':''}" data-w="d20"${has20?'':' disabled title="다음 빌드부터 제공"'}>20일 신고가</button>
      <button class="rng${khWin==='d60'?' on':''}" data-w="d60">60일 신고가</button>
      <button class="rng${khWin==='w52'?' on':''}" data-w="w52"${has52?'':' disabled title="구버전 데이터 — 다음 빌드부터 제공"'}>52주 신고가</button></div>
    <div class="rngwrap" id="khMktBar">
      <button class="rng${khMkt==='all'?' on':''}" data-m="all">전체 ${all.length}</button>
      <button class="rng${khMkt==='코스피'?' on':''}" data-m="코스피">코스피 ${src.kospi.length}</button>
      <button class="rng${khMkt==='코스닥'?' on':''}" data-m="코스닥">코스닥 ${src.kosdaq.length}</button></div>
    <div class="rngwrap" id="khSortBar" style="margin-left:auto">
      <button class="rng${khSort==='flu'?' on':''}" data-s="flu">등락률순</button>
      <button class="rng${khSort==='val'?' on':''}" data-s="val">거래대금순</button></div></div>
  <div class="rcard"><div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="ddt"><thead><tr>
    <th>#</th><th style="text-align:left">종목</th><th>종가</th><th>등락률</th><th>거래대금</th><th>시총</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${show.map((r,i)=>`<tr><td style="color:var(--dim2)">${i+1}</td>
      <td style="text-align:left;font-weight:700"><a href="#" data-qc="${r.code}" style="color:var(--text);text-decoration:none">${esc(r.name)}</a> <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--dim2);font-size:11px">${r.code} · ${r.mkt}</span></td>
      <td>${f0(r.close)}</td><td>${qtChg(r.flu)}</td>
      <td>${f0(r.val_eok)}억</td><td>${r.mac_eok>=10000?(r.mac_eok/10000).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:1})+'조':f0(r.mac_eok)+'억'}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>
    <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:9px">신고가 판정 = ${judge}(키움 일봉 전수) · 종목명 클릭 시 종목 분석 탭으로 이동</div></div>`;
  document.getElementById('khWinBar').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-w]');if(b&&!b.disabled){khWin=b.dataset.w;khRender();}};
  document.getElementById('khMktBar').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-m]');if(b){khMkt=b.dataset.m;khRender();}};
  document.getElementById('khSortBar').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-s]');if(b){khSort=b.dataset.s;khRender();}};
  body.querySelectorAll('[data-qc]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    e.preventDefault();qtSel=a.dataset.qc;openTab('quote');qtRender();}));
}

/* ══════════ 美 신고가 20일·60일·52주 (data/usnewhigh.json — TradingView 스캐너) ══════════ */
let UH=null,uhSector='all',uhWin='w52';
async function uhLoad(){
  const meta=document.getElementById('uhMeta');
  if(!UH){
    try{UH=await getJson('data/usnewhigh.json');}
    catch(e){meta.textContent='데이터가 아직 없습니다 — 매일 아침 06:40 빌드 후 이용 가능합니다.';return;}
  }
  uhRender();
}
function uhRender(){
  const meta=document.getElementById('uhMeta'),body=document.getElementById('uhBody');
  const has60=!!(UH.d60&&UH.d60.items),has20=!!(UH.d20&&UH.d20.items);
  if((uhWin==='d60'&&!has60)||(uhWin==='d20'&&!has20))uhWin='w52';
  const src=uhWin==='w52'?{items:UH.items,criteria:UH.criteria}:UH[uhWin];
  const items=src.items||[];
  const bySec={};items.forEach(r=>{bySec[r.sector]=(bySec[r.sector]||0)+1;});
  const secs=Object.entries(bySec).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  if(uhSector!=='all'&&!bySec[uhSector])uhSector='all';
  const show=uhSector==='all'?items:items.filter(r=>r.sector===uhSector);
  meta.innerHTML=`미국 세션 <b>${UH.session}</b> · <b>${items.length}종목</b> 신고가 · ${esc(src.criteria||'')} · ${UH.updated} 갱신`;
  body.innerHTML=`
  <div class="rngwrap" style="margin-bottom:12px" id="uhWinBar">
    <button class="rng${uhWin==='d20'?' on':''}" data-w="d20"${has20?'':' disabled title="다음 빌드부터 제공"'}>20일 신고가</button>
    <button class="rng${uhWin==='d60'?' on':''}" data-w="d60"${has60?'':' disabled title="다음 빌드부터 제공"'}>60일 신고가</button>
    <button class="rng${uhWin==='w52'?' on':''}" data-w="w52">52주 신고가</button></div>
  <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px" id="uhSecBar">
    <button class="rng${uhSector==='all'?' on':''}" data-sec="all" style="font-size:11.5px;padding:5px 11px">전체 ${items.length}</button>
    ${secs.map(([s,n])=>`<button class="rng${uhSector===s?' on':''}" data-sec="${esc(s)}" style="font-size:11.5px;padding:5px 11px">${esc(s)} ${n}</button>`).join('')}</div>
  <div class="rcard"><div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="ddt"><thead><tr>
    <th>#</th><th style="text-align:left">티커</th><th style="text-align:left">기업명</th><th style="text-align:left">섹터</th><th style="text-align:left">업종</th><th>시총($B)</th><th>등락률</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${show.map((r,i)=>`<tr><td style="color:var(--dim2)">${i+1}</td>
      <td style="text-align:left;font-weight:800">${esc(r.ticker)}</td>
      <td style="text-align:left">${esc(r.nm)}</td>
      <td style="text-align:left;color:var(--dim)">${esc(r.sector)}</td>
      <td style="text-align:left;color:var(--dim2);font-size:11.5px">${esc(r.industry)}</td>
      <td>${r.capB.toLocaleString('en-US')}</td>
      <td class="${r.chg>=0?'up':'down'}">${r.chg>=0?'+':''}${r.chg.toFixed(1)}%</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
  document.getElementById('uhWinBar').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-w]');if(b&&!b.disabled){uhWin=b.dataset.w;uhRender();}};
  document.getElementById('uhSecBar').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-sec]');if(b){uhSector=b.dataset.sec;uhRender();}};
}

/* ══════════ RS 분석 (섹터·테마 ETF 상대강도 — 태린이아빠 방식) ══════════ */
let RS=null,RSSEC=null,rsMkt='kr',rsSort='navg';
async function rsLoad(){
  if(!RS){
    try{RS=await getJson('data/rs.json');}
    catch(e){document.getElementById('rsMeta').textContent='RS 데이터가 아직 없습니다 — 평일 17시 빌드 후 이용 가능합니다.';return;}
  }
  if(RSSEC===null){try{RSSEC=await getJson('data/rs_sectors.json');}catch(e){RSSEC=false;}}
  rsSecRender();
  rsRender();
}
/* ── 섹터 RS 로테이션(RS 맵) — RS 탭 상단 ── */
function rsSecRender(){
  const el=document.getElementById('rsSectors');if(!el)return;
  if(!RSSEC||!RSSEC.sectors){el.innerHTML='';return;}
  const S=RSSEC.sectors,bd=RSSEC.base_dt||'';
  const dt=bd.length>=8?`${bd.slice(0,4)}.${bd.slice(4,6)}.${bd.slice(6,8)}`:bd;
  const cap=v=>v.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:1})+'조';
  const chg=v=>`<span class="${v>=0?'up':'down'}">${v>=0?'+':''}${v.toFixed(2)}%</span>`;
  el.innerHTML=`
  <div class="ptitle" style="font-size:16px;margin:2px 0 4px">섹터 로테이션 <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--dim2)">시장 대비 상대강도(RS)로 보는 섹터 로테이션</span></div>
  <div class="rgrid2" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px">
    <div class="rcard" style="padding:13px 16px"><div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint)">섹터</div><div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:800">${RSSEC.n_sec}개</div></div>
    <div class="rcard" style="padding:13px 16px"><div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint)">합산 시총</div><div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:800">${RSSEC.total_cap.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:1})}조</div></div>
    <div class="rcard" style="padding:13px 16px"><div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint)">기준일</div><div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:800">${dt}</div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="rcard" style="margin-bottom:14px">
    <h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:2px">RS 맵 <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:600">크기=시총 · 색=5일 등락 · 가로=장기RS(60일) · 세로=단기RS(10일)</span></h3>
    <div style="position:relative"><canvas id="rsMapCv" style="width:100%"></canvas></div>
    <div class="clegend" style="margin-top:4px"><i style="background:var(--up)"></i>5일 상승&nbsp;&nbsp;<i style="background:var(--down)"></i>5일 하락&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="color:var(--dim2)">사분면: 부상(좌상) · 주도(우상) · 소외(좌하) · 쇠퇴(우하)</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="rcard" style="margin-bottom:16px">
    <h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:8px">산업(섹터) 구성 <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:600">시총순</span></h3>
    <div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="ddt"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">섹터</th><th>강도</th><th>테마 수</th><th>섹터 시총</th><th>상대 비중</th><th>5일 등락</th><th>장기 RS</th><th>단기 RS</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${S.map(r=>`<tr><td style="text-align:left;font-weight:700">${esc(r.name)}</td>
      <td><span style="font-size:10.5px;color:${r.strong?'#e0a457':'var(--dim2)'}">●</span> ${r.strong?'강세':'약세'}</td>
      <td>${r.nth}개</td><td>${cap(r.cap)}</td><td>${r.w.toFixed(1)}%</td><td>${chg(r.chg5)}</td>
      <td><b style="color:${r.rs_long>=50?'var(--accent)':'var(--dim2)'}">${r.rs_long}</b></td>
      <td>${r.rs_short}</td></tr>`).join('')}
    </tbody></table></div>
    <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:8px">장기/단기 RS = 60일/10일 시총가중 수익률의 섹터 내 백분위(0~100) · 강세=장기RS≥50 · 종목→테마→섹터(GICS 산업그룹) 집계</div>
  </div>`;
  drawRsMap(document.getElementById('rsMapCv'),S);
}
let rsMapGeo=null;
function drawRsMap(cv,S){
  if(!cv)return;
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1,W=cv.clientWidth||900,H=Math.max(400,Math.min(580,W*0.56));
  cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;cv.style.height=H+'px';
  const x=cv.getContext('2d');x.scale(dpr,dpr);x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const cs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement),V=n=>cs.getPropertyValue(n).trim();
  const UP=V('--up')||'#f04452',DN=V('--down')||'#3485fa';                 // 상승 빨강 / 하락 파랑
  const P={l:48,r:20,t:16,b:34},IW=W-P.l-P.r,IH=H-P.t-P.b,PAD=6;           // 가장자리 인셋
  const sc=v=>PAD+(100-2*PAD)*Math.max(0,Math.min(100,v))/100;
  const px=v=>P.l+IW*sc(v)/100, py=v=>P.t+IH*(1-sc(v)/100);
  // 사분면 라벨 (코너, 아주 옅게 → 버블과 겹쳐도 방해 안 되게)
  x.textAlign='center';x.globalAlpha=.20;x.fillStyle=V('--faint');
  [['부상','미래 주도 후보',17,90],['주도','현재 시장 주도',83,90],['소외','관망',17,10],['쇠퇴','힘 빠지는 중',83,10]]
    .forEach(([t,sub,qx,qy])=>{x.font='800 14px Pretendard';x.fillText(t,px(qx),py(qy));x.font='500 10px Pretendard';x.fillText(sub,px(qx),py(qy)+14);});
  x.globalAlpha=1;
  // 십자선(50 기준)
  x.strokeStyle=V('--line');x.lineWidth=1;x.setLineDash([4,4]);
  x.beginPath();x.moveTo(px(50),P.t);x.lineTo(px(50),P.t+IH);x.moveTo(P.l,py(50));x.lineTo(P.l+IW,py(50));x.stroke();x.setLineDash([]);
  // 축
  x.fillStyle=V('--dim2');x.font='10px Pretendard';x.textAlign='center';
  x.fillText('장기 RS (60거래일) →',W/2,H-9);
  x.save();x.translate(14,H/2);x.rotate(-Math.PI/2);x.fillText('단기 RS (10거래일) →',0,0);x.restore();
  // 버블: 완만한 스케일 + 상한 축소(51% 반도체가 코너를 다 덮지 않도록)
  const cmax=Math.max(...S.map(r=>r.cap),1);
  const rad=c=>7+Math.pow(c/cmax,0.42)*18;                                 // 최대 ~25px
  rsMapGeo={pts:S.map(r=>({r,cx:px(r.rs_long),cy:py(r.rs_short),rr:rad(r.cap)}))};
  const order=[...rsMapGeo.pts].sort((a,b)=>b.rr-a.rr);                    // 큰 것 먼저(뒤에)
  order.forEach(p=>{const up=p.r.chg5>=0;x.beginPath();x.arc(p.cx,p.cy,p.rr,0,7);
    x.fillStyle=up?'rgba(240,68,82,.74)':'rgba(52,133,250,.74)';x.fill();
    x.lineWidth=1.2;x.strokeStyle=up?UP:DN;x.stroke();});
  // 라벨: 큰 버블 우선, 위/아래/옆 후보 중 안 겹치는 곳에만(겹치면 생략 → 호버로)
  x.font='600 11px Pretendard';
  const placed=[];const fits=b=>!placed.some(o=>!(b[2]<o[0]||b[0]>o[2]||b[3]<o[1]||b[1]>o[3]));
  order.forEach(p=>{if(p.rr<8.5)return;
    const nm=p.r.name.length>8?p.r.name.slice(0,7)+'…':p.r.name;
    const w=x.measureText(nm).width;
    for(const [lx,ly] of [[p.cx,p.cy-p.rr-6],[p.cx,p.cy+p.rr+13],[p.cx+p.rr+w/2+5,p.cy+4],[p.cx-p.rr-w/2-5,p.cy+4]]){
      const b=[lx-w/2-2,ly-11,lx+w/2+2,ly+3];
      if(lx-w/2<P.l-2||lx+w/2>W-P.r+2)continue;
      if(fits(b)){placed.push(b);x.textAlign='center';x.fillStyle=V('--text');x.fillText(nm,lx,ly);break;}}});
  cv.onmousemove=e=>{if(!rsMapGeo)return;const rect=cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mx=e.clientX-rect.left,my=e.clientY-rect.top;
    let hit=null;for(const p of rsMapGeo.pts){if((mx-p.cx)**2+(my-p.cy)**2<=p.rr*p.rr){if(!hit||p.rr<hit.rr)hit=p;}}
    const tt=document.getElementById('rstt')||(()=>{const d=document.createElement('div');d.id='rstt';
      d.style.cssText='position:fixed;z-index:60;display:none;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 11px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text);pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.4)';document.body.appendChild(d);return d;})();
    if(!hit){tt.style.display='none';return;}
    const r=hit.r;tt.innerHTML=`<b>${esc(r.name)}</b> ${r.strong?'<span style="color:#e0a457">강세</span>':'<span style="color:var(--dim2)">약세</span>'}<br>시총 ${r.cap.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:1})}조 · 비중 ${r.w.toFixed(1)}%<br>장기RS <b>${r.rs_long}</b> · 단기RS <b>${r.rs_short}</b> · 5일 <span class="${r.chg5>=0?'up':'down'}">${r.chg5>=0?'+':''}${r.chg5.toFixed(2)}%</span>`;
    tt.style.display='block';tt.style.left=Math.min(e.clientX+14,innerWidth-220)+'px';tt.style.top=(e.clientY+14)+'px';};
  cv.onmouseleave=()=>{const tt=document.getElementById('rstt');if(tt)tt.style.display='none';};
}
function rsRender(){
  const mk=RS[rsMkt],items=[...(mk.items||[])];
  const meta=document.getElementById('rsMeta'),body=document.getElementById('rsBody');
  meta.innerHTML=`${esc(RS.method)} · 벤치마크 <b>${esc(mk.bench)}</b> · ${RS.updated} 갱신`;
  const key=rsSort;
  items.sort((a,b)=>((b[key]==null?-1e9:b[key])-(a[key]==null?-1e9:a[key])));
  const leaders=mk.items.filter(r=>(r.navg||0)>=70);
  const fmt=(v,d)=>v==null?'<span style="color:var(--dim2)">—</span>':v.toFixed(d==null?2:d);
  const fRS=v=>v==null?'<span style="color:var(--dim2)">—</span>':`<span class="${v>=0?'up':'down'}">${v>0?'+':''}${v.toFixed(1)}</span>`;
  const fN=v=>{if(v==null)return '<span style="color:var(--dim2)">—</span>';
    const c=v>=90?'font-weight:800;color:var(--accent)':v>=70?'font-weight:700;color:var(--accent)':v<30?'color:var(--dim2)':'';
    return `<span style="${c}">${v.toFixed(0)}</span>`;};
  let html=`<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px">
    <div class="rngwrap" id="rsMktBar">
      <button class="rng${rsMkt==='kr'?' on':''}" data-k="kr">韓 한국 ETF</button>
      <button class="rng${rsMkt==='us'?' on':''}" data-k="us">美 미국 ETF</button></div>
    <div class="rngwrap" id="rsSortBar" style="margin-left:auto">
      <button class="rng${rsSort==='navg'?' on':''}" data-s="navg">Norm 평균</button>
      <button class="rng${rsSort==='srk'?' on':''}" data-s="srk">소티노</button>
      <button class="rng${rsSort==='rs60'?' on':''}" data-s="rs60">RS 60일</button>
      <button class="rng${rsSort==='rs250'?' on':''}" data-s="rs250">RS 250일</button></div></div>`;
  html+=`<div class="rcard" style="padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:14px">
    <div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:8px">주도 시그널 — Norm RS 평균 ≥ 70 (${leaders.length}개)</div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap">${leaders.map(r=>
      `<span style="font-size:11.5px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(77,125,245,.12);color:var(--accent);font-weight:700" title="${esc(r.name)}">${esc(rsMkt==='us'?r.t:r.name)} ${r.navg.toFixed(0)}</span>`).join('')||'<span style="color:var(--dim2);font-size:12px">없음</span>'}</div></div>`;
  if(rsMkt==='kr'&&RS.krstocks){
    const ks=RS.krstocks;
    const fSgn=v=>v==null?'—':`<span class="${v>=0?'up':'down'}">${v>0?'+':''}${v.toFixed(1)}%</span>`;
    html+=`<div class="rcard" style="padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:14px">
      <div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:8px">개별 종목 주도주 — RS종합 상위 20 (시총 2,000억↑ ${ks.n_universe}종목 중)</div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap">${ks.leaders.map(r=>
        `<span style="font-size:11.5px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(77,125,245,.12);color:var(--accent);font-weight:700" title="${r.c} · RS20 ${r.rs20}">${esc(r.n)} ${r.rsc.toFixed(0)}</span>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
    html+=`<div class="rcard" style="margin-bottom:14px"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:8px">🌱 떠오르는 주도주 가능성 TOP 10 <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:600">RS 가속 + 거래대금 — 기존 주도주 제외</span></h3>
      <div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="ddt"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th style="text-align:left">종목</th>
      <th>가능성점수</th><th>RS가속</th><th>RS20</th><th>RS종합</th><th>거래대금(20일)</th><th>3개월 수익률</th></tr></thead><tbody>
      ${ks.risers.map((r,i)=>`<tr><td style="color:var(--dim2)">${i+1}</td>
        <td style="text-align:left;font-weight:700">${esc(r.n)} <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--dim2);font-size:11px">${r.c}</span></td>
        <td style="font-weight:800;color:var(--accent)">${r.score.toFixed(1)}</td>
        <td>${fSgn(r.acc).replace('%','')}</td><td>${r.rs20.toFixed(1)}</td><td>${r.rsc.toFixed(1)}</td>
        <td>${r.v20.toLocaleString('ko-KR')}억</td><td>${fSgn(r.r60)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:9px">RS20·RS종합 = 20일 / 3·6·12개월(0.5·0.3·0.2 가중) 수익률의 유니버스 백분위 · RS가속 = RS20 − RS종합 · 가능성점수 = 0.45×RS20 + 0.35×(50+가속) + 0.20×거래대금점수 · 조건: RS종합<85, RS20≥70, 거래대금 50억↑</div></div>`;
  }
  html+=`<div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:8px">${rsMkt==='kr'?'섹터·테마 ETF 상대강도':'섹터·테마 ETF 상대강도'}</h3><div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="ddt"><thead><tr>
    <th>#</th><th style="text-align:left">${rsMkt==='us'?'티커':'코드'}</th><th style="text-align:left">이름</th>
    <th>RS 60d</th><th>RS 120d</th><th>RS 250d</th><th>RS 평균</th>
    <th>N60</th><th>N120</th><th>N250</th><th>N평균</th><th>소티노</th><th>소티노%</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${items.map((r,i)=>`<tr${(r.navg||0)>=70?' style="background:rgba(77,125,245,.07)"':''}>
      <td style="color:var(--dim2)">${i+1}</td>
      <td style="text-align:left;font-weight:700">${esc(r.t)}</td>
      <td style="text-align:left">${esc(r.name)}</td>
      <td>${fRS(r.rs60)}</td><td>${fRS(r.rs120)}</td><td>${fRS(r.rs250)}</td><td>${fRS(r.rsavg)}</td>
      <td>${fN(r.n60)}</td><td>${fN(r.n120)}</td><td>${fN(r.n250)}</td><td>${fN(r.navg)}</td>
      <td>${fmt(r.srt)}</td><td>${fN(r.srk)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>
    <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:10px">RS = 같은 기간 벤치마크 대비 상대수익(%) · Norm = 유니버스 내 백분위(0~100) · 소티노 = 60일 하방변동 대비 수익(연율) · ETF는 시그널용 — 주도 섹터 판별 후 개별 종목은 신고가·컨센 상향과 교집합으로 접근 (태린이아빠 방식)</div></div>`;
  body.innerHTML=html;
  document.getElementById('rsMktBar').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-k]');if(b){rsMkt=b.dataset.k;rsRender();}};
  document.getElementById('rsSortBar').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-s]');if(b){rsSort=b.dataset.s;rsRender();}};
}

/* ══════════ 종목 분석 (전 종목 검색 + TradingView 차트 + 네이버 기본정보) ══════════ */
let QT=null,QTX=null,qtSel=null,qtCv='day',qtStyle='candle',qtRng='1Y',qtMA=new Set([20,60]);
async function needExt(){
  if(!QTX){try{QTX=await getJson('data/quotes_ext.json');}catch(e){QTX={s:{},idx:{}};}}
  return QTX;
}
async function qtLoad(){
  if(!QT){
    try{QT=await getJson('data/quotes.json');}
    catch(e){document.getElementById('qtMeta').textContent='종목 데이터가 아직 없습니다 — 평일 16:20 빌드 후 이용 가능합니다.';return;}
    document.getElementById('qtMeta').innerHTML=`코스피·코스닥 <b>${QT.stocks.length.toLocaleString()}종목</b> 검색 · 차트 TradingView Lightweight(일봉 2년) · 기본정보 네이버증권 <span style="color:var(--dim2)">${QT.updated} 갱신</span>`;
  }
  if(qtSel)qtRender(); /* 테마 토글/리사이즈 재진입 시 차트 재생성 */
}
function qtSearchRun(q){
  const drop=document.getElementById('qtDrop');
  q=q.trim().toLowerCase();
  if(!QT||!q){drop.style.display='none';return;}
  const hits=QT.stocks.filter(s=>s.n.toLowerCase().includes(q)||s.c.startsWith(q))
    .sort((a,b)=>(b.v||0)-(a.v||0)).slice(0,12);
  if(!hits.length){drop.style.display='none';return;}
  drop.innerHTML=hits.map(s=>`<div class="qthit" data-c="${s.c}" style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:9px;padding:9px 14px;cursor:pointer">
    <b style="font-size:13px">${esc(s.n)}</b><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2)">${s.c} · ${s.m==='KS'?'코스피':'코스닥'}</span>
    <span style="margin-left:auto;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim)">${qtCap(s.v)}</span></div>`).join('');
  drop.style.display='block';
}
const qtCap=v=>v==null?'—':v>=10000?(v/10000).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:1})+'조':v.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:0})+'억';
const qtNum=(v,d)=>v==null?'—':v.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?2:d});
const qtChg=v=>v==null?'':`<span class="${v>=0?'up':'down'}">${v>=0?'▲':'▼'}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(2)}%</span>`;
let qtTab='ov',qtFlowN=20;
const QT_TABS=[['ov','종목개요','요약 · 차트 · 컨센서스'],['val','밸류에이션','PER·PBR 밴드 · Peer'],['flow','수급','외국인 · 기관 · 개인'],['fin','재무','실적 추이 · 컨센서스'],['news','리포트·링크','최신 소식']];
function qtRender(){
  const s=QT&&QT.stocks.find(x=>x.c===qtSel);if(!s)return;
  const body=document.getElementById('qtBody');
  const up=s.f>=0;
  const chgAbs=(s.p!=null&&s.f!=null)?Math.round(s.p-s.p/(1+s.f/100)):null;
  const pos52=(s.h52&&s.l52&&s.p&&s.h52>s.l52)?Math.min(100,Math.max(0,(s.p-s.l52)/(s.h52-s.l52)*100)):null;
  body.innerHTML=`
  <div class="rcard" style="padding:20px 22px;margin-bottom:16px">
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px">
      <div>
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
          <span style="font-size:21px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em">${esc(s.n)}</span>
          <span class="qtchip">${s.c} · ${s.m==='KS'?'KOSPI':'KOSDAQ'}</span>
          ${s.sec?`<span class="qtchip">${esc(s.sec)}</span>`:''}
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap">
          <span class="num ${up?'up':'down'}" style="font-size:33px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em">${qtNum(s.p,0)}</span>
          <span class="${up?'up':'down'}" style="font-size:15px;font-weight:600">${up?'▲':'▼'} ${chgAbs==null?'':Math.abs(chgAbs).toLocaleString('ko-KR')} (${s.f>=0?'+':''}${(s.f??0).toFixed(2)}%)</span>
          <span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--dim2)">원 · 일별 종가 기준</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,auto);gap:10px 28px;font-size:12.5px">
        ${[['시가총액',qtCap(s.v)],['PER',qtNum(s.per)+'배'],['PBR',qtNum(s.pbr)+'배'],['배당수익률',qtNum(s.dvr)+'%'],['거래대금',s.tv==null?'—':(s.tv>=10000?(s.tv/10000).toFixed(2)+'조':Math.round(s.tv).toLocaleString('ko-KR')+'억')]].map(([l,v])=>
          `<div><div style="color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:4px">${l}</div><div style="font-weight:700">${v}</div></div>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>
    ${pos52!=null?`<div style="margin-top:16px">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:6px">
        <span>52주 최저 ${qtNum(s.l52,0)}</span><span>52주 최고 ${qtNum(s.h52,0)}</span></div>
      <div style="position:relative;height:4px;background:var(--line);border-radius:2px">
        <div style="position:absolute;left:0;width:${pos52.toFixed(1)}%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(77,125,245,.35),var(--accent));border-radius:2px"></div>
        <div style="position:absolute;left:${pos52.toFixed(1)}%;top:-3px;width:10px;height:10px;margin-left:-5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);border:2px solid var(--surface);box-sizing:border-box"></div>
      </div></div>`:''}
  </div>
  <div id="qtLayout">
    <nav id="qtSubNav">${QT_TABS.map(([k,t,c])=>`<button class="qtnav${qtTab===k?' on':''}" data-qtab="${k}"><b>${t}</b><small>${c}</small></button>`).join('')}</nav>
    <main id="qtView" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;min-width:0"></main>
  </div>`;
  document.getElementById('qtSubNav').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-qtab]');if(!b)return;
    qtTab=b.dataset.qtab;qtViewRender(s);};
  qtViewRender(s);
  needExt().then(()=>{if(qtSel===s.c&&!document.getElementById('qtView').dataset.extDone){
    document.getElementById('qtView').dataset.extDone='1';qtViewRender(s);}});
}
function qtViewRender(s){
  const view=document.getElementById('qtView');if(!view||qtSel!==s.c)return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.qtnav').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.qtab===qtTab));
  if(QTX)view.dataset.extDone='1';
  ({ov:qtViewOv,val:qtViewVal,flow:qtViewFlow,fin:qtViewFin,news:qtViewNews}[qtTab]||qtViewOv)(s,view);
}
/* ── 뷰 1: 종목개요 ── */
function qtViewOv(s,view){
  const gain=s.tgt&&s.p?((s.tgt/s.p-1)*100):null;
  const recPct=s.rec?Math.min(100,s.rec/5*100):null;
  const e=(QTX&&QTX.s||{})[s.c];
  const idx=(QTX&&QTX.idx||{})[s.m]||{};
  const rel=(r,ir)=>(r==null||ir==null)?null:r-ir;
  const cell=v=>v==null?'—':`<span class="${v>=0?'up':'down'}">${v>=0?'+':''}${v.toFixed(1)}%</span>`;
  view.innerHTML=`
  <div class="rcard" style="padding:14px">
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px">
      <div class="rngwrap" id="qtCvBar">${[['day','일'],['week','주'],['month','월'],['y5','5년']].map(([k,l])=>`<button class="rng${qtCv===k?' on':''}" data-cv="${k}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="rngwrap" id="qtStyleBar">${[['candle','캔들'],['line','라인']].map(([k,l])=>`<button class="rng${qtStyle===k?' on':''}" data-st="${k}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div>
      <div id="qtMaBar" style="display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap">${[5,10,20,60,120].map(w=>`<button class="rng${qtMA.has(w)?' on':''}" data-ma="${w}" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 9px">MA${w}</button>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="rngwrap" id="qtRngBar" style="margin-left:auto">${[['1M','1M'],['3M','3M'],['6M','6M'],['YTD','YTD'],['1Y','1Y'],['ALL','전체']].map(([k,l])=>`<button class="rng${qtRng===k?' on':''}" data-rg="${k}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    </div>
    <div style="position:relative">
      <div id="qtLwLegend" style="position:absolute;top:8px;left:10px;z-index:5;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--sub);background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 72%, transparent);padding:4px 9px;border-radius:8px;pointer-events:none"></div>
      <div id="qtLw" style="height:420px"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:7px"><span>TradingView Lightweight Charts · 일봉 2년(수정주가 ADJ) · 주/월봉은 일봉 합산, 5년은 월별 종가</span><span id="qtMaLg" style="margin-left:auto"></span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="rgrid2" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr))">
    <div class="rcard" style="padding:18px 20px">
      <h3 style="font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:12px">컨센서스</h3>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin-bottom:4px">
        <span style="font-size:24px;font-weight:800">${qtNum(s.tgt,0)}</span>
        ${gain!=null?`<span class="${gain>=0?'up':'down'}" style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700">상승여력 ${gain>=0?'+':''}${gain.toFixed(1)}%</span>`:''}
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:14px">평균 목표주가(원) · 네이버 컨센서스</div>
      ${recPct!=null?`<div style="display:flex;height:8px;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--line);margin-bottom:8px">
        <div style="width:${recPct.toFixed(0)}%;background:var(--up)"></div></div>
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--sub)">투자의견 <b style="color:var(--text)">${qtNum(s.rec)}</b> / 5점 <span style="color:var(--faint)">(높을수록 매수 우위)</span></div>`:'<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--dim2)">투자의견 데이터 없음</div>'}
    </div>
    <div class="rcard" style="padding:18px 20px">
      <h3 style="font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:12px">기업 개요</h3>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:7px 16px;font-size:12.5px">
        <span style="color:var(--faint)">업종</span><span>${esc(s.sec||'—')}</span>
        <span style="color:var(--faint)">발행주식수</span><span>${(s.v&&s.p)?qtShares(s.v,s.p):'—'}</span>
        <span style="color:var(--faint)">외국인비중</span><span>${qtNum(s.fgn)}%</span>
        <span style="color:var(--faint)">평균거래대금</span><span>${e&&e.avt!=null?e.avt.toLocaleString('ko-KR')+'억 (20일)':'—'}</span>
      </div>
      <table class="ddt" style="margin-top:12px"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">상승률</th><th>1개월</th><th>6개월</th><th>12개월</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody><tr><td style="text-align:left">절대</td><td>${cell(e&&e.r1)}</td><td>${cell(e&&e.r6)}</td><td>${cell(e&&e.r12)}</td></tr>
      <tr><td style="text-align:left">상대</td><td>${cell(e&&rel(e.r1,idx.r1))}</td><td>${cell(e&&rel(e.r6,idx.r6))}</td><td>${cell(e&&rel(e.r12,idx.r12))}</td></tr></tbody></table>
    </div>
  </div>`;
  const qtBarBind=(id,key,fn)=>{document.getElementById(id).onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest(`[data-${key}]`);if(!b)return;
    fn(b.dataset[key],b);qtDrawLw(s);};};
  qtBarBind('qtCvBar','cv',v=>{qtCv=v;document.querySelectorAll('#qtCvBar .rng').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x.dataset.cv===v));});
  qtBarBind('qtStyleBar','st',v=>{qtStyle=v;document.querySelectorAll('#qtStyleBar .rng').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x.dataset.st===v));});
  qtBarBind('qtMaBar','ma',(v,b)=>{const w=+v;qtMA.has(w)?qtMA.delete(w):qtMA.add(w);b.classList.toggle('on',qtMA.has(w));});
  qtBarBind('qtRngBar','rg',v=>{qtRng=v;document.querySelectorAll('#qtRngBar .rng').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x.dataset.rg===v));});
  qtDrawLw(s);
}
/* ── 뷰 2: 밸류에이션 (밴드 + 지표 + Peer) ── */
function qtViewVal(s,view){
  view.innerHTML=`
  <div class="rgrid2" id="qtBands" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(340px,1fr))">
    <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:8px">PER 밴드 <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:600">월별 종가 × 연간 EPS(컨센 포함)</span></h3><canvas id="qtBandPer"></canvas><div class="clegend" id="qtBandPerLg"></div></div>
    <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:8px">PBR 밴드 <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:600">월별 종가 × 연간 BPS</span></h3><canvas id="qtBandPbr"></canvas><div class="clegend" id="qtBandPbrLg"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="rgrid2" id="qtValStats" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr))"></div>
  <div id="qtPeer"></div>`;
  const e=(QTX&&QTX.s||{})[s.c];
  let perStat=null,pbrStat=null;
  if(e&&e.m&&e.fin){
    perStat=qtBandDraw(document.getElementById('qtBandPer'),document.getElementById('qtBandPerLg'),e.m,e.fin,'eps');
    pbrStat=qtBandDraw(document.getElementById('qtBandPbr'),document.getElementById('qtBandPbrLg'),e.m,e.fin,'bps');
    if(!perStat)document.getElementById('qtBandPer').parentElement.style.display='none';
    if(!pbrStat)document.getElementById('qtBandPbr').parentElement.style.display='none';
  }else{
    document.getElementById('qtBands').innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>밴드 데이터 불러오는 중…</b></div>';
  }
  const lastRev=e&&e.fin?[...e.fin].reverse().find(f=>!f.c&&f.rev):null;
  const psr=(lastRev&&s.v)?s.v/lastRev.rev:null;
  const stat=(label,val,avg)=>{
    let sub='';
    if(val!=null&&avg!=null&&avg>0){const d=(val/avg-1)*100;
      sub=`<div style="font-size:11px;margin-top:5px" class="${d<=0?'down':'up'}">5Y 평균 대비 ${d>=0?'+':''}${d.toFixed(0)}%</div>`;}
    return `<div class="rcard" style="padding:14px 16px"><div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:6px">${label}</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:800">${val==null?'—':val.toFixed(2)}</div>${sub}</div>`;};
  document.getElementById('qtValStats').innerHTML=
    stat('PER (배)',s.per,perStat&&perStat.avg)+stat('PBR (배)',s.pbr,pbrStat&&pbrStat.avg)
    +stat('추정 PER (배)',s.cper,perStat&&perStat.avg)+stat(`PSR (배)${lastRev?' · '+lastRev.y:''}`,psr,null);
  qtPeerRender(s);
}
/* ── 뷰 3: 수급 ── */
async function qtViewFlow(s,view){
  view.innerHTML=`
  <div class="rcard" style="padding:16px 18px">
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px">
      <h3 style="font-size:14px;margin:0">투자자별 순매수 <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:600">일별 · 억원 · 키움(KRX 잠정)</span></h3>
      <span style="font-size:11px;margin-left:6px"><i style="display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent);margin-right:4px"></i>외국인 <i style="display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;background:#e8b45a;margin:0 4px 0 10px"></i>기관</span>
      <div class="rngwrap" style="margin-left:auto" id="qtFlowBar">
        <button class="rng${qtFlowN===20?' on':''}" data-fn="20">20일</button>
        <button class="rng${qtFlowN===60?' on':''}" data-fn="60">60일</button></div>
    </div>
    <canvas id="qtFlowCv"></canvas>
  </div>
  <div class="rgrid2" id="qtFlowSum" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr))"></div>
  <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:8px">최근 매매동향 <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:600">순매수 주식수 · 네이버</span></h3>
    ${(s.deal&&s.deal.length)?`<table class="ddt"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">일자</th><th>외국인</th><th>기관</th><th>개인</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${s.deal.map(d=>`<tr><td style="text-align:left">${esc((d.d||'').replace(/(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})/,'$2.$3'))}</td>
      ${[d.fr,d.og,d.in].map(v=>`<td class="${v>0?'up':v<0?'down':''}">${v==null?'—':(v>0?'+':'')+v.toLocaleString('ko-KR')}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`
    :'<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--dim2)">데이터 없음</div>'}</div>`;
  document.getElementById('qtFlowBar').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-fn]');if(!b)return;
    qtFlowN=+b.dataset.fn;qtViewFlow(s,view);};
  const pack=await qtCandles(s.c);
  if(qtSel!==s.c||qtTab!=='flow')return;
  const flows=(pack&&pack.f)||[];
  const cv=document.getElementById('qtFlowCv'),sum=document.getElementById('qtFlowSum');
  if(!flows.length){if(cv)cv.outerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>수급 데이터가 아직 없습니다</b></div>';return;}
  const rows=flows.slice(-qtFlowN);
  qtFlowChart(cv,rows);
  const tot=i=>rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+(r[i]||0),0);
  const card=(label,v,color)=>`<div class="rcard" style="padding:15px 18px"><div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:6px">${label} 누적 (${qtFlowN}일)</div>
    <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:800" class="${v>=0?'up':'down'}">${v>=0?'+':''}${Math.round(v).toLocaleString('ko-KR')}억</div>
    <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:4px">${color}</div></div>`;
  sum.innerHTML=card('외국인',tot(1),'순매수 금액 합계')+card('기관',tot(2),'순매수 금액 합계')+card('개인',tot(3),'순매수 금액 합계');
}
function qtFlowChart(cv,rows){
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1,W=cv.clientWidth||cv.parentElement.clientWidth||800,H=210;
  cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;cv.style.height=H+'px';cv.style.width='100%';
  const x=cv.getContext('2d');x.scale(dpr,dpr);x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const cs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
  const P={l:46,r:8,t:8,b:18},IW=W-P.l-P.r,IH=H-P.t-P.b;
  let mx=0;rows.forEach(r=>{mx=Math.max(mx,Math.abs(r[1]||0),Math.abs(r[2]||0));});
  if(mx<=0)mx=1;
  const zero=P.t+IH/2,scale=(IH/2-4)/mx;
  x.strokeStyle=cs.getPropertyValue('--line').trim()||'#272930';x.lineWidth=1;
  x.beginPath();x.moveTo(P.l,zero);x.lineTo(W-P.r,zero);x.stroke();
  x.fillStyle=cs.getPropertyValue('--faint').trim()||'#8b95a1';x.font='10px Pretendard, sans-serif';
  x.textAlign='right';
  [mx,0,-mx].forEach(v=>{x.fillText(Math.round(v).toLocaleString('ko-KR'),P.l-6,zero-v*scale+3);});
  const gw=IW/rows.length,bw=Math.max(2,Math.min(9,gw*0.32));
  const AC=cs.getPropertyValue('--accent').trim()||'#4d7df5';
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const cx0=P.l+gw*i+gw/2;
    [[r[1],AC,-bw-1],[r[2],'#e8b45a',1]].forEach(([v,c,off])=>{
      if(v==null)return;const h=v*scale;
      x.fillStyle=c;x.fillRect(cx0+off,h>=0?zero-h:zero,bw,Math.abs(h)||1);});
    if(rows.length<=20||i%10===0){x.fillStyle=cs.getPropertyValue('--faint').trim();x.textAlign='center';
      x.fillText(r[0].slice(2,4)+'.'+r[0].slice(4),cx0,H-5);}
  });
}
/* ── 뷰 4: 재무 ── */
function qtViewFin(s,view){
  const e=(QTX&&QTX.s||{})[s.c];
  if(!e||!e.fin||!e.fin.length){view.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>재무 데이터 불러오는 중…</b></div>';return;}
  const F=e.fin;
  const mxRev=Math.max(...F.map(f=>f.rev||0),1);
  const fmt=(v,d)=>v==null?'—':v.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?1:d});
  const epsG=i=>{const a=F[i].eps,b=i>0?F[i-1].eps:null;
    return (a!=null&&b!=null&&b!==0)?((a/Math.abs(b)-1)*100):null;};
  const rows=[
    ['매출액(억)',f=>fmt(f.rev,0)],['영업이익(억)',f=>fmt(f.op,0)],['지배주주순이익(억)',f=>fmt(f.ni,0)],
    ['EPS(원)',f=>fmt(f.eps,0)],['EPS 증감률(%)',(f,i)=>{const g=epsG(i);return g==null?'—':`<span class="${g>=0?'up':'down'}">${g>=0?'+':''}${g.toFixed(1)}</span>`;}],
    ['BPS(원)',f=>fmt(f.bps,0)],['PER(배)',f=>fmt(f.per)],['PBR(배)',f=>fmt(f.pbr)],
    ['ROE(%)',f=>fmt(f.roe)],['부채비율(%)',f=>fmt(f.debt)],['주당배당금(원)',f=>fmt(f.dps,0)]];
  view.innerHTML=`
  <div class="rcard" style="padding:18px 20px">
    <h3 style="font-size:14px;margin-bottom:16px">실적 추이 <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:600">연간 매출액 · 막대 위 영업이익 · E=컨센서스</span></h3>
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:${F.length>5?'12':'26'}px;height:190px;padding:0 6px">
      ${F.map(f=>{
        const h=Math.max(8,(f.rev||0)/mxRev*140);
        const opC=(f.op??0)>=0?'':' class="down"';
        return `<div style="flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;height:100%">
          <div style="font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px"${opC}>${f.op==null?'':'OP '+fmt(f.op,0)}</div>
          <div style="width:70%;max-width:74px;height:${h}px;border-radius:6px 6px 0 0;background:${f.c?'linear-gradient(180deg,var(--accent),rgba(77,125,245,.45))':'linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(77,125,245,.55),rgba(77,125,245,.22))'}"></div>
          <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:7px">${f.y}${f.c?'E':''} · ${fmt(f.rev,0)}</div>
        </div>`;}).join('')}
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:8px">Financial Data <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:600">연간 · E = 컨센서스 추정</span></h3>
    <div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="ddt"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left"></th>
    ${F.map(f=>`<th style="${f.c?'color:var(--accent)':''}">${f.y}${f.c?'E':''}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>
    ${rows.map(([lbl,fn])=>`<tr><td style="text-align:left;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap">${lbl}</td>
      ${F.map((f,i)=>`<td style="${f.c?'background:rgba(77,125,245,.05)':''}">${fn(f,i)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}
    </tbody></table></div></div>`;
}
/* ── 뷰 5: 리포트·링크 ── */

  <div class="rcard" style="padding:18px 20px">

    ${(s.res&&s.res.length)?s.res.map(r=>`<div style="font-size:12.5px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line2)">

      <b>${esc(r.t||'')}</b><div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:4px">${esc(r.b||'')} · ${esc(r.d||'')}</div></div>`).join('')
    :'<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--dim2)">최근 리포트 없음</div>'}

    </div>

/* ── TradingView Lightweight Charts (KRX는 TV 호스팅 위젯 임베드 불가 → OSS 라이브러리 + 자체 데이터) ── */
let lwReady=null,lwChart=null,QTC={};
function needLW(){
  if(!lwReady)lwReady=new Promise((res,rej)=>{const sc=document.createElement('script');
    sc.src='https://unpkg.com/lightweight-charts@4.2.3/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js';
    sc.onload=res;sc.onerror=rej;document.head.appendChild(sc);});
  return lwReady;
}
async function qtCandles(code){
  /* 샤드 값: {"c": 캔들 500, "f": 수급 60일} (구버전 배열 호환) */
  const n=parseInt(code,10);if(isNaN(n))return null;
  const sh='c'+String(n%40).padStart(2,'0');
  if(!QTC[sh])QTC[sh]=getJson('data/candles/'+sh+'.json').catch(()=>({}));
  const v=(await QTC[sh])[code];
  if(!v)return null;
  return Array.isArray(v)?{c:v,f:[]}:v;
}
const lwDate=ymd=>'20'+ymd.slice(0,2)+'-'+ymd.slice(2,4)+'-'+ymd.slice(4,6);
function lwAgg(rows,mode){ /* 일봉 → 주봉/월봉 합산 */
  if(mode==='day')return rows;
  const out=[];let cur=null,key=null;
  for(const r of rows){
    const d=new Date(lwDate(r[0]));
    const k=mode==='week'?`${d.getFullYear()}-${Math.floor((d.getTime()/864e5-4)/7)}`:r[0].slice(0,4);
    if(k!==key){if(cur)out.push(cur);key=k;cur=[r[0],r[1],r[2],r[3],r[4],r[5]];}
    else{cur[0]=r[0];cur[2]=Math.max(cur[2],r[2]);cur[3]=Math.min(cur[3],r[3]);cur[4]=r[4];cur[5]+=r[5];}
  }
  if(cur)out.push(cur);
  return out;
}
const MA_COLORS={5:'#f0a860',10:'#e0d060',20:'#b08ad6',60:'#2dd4bf',120:'#8ab4f8'};
async function qtDrawLw(s){
  const el=document.getElementById('qtLw');if(!el)return;
  try{await needLW();}catch(e){el.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>차트 라이브러리 로드 실패</b></div>';return;}
  const code=s.c;
  let rows=null;
  if(qtCv!=='y5'){const pack=await qtCandles(code);rows=pack&&pack.c;}
  if(qtSel!==code||!document.getElementById('qtLw'))return; /* 종목/뷰 변경 가드 */
  if(lwChart){lwChart.remove();lwChart=null;}
  el.innerHTML='';
  const legend=document.getElementById('qtLwLegend'),maLg=document.getElementById('qtMaLg');
  const cs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
  const v=n=>cs.getPropertyValue(n).trim();
  lwChart=LightweightCharts.createChart(el,{
    layout:{background:{color:'transparent'},textColor:v('--sub')||'#9aa2ad',fontFamily:'Pretendard, sans-serif'},
    grid:{vertLines:{color:v('--line2')||v('--line')||'#272930'},horzLines:{color:v('--line2')||v('--line')||'#272930'}},
    rightPriceScale:{borderVisible:false},timeScale:{borderVisible:false},
    crosshair:{mode:0},autoSize:true});
  const UP='#f04452',DN='#3485fa';
  const fmtP=x=>x>=1e4?x.toLocaleString('ko-KR'):String(Math.round(x*100)/100);
  if(qtCv==='y5'){
    const e=(QTX&&QTX.s||{})[code];
    const m=e&&e.m;
    if(!m||m.length<6){el.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>장기 데이터가 아직 없습니다</b></div>';legend.innerHTML='';maLg.innerHTML='';return;}
    const line=lwChart.addAreaSeries({lineColor:'#3168f0',topColor:'rgba(49,104,240,.25)',bottomColor:'rgba(49,104,240,.02)',lineWidth:2});
    line.setData(m.map(([ym,c])=>({time:'20'+ym.slice(0,2)+'-'+ym.slice(2)+'-28',value:c})));
    legend.innerHTML=`<b>${esc(s.n)}</b> · 월별 종가 5년`;maLg.innerHTML='';
    lwChart.timeScale().fitContent();return;
  }
  if(!rows||rows.length<5){el.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>캔들 데이터가 아직 없습니다</b>평일 16:20 빌드 후 이용 가능합니다.</div>';legend.innerHTML='';return;}
  const agg=lwAgg(rows,qtCv);
  let main;
  if(qtStyle==='candle'){
    main=lwChart.addCandlestickSeries({upColor:UP,downColor:DN,borderUpColor:UP,borderDownColor:DN,wickUpColor:UP,wickDownColor:DN});
    main.setData(agg.map(r=>({time:lwDate(r[0]),open:r[1],high:r[2],low:r[3],close:r[4]})));
  }else{
    main=lwChart.addAreaSeries({lineColor:'#3168f0',topColor:'rgba(49,104,240,.22)',bottomColor:'rgba(49,104,240,.02)',lineWidth:2});
    main.setData(agg.map(r=>({time:lwDate(r[0]),value:r[4]})));
  }
  const vol=lwChart.addHistogramSeries({priceScaleId:'vol',priceFormat:{type:'volume'},lastValueVisible:false,priceLineVisible:false});
  lwChart.priceScale('vol').applyOptions({scaleMargins:{top:0.84,bottom:0}});
  vol.setData(agg.map((r,i)=>({time:lwDate(r[0]),value:r[5],
    color:(i>0&&r[4]>=agg[i-1][4])?'rgba(240,68,82,.45)':'rgba(52,133,250,.45)'})));
  /* 이동평균 (지표) */
  const closes=agg.map(r=>r[4]);
  [...qtMA].sort((a,b)=>a-b).forEach(w=>{
    if(closes.length<w+1)return;
    const ma=lwChart.addLineSeries({color:MA_COLORS[w]||'#999',lineWidth:1,lastValueVisible:false,priceLineVisible:false,crosshairMarkerVisible:false});
    const pts=[];let sum=0;
    for(let i=0;i<closes.length;i++){sum+=closes[i];if(i>=w)sum-=closes[i-w];
      if(i>=w-1)pts.push({time:lwDate(agg[i][0]),value:sum/w});}
    ma.setData(pts);});
  maLg.innerHTML=[...qtMA].sort((a,b)=>a-b).map(w=>`<span style="color:${MA_COLORS[w]}">— MA${w}</span>`).join(' ');
  /* 시고저종 레전드 (크로스헤어 연동, 기본=마지막 봉) */
  const unit={day:'일',week:'주',month:'월'}[qtCv];
  const showBar=(r,prevClose)=>{
    const ch=prevClose?((r[4]/prevClose-1)*100):null;
    const cc=ch==null?'':`<span class="${ch>=0?'up':'down'}">${ch>=0?'+':''}${ch.toFixed(2)}%</span>`;
    legend.innerHTML=`<b style="color:var(--text)">${esc(s.n)}</b> · 1${unit} · ADJ&nbsp;&nbsp;시 <b>${fmtP(r[1])}</b> 고 <b class="up">${fmtP(r[2])}</b> 저 <b class="down">${fmtP(r[3])}</b> 종 <b style="color:var(--text)">${fmtP(r[4])}</b> ${cc}`;
  };
  showBar(agg[agg.length-1],agg.length>1?agg[agg.length-2][4]:null);
  const timeMap={};agg.forEach((r,i)=>timeMap[lwDate(r[0])]=i);
  lwChart.subscribeCrosshairMove(p=>{
    if(!p||!p.time){showBar(agg[agg.length-1],agg.length>1?agg[agg.length-2][4]:null);return;}
    const i=timeMap[typeof p.time==='string'?p.time:'']; if(i==null)return;
    showBar(agg[i],i>0?agg[i-1][4]:null);
  });
  /* 레인지 */
  const last=new Date(lwDate(agg[agg.length-1][0]));
  let from=null;
  if(qtRng==='YTD')from=new Date(last.getFullYear(),0,1);
  else if(qtRng!=='ALL'){const mm={'1M':1,'3M':3,'6M':6,'1Y':12}[qtRng];
    from=new Date(last);from.setMonth(from.getMonth()-mm);}
  if(from){
    const f=from.toISOString().slice(0,10);
    const first=agg.find(r=>lwDate(r[0])>=f);
    if(first)lwChart.timeScale().setVisibleRange({from:lwDate(first[0]),to:lwDate(agg[agg.length-1][0])});
    else lwChart.timeScale().fitContent();
  }else lwChart.timeScale().fitContent();
}
const qtShares=(vEok,p)=>{const n=vEok*1e8/p;return n>=1e8?(n/1e8).toFixed(2)+'억주':(n/1e4).toFixed(0).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g,',')+'만주';};
function qtBandDraw(cv,lg,months,fin,key){
  const byY={};fin.forEach(f=>{if(f[key]!=null&&f[key]>0)byY[f.y]=f[key];});
  const years=Object.keys(byY).sort();
  if(!years.length||months.length<12)return null;
  const val=ym=>{const y='20'+ym.slice(0,2);let best=null;
    for(const yy of years){if(yy<=y)best=yy;}
    return byY[best==null?years[0]:best];};
  const ratios=[];
  months.forEach(([ym,c])=>{const v=val(ym);if(v>0&&c>0)ratios.push(c/v);});
  if(ratios.length<12)return null;
  const lo=Math.min(...ratios),hi=Math.max(...ratios);
  if(!(hi>lo))return null;
  const levels=[0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1].map(t=>lo+(hi-lo)*t);
  const grey='rgba(140,150,165,.55)';
  const series=levels.map(lv=>({color:grey,w:1,
    data:months.map(([ym])=>{const v=val(ym);return v>0?v*lv:null;})}));
  series.push({color:'#3168f0',w:2.2,data:months.map(m=>m[1])});
  lineChart(cv,{labels:months.map(m=>m[0]),h:230,pl:52,series,
    yfmt:v=>v>=1e4?(v/1e4).toFixed(1)+'만':v.toFixed(0),
    xfmt:ym=>"'"+ym.slice(0,2)+'.'+ym.slice(2)});
  lg.innerHTML=`<i style="background:#3168f0"></i>주가&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="color:var(--dim2)">밴드 ${levels.map(l=>l.toFixed(1)+'x').join(' / ')} (${key==='eps'?'PER':'PBR'} 5년 최저~최고)</span>`;
  return {avg:ratios.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/ratios.length,cur:ratios[ratios.length-1]};
}
function qtPeerRender(s){
  const el=document.getElementById('qtPeer');if(!el)return;
  if(!s.sec){el.innerHTML='';return;}
  const peers=QT.stocks.filter(x=>x.sec===s.sec).sort((a,b)=>(b.v||0)-(a.v||0)).slice(0,8);
  if(peers.length<2){el.innerHTML='';return;}
  const fmt=v=>v==null?'—':v.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:1});
  el.innerHTML=`<div class="rcard"><h3 style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:8px">Peer 비교 <span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim2);font-weight:600">${esc(s.sec)} 시총 상위 · 컨센서스 기준</span></h3>
    <div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="ddt"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">종목</th><th>시총</th><th>등락률</th><th>PER</th><th>추정PER</th><th>PBR</th><th>배당(%)</th><th>외국인(%)</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${peers.map(p=>`<tr${p.c===s.c?' style="background:rgba(77,125,245,.08)"':''}>
      <td style="text-align:left;font-weight:${p.c===s.c?'800':'600'}"><a href="#" data-qc="${p.c}" style="color:${p.c===s.c?'var(--accent)':'var(--text)'};text-decoration:none">${esc(p.n)}</a></td>
      <td>${qtCap(p.v)}</td><td>${qtChg(p.f)}</td><td>${fmt(p.per)}</td><td>${fmt(p.cper)}</td><td>${fmt(p.pbr)}</td><td>${fmt(p.dvr)}</td><td>${fmt(p.fgn)}</td></tr>`).join('')}
    </tbody></table></div>
    <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:8px">업종 분류: 키움 업종(sector_cap) 기준 · 종목 클릭 시 이동</div></div>`;
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-qc]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    e.preventDefault();qtSel=a.dataset.qc;qtRender();}));
}
(function(){
  const inp=document.getElementById('qtSearch'),drop=document.getElementById('qtDrop');
  inp.addEventListener('input',()=>qtSearchRun(inp.value));
  inp.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){const f=drop.querySelector('.qthit');if(f){qtSel=f.dataset.c;drop.style.display='none';inp.blur();qtRender();}}});
  drop.addEventListener('click',e=>{const h=e.target.closest('.qthit');if(h){qtSel=h.dataset.c;drop.style.display='none';qtRender();}});
  drop.addEventListener('mouseover',e=>{const h=e.target.closest('.qthit');if(h)h.style.background='var(--hover)';});
  drop.addEventListener('mouseout',e=>{const h=e.target.closest('.qthit');if(h)h.style.background='';});
  document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!e.target.closest('#qtSearch,#qtDrop'))drop.style.display='none';});
})();

/* ── 탭 전환 (iframe은 첫 진입 시에만 로드) ── */
const items=document.querySelectorAll('.navitem'),panels=document.querySelectorAll('.panel');
function openTab(tab){
  const btn=document.querySelector(`.navitem[data-tab="${tab}"]`);if(!btn)return;
  items.forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('on'));
  panels.forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('on'));
  btn.classList.add('on');
  const panel=document.getElementById('tab-'+tab);
  panel.classList.add('on');
  const f=panel.querySelector('iframe[data-src]');
  // 자주 갱신되는 대시보드는 10분 단위 캐시버스터를 붙여 낡은 페이지가 남지 않게 한다
  const FRESH={backlog:1,basket7:1,supply:1,worklog:1};
  if(f&&!f.src){f.src=f.dataset.src+(FRESH[tab]?'?v='+Math.floor(Date.now()/6e5):'');}
  if(tab==='telegram')loadTG(false);
  if(tab==='home')homeStart();
  if(tab==='krwrap'||tab==='uswrap')loadMW(tab);
  if(tab==='quote')qtLoad();
  if(tab==='rs')rsLoad();
  if(tab==='streak')skLoad();
  if(tab==='krhigh')khLoad();
  if(tab==='ushigh')uhLoad();
  if(tab==='raoni')raStart();
  if(tab==='caps')capsInit();
  if(tab==='gap')gapInit();
  if(tab==='etfgap')etfgLoad();
  if(tab==='dd')ddLoad();
  if(tab==='term')termStart();
  if(tab==='ram')ramLoad();
  if(tab==='deepresearch')drLoad();
  if(tab==='rrgsec'||tab==='rrgstk'||tab==='leaders')lockInit(tab);
  if(window.rrOnTab)rrOnTab(tab);
  document.getElementById('nav').classList.remove('open');
  history.replaceState(null,'','#'+tab);
}

/* ── Locked 섹션: 비밀번호 → PBKDF2/AES-GCM 복호화 → blob iframe ── */
async function lockDecrypt(pw,buf){
  const u8=new Uint8Array(buf);
  if(u8.length<33||u8[0]!==82||u8[1]!==82||u8[2]!==71||u8[3]!==49)throw new Error('잘못된 파일 형식');
  const salt=u8.slice(4,20),nonce=u8.slice(20,32),ct=u8.slice(32);
  const km=await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',new TextEncoder().encode(pw),'PBKDF2',false,['deriveKey']);
  const key=await crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:'PBKDF2',salt,iterations:200000,hash:'SHA-256'},km,
    {name:'AES-GCM',length:256},false,['decrypt']);
  const gz=await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:nonce},key,ct);
  return await new Response(new Response(gz).body.pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'))).arrayBuffer();
}
async function lockOpen(tab,pw){
  const panel=document.getElementById('tab-'+tab);
  if(panel.dataset.unlocked)return;
  const gate=panel.querySelector('.lockgate'),msg=panel.querySelector('.lockmsg'),
        btn=panel.querySelector('.lockbtn'),frame=panel.querySelector('iframe');
  btn.disabled=true;msg.textContent='여는 중…';msg.style.color='var(--faint)';
  try{
    const r=await fetch(panel.dataset.enc+'?v='+Math.floor(Date.now()/6e5));
    if(!r.ok)throw new Error('파일 로드 실패 ('+r.status+')');
    const html=await lockDecrypt(pw,await r.arrayBuffer());
    frame.src=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html],{type:'text/html'}));
    frame.style.display='block';gate.style.display='none';
    panel.dataset.unlocked='1';
    sessionStorage.setItem('rl-lock-pw',pw);
  }catch(e){
    msg.style.color='#e5484d';
    msg.textContent=(e&&(e.name==='OperationError'))?'비밀번호가 올바르지 않습니다.':('오류: '+(e.message||e));
    sessionStorage.removeItem('rl-lock-pw');
  }
  btn.disabled=false;
}
function lockInit(tab){
  const panel=document.getElementById('tab-'+tab);
  if(!panel.dataset.wired){
    panel.dataset.wired='1';
    panel.querySelector('.lockform').addEventListener('submit',ev=>{
      ev.preventDefault();
      const pw=panel.querySelector('.lockpw').value;
      if(pw)lockOpen(tab,pw);
    });
  }
  const saved=sessionStorage.getItem('rl-lock-pw');
  if(saved&&!panel.dataset.unlocked)lockOpen(tab,saved);
}
items.forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>openTab(btn.dataset.tab)));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(c=>c.addEventListener('click',()=>openTab(c.dataset.go)));
if(location.hash)openTab(location.hash.slice(1));

/* ── 탭 보관: 비밀번호(Locked와 동일, ~/.rrg_lock_pass) 검증 후 편집, 목록은 localStorage ── */
const ARCH_SALT='rl-arch-v1',
      ARCH_HASH='«HEX_REDACTED»', // rrg_publish.py가 비번 변경 시 동기화
      archNav=document.getElementById('nav'),
      archHead=document.getElementById('archHead'),
      archList=document.getElementById('archList'),
      archManage=document.getElementById('archManage'),
      archOrder=Array.from(archNav.children);           // 사이드바 원래 순서 (복원용)
let archSet=new Set(),archEdit=false;
try{const s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('rl-archived'));if(Array.isArray(s))archSet=new Set(s);}catch(_){}
function archApply(){
  archOrder.forEach(el=>archNav.appendChild(el));       // 전부 원위치 후 보관분만 아래로
  const archived=[];
  archNav.querySelectorAll('.navitem[data-tab]').forEach(b=>{
    if(b.dataset.tab!=='home'&&archSet.has(b.dataset.tab))archived.push(b);
  });
  archived.forEach(b=>archList.appendChild(b));
  archNav.querySelectorAll('.navgroup').forEach(g=>{    // 전부 보관돼 비어버린 그룹 라벨 숨김
    let el=g.nextElementSibling,has=false;
    while(el&&!el.classList.contains('navgroup')&&!el.classList.contains('archhead')){
      if(el.classList.contains('navitem')){has=true;break}
      el=el.nextElementSibling;
    }
    g.style.display=has?'':'none';
  });
  archHead.style.display=archived.length?'':'none';
  if(!archived.length)archHead.classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('archCnt').textContent=archived.length||'';
  document.querySelectorAll('.card[data-go]').forEach(c=>{c.style.display=archSet.has(c.dataset.go)?'none':'';});
  document.querySelectorAll('#tab-home .section').forEach(s=>{
    const cards=s.querySelectorAll('.card[data-go]');
    if(cards.length)s.style.display=Array.from(cards).some(c=>c.style.display!=='none')?'':'none';
  });
}
archHead.addEventListener('click',()=>archHead.classList.toggle('open'));
archNav.addEventListener('click',e=>{                   // 편집 모드: 클릭=보관 토글 (capture로 openTab 차단)
  if(!archEdit)return;
  const b=e.target.closest('.navitem');if(!b)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  const t=b.dataset.tab;if(!t||t==='home')return;
  archSet.has(t)?archSet.delete(t):archSet.add(t);
  localStorage.setItem('rl-archived',JSON.stringify([...archSet]));
  archApply();
  if(archSet.size)archHead.classList.add('open');
},true);
async function archHash(pw){
  const d=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode(ARCH_SALT+'|'+pw));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(d)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}
archManage.addEventListener('click',async()=>{
  if(archEdit){
    archEdit=false;document.body.classList.remove('archedit');
    archManage.textContent='⚙ 보관 관리';return;
  }
  let ok=sessionStorage.getItem('rl-arch-ok')==='1';
  if(!ok){
    const saved=sessionStorage.getItem('rl-lock-pw');   // Locked 탭에서 이미 입력한 비번 재활용
    if(saved&&(await archHash(saved))===ARCH_HASH)ok=true;
  }
  if(!ok){
    const pw=window.prompt('보관 관리 비밀번호');
    if(pw==null||pw==='')return;
    if((await archHash(pw))!==ARCH_HASH){alert('비밀번호가 올바르지 않습니다.');return;}
    ok=true;
  }
  sessionStorage.setItem('rl-arch-ok','1');
  archEdit=true;document.body.classList.add('archedit');
  archManage.textContent='✓ 보관 관리 종료';
  archHead.classList.add('open');
});
archApply();

/* ── 심층 리서치: data/research.json 렌더 ── */
var drLoaded=false;
async function drLoad(){
  if(drLoaded)return;
  const grid=document.getElementById('drGrid'),meta=document.getElementById('drMeta');
  const escd=s=>String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  try{
    const res=await fetch('data/research.json?t='+Date.now(),{cache:'no-store'});
    const j=await res.json();const items=j.items||[];
    meta.textContent=items.length?`${items.length}건 · 최근 갱신 ${j.updated||'-'} — 카드를 누르면 리포트가 새 창으로 열립니다.`:'아직 게시된 리서치가 없습니다.';
    grid.style.cssText='display:grid;gap:12px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(320px,1fr))';
    grid.innerHTML=items.map(r=>`<a href="research/${encodeURIComponent(r.file)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="display:block;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--txt)"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px">${escd(r.name)} <span style="color:var(--dim);font-size:12px">${escd(r.ticker)}</span></div><div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--gold)">${escd(r.rating)}${r.version?' · '+escd(r.version):''}</div></div><div style="margin-top:7px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.5">${escd(r.call)}</div><div style="margin-top:8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--dim2)">${escd(r.date)}</div></a>`).join('');
    drLoaded=true;
  }catch(e){meta.textContent='research.json 로드 실패: '+e;}
}
