/* ── 홈: 실시간 시세 카드 + 지수 스트립 (5초) ── */
let homeTimer=null;
async function homeTick(){
  const ref=await needRa();
  let hl;try{const r=await fetch('https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({type:'metaAndAssetCtxs',dex:'xyz'})});hl=await r.json();}catch(e){return;}
  const names=hl[0].universe.map(u=>u.name),ctxs=hl[1];
  const C=t=>ctxs[names.indexOf('xyz:'+t)]||{};
  const rate=(ref&&ref.usdt_krw)||null;
  const q=(key,tk)=>{
    const c=C(tk),st=(ref&&ref.stocks&&ref.stocks[key])||{};
    const mark=parseFloat(c.markPx),prev=parseFloat(c.prevDayPx);
    const won=rate?mark*rate:null,chg=mark-prev,pct=prev?chg/prev*100:0,up=chg>=0;
    const prem=(won&&st.price)?(won-st.price)/st.price*100:null;
    const fund=parseFloat(c.funding)*100;
    const oiUsd=parseFloat(c.openInterest)*mark/1e6;
    return `<div class="quote-card"><div class="qhead"><div class="qname">${st.name||tk} <small>${st.code||''}</small></div><div class="badge-live">5초 갱신</div></div>
      <div class="price-row"><div class="qprice num">${won?Math.round(won).toLocaleString('ko-KR'):'—'}<small>원</small></div>
        <div class="qchange num ${up?'up':'down'}">${up?'+':'−'}${Math.abs(chg*(rate||1)).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:0})} (${up?'+':''}${pct.toFixed(2)}%)</div></div>
      <div class="qmeta num">
        <span>김프 <strong class="${prem>=0?'up':'down'}">${prem!=null?(prem>=0?'+':'')+prem.toFixed(2)+'%':'-'}</strong></span>
        <span>펀딩비 <strong>${fund>=0?'+':''}${fund.toFixed(3)}%</strong></span>
        <span>미결제 <strong>$${oiUsd.toFixed(1)}M</strong></span></div></div>`;
  };
  // 지수 실시간 추정(EWY×계수) + 선물
  const ewy=C('EWY'),kr=C('KR200');
  const coef=ref&&ref.kospi_coef;
  const em=parseFloat(ewy.markPx),ep=parseFloat(ewy.prevDayPx);
  const est=coef&&isFinite(em)?em*coef:null,estPct=ep?(em-ep)/ep*100:0;
  const km=parseFloat(kr.markPx),kp=parseFloat(kr.prevDayPx),kPct=kp?(km-kp)/kp*100:0;
  // 코스피·코스닥 지수 카드 (네이버 지수 + 코스피는 EWY 실시간 추정 병기)
  const ic=(key,label,short)=>{
    const ix=(ref&&ref.indices&&ref.indices[key])||{};
    if(ix.value==null)return `<div class="quote-card"><div class="qhead"><div class="qname">${label} <small>${short}</small></div><div class="badge-live">지수</div></div>
      <div class="price-row"><div class="qprice num">—</div></div><div class="qmeta num">지수 로딩…</div></div>`;
    const up=(ix.pct||0)>=0;
    const meta=(key==='KOSPI'&&est)
      ? `<span>실시간 추정 <strong class="${estPct>=0?'up':'down'}">${est.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:2})} (${estPct>=0?'+':''}${estPct.toFixed(2)}%)</strong> <small style="color:var(--faint)">EWY 환산</small></span>`
      : `<span style="color:var(--faint)">네이버 지수 · 장중 5분 갱신</span>`;
    return `<div class="quote-card"><div class="qhead"><div class="qname">${label} <small>${short}</small></div><div class="badge-live">${key==='KOSPI'&&est?'5초 추정':'지수'}</div></div>
      <div class="price-row"><div class="qprice num ${up?'up':'down'}">${ix.value.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2})}</div>
        <div class="qchange num ${up?'up':'down'}">${up?'+':''}${(ix.chg||0).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:2})} (${up?'+':''}${(ix.pct||0).toFixed(2)}%)</div></div>
      <div class="qmeta num">${meta}</div></div>`;
  };
  document.getElementById('homeQuotes').innerHTML=ic('KOSPI','코스피','KOSPI')+ic('KOSDAQ','코스닥','KOSDAQ')+q('SMSN','SMSN')+q('SKHX','SKHX');
  if(!MEM){try{MEM=await getJson('data/memory.json');}catch(e){}}
  let ddr='';
  if(MEM&&MEM.spot&&MEM.spot.dram){const it=MEM.spot.dram.find(i=>i.name.startsWith('DDR5 16Gb'));
    if(it)ddr=`<div class="item"><span class="label">DDR5 16G 스팟</span><span class="value">$${it.avg.toFixed(2)}</span></div>`;}
  const cell=(lb,v,pct)=>`<div class="item"><span class="label">${lb}</span><span class="value">${v}${pct!=null?` <span class="${pct>=0?'up':'down'}">${pct>=0?'+':''}${pct.toFixed(2)}%</span>`:''}</span></div>`;
  document.getElementById('homeStrip').innerHTML=
    (isFinite(km)?cell('코스피200 선물 (KR200)',km.toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:2}),kPct):'')
    +(rate?cell('USDT/KRW',Math.round(rate).toLocaleString('ko-KR'),null):'')
    +ddr;
}
function homeStart(){homeTick();clearInterval(homeTimer);homeTimer=setInterval(()=>{
  if(document.getElementById('tab-home').classList.contains('on'))homeTick();else clearInterval(homeTimer);},5000);}
homeStart();
</script>

<!-- ── 수동 갱신 버튼 (전 탭 공통) — Worker 큐 → 맥 rl_refresh_poll.py가 즉시 실행 ── -->
<div id="rlFab" style="display:none">
  <button id="rrBtn" type="button">↻ 수동 갱신</button>
  <span id="rrStat"></span>
</div>
<style>
#rlFab{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:70;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 8px 6px 14px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);font-size:12px;color:var(--dim2);max-width:min(86vw,460px)}
#rlFab #rrStat{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;order:-1}
#rlFab #rrStat:empty{display:none}
#rrBtn{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--hover);color:var(--text);font:inherit;font-size:12px;
  font-weight:700;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer}
#rrBtn:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
@media(max-width:860px){#rlFab{right:10px;bottom:10px}}
</style>
<script>
/* 갱신 요청은 매번 비밀번호 입력 — 서버(worker.js)가 해시 검증, 저장하지 않는다 */
const RL_API=location.hostname==='research-lab.jwk490.workers.dev'?'':'https://research-lab.jwk490.workers.dev';
const RR_TABS={
  home:{m:'x'},
  raoni:{m:'a',eta:'~1분'}, term:{m:'a',eta:'~1분'}, quote:{m:'a',eta:'~5분'},
  weekly:{m:'x',note:'주간 일정은 텔레그램 취합+웹검증 수동 워크플로우 — Claude 세션에서 갱신'},
  krwrap:{m:'a',eta:'~2분'}, uswrap:{m:'a',eta:'~2분'}, sector:{m:'a',eta:'~3분'}, disparity:{m:'a',eta:'~2분'},
  supply:{m:'a',eta:'~7분'}, streak:{m:'a',eta:'~3분'}, krhigh:{m:'a',eta:'~10분'}, ushigh:{m:'a',eta:'~5분'},
  rs:{m:'a',eta:'~5분'}, semietf:{m:'a',eta:'~2분'}, align:{m:'a',eta:'~15분'},
  caps:{m:'a',eta:'~2분'}, gap:{m:'a',eta:'~2분'}, dd:{m:'a',eta:'~2분'}, ram:{m:'a',eta:'~2분'},
  etfgap:{m:'l'}, basket7:{m:'a',eta:'~5분'}, semiexport:{m:'a',eta:'~2분'},
  export:{m:'a',eta:'~1분 (신규 월 데이터는 엑셀 수동 반입)'}, corpexport:{m:'a',eta:'~3분'},
  trade10:{m:'a',eta:'~3분'}, taiwan:{m:'a',eta:'~3분'}, chem:{m:'a',eta:'~1분'},
  telegram:{m:'a',eta:'~2분'}, taerin:{m:'a',eta:'~2분'}, thememap:{m:'a',eta:'~3분'},
  deepresearch:{m:'x',note:'심층 리서치는 Claude 세션에서 발행합니다'},
  leadflow:{m:'a',eta:'~5분'}, rstime:{m:'a',eta:'~10분'},
  backlog:{m:'a',eta:'수십 분 (DART 전수 재추출)'}, rrgsec:{m:'a',eta:'~7분'}, rrgstk:{m:'a',eta:'~7분'}
};
let rrTab='home',rrKey=null,rrTimer=null;
function rrCfg(t){return RR_TABS[t]||{m:'a',eta:'~수 분'};}
function rrFmt(ts){return new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString('ko-KR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});}
function rrOnTab(tab){rrTab=tab;clearInterval(rrTimer);rrRender(null);}
async function rrCall(path,payload,key){
  const r=await fetch(RL_API+path,{method:payload?'POST':'GET',
    headers:{'X-RL-Key':key,...(payload?{'Content-Type':'application/json'}:{})},
    body:payload?JSON.stringify(payload):undefined});
  if(r.status===401)throw new Error('unauthorized');
  if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);
  return r.json();
}
async function rrClick(){
  const cfg=rrCfg(rrTab);
  if(cfg.m==='l'){alert('이 탭은 실시간 자동 갱신됩니다.');return;}
  if(cfg.m==='x'){alert(cfg.note||'수동 취합 탭입니다.');return;}
  const pw=prompt('갱신 비밀번호 (매번 입력)');
  if(!pw)return;
  try{
    const res=await rrCall('/api/refresh',{tab:rrTab},pw);
    rrKey=pw;rrRender(res.job);rrPoll();
  }catch(e){alert(e.message==='unauthorized'?'비밀번호가 올바르지 않습니다.':'요청 실패: '+e.message);}
}
function rrPoll(){
  clearInterval(rrTimer);
  const tab=rrTab;
  rrTimer=setInterval(async()=>{
    if(rrTab!==tab){clearInterval(rrTimer);return;}
    try{
      const res=await rrCall('/api/refresh/status?tab='+tab,null,rrKey);
      rrRender(res.job);
      if(res.job&&['done','failed','skipped'].includes(res.job.status)){
        clearInterval(rrTimer);
        if(res.job.status==='done')rrDone(tab);
      }
    }catch(e){clearInterval(rrTimer);}
  },6000);
}
function rrDone(tab){
  // git push 후 사이트 재빌드에 ~1분 — 75초 카운트다운 뒤 자동 새로고침
  let left=75;const st=document.getElementById('rrStat');
  const cd=setInterval(()=>{
    if(rrTab!==tab){clearInterval(cd);return;}
    left--;
    st.innerHTML='갱신 완료 — <u style="cursor:pointer" id="rrNow">지금 새로고침</u> ('+left+'초 후 자동)';
    const n=document.getElementById('rrNow');if(n)n.onclick=()=>{clearInterval(cd);rrReload(tab);};
    if(left<=0){clearInterval(cd);rrReload(tab);}
  },1000);
}
function rrReload(tab){
  const panel=document.getElementById('tab-'+tab);
  const f=panel&&panel.querySelector('iframe[data-src]');
  if(f){f.src=f.dataset.src+'?v='+Date.now();rrRender(null);}
  else location.reload();
}
function rrRender(job){
  const cfg=rrCfg(rrTab),box=document.getElementById('rlFab'),
        st=document.getElementById('rrStat'),btn=document.getElementById('rrBtn');
  if(rrTab==='home'){box.style.display='none';return;}
  box.style.display='flex';btn.style.display='';
  if(cfg.m==='l'){btn.style.display='none';st.textContent='실시간 자동 갱신 탭';return;}
  if(cfg.m==='x'){btn.style.display='none';st.textContent='수동 취합 탭';return;}
  if(!job){st.textContent='';return;}
  if(job.status==='queued')st.textContent='대기 중 — 1분 내 시작';
  else if(job.status==='running')st.textContent='갱신 중 '+(cfg.eta||'')+' — '+rrFmt(job.started_at||job.requested_at)+' 시작';
  else if(job.status==='failed'){
    st.innerHTML='<span style="color:var(--down);cursor:pointer" id="rrErr">갱신 실패 — 로그 보기</span>';
    const e2=document.getElementById('rrErr');if(e2)e2.onclick=()=>alert(job.note||'로그 없음');
  }else if(job.status==='skipped')st.textContent='자동 갱신 체인이 없는 탭';
  else if(job.status==='done')st.textContent='갱신 완료 '+rrFmt(job.finished_at)+(job.note?' — '+job.note:'');
}
document.getElementById('rrBtn').addEventListener('click',rrClick);
rrOnTab(location.hash?location.hash.slice(1):'home');
</script>
</body>
</html>

// HTTP Basic Auth in front of the static assets + manual-refresh queue API.
// Basic Auth credentials come from Worker variables (BASIC_USER / BASIC_PASS);
// if they are not configured, access is denied (fail closed).
//
// /api/refresh/* — 수동 갱신 큐 (Basic Auth 대신 자체 키 인증 + CORS)
//   버튼(index.html) → enqueue → 로컬 맥의 rl_refresh_poll.py(1분 cron)가
//   poll/claim → 탭별 갱신 체인 실행 → report. 상태는 Durable Object에 저장.
//   키 = 사이트 보관/Locked 비밀번호(~/.rrg_lock_pass)와 동일. 아래 해시는
//   rrg_publish.py sync_arch_hash()가 비밀번호 변경 시 자동 동기화한다.
const REFRESH_HASH = "«HEX_REDACTED»";
const ALLOWED_ORIGINS = ["https://jwk490-cell.github.io"];

export default {
  async fetch(request, env) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    if (url.pathname === "/api/refresh/ping") {
      return withCors(request, json({ ok: true, t: Date.now() }));
    }
    if (url.pathname.startsWith("/api/refresh")) {
      return handleRefresh(request, env, url);
    }

    const user = env.BASIC_USER;
    const pass = env.BASIC_PASS;

    const auth = request.headers.get("Authorization") || "";
    if (user && pass && auth.startsWith("Basic ")) {
      let decoded = "";
      try {
        decoded = atob(auth.slice(6));
      } catch (_) {
        decoded = "";
      }
      const sep = decoded.indexOf(":");
      const gotUser = sep >= 0 ? decoded.slice(0, sep) : "";
      const gotPass = sep >= 0 ? decoded.slice(sep + 1) : "";
      if (timingSafeEqual(gotUser, user) && timingSafeEqual(gotPass, pass)) {
        return env.ASSETS.fetch(request);
      }
    }

    return new Response("Authentication required", {
      status: 401,
      headers: {
        "WWW-Authenticate": 'Basic realm="Research Lab", charset="UTF-8"',
        "Cache-Control": "no-store",
        // Temporary diagnostic: shows whether env vars are configured (not their values).
        "X-Auth-Config": `user=${user ? "set" : "missing"}; pass=${pass ? "set" : "missing"}`,
      },
    });
  },
};

// ─── 수동 갱신 큐 ───
async function handleRefresh(request, env, url) {
  if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: corsHeaders(request) });
  }
  const key = request.headers.get("X-RL-Key") || "";
  const h = await sha256hex("rl-refresh-v1|" + key);
  if (!timingSafeEqual(h, REFRESH_HASH)) {
    return withCors(request, json({ error: "unauthorized" }, 401));
  }
  // POST /api/refresh → enqueue, 그 외 /api/refresh/<action>
  const act = url.pathname.replace(/^\/api\/refresh\/?/, "") || "enqueue";
  const stub = env.REFRESH.get(env.REFRESH.idFromName("queue"));
  const resp = await stub.fetch(new Request("https://do/" + act + url.search, request));
  return withCors(request, resp);
}

export class RefreshQueue {
  constructor(state) {
    this.storage = state.storage;
  }
  async fetch(request) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const act = url.pathname.slice(1);
    const now = Date.now();
    const jobs = (await this.storage.get("jobs")) || {};
    for (const [id, j] of Object.entries(jobs)) {
      if (now - j.requested_at > 3 * 864e5) delete jobs[id]; // 3일 지난 기록 정리
    }
    const save = () => this.storage.put("jobs", jobs);

    if (act === "enqueue" && request.method === "POST") {
      let body = {};
      try { body = await request.json(); } catch (_) {}
      const tab = String(body.tab || "");
      if (!/^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/.test(tab)) return json({ error: "bad tab" }, 400);
      // 같은 탭이 이미 대기/실행 중이면 새로 쌓지 않는다 (running은 2시간 지나면 유령으로 보고 무시)
      const dup = Object.values(jobs).find(
        (j) => j.tab === tab &&
          (j.status === "queued" || (j.status === "running" && now - j.requested_at < 2 * 36e5))
      );
      if (dup) { await save(); return json({ job: dup, dedup: true }); }
      const job = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), tab, status: "queued", requested_at: now };
      jobs[job.id] = job;
      await save();
      return json({ job });
    }
    if (act === "status") {
      const tab = url.searchParams.get("tab") || "";
      const list = Object.values(jobs)
        .filter((j) => j.tab === tab)
        .sort((a, b) => b.requested_at - a.requested_at);
      await save();
      return json({ job: list[0] || null });
    }
    if (act === "poll") {
      const q = Object.values(jobs)
        .filter((j) => j.status === "queued")
        .sort((a, b) => a.requested_at - b.requested_at);
      await save();
      return json({ job: q[0] || null, queued: q.length });
    }
    if (act === "claim" && request.method === "POST") {
      const { id } = await request.json();
      const j = jobs[id];
      if (!j) return json({ error: "no job" }, 404);
      if (j.status !== "queued") return json({ error: "not queued", job: j }, 409);
      j.status = "running";
      j.started_at = now;
      await save();
      return json({ job: j });
    }
    if (act === "report" && request.method === "POST") {
      const { id, status, note } = await request.json();
      const j = jobs[id];
      if (!j) return json({ error: "no job" }, 404);
      j.status = ["done", "failed", "skipped"].includes(status) ? status : "failed";
      j.note = String(note || "").slice(0, 2000);
      j.finished_at = now;
      await save();
      return json({ job: j });
    }
    return json({ error: "unknown action" }, 404);
  }
}

function json(obj, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(obj), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" },
  });
}

function corsHeaders(request) {
  const origin = request.headers.get("Origin") || "";
  const self = new URL(request.url).origin;
  const h = {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,OPTIONS",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,X-RL-Key",
    "Access-Control-Max-Age": "86400",
  };
  if (origin === self || ALLOWED_ORIGINS.includes(origin)) {
    h["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = origin;
  }
  return h;
}

function withCors(request, resp) {
  const r = new Response(resp.body, resp);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(corsHeaders(request))) r.headers.set(k, v);
  r.headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
  return r;
}

async function sha256hex(s) {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(s));
  return [...new Uint8Array(buf)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

function timingSafeEqual(a, b) {
  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const ab = enc.encode(a);
  const bb = enc.encode(b);
  if (ab.length !== bb.length) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < ab.length; i++) diff |= ab[i] ^ bb[i];
  return diff === 0;
}

/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Research Lab — 공통 테마 (Claude Design 다크(항상 다크))
   모든 세부 페이지에 주입되어 ① Pretendard 통일 ② 본문 13px
   ③ 딥 잉크 다크 팔레트(허브 셸과 동일) ④ 둥근 모서리(13px)를 강제한다.
   주입: <html class="ht-supply|ht-sector|ht-disp|ht-osc|ht-export|ht-semietf">
        + </head> 직전 <link rel="stylesheet" href="hub-theme.css">
   (publish.ps1 / daily_close.py 가 자동 처리)
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@import url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/orioncactus/pretendard@v1.3.9/dist/web/variable/pretendardvariable.css');

/* ── 다크 팔레트: 페이지들이 쓰는 CSS 변수 전부 덮어쓰기 ── */
:root{
  --bg:#101014; --panel:#1a1b20; --panel2:#202128; --line:#272930;
  --txt:#e9ebee; --dim:#9aa2ad; --dim2:#6d7480;
  --up:#22c55e; --down:#ef4444; --dn:#ef4444;
  --accent:#4d7df5; --kospi:#5a9bd8; --kosdaq:#c879e6; --warn:#e0a030;
  --card:#1a1b20; --border:#272930; --border2:#31343d; --text:#e9ebee;
  --ink:#e9ebee; --sub:#9aa2ad;
  --gold:#4d7df5; --teal:#2dd4bf; --red:#ef4444; --green:#22c55e;
  --blue:#5a9bd8; --purple:#b08ad6;
  --tx:#e9ebee; --bar:#3d566e; --yoy:#e0a457; --mom:#56b4c8; --mma:#b08ad6;
}
/* 수출 대시보드는 상승=빨강 / 하락=파랑 (한국 관례) */
html.ht-export{--up:#ef4444; --dn:#5a9bd8}

/* ── 폰트: 모든 폰트 Pretendard 강제 (literally all) ── */
*,*::before,*::after{
  font-family:"Pretendard Variable",Pretendard,"Malgun Gothic","맑은 고딕",
    "Segoe UI",-apple-system,sans-serif !important;
}
body{font-size:13px;background:#101014}

/* ── 둥근 모서리 통일 ── */
.card,.section,.stat-card,.mcard,.dcard,.formula,.stock-list,.stock-info-box,
.note,.kv,.search,#search,.group,.empty{border-radius:13px}

/* ════════ 수급 대시보드 (ht-supply) ════════ */
.ht-supply body{font-size:13px}
.ht-supply .sub{font-size:13px}
.ht-supply .sub b{color:#c6ccd4}
.ht-supply .legend{font-size:12px}
.ht-supply .tab{font-size:13.5px}
.ht-supply .tab.on{color:var(--gold);border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}
.ht-supply .btn{font-size:12.5px}
.ht-supply .btn.on{background:var(--gold);color:#1a1b20;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(77,125,245,.3)}
.ht-supply .glabel{font-size:11.5px}
.ht-supply .card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1a1b20,#17181d)}
.ht-supply .card h3{font-size:13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.ht-supply th{font-size:11px}
.ht-supply td{font-size:12.5px;border-bottom:1px solid #232530}

.ht-supply .nm .code{font-size:10.5px}
.ht-supply .slnk:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.ht-supply .net{color:#c6ccd4}
.ht-supply .badge{font-size:10.5px;color:#4d7df5;background:rgba(77,125,245,.12);border-color:rgba(77,125,245,.3)}
.ht-supply .badge.sell{color:#f0a3a5;background:rgba(239,68,68,.1);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.3)}
.ht-supply .badge.comm{color:#c9b3ee;background:rgba(176,138,214,.14);border-color:rgba(176,138,214,.32)}
.ht-supply .commchip{background:rgba(176,138,214,.1);border-color:rgba(176,138,214,.32);color:#d9c8f2}

/* ════════ 산업별 등락 (ht-sector) ════════ */
.ht-sector h3{color:var(--text);font-size:15px}

.ht-sector .stock-info-box .pill{background:#232530;color:#c6ccd4}
.ht-sector .section a{color:#e9ebee !important}
.ht-sector .stock-info-box a{color:var(--gold) !important}
.ht-sector tr.stock-row.open td:first-child{border-left-color:var(--gold)}
.ht-sector tr.stock-info td{border-bottom:1px solid #232530 !important}
.ht-sector footer{font-size:12px}

/* ════════ 50일 이격도 (ht-disp) ════════ */
.ht-disp .sub{font-size:13px}
.ht-disp .meta{font-size:12.5px}
.ht-disp .formula{font-size:13px}
.ht-disp .legend{font-size:12px}
.ht-disp .foot{font-size:12px}

/* ════════ 반도체 ETF 수혜 (ht-semietf) — 44종 테이블 레이아웃 ════════ */
html.ht-semietf{--red:#ef4444;--blue:#5a9bd8;--mut:#9aa2ad;--acc:#4d7df5;
  --ink:#e9ebee;--line:#272930;--bg:#101014}
.ht-semietf body{font-size:13px}
.ht-semietf .sub{font-size:13px}
.ht-semietf table{background:#1a1b20;border-color:#272930}
.ht-semietf th{background:#202128;color:#9aa2ad;font-size:11.5px}
.ht-semietf td{border-top:1px solid #232530;font-size:12.5px}
.ht-semietf tr:hover td{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
/* 상위10 하이라이트 — 라이트 크림(#fffdf5) 대신 액센트 틴트 */
.ht-semietf tr.t10 td{background:rgba(77,125,245,.09) !important}
.ht-semietf tr.t10:hover td{background:rgba(77,125,245,.15) !important}
.ht-semietf tr[style*="fffdf5"]{background:rgba(77,125,245,.09) !important}
.ht-semietf .btn{background:#1a1b20;border-color:#272930;color:#9aa2ad}
.ht-semietf .btn:hover{color:#e9ebee}
.ht-semietf .btn.on{background:#4d7df5;color:#1a1b20;border-color:#4d7df5}
.ht-semietf .chip{background:#232530;color:#c6ccd4}
.ht-semietf .note{background:#1a1b20;border-color:#272930;color:#9aa2ad;font-size:12.5px}
.ht-semietf .rk{color:#6d7480}
.ht-semietf #stkt th{background:#202128}

/* ════════ 수출 데이터 (ht-export) ════════ */
.ht-export body{font-size:13px}
.ht-export .nav.on{background:rgba(77,125,245,.14)}
.ht-export .nav.fix{background:var(--panel2)}
.ht-export .nav.fix.on{background:rgba(77,125,245,.14)}
.ht-export .rng button.on{background:rgba(77,125,245,.14);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.ht-export .ctt{background:rgba(18,22,31,.97)}
.ht-export .badge.imp{color:var(--gold);border-color:rgba(77,125,245,.4)}
.ht-export .axr{fill:#a98a5a}

/* ════════ 주간 일정 (ht-weekly) — Excel 라이트 → 딥 잉크 다크 ════════ */
html.ht-weekly{
  --bg:#101014; --bg-soft:#17181d; --bg-soft-2:#1a1b20;
  --bg-header:#202128;
  --bg-today:rgba(224,160,48,.13); --bg-today-strong:rgba(224,160,48,.4);

#!/bin/bash
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Joy and July Research Hub — 일일 배포 스크립트 (publish.ps1 맥 포팅)
#   최신 대시보드 HTML을 site/ 로 복사하면서 공통 테마(hub-theme.css)를
#   주입하고 git push 한다.  사용:  bash publish.sh  [--no-push]
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
set -u
SITE="$HOME/수급html/site"
SRC="$HOME/수급html"
SECTOR="$HOME/sector-report"
NO_PUSH=0
[ "${1:-}" = "--no-push" ] && NO_PUSH=1

publish_one() {  # $1=원본경로 $2=타겟명 $3=주입클래스
    local src="$1" target="$2" cls="$3"
    if [ -z "$src" ] || [ ! -f "$src" ]; then
        echo "  skip  $target (원본 없음)"; return
    fi
    /usr/bin/python3 - "$src" "$SITE/$target" "$cls" <<'PYEOF'
import sys
src, dst, cls = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
html = open(src, encoding="utf-8").read()
if "hub-theme.css" not in html:
    html = html.replace('<html lang="ko">', f'<html lang="ko" class="{cls}">', 1)
    html = html.replace('</head>', '<link rel="stylesheet" href="hub-theme.css"></head>', 1)
open(dst, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(html)
PYEOF
    echo "  done  $target  <-  $(basename "$src")"
}

newest() {  # $1=글롭 패턴 (SRC 기준) — 최신 수정본 1개
    ls -t "$SRC"/$1 2>/dev/null | head -1
}

echo "=== 최신 원본 탐색 ==="
EXPORT=$(newest "주요품목 수출 대시보드*.html")
SEMIETF=$(newest "반도체ETF_수혜_*.html")

echo "=== 배포 ==="
publish_one "$SRC/index.html"                  "supply.html"     "ht-supply"
publish_one "$SECTOR/sector-report.html"       "sector.html"     "ht-sector"
publish_one "$EXPORT"                          "export.html"     "ht-export"
publish_one "$SRC/이격도.html"                 "disparity.html"  "ht-disp"
publish_one "$SEMIETF"                         "semietf.html"    "ht-semietf"
publish_one "$SRC/trade_corp/기업수출.html"    "corpexport.html" "ht-corpexport"
publish_one "$SRC/trade10/수출입_잠정치.html"  "trade10.html"    "ht-trade10"

if [ "$NO_PUSH" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ -n "$(git -C "$SITE" status --porcelain)" ]; then
        git -C "$SITE" add -A
        git -C "$SITE" commit -m "daily publish $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')"
        git -C "$SITE" push
        echo "=== push 완료 ==="
    else
        echo "=== 변경 없음 — push 생략 ==="
    fi
fi
publish.ps1Joy and July Research Hub — 일일 배포 스크립트50줄 · 2KB · 2026-07-27
﻿# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Joy and July Research Hub — 일일 배포 스크립트
#   최신 대시보드 HTML을 site/ 로 복사하면서 공통 테마(hub-theme.css)를
#   주입하고 git push 한다.  사용:  powershell -File publish.ps1  [-NoPush]
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
param([switch]$NoPush)

$site = "C:\Users\smily\.claude\수급 html\site"
$src  = "C:\Users\smily\.claude\수급 html"

function Publish-One($sourcePath, $target, $class) {
    if (-not $sourcePath -or -not (Test-Path $sourcePath)) {
        Write-Host "  skip  $target (원본 없음)"; return
    }
    $html = Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 $sourcePath
    if ($html -notmatch 'hub-theme\.css') {
        $html = $html -replace '<html lang="ko">', ('<html lang="ko" class="' + $class + '">')
        $html = $html.Replace('</head>', '<link rel="stylesheet" href="hub-theme.css"></head>')
    }
    Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $site $target) -Value $html -Encoding UTF8
    Write-Host "  done  $target  <-  $(Split-Path $sourcePath -Leaf)"
}

Write-Host "=== 최신 원본 탐색 ==="
$export = Get-ChildItem $src -Filter "주요품목 수출 대시보드*.html" -File |
          Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
$semietf = Get-ChildItem $src -Filter "반도체ETF_수혜_*.html" -File |
           Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1

Write-Host "=== 배포 ==="
Publish-One "$src\index.html"                                       "supply.html"     "ht-supply"
Publish-One "C:\Users\smily\.claude\sector-report\sector-report.html" "sector.html"   "ht-sector"
Publish-One $export.FullName                                        "export.html"     "ht-export"
Publish-One "$src\이격도.html"                                       "disparity.html"  "ht-disp"
Publish-One $semietf.FullName                                       "semietf.html"    "ht-semietf"
Publish-One "$src\trade_corp\기업수출.html"                          "corpexport.html" "ht-corpexport"
Publish-One "$src\trade10\수출입_잠정치.html"                        "trade10.html"    "ht-trade10"

if (-not $NoPush) {
    $st = git -C $site status --porcelain
    if ($st) {
        git -C $site add -A
        git -C $site commit -m ("daily publish " + (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"))
        git -C $site push
        Write-Host "=== push 완료 ==="
    } else {
        Write-Host "=== 변경 없음 — push 생략 ==="
    }
}

  }
